id: Pisau ini dibuat oleh pandai pedang Sorgel, yang aktif ikut serta dalam perang melawan dewa-dewa. Pedang karya Sorgel terkenal seimbang sempurna antara keras dan tajam, konstruksinya awet. Dari semua karyanya, Pedang Beken adalah yang paling terkenal, katanya Kaisar Agni pun ingin memilikinya.
name: MST_SPHERES_30000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This blade was made by the swordsmith Sorgel, who played an active part in the war against gods. Swords by Sorgel were known for their excellent balance between hardness and sharpness, as well as their durable construction. Among all of his works, the Famous Blade is the most well-known, it's said that even the Emperor of the Agni Empire longed to have it be his.

raw.en: This blade was made by the swordsmith Sorgel, who played an active part in the war against gods. Swords by Sorgel were known for their excellent balance between hardness and sharpness, as well as their durable construction. Among all of his works, the Famous Blade is the most well-known, it's said that even the Emperor of the Agni Empire longed to have it be his.
raw.es: Esta hoja es obra del famoso herrero Sorgel, quien desempeñó un papel muy activo en la guerra contra los dioses. Las espadas de Sorgel eran famosas por su resistencia y durabilidad, además de por su preciso manejo. De entre todas las armas que salieron de su forja, esta es la más conocida. Cuentan que el propio emperador de Agní anhelaba obtenerla.
raw.id: Pisau ini dibuat oleh pandai pedang Sorgel, yang aktif ikut serta dalam perang melawan dewa-dewa. Pedang karya Sorgel terkenal seimbang sempurna antara keras dan tajam, konstruksinya awet. Dari semua karyanya, Pedang Beken adalah yang paling terkenal, katanya Kaisar Agni pun ingin memilikinya.
raw.pt: Esta lâmina foi feita pelo ferreiro Sorgel, que foi parte ativa na guerra contra os deuses. Espadas feitas por Sorgel eram conhecidas pelo equilíbrio excelente entre dureza e afiação, além de uma contrução durável. Entre todos os trabalhos dele, o mais conhecido é o da Lâmina Famosa. Dizem que até o imperador do Império Agni queria essa lâmina para si.
raw.th: ดาบเล่มนี้นี้ถูกสร้างขึ้นโดยนักตีดาบที่ชื่อว่า ซอร์เจล ผู้เล่นมีส่วนร่วมในการทำสงครามกับเหล่าทวยเทพ ดาบของซอร์เจลเป็นที่รู้จักกันในเรื่องความสมดุลที่ยอดเยี่ยม ระหว่างความแข็งและความคมเช่นเดียวกับความแข็งแรงทนทาน ในทุกผลงานของเขา 'ดาบลือชื่อ' นั้นที่มีชื่อเสียงเป็นที่รู้จักมากที่สุด กล่าวได้ว่าแม้แต่จักรพรรดิแห่งจักรวรรดิแอคนียังอยากมีมันไว้ในครอบครอง
raw.vi: Thanh kiếm này được rèn bởi thợ rèn kiếm Sorgel, người đóng vai trò rất thiết thục trong cuộc chiến chống lại các vị thần. Những thanh kiếm rèn dưới bàn tay của Sorgel được biết đến bởi khả năng cân bằng tuyệt vời giữa độ cứng và độ sắc bén, cùng với kết cấu bền vững. Trong số tất cả các thanh kiếm do Sorgel rèn ra thì Thanh kiếm Trứ danh là thanh nổi tiếng nhất, đến mức thiên hạ thường đồn đại rằng ngay cả Hoàng đế của Đế chế Agni cũng ao ước sở hữu thanh kiếm này.

id: Pedang lain buatan pandai pedang Sorgel, yang aktif ikut serta dalam perang melawan dewa-dewa. Pedang Suci katanya dibuat memakai teknik Sorgel yang paling canggih, jadi punya kekuatan yang cukup murni untuk menghancurkan kejahatan. Ironisnya, banyak ksatria berpedang yang memperebutkannya akibat reputasi ini, akhirnya Sorgel menyegel Pedang Suci untuk mencegah perang perebutan pedang.
name: MST_SPHERES_30001_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Another sword made by the swordsmith Sorgel, who played an active part in the war against gods. The Holy Blade is said to have been crafted using the Sorgel's most refined techniques, therefore it was said to possess a power pure enough to vanquish evil. However, ironically many swordsmen fought over it due to its reputation, and in the end, Sorgel sealed the Holy Blade to prevent a war over it.

raw.en: Another sword made by the swordsmith Sorgel, who played an active part in the war against gods. The Holy Blade is said to have been crafted using the Sorgel's most refined techniques, therefore it was said to possess a power pure enough to vanquish evil. However, ironically many swordsmen fought over it due to its reputation, and in the end, Sorgel sealed the Holy Blade to prevent a war over it.
raw.es: Otra de las obras del herrero Sorgel, quien desempeñó un papel muy activo en la guerra contra los dioses. Cuentan que, gracias a las refinadas técnicas que Sorgel usó para forjar la hoja sacra, el arma quedó imbuida de un poder tan puro que la hacía capaz de derrotar al mal. La ironía quiso que su fama la convirtiera en motivo de disputa entre muchos espadachines. Para no provocar una guerra, Sorgel decidió guardarla bajo llave.
raw.id: Pedang lain buatan pandai pedang Sorgel, yang aktif ikut serta dalam perang melawan dewa-dewa. Pedang Suci katanya dibuat memakai teknik Sorgel yang paling canggih, jadi punya kekuatan yang cukup murni untuk menghancurkan kejahatan. Ironisnya, banyak ksatria berpedang yang memperebutkannya akibat reputasi ini, akhirnya Sorgel menyegel Pedang Suci untuk mencegah perang perebutan pedang.
raw.pt: Outra espada feita pelo ferreiro Sorgel, que foi parte ativa na guerra contra os deuses. Dizem que a Lâmina Sagrada foi feita com as técnicas mais refinadas de Sorgel, portanto acredita-se que tenha um poder puro o suficiente para vencer o mal. No entanto, ironicamente, muitos espadachins brigaram por ela devido à reputação e, no fim das contas, Sorgel lacrou a Lâmina Sagrada para evitar uma guerra por ela.
raw.th: ดาบเล่มนี้นี้ถูกสร้างขึ้นโดยนักตีดาบที่ชื่อว่า ซอร์เจล ผู้เล่นมีส่วนร่วมในการทำสงครามกับเหล่าทวยเทพ ได้กล่าวเอาไว้ว่า 'ดาบโฮลี่' ถูกสร้างขึ้นโดยใช้เทคนิคการทำให้บริสุทธิ์ขั้นสุดยอดของ ซอร์เจล จึงกล่าวได้ว่ามันมีพลังอันบริสุทธิ์มากพอที่จะกำราบความชั่วร้าย แต่กระนั้นพวกนักดาบกลับต่อสู้กันเองเพื่อแย่งชิงดาบ และในที่สุดซอร์เจลก็ปิดผนึกโฮลี่เบลดเพื่อป้องกันไม่ให้เกินสงครามมากไปกว่านั้น
raw.vi: Một thanh kiếm khác được chế tạo bởi bậc thầy Sorgel, người đóng vai trò rất thiết thực trong cuộc chiến chống lại các vị thần. Người ta đồn rằng Thanh gươm Thánh đã được Sorgel chế tác bằng những kỹ nghệ tinh túy nhất, do đó mà thanh kiếm này sở hữu sức mạnh thuần khiết có khả năng chế ngự quỷ dữ. Tuy nhiên, trớ trêu thay chính danh tiếng lẫy lừng này đã làm nảy sinh tranh cãi trong giới thợ rèn kiếm, và sau cùng, Sorgel đã niêm phong Thanh gươm Thánh để tránh gây thêm xung đột.

id: Sorgel, pandai pedang terkenal, telah membuat banyak sekali pedang birilian, tetapi tidak ada yang bisa melindungi keluarganya saat diserang dewa-dewa. Penderitaan dan kemarahannya terhadap para dewa telah membuatnya melahirkan pedang bersihir membunuh dewa. Pisau Beast terkutuk mengeluarkan aura es yang dapat mengirim bahkan dewa yang paling kuat ke dunia lain.
name: MST_SPHERES_30002_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Sorgel, the famed swordsmith, had forged countless brilliant swords, but none of them could protect his family when the gods attacked. His misery and fury towards the gods led to the birth of a god-slaying magic sword. The cursed Beast Blade exudes an icy aura that can send even the most powerful of gods to the netherworld.

raw.en: Sorgel, the famed swordsmith, had forged countless brilliant swords, but none of them could protect his family when the gods attacked. His misery and fury towards the gods led to the birth of a god-slaying magic sword. The cursed Beast Blade exudes an icy aura that can send even the most powerful of gods to the netherworld.
raw.es: El reputado herrero Sorgel forjó un sinnúmero de armas en su vida, pero ninguna de ellas sirvió para proteger a su familia cuando los dioses atacaron. De su desdicha y de su ira hacia los dioses nació esta hoja mágica capaz de aniquilar deidades. La hoja bestial está maldita y refulge con una gélida aura capaz de enviar al más poderoso de los dioses en un viaje sin retorno al inframundo.
raw.id: Sorgel, pandai pedang terkenal, telah membuat banyak sekali pedang birilian, tetapi tidak ada yang bisa melindungi keluarganya saat diserang dewa-dewa. Penderitaan dan kemarahannya terhadap para dewa telah membuatnya melahirkan pedang bersihir membunuh dewa. Pisau Beast terkutuk mengeluarkan aura es yang dapat mengirim bahkan dewa yang paling kuat ke dunia lain.
raw.pt: Sorgel, o famoso ferreiro, havia forjado muitas espadas incríveis, mas nenhuma foi capaz de proteger a própria família dele quando os deuses atacaram. O sofrimento e a fúria dele com os deuses levou ao nascimento de uma espada mágica assassina de deuses. A Lâmina da Besta amaldiçoada gera uma aura de gelo que pode mandar até os deuses mais poderosos para o submundo.
raw.th: ซอร์เจล นักตีดาบผู้มีชื่อเสียงได้หลอมดาบที่ยอดเยี่ยมแทบนับไม่ถ้วน แต่ไม่มีดาบเล่มใดสามารถจะปกป้องครอบครัวของเขาได้เมื่อเหล่าเทพเจ้าโจมตี ความทุกข์และความโกรธแค้นของเขาที่มีต่อเหล่าทวยเทพ นำไปสู่การกำเนิดของดาบวิเศษที่ใช้สังหารเทพเจ้า ดาบปีศาจ 'ดาบสมิง' มีออร่าน้ำแข็งไหลซึมออกมาที่สามารถส่งเทพเจ้าผู้แข็งแกร่งที่สุดลงไปสู่ยมโลก
raw.vi: Sorgel, bậc thầy rèn kiếm đã rèn ra không biết bao nhiêu thanh kiếm lẫy lừng, nhưng không thanh kiếm nào trong số đó có thể bảo vệ gia đình ông khi các vị thần bắt đầu chiến sự. Nỗi bất hạnh và cơn thịnh nộ của ông đối với các vị thần đã dẫn đến sự ra đời của thanh kiếm ma thuật sát thần. Thanh Quái vật bị nguyền rủa tỏa ra ánh hào quang băng giá có thể đày vị thần quyền năng nhất xuống địa  ngục.

id: Tameng standar yang dipakai tentara ras Titan. Dipaskan untuk Titan, ukuran dan berat yang luar biasa. Manusia biasa tidak mampu mengangkatnya, tameng tabel ini katanya bisa memblokir serangan kuat dari Titan dan terbukti adalah ases berharga di medan perang jika bisa memegangnya. Riwayat tentang Tameng Raksasa ada di arsip sejarah ras Titan.
name: MST_SPHERES_30100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A standard shield used by soldiers of the Titan race. Tailored for the Titans, the size and weight of it is extraordinary. Though normal humans aren't able to hold it, its thick armor is said to be able to block even powerful attacks from the Titans, and would prove to be a valuable asset on the battlefield if only one could actually wield it. Records of the Giant Shield can be found in the historical archives of the Titan race.

raw.en: A standard shield used by soldiers of the Titan race. Tailored for the Titans, the size and weight of it is extraordinary. Though normal humans aren't able to hold it, its thick armor is said to be able to block even powerful attacks from the Titans, and would prove to be a valuable asset on the battlefield if only one could actually wield it. Records of the Giant Shield can be found in the historical archives of the Titan race.
raw.es: Un escudo estándar fabricado a la medida para los titanes soldados con un tamaño y peso verdaderamente formidables. De su fuerte blindaje se dice que es capaz de resistir el más potente de los ataques titanes. Es una lástima que un ser humano normal no pueda con esta mole, pues le resultaría de gran utilidad en combate. Este escudo aparece mencionado en los archivos históricos de los titanes.
raw.id: Tameng standar yang dipakai tentara ras Titan. Dipaskan untuk Titan, ukuran dan berat yang luar biasa. Manusia biasa tidak mampu mengangkatnya, tameng tabel ini katanya bisa memblokir serangan kuat dari Titan dan terbukti adalah ases berharga di medan perang jika bisa memegangnya. Riwayat tentang Tameng Raksasa ada di arsip sejarah ras Titan.
raw.pt: Um escudo comum usado por soldados da raça Titã. Feito pelos Titãs, o tamanho deste escudo é incrível. Embora humanos normais não consigam segurá-la, dizem que sua blindagem grossa consegue bloquear até os ataques poderosos de Titãs e seria um ótimo recurso na batalha, caso consiga levantá-lo. Registros do Escudo Gigante podem ser encontrados nos arquivos históricos da raça Tita.
raw.th: โล่มาตรฐานที่ใช้โดยทหารของเหล่าไททัน มันถูกสร้างมาเพื่อไททันโดยขนาดและน้ำหนักของมันพิเศษกว่าธรรมดาทั่วไป แม้ว่ามนุษย์ปกติจะไม่สามารถจะถือมันได้ แต่เกราะที่หนาของมันสามารถป้องกันการโจมตีที่รุนแรงจากไททัน และพิสูจน์ว่ามันมีคุณค่ามากในสนามรบ ถ้ามีเพียงใครสักคนถือมันได้จริงๆ ประวัติของ 'โล่ยักษ์' สามารถพบได้ในเอกสารทางประวัติศาสตร์ของเผ่าพันธุ์ไททัน
raw.vi: Loại khiên mà các chiến binh của tộc Người Khổng lồ sử dụng. Được chế tác riêng cho những Người khổng lồ, nên kích cỡ và trọng lượng của tấm khiên này vô cùng khác thường. Mặc dù người thường không thể cầm được nhưng lớp vỏ thép rất dày của tấm khiên lại có khả năng phòng thủ lại những đòn tấn công uy lực nhất từ những Người khổng lồ, và được minh chứng là tài sản giá trị nhất trên chiến trường khi một chiến binh thực sự có thể chế ngự tấm khiên này. Những ghi chép về tấm khiên Giant Shield vẫn còn trong kho lưu trữ lịch sử của tộc Người khổng lồ.

id: Tameng yang dipakai oleh Ksatria Naga Balgeos. Katanya dibuat dari sisik naga yang diberikan kepada Balgeos sebagai hadiah persahabatan saat ia bertemu naga. Tameng ini memiliki kekuatan pertahanan naga dan kemungkinan tidak akan terkena cacat sedikit pun saat terkena pedang biasa. Setelah Balgeos mati, Segel Naga dipasang di Istana Ksatria Kerajaan Sama.
name: MST_SPHERES_30101_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A shield used by the Dragon Knight Balgeos. It's said to be crafted from a dragon scale that was given to Balgeos as a token of friendship when he met a dragon. The shield possesses the defensive strength of a dragon and likely wouldn't suffer even a scratch from the slash of a regular sword. After Balgeos died, the Dragon Seal was put up in the Sama Kingdom Knight's Court.

raw.en: A shield used by the Dragon Knight Balgeos. It's said to be crafted from a dragon scale that was given to Balgeos as a token of friendship when he met a dragon. The shield possesses the defensive strength of a dragon and likely wouldn't suffer even a scratch from the slash of a regular sword. After Balgeos died, the Dragon Seal was put up in the Sama Kingdom Knight's Court.
raw.es: El escudo que usaba el caballero dragón Balgeos. Se dice que está fabricado a partir de la escama que un dragón entregó a Balgeos como muestra de amistad cuando se conocieron. Este escudo cuenta con la fuerza defensiva de aquel dragón y es tan resistente que una espada normal no lo raasguñaría. A la muerte de Balgeos, el escudo se entregó a la Orden de Caballeros del reino de Sama.
raw.id: Tameng yang dipakai oleh Ksatria Naga Balgeos. Katanya dibuat dari sisik naga yang diberikan kepada Balgeos sebagai hadiah persahabatan saat ia bertemu naga. Tameng ini memiliki kekuatan pertahanan naga dan kemungkinan tidak akan terkena cacat sedikit pun saat terkena pedang biasa. Setelah Balgeos mati, Segel Naga dipasang di Istana Ksatria Kerajaan Sama.
raw.pt: Um escudo usado pelo Cavaleiro Dragão Balgeos. Dizem que é feito de uma escama de dragão que foi dada a Balgeos como símbolo da amizade quando conheceu um dragão. O escudo tem a força defensiva de um dragão e provavelmente não será nem arranhado com o golpe de uma espada comum. Depois da morte de Balgeos, o Selo do Dragão foi colocado na Corte dos Cavaleiros do Reino de Sama.
raw.th: โล่ที่ใช้โดยอัศวินมังกร บัลกีโอส กล่าวกันว่ามันสร้างขึ้นจากเกล็ดมังกรที่ บัลกีโอสได้รับมาแทนสัญลักษณ์ของมิตรภาพเมื่อเขาได้พบกับมังกร โล่มีความแข็งแรงต้านทานต่อมังกร และป้องกันไม่ให้ได้รับแม้แต่รอยขีดข่วนจากการเฉือนของดาบปกติ หลังจากบัลกีโอสตาย 'ดราก้อนซีล' ก็ถูกนำไปในสถาของอัศวินที่ราชอาณาจักรซามะ
raw.vi: Tấm khiên này do Kỵ sĩ rồng Balgeos sử dụng. Người ta đồn rằng tấm khiên được chế tác từ chiếc vảy rồng mà Balgeos được tặng khi gặp một con rồng như là minh chứng cho tình bằng hữu. Tấm khiên sở hữu sức mạnh phòng thủ của rồng và gần như không bị trày xước ngay cả khi bị chém bởi một thanh kiếm lão luyện. Sau khi Balgeos qua đời, tấm khiên Dấu ấn của Rồng đã được đưa ra trước Tòa Kỵ sỹ của Vương quốc Sama.

id: Tameng legendaris, katanya dibuat oleh Rau Reik, pandai pedang biasa, setelah berbicara dengan dewi dalam perjalanannya. Siapa yang memakai tameng ini akan menerima proteksi sang dewi, dan tidak akan menderita luka panah di medan perang. Tameng memilih pemiliknya, dan siapa yang tidak diakui sang dewi, tidak akan pernah bisa menjamahnya, walau dicoba dengan cara apa pun.
name: MST_SPHERES_30102_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A legendary shield said to have been crafted by Rau Reik, a simple swordsmith, upon speaking with a goddess during his travels. It's said that those who use the shield receive protection from the goddess, and never suffer arrow wounds on the battlefield. Legends also say that the shield picks its owner, and those who have not gained the recognition of the goddess can never lay their hands on it no matter how hard they try.

raw.en: A legendary shield said to have been crafted by Rau Reik, a simple swordsmith, upon speaking with a goddess during his travels. It's said that those who use the shield receive protection from the goddess, and never suffer arrow wounds on the battlefield. Legends also say that the shield picks its owner, and those who have not gained the recognition of the goddess can never lay their hands on it no matter how hard they try.
raw.es: Un legendario escudo atribuido a Rau Reik, un sencillo herrero que tuvo la oportunidad de hablar con una diosa durante uno de sus viajes. Cuentan que la diosa protege a quienes usan este escudo y evita que sufran heridas de flecha en combate. La leyenda del escudo afirma que este escoge a su portador. Así, aquellos que no se hayan ganado el reconocimiento de la diosa, jamás podrán usarlo por mucho que lo intenten.
raw.id: Tameng legendaris, katanya dibuat oleh Rau Reik, pandai pedang biasa, setelah berbicara dengan dewi dalam perjalanannya. Siapa yang memakai tameng ini akan menerima proteksi sang dewi, dan tidak akan menderita luka panah di medan perang. Tameng memilih pemiliknya, dan siapa yang tidak diakui sang dewi, tidak akan pernah bisa menjamahnya, walau dicoba dengan cara apa pun.
raw.pt: Um escudo lendário que dizem ter sido feito por Rau Reik, um ferreiro comum, após falar com uma deusa em suas viagens. Dizem que quem usa o escudo recebe a proteção dessa deusa e nunca será ferido por flechas durante as batalhas. As lendas também dizem que o escudo escolhe um dono, e aqueles que não ganharem o reconhecimendo da deusa nunca poderão encostar nesse escudo, não importa o quanto tentem.
raw.th: โล่ในตำนาน ถูกกล่าวขานกันว่ามันสร้างขึ้นมาโดย ราอูล ริค ช่างตีดาบธรรมดาเมื่อเขาได้พูดกับเทพธิดาในระหว่างการเดินทาง ซึ่งกล่าวไว้ว่าคนที่ใช้โล่นี้จะได้รับการคุ้มครองจากเทพธิดา และจะไม่ได้รับบาดแผลจากลูกศรใดๆ ในสนามรบ ตำนานยังบอกว่าโล่นั้นจะเลือกเจ้าของของตน และผู้ที่ไม่ได้การเลือกจากเทพธิดา จะไม่สามารถสัมผัสมันได้เลยไม่ว่าจะพยายามด้วยวิธีใดก็ตาม
raw.vi: Tấm khiên huyền thoại được đồn đại là do Rau Reik, một người thợ rèn kiếm bình thường, chế tác sau khi nói chuyện với một nữ thần trên đường đi. Người ta đồn rằng những ai sử dụng tấm khiên này sẽ được nữ thần kia bảo vệ và sẽ không bao giờ bị trúng tên trên chiến trường. Truyền thuyết còn kể rằng tấm khiên này sẽ chọn người sở hữu, và những ai không được nữ thần thừa nhận thì dù có cố gắng thế nào cũng sẽ không thể đặt tay vào tấm khiên.

id: Ada dahan putih yang amat langka, tumbuh jauh di dalam hutan. Bisa tumbuh di segala jenis pohon, punya kekuatan sihir yang berefek menyembuhkan semua bentuk makhluk hidup di sekitarnya. Rotan Putih terbuat dari dahan putih ini. Seperti dahan putih, Rotan Putih berwarna putih dan memiliki daya penyembuh, meningkatkan laju pemulihan bagi yang memakainya.
name: MST_SPHERES_30200_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There is an extremely rare white branch that grows deep in the forest. It can grow on any type of tree, and holds a strong magical power that has a healing effect on all lifeforms around it. The White Cane is made from this white branch. Just like the white branch, the White Cane is white in appearance and retains its healing powers, boosting the recovery rate of those who wield it.

raw.en: There is an extremely rare white branch that grows deep in the forest. It can grow on any type of tree, and holds a strong magical power that has a healing effect on all lifeforms around it. The White Cane is made from this white branch. Just like the white branch, the White Cane is white in appearance and retains its healing powers, boosting the recovery rate of those who wield it.
raw.es: En lo más profundo del bosque crece una extraordinaria rama blanca. Puede nacer en cualquier árbol, y cuenta con propiedades mágicas que hacen sanar a todo ser vivo que tenga cerca. La varita blanca está tallada a partir de esta rama, de la que ha conservado su níveo color y sus propiedades curativas. Por ello, aumenta la capacidad de recuperación de quienes la usan.
raw.id: Ada dahan putih yang amat langka, tumbuh jauh di dalam hutan. Bisa tumbuh di segala jenis pohon, punya kekuatan sihir yang berefek menyembuhkan semua bentuk makhluk hidup di sekitarnya. Rotan Putih terbuat dari dahan putih ini. Seperti dahan putih, Rotan Putih berwarna putih dan memiliki daya penyembuh, meningkatkan laju pemulihan bagi yang memakainya.
raw.pt: Há um ramo branco extremamente raro que cresce nas profundezas da floresta. Ele pode crescer em qualquer árvore e tem um poder mágico muito forte com efeito de cura sobre todas as formas de vida ao redor. O Cetro Branco é feito deste ramo branco. Assim como o ramo, o Cetro Branco obviamente é branco e retém os poderes de cura, melhorando a taxa de recuperação de quem o usar.
raw.th: นี่คือกิ่งไม้สีขาวที่เติบโตในป่าลึกหายาก มันสามารถเติบโตกับชนิดของต้นไม้ชนิดใดๆ ก็ได้ และมีพลังอำนาจวิเศษอันแข็งแกร่ง ซึ่งสามารถรักษาทุกสิ่งรอบๆตัวมัน 'คทาขาว' จึงมีลักษณาเป็นสีขาวและอีกทั้งยังมีพลังในการรักษา รวมไปถึงช่วยเพิ่มพลังการฟื้นฟูของผู้ที่ถือมันอีกด้วย
raw.vi: Có một nhánh bạch mộc cực kỳ hiếm gặp mọc sâu trong các khu rừng. Nhánh bạch mộc này này có thể mọc trên bất kỳ loại cây nào và sở hữu sức mạnh ma thuật mạnh mẻ có khả năng chữa lành cho mọi sinh vật sống xung quanh. Cây Đũa phép Trắng được chế tạo từ nhánh bạch mộc này. Cũng giống như nhánh bạch mộc, Cây Đũa phép Trắng có màu trắng và mang năng lực chữa lành, tăng tỉ lệ phục hồi cho người sử dụng.

id: Tongkat Jaga adalah tongkat penyihir tinggi di zaman Republik La Veda kuno yang dihancurkan para dewa. Punya kekuatan roh terang dan angin, menambah kekuatan penyihir. Kekuatannya memainkan peranan penting dalam menyembuhkan tentara yang terluka di medan perang.
name: MST_SPHERES_30201_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The Sentry Cane is a wand used by the high wizards of the ancient La Veda Republic that was destroyed by the gods. It holds the power of spirits of light and wind, and enhances the powers of wizards. It's said that its powers played a vital role in healing the soldiers wounded in battle.

raw.en: The Sentry Cane is a wand used by the high wizards of the ancient La Veda Republic that was destroyed by the gods. It holds the power of spirits of light and wind, and enhances the powers of wizards. It's said that its powers played a vital role in healing the soldiers wounded in battle.
raw.es: La varita vigía es el arma que usaban los archimagos de la antigua república de Laveda, que fue arrasada por los dioses. Está imbuida del poder espiritual de la luz y del viento, y los magos la usan para potenciar su poder. Dicen que fue un elemento clave para curar a los soldados heridos en combate.
raw.id: Tongkat Jaga adalah tongkat penyihir tinggi di zaman Republik La Veda kuno yang dihancurkan para dewa. Punya kekuatan roh terang dan angin, menambah kekuatan penyihir. Kekuatannya memainkan peranan penting dalam menyembuhkan tentara yang terluka di medan perang.
raw.pt: O Cetro Sentinela é usado pelos magos mestres da antiga República de La Veda, que foi destruída pelos deuses. Ela tem o poder dos espíritos da luz e do vento e intensifica os poderes dos magos. Dizem que os poderes dele tiveram um papel essencial na cura dos soldados feridos na batalha.
raw.th: 'คทาตรวจตรา' คือคทาที่ใช้โดยนักเวทย์ชั้นสูงของอาณาจักรโบราณลาเวด้า ที่ถูกทำลายโดยเทพเจ้า มันถือครองอำนาจวิญญาณของแสงและลม และช่วยเพิ่มพลังอำนาจของนักเวทย์ กล่าวกันว่าพลังของมันมีบทบาทสำคัญในการรักษาทหารที่ได้รับบาดเจ็บในการสู้รบ
raw.vi: Cây Đũa phép Canh gác là cây đũa phép được sử dụng bởi các phù thủy cao tay của nền Cộng hòa La Veda cổ xưa, nền cộng hòa đã bị các vị thần tiêu diệt. Cây đũa phép này sở hữu sức mạnh linh hồn của ánh sáng và gió, tăng quyền năng phù thủy. Người ta đồn rằng sức mạnh của cây đũa này đã từng đóng vai trò sống còn, giúp chữa lành cho những chiến binh bị thương trong chiến trận.

id: Tongkat yang dipakai Ladeltia, putri yang disebut santa di berbagai catatan sejarah. Katanya mukjizat terjadi setiap kali ia mengangkat tongkatnya. Dari berbagai dongeng, yang paling terkenal adalah di desa yang terkena epidemi dan banyak yang takut datang, tapi Ladeltia bisa masuk dan secara instan membersihkan tempat itu dan penduduknya.
name: MST_SPHERES_30202_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A cane used by Ladeltia, a lady who was cited as being a saint in many historic records. It's said that miracles happened whenever she raised her cane. Among the many tales of her, the most well-known of all is of a village where an epidemic broke out and many feared of even getting close to it, but she was able to enter in and instantly cleanse the place and its people.

raw.en: A cane used by Ladeltia, a lady who was cited as being a saint in many historic records. It's said that miracles happened whenever she raised her cane. Among the many tales of her, the most well-known of all is of a village where an epidemic broke out and many feared of even getting close to it, but she was able to enter in and instantly cleanse the place and its people.
raw.es: La varita que usaba Ladeltia, a quien se cita en varios archivos como santa. Cuentan que ocurrían milagros cuando Ladeltia alzaba su varita. Entre las muchas historias que hablan de ella, la más famosa es la que aconteció en una aldea asolada por una epidemia. La gente temía acercarse al lugar por ello, pero Ladeltia acudió allí y libró la aldea y a su gente del mal que los aquejaba.
raw.id: Tongkat yang dipakai Ladeltia, putri yang disebut santa di berbagai catatan sejarah. Katanya mukjizat terjadi setiap kali ia mengangkat tongkatnya. Dari berbagai dongeng, yang paling terkenal adalah di desa yang terkena epidemi dan banyak yang takut datang, tapi Ladeltia bisa masuk dan secara instan membersihkan tempat itu dan penduduknya.
raw.pt: Um cetro usado por Ladeltia, uma mulher citada como santa em muitos registros históricos. Dizem que aconteciam milagres onde ela levantasse o cetro. Entre os muitos relatos sobre ela, o mais conhecido é o de uma vila em que aconteceu uma epidemia. Muitos tinham medo até de chegar perto de lá, mas ela conseguiu entrar e acabar com a epidemia.
raw.th: คทาที่ใช้โดยลาเดลเทีย ผู้หญิงที่อ้างว่าเป็นนักบุญในบันทึกประวัติศาสตร์มากมาย กล่าวกันว่าปาฏิหาริย์จะบังเกิดในยามที่เธอยกไม้เท้าขึ้น มีเรื่องเล่ามากมายที่กล่าวขวัญถึงเธอ แต่ที่มีชื่อเสียงที่สุดก็คือเรื่องของหมู่บ้านที่มีโรคระบาดแผ่ขยายไปทั่ว ผู้คนต่างหวาดกลัวที่จะเข้าใกล้ ทว่าเธอกลับเข้าไปทำการชำระล้างทั้งสถานที่และผู้คนในทันที
raw.vi: Cây đũa phép từng được sử dụng bởi Ladeltia, người phụ nữ được phong thánh trong rất nhiều ghi chép lịch sử. Người ta đồn rằng điều kỳ diệu xảy ra cứ mỗi khi bà cất cao cây đũa phép. Trong số rất nhiều những câu chuyện về bà, thì câu chuyện được biết đến nhiều nhất là về một ngôi làng  nơi bệnh dịch bùng phát và nhiều người sợ hãi ngay cả việc đến gần ngôi làng đó, nhưng Ladeltia có thể bước vào trong ngôi làng và ngay lập tức chữa khỏi cho toàn bộ người dân trong làng.

id: Pengunjung dari dunia yang berbeda datang ke Gaia Besar dan meninggalkan banyak cerita, beberapa di antara tentang ras roh. Lebih tabah daripada manusia, sampai ditakuti orang. Pandai besi Gavallia membuat zirah bermodel roh. Penampilannya mengancam, dan mendapat ulasan negatif meski berfungsi. Nama zirah ini bersama penciptanya segera menyebar luas.
name: MST_SPHERES_30300_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Visitors from different worlds came to Grand Gaia and left behind many stories, among them were those concerning a race known as spirits. They were far more resilient than humans, and to a point people feared them. Despite this, the blacksmith Gavallian crafted an armor modelled after them. Its menacing look, despite its functionality, gained it negative reviews, but its name along with its creator's soon spread far and wide.

raw.en: Visitors from different worlds came to Grand Gaia and left behind many stories, among them were those concerning a race known as spirits. They were far more resilient than humans, and to a point people feared them. Despite this, the blacksmith Gavallian crafted an armor modelled after them. Its menacing look, despite its functionality, gained it negative reviews, but its name along with its creator's soon spread far and wide.
raw.es: Muchos visitantes acuden a Gran Gaia y dejan en ella historias. Esta tiene que ver con la raza de los espíritus, unos seres mucho más fuertes que los humanos, lo que hizo que la gente los temiera. Pese a ello, el herrero Gavalián fabricó esta coraza a su imagen y semejanza. Su aspecto amenazador hizo sombra a su gran utilidad, y muchos criticaron su existencia. Sin embargo, su nombre y el de su creador pronto se hicieron famosos.
raw.id: Pengunjung dari dunia yang berbeda datang ke Gaia Besar dan meninggalkan banyak cerita, beberapa di antara tentang ras roh. Lebih tabah daripada manusia, sampai ditakuti orang. Pandai besi Gavallia membuat zirah bermodel roh. Penampilannya mengancam, dan mendapat ulasan negatif meski berfungsi. Nama zirah ini bersama penciptanya segera menyebar luas.
raw.pt: Visitantes de mundos diferentes vieram a Grand Gaia e deixaram muitas histórias, entre essas histórias estão as de uma raça conhecida como espíritos. Eles eram muito mais resistentes que humanos e muitos tinham medo deles. Apesar disso, o ferreiro Gavallian fez uma armadura com modelo baseado neles. Apesar de ser eficiente, a aparência ameaçadora dela gerou opiniões negativas, mas seu nome e o criador ficaram conhecidos por todos os lugares.
raw.th: ผู้มาเยือนจากโลกที่แตกต่างกันมาถึงแกรนด์ไกอา และทิ้งเรื่องราวมากมายเอาไว้ด้านหลัง ในหมู่พวกเขามีผู้ที่เกี่ยวข้องกับเผ่าพันธุ์ที่เรียกกันว่าวิญญาณ พวกเขามรการฟื้นตัวได้ดีกว่าพวกมนุษย์มาก และเป็นสิ่งที่มนุษย์กลัว อย่างไรก็ตามเรื่องนี้ช่างตีเหล็ก กาวาลเลียน สร้างชุดเกราะตามแบบพวกนั้น เพราะรูปร่างที่ดูน่ากลัวของมันเลยไม่รับความนิยม โดยที่ไม่ได้พูดถึงการทำงานของมันโดยแท้จริง แต่ไม่นานนักชื่อของมันและผู้สร้างก็ได้แพร่กระจายออกไปเป็นวงกว้าง
raw.vi: Du khách từ nhiều vùng đất khác nhau đến với Grand Gaia và mang theo nhiều câu chuyện ly kì, trong số đó có những câu chuyện về một chủng tộc được biết đến như là những sinh vật siêu nhiên. Chủng tộc này có khả năng phục hồi vượt xa con người, và con người,ở một mức độ nhất định, sợ hãi những sinh vật này. Cho dù vậy, người thợ rèn Gavallian đã chế tạo ra một bộ áo giáp mô phỏng theo những sinh vật này. Bất kể chức năng của chiếc áo giáp này thì vẻ ngoài đầy đe dọa của nó cũng đã nhận được nhiều ý kiến phản bác, tuy nhiên tên tuổi của bộ giáp cùng với người chế tạo ra nó sớm đã lan truyền khắp nơi.

id: Qilin, monster mitos yang hanya ada di dongeng, katanya mengontrol kehidupan. Zirah ini, dinamai Qilin, katanya menambah vitalitas pemakainya. Meski terkenal, penciptanya masih menjadi misteri. Ada berbagai cerita tentang asalnya, beberapa bilang itu hadiah dari surga, yang lain bilang itu dulu milik pengunjung dari dunia lain.
name: MST_SPHERES_30301_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The Qilin, a mythical beast that only exists in fairy tales, was said to have control over life. This armor, named after the Qilin, is said to enhancing it's wearer's vitality. Although it's a well-known piece of armor, its creator is still a mystery. There are many stories about its origin, some claiming it was a gift from heaven, with others saying it once belonged to visitors from another world.

raw.en: The Qilin, a mythical beast that only exists in fairy tales, was said to have control over life. This armor, named after the Qilin, is said to enhancing it's wearer's vitality. Although it's a well-known piece of armor, its creator is still a mystery. There are many stories about its origin, some claiming it was a gift from heaven, with others saying it once belonged to visitors from another world.
raw.es: Cuenta la leyenda que existió una mítica bestia, de nombre Qilin, que era capaz de controlar la vida. La coraza bestial, llamada así en honor a Qilin, aumenta la vitalidad de quien la lleva puesta. Como se desconoce el nombre del creador de esta famosa coraza, abundan las leyendas sobre su origen. Hay quien dice que fue un regalo del cielo; otros afirman que perteneció a unos seres que acudieron aquí desde otro mundo.
raw.id: Qilin, monster mitos yang hanya ada di dongeng, katanya mengontrol kehidupan. Zirah ini, dinamai Qilin, katanya menambah vitalitas pemakainya. Meski terkenal, penciptanya masih menjadi misteri. Ada berbagai cerita tentang asalnya, beberapa bilang itu hadiah dari surga, yang lain bilang itu dulu milik pengunjung dari dunia lain.
raw.pt: Dizem que Qilin, a fera mítica que só existe em contos de fadas, tem controle sobre a vida. O nome dessa armadura vem de Qilin e dizem que ela aumenta a vitalidade de quem usar. Mesmo sendo uma armadura muito conhecida, ninguém sabe quem a criou. Há muitas histórias sobre a origem dela; algumas dizem que foi um presente do paraíso, outros dizem que ela já pertenceu a visitantes de outro planeta.
raw.th: กิเลน, สัตว์ในตำนานที่ว่ากันว่ามีอยู่แค่ในนิทาน บ้างก็บอกว่ามันควบคุมชีวิตทั้งหมด เกราะนี้ตั้งชื่อตามกิเลน กล่าวกันว่ามันเสริมสร้างพลังให้ผู้สวมใส่ แม้ว่ามันจะเป็นเกราะที่รู้จักกันดี แต่ใครเป็นผู้สร้างมันก็ยังคงเป็นปริศนา มีเรื่องราวมากมายเกี่ยวกับกำเนิดของมัน บางคนอ้างว่ามันเป็นของขวัญจากสวรรค์ ส่วนคนอื่นๆ ก็ว่ามันเคยเป็นของผู้มาเยือนจากโลกอื่น
raw.vi: Kỳ lân, loài thú thần thoại chỉ có trong truyện cổ tích, theo lời đồn đại có khả năng cải tử hoàn sinh. Bộ giáp này được đặt theo tên của Kỳ lân, giúp người mặc tăng thêm sinh khí. Mặc dù đây là một bộ giáp rất nổi tiếng nhưng người chế tác ra nó thì vẫn còn là một bí ẩn. Có hàng tá các câu chuyện kể về nguồn gốc của bộ giáp này, có người cho rằng đây là món quà từ thiên đường, và cũng có người nói rằng bộ giáp này từng thuộc về những du khách đến từ một thế giới khác.

id: Baju Suci katanya membangunkan dan memaksimalkan insting bertahan purba. Sejarah mencatat baju ini dirajut oleh pendeta Emeldia untuk mengubah pikiran pria yang mencoba bunuh diri. siapa yang memakai Baju Suci, dilepaskan dari maut, meski tidak luput dari luka, jadi mereka dipaksa menahan rasa sakit buatan sendiri sampai akhirnya berhenti memikirkan mati.
name: MST_SPHERES_30302_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The Holy Robe is said to rouse and maximize one's primeval survival instincts. Records say the robe was knitted by the cleric Emeldia in order to change the mind of a man who attempted suicide. Those who wear the Holy Robe are spared from death, though not from their injuries, so they're forced to endure their self-inflicted pain uttil they eventually give up on the thought of dying.

raw.en: The Holy Robe is said to rouse and maximize one's primeval survival instincts. Records say the robe was knitted by the cleric Emeldia in order to change the mind of a man who attempted suicide. Those who wear the Holy Robe are spared from death, though not from their injuries, so they're forced to endure their self-inflicted pain uttil they eventually give up on the thought of dying.
raw.es: La capa sacra despierta y agudiza el instinto de supervivencia primigenio de quien la lleva puesta. Se supone que la clérigo Emeldia tejió esta capa para hacer cambiar de opinión a un hombre que había intentado suicidarse. Quienes se visten con la capa sacra no pueden morir, pero sí sufrir amargamente el dolor de sus heridas. Se ven forzados a aguantar este sufrimiento hasta que dejan de pensar en la muerte.
raw.id: Baju Suci katanya membangunkan dan memaksimalkan insting bertahan purba. Sejarah mencatat baju ini dirajut oleh pendeta Emeldia untuk mengubah pikiran pria yang mencoba bunuh diri. siapa yang memakai Baju Suci, dilepaskan dari maut, meski tidak luput dari luka, jadi mereka dipaksa menahan rasa sakit buatan sendiri sampai akhirnya berhenti memikirkan mati.
raw.pt: Dizem que a Túnica Sagrada desperta e maximiza os instintos de sobrevivência de uma pessoa. Há registros que dizem que ela foi feita pela sacerdotisa Emeldia para fazer um suicida mudar de ideia. Quem vestir a Túnica Sagrada é poupado da morte, mas não de seus ferimentos, então é forçado a suportar a dor que causou a si mesmo até desistir da ideia de morrer.
raw.th: 'โฮลี่โร้บ' ว่ากันว่ามันปลุกสัญชาตญาณการอยู่รอดของผู้ล่า บันทึกว่ามันเป็นเสื้อคลุมที่ถักโดย อีเมลเดีย เพื่อจะเปลี่ยนความคิดของชายที่พยายามฆ่าตัวตาย บรรดาผู้ที่สวมใส่โฮลี่โร้บจะได้ละเว้นจากความตาย แต่ไม่ได้รับการละเว้นจากการบาดเจ็บบาด ดังนั้นพวกเขาจึงถูกบังคับให้ทนความเจ็บปวด จนกระทั่งพวกเขายอมแพ้และคิดที่จะตายในที่สุด
raw.vi: Người ta đồn rằng Aó choàng Thánh có thể thức tỉnh và thúc đẩy tối đa những bản năng sống còn sơ khai của con người. Sử sách ghi lại rằng tấm áo choàng này được đan bởi giáo sĩ Emeldia nhằm thay đổi ý định của một người đang cố tự tử. Những ai mặc Aó choàng Thánh được bảo vệ khỏi tử thần, cho dù không phải là do bị thương, vì thế người mặc tấm áo choàng buộc phải chịu đựng cơn đau mình tự gây ra cho đến khi họ thực sự từ bỏ  suy nghĩ rằng mình sẽ chết

id: Kapak perang tadinya milik Mariudeth, pria terkuat di Kekaisaran Agni. Kapaknya begitu besar sehingga manusia biasa tidak bisa mengangkatnya. Katanya, saat Mariudeth mengayunkan kapak, ia dapat mengiris Titan menjadi dua. Setelah Mariudeth mati, ahli sihir memeriksa kapak, tetapi tidak ditemukan jejak sihir, membuktikan ini hanyalah kapak raksasa.
name: MST_SPHERES_30400_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A battle axe that belonged to Mariudeth who was said to be the strongest man in the Agni Empire. This axe is so large that a regular human can't even lift it. However, it's said that when Mariudeth swung the axe, he could slice even a Titan in two. After Mariudeth's death, magicians examined the axe but found no trace of magic, proving it to be just a huge axe.

raw.en: A battle axe that belonged to Mariudeth who was said to be the strongest man in the Agni Empire. This axe is so large that a regular human can't even lift it. However, it's said that when Mariudeth swung the axe, he could slice even a Titan in two. After Mariudeth's death, magicians examined the axe but found no trace of magic, proving it to be just a huge axe.
raw.es: Esta hacha de guerra perteneció a Mariudeth, quien tenía fama de ser el hombre más fuerte del imperio de Agní. Es tan larga que un ser humano de tamaño normal no es capaz ni de levantarla. Cuentan que, cuando Mariudeth la blandía entre sus manos, podía partir un titán a la mitad con ella. Cuando Mariudeth falleció, unos magos examinaron el hacha pero no hallaron en ella vestigios de magia y determinaron que era un hacha grande, sin más.
raw.id: Kapak perang tadinya milik Mariudeth, pria terkuat di Kekaisaran Agni. Kapaknya begitu besar sehingga manusia biasa tidak bisa mengangkatnya. Katanya, saat Mariudeth mengayunkan kapak, ia dapat mengiris Titan menjadi dua. Setelah Mariudeth mati, ahli sihir memeriksa kapak, tetapi tidak ditemukan jejak sihir, membuktikan ini hanyalah kapak raksasa.
raw.pt: Um machado de batalha que pertenceu a Mariudeth, que muitos acreditavam ser o homem mais forte do Império Agni. Este machado é tão grande que um humano normal não consegue erguê-lo. Dizem que, quando Mariudeth golpeava com ele, podia até cortar um Titã no meio. Depois da morte de Mariudeth, magos examinaram o machado mas não encontraram sinais de magia, o que provava que era somente um machado enorme.
raw.th: ขวานต่อสู้ที่เป็นของ มาริอุเด็ธ ผู้ถูกขนานนามว่าเป็นคนแข็งแกร่งที่สุดในอาณาจักรแอ็กนี ขวานนี้มีขนาดใหญ่จนคนทั่วไปไม่สามารถยกมันขึ้นได้ แต่ก็กล่าวกันว่าเมื่อ มาริอุเด็ธ เหวี่ยงขวาน เขาสามารถเชือดไททันได้ถึงสองตัวหลังจากการตายของ มาริอุเด็ธ นักเวทย์ก็ได้ทำการตรวจสอบ แต่ก็ไม่พบร่องรอยของเวทมนตร์ นอกจากพิสูจน์ว่ามันเป็นแค่ขวานขนาดใหญ่เท่านั้น
raw.vi: Chiếc rìu chiến đấu thuộc quyền sở hữu của Mariudeth, người được đồn đại là người đàn ông khỏe nhất trong Đế chế Agni. Chiếc rìu này lớn đến mức mà người thường không thể nâng được. Tuy nhiên, người ta đồn rằng khi Mariudeth vung rìu, anh ta có thể xẻ một Người khổng lồ ra làm hai mảnh. Sau khi Mariudeth qua đời, các pháp sư đã xem xét chiếc rìu nhưng không tìm thấy bất kỳ dấu hiệu nào của pháp thuật, chửng tỏ rằng nó chỉ là một chiếc rìu khổng lồ mà thôi

id: Kapak tadinya milik Lord Magress yang jahat. Dikirim ke Gaia Besar saat kalah perang dengan manusia. Kekuatan impresifnya menghancurkan jiwa seseorang dalam sekali serang. Namun ini disegel dalam peti harta karun bertahun-tahun karena terlalu kuat untuk dipakai manusia. Kapak Sihir muncul lambat dalam perang besar dengan dewa.
name: MST_SPHERES_30401_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An axe that belonged to the evil Lord Magress. It was sent to Grand Gaia when the the war with the humans was lost. Its impressive power is said to shatter one's soul in a single attack. However, it was sealed away in a treasure vault for many years as it was just too powerful for humans to wield. The Magical Axe surfaced late in the great war with the gods.

raw.en: An axe that belonged to the evil Lord Magress. It was sent to Grand Gaia when the the war with the humans was lost. Its impressive power is said to shatter one's soul in a single attack. However, it was sealed away in a treasure vault for many years as it was just too powerful for humans to wield. The Magical Axe surfaced late in the great war with the gods.
raw.es: Esta hacha perteneció al malvado Magress y fue enviada a Gran Gaia cuando se perdió la guerra contra los humanos. Se dice que es tan potente que destroza el alma del enemigo de un solo golpe. Por ello, permaneció guardada bajo llave en una cámara durante muchos años, pues era demasiado poderosa para los humanos. Durante la gran guerra contra los dioses, esta hacha mágica volvió a estar en uso.
raw.id: Kapak tadinya milik Lord Magress yang jahat. Dikirim ke Gaia Besar saat kalah perang dengan manusia. Kekuatan impresifnya menghancurkan jiwa seseorang dalam sekali serang. Namun ini disegel dalam peti harta karun bertahun-tahun karena terlalu kuat untuk dipakai manusia. Kapak Sihir muncul lambat dalam perang besar dengan dewa.
raw.pt: Um machado que pertenceu ao maligno Lorde Magress. Ele foi enviado a Grand Gaia quando a guerra contra os humanos foi perdida. Dizem que seu poder impressionante pode destruir a alma de alguém com um único golpe. No entanto, ele foi lacrado em um cofre de tesouro por muitos anos porque era poderoso demais para ser usado por humanos. O Machado Mágico apareceu perto do fim da grande guerra.
raw.th: ขวานที่เป็นของ มาเกรส จ้าวแห่งความชั่วร้าย มันถูกส่งมาที่แกรนด์ไกอา เมื่อกำลังแพ้ศึกให้กับมนุษย์ อำนาจที่น่าประทับใจสามารถสลายจิตวิญญาณของศัตรูได้ด้วยการโจมตีเพียงครั้งเดียว แต่ก็ถูกปิดผนึกอยู่ในกรุสมบัติเป็นเวลาหลายปีเพราะมันมีพลังมากเกินไปสำหรับมนุษย์ 'ขวานแมจิก' โผล่มาในช่วงปลายสงครามครั้งใหญ่กับเหล่าเทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Chiếc rìu thuộc sở hữu của ác chúa Magress. Chiếc rìu này được gửi tới Gaia khi cuộc chiến với loài người thất thủ. Người ta đồn rằng quyền năng uy hùng của chiếc rìu này có thể làm tiêu tan linh hồn con người chỉ bằng một đòn tấn công duy nhất. Tuy nhiên, chiếc rìu này đã được phong ấn trong một hầm kho báu hàng bao năm qua bởi con người không thể sử dụng quyền năng quá mạnh mẽ của nó. Chiếc rìu Ma thật sau đó đã lộ diện trong cuộc đại chiến với các vị thần.

id: Set unik pedang yang dikenal sebagai katana, dibawa ke Gaia Besar oleh pengunjung dari dunia lain. Sejak itu meraih perhatian ahli pedang dari mana saja. Yang paling tajam, dengan ukiran Muramusa, saking tajamnya membuat lalat yang mendarat di atasnya, terbelah menjadi dua. Katanya Muramusa menyihirnya dengan kuat, membuat pemiliknya ingin bertarung.
name: MST_SPHERES_31000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There is a unique set of swords known as katanas which were brought to Grand Gaia by a visitor from another world, having since gained the attention of swordsmen everywhere. The sharpest among these, one with Muramasa engraved in it, is so sharp even a fly that landed on its edge would be sliced in two. It's said that the Muramasa is bewitchingly powerful, urging its wielder to fight.

raw.en: There is a unique set of swords known as katanas which were brought to Grand Gaia by a visitor from another world, having since gained the attention of swordsmen everywhere. The sharpest among these, one with Muramasa engraved in it, is so sharp even a fly that landed on its edge would be sliced in two. It's said that the Muramasa is bewitchingly powerful, urging its wielder to fight.
raw.es: Existe en Gran Gaia un conjunto único de espadas traído aquí por un visitante que vino de otro mundo. La singularidad de estas espadas, llamadas katanas, ha cautivado a espadachines de todas partes. De entre ellas, la que lleva el nombre "Muramasa" grabado es sin duda la más afilada: puede partir una mosca en dos en cuanto se posa en su filo. Dicen que Muramasa está dotada de un poder cautivador e incita a quien la blande a la lucha.
raw.id: Set unik pedang yang dikenal sebagai katana, dibawa ke Gaia Besar oleh pengunjung dari dunia lain. Sejak itu meraih perhatian ahli pedang dari mana saja. Yang paling tajam, dengan ukiran Muramusa, saking tajamnya membuat lalat yang mendarat di atasnya, terbelah menjadi dua. Katanya Muramusa menyihirnya dengan kuat, membuat pemiliknya ingin bertarung.
raw.pt: Há um conjunto único de espadas, conhecidas como katanas, que foram trazidas a Grand Gaia por um visitante de outro mundo. Desde então, elas chamam a atenção de espadachins de todos os lugares. A mais afiada dessas espadas é a que tem uma gravação que diz Murumasa. Ela é tão afiada que, se uma mosca pousasse na lâmina, seria cortada ao meio. Dizem que a Murumasa tem um poder maligno, que força quem a usa a lutar.
raw.th: นี่คือชุดดาบที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์รู้จักกันในนาม คาตาน่า ซึ่งถูกนำมายังแกรนด์ไกอาโดยผู้มาเยือนจากอีกโลกหนึ่ง เป็นที่ได้รับความสนใจจากนักดาบทั่วทุกหนแห่ง ซึ่งเล่มที่คมที่สุด คือเล่มที่ถูกสลักเอาไว้ด้วยคำว่า 'มุรามาซะ' มันคมมากเสียจนแมลงวันที่บินลงไปเกาะบนคมดาบ จะถูกหั่นออกเป็นสองซีก ว่ากันว่ามุรามาซะมีพลังปีศาจแฝงอยู่ และจะทำให้ผู้ใช้มันกระหายในการต่อสู้
raw.vi: Một bộ những thanh gươm được người đời biết đến như là những thanh gươm Nhật, được mang đến Grand Gaia bởi một du khách đến từ thế giới khác, và kể từ đó đã thu hút sự chú ý của kiếm sĩ trên khắp mọi nơi. Thanh gươm sắc bén nhất trong số đó, thanh gươm được khắc chũ Muramasa, sắc đến nỗi ngay cả một con ruồi đậu trên lưỡi kiếm cũng bị xẻ làm hai. Người ta đồn rằng thanh Muramasa có sức mạnh làm mê mẩn, thúc đẩy người sử dụng tranh đấu.

id: Ada Perdana Menteri bernama Darvanshel di Kerajaan Sama. Meski ia adalah pegawai negeri sipil, ia selalu membawa tameng dan rakyatnya bingung. Suatu hari, Raja Sama diserang pembunuh saat keluar berburu. Saat itu Darvanshel melemparkan diri bersama dengan tamengnya, di depan Raja, menyelamatkan nyawanya. Dari dulu, itulah tujuan tamengnya.
name: MST_SPHERES_31100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There was once a prime minister named Darvanshel in the Sama Kingdom. Despite being a civil officer, to the dismay of his people he always carried a shield. However, one day the King of Sama was attacked by an assasin while out hunting. At that moment, Darvanshel threw himself, together with his shield, in front of the King, saving his life. This was always his shield's purpose.

raw.en: There was once a prime minister named Darvanshel in the Sama Kingdom. Despite being a civil officer, to the dismay of his people he always carried a shield. However, one day the King of Sama was attacked by an assasin while out hunting. At that moment, Darvanshel threw himself, together with his shield, in front of the King, saving his life. This was always his shield's purpose.
raw.es: En el reino de Sama hubo una vez un primer ministro llamado Darvanshel que, pese a ser un funcionario del gobierno, siempre portaba consigo un escudo. Esto tenía escandalizado a su pueblo. En una ocasión, un asesino intentó acabar con la vida del rey de Sama durante una cacería. Darvanshel, escudo en mano, se interpuso entre el asesino y el rey y logró salvarle la vida, revelando así el verdadero propósito del escudo.
raw.id: Ada Perdana Menteri bernama Darvanshel di Kerajaan Sama. Meski ia adalah pegawai negeri sipil, ia selalu membawa tameng dan rakyatnya bingung. Suatu hari, Raja Sama diserang pembunuh saat keluar berburu. Saat itu Darvanshel melemparkan diri bersama dengan tamengnya, di depan Raja, menyelamatkan nyawanya. Dari dulu, itulah tujuan tamengnya.
raw.pt: Houve um primeiro ministro do Reino de Sama chamado Darvanshel. Apesar de ser uma autoridade civil, ele sempre carregava um escudo que amedrontava o povo. Mas um dia o Rei de Sama foi atacado por um assassino enquanto caçaca. Nesse momento, Darvanshel se jogou na frente do rei com o escudo, o que salvou a vida dos dois. Este sempre foi o propósito do escudo.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีนายกรัฐมนตรีที่ชื่อว่า ดาร์แวนเชล แห่งราชอาณาจักรซามะ แม้ว่าจะเป็นเจ้าหน้ารัฐ แต่เขาก็กลัวประชาชนจนต้องถือโล่เอาไว้ตลอดเวลา แต่วันหนึ่งกษัตริย์แห่งซามะถูกโจมตีโดยมือสังหารในขณะที่ออกไปล่าสัตว์ ในจังหวะนั้นเองดาร์แวนแชลพุ่งเข้าไปพร้อมกับโล่ของเขา เข้าไปขวางด้านหน้าของกษัตริย์เพื่อช่วยชีวิตของพระองค์เอาไว้ และนี่คือหน้าที่หลักของโล่นั้นสืบต่อมา
raw.vi: Tại Vương quốc Sama từng có một vị Tể tướng tên là Darvanshel. Mặc dù là một viên chức nhưng để làm nhụt tinh thần người dân ông ta luôn mang theo một tấm khiên. Tuy nhiên, một ngày kia Hoàng đế Sama đã bị một sát thủ tấn công khi đang trên đường đi ăn. Vào lúc đó, Darvanshel đã quăng thân mình cùng với tấm khiên ra chắn trước Hoàng đế, cứu mạng Người. Và đây luôn là mục đích ông mang theo tấm khiên.

id: Kekaisaran Bariula dihancurkan para dewa, meninggalkan warisannya sebagai rumah senjata dan zirah bermantera. Sabit Maut adalah salah satunya, dengan kemampuan khusus menarik dari kekuatan si pemakai saat bahaya, menggunakannya untuk meningkatkan kekuatan. Sejarah mencatat ini dibentuk sebagai sabit karena sabit ialah senjata favorit Kaisar Wanita era itu.
name: MST_SPHERES_31200_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The Bariula Empire was destroyed by the gods, leaving behind its legacy of being home to its enchanted weapons and armor. The Death Scythe was among these pieces, with the special ability to draw from its wielder's strength in times of danger, using it to boost its power. Records say that it was forged in the shape of a sickle because the Empress of that time prefered weapons.

raw.en: The Bariula Empire was destroyed by the gods, leaving behind its legacy of being home to its enchanted weapons and armor. The Death Scythe was among these pieces, with the special ability to draw from its wielder's strength in times of danger, using it to boost its power. Records say that it was forged in the shape of a sickle because the Empress of that time prefered weapons.
raw.es: Los dioses arrasaron el imperio de Bariula y dejaron allí sus armas y armamento mágico. Entre su arsenal se encontraba esta hoz, que es capaz de absorber parte de la fuerza de quien la porta y usarla para aumentar su poder cuando acecha algún peligro. Según los registros históricos, su forma se debe a la predilección que sentía la emperatriz de la época por las hoces.
raw.id: Kekaisaran Bariula dihancurkan para dewa, meninggalkan warisannya sebagai rumah senjata dan zirah bermantera. Sabit Maut adalah salah satunya, dengan kemampuan khusus menarik dari kekuatan si pemakai saat bahaya, menggunakannya untuk meningkatkan kekuatan. Sejarah mencatat ini dibentuk sebagai sabit karena sabit ialah senjata favorit Kaisar Wanita era itu.
raw.pt: O Império de Bariula foi destruído pelos deuses, deixando para trás o legado de ser o lar de armas e armaduras encantadas. A Foice da Morte estava entre essas peças, com a habilidade especial de sugar a força do usuário em momentos de perigo para aumentar seus poderes. Os registros dizem que ela foi feita no formato de uma foice porque era uma das armas preferidas Imperadora da época.
raw.th: จักรวรรดิบาริอุละถูกทำลายโดยเทพเจ้า เหลือทิ้งไว้เพียงมรดกกับการเป็นที่ฝังของอาวุธและชุดเกราะเวทย์ เคียวแห่งความตายเป็นหนึ่งในบรรดาของเหล่านั้น ซึ่งมีความสามารถพิเศษ ในการนำความแข็งแรงของผู้ครอบครองมาใช้ ในเวลาที่เกิดอันตราย บันทึกบอกไว้ว่ามันถูกหลอมขึ้นในรูปของเคียว เพราะในเวลานั้นจักรพรรดินีชอบอาวุธเช่นนี้
raw.vi: Đế chế Bariula đã bị các vị thần hủy diệt, chỉ còn sót lại di sản là những vũ khí và những bộ áo giáp bị bỏ bùa. Lưới hái Tử thần là một trong số đó, với quyền năng đặc biệt đó là hấp thụ sức mạnh của người sử dụng khi nguy cấp, và sử dụng sức mạnh đó để tăng sức mạnh của chính mình. Sử sách có ghi lại rằng lưỡi hái này được rèn dưới hình dạng của một cái liềm Nữ hoàng của triều đại này yêu thích vũ khí.

id: Mutiara dengan kekuatan menyembuhkan segala makhluk hidup yang terluka, ditemukan jauh di dalam hutan di ujung timur Kerajaan Kecil Vuliksha. Katanya mutiara ini berasal dari pohon ribuan tahun yang mengisi vitalitas ke dalam mutiara untuk melindungi makhluk hutan. Makhluk yang sudah disembuhkan selamanya bersyukur pada pohon-pohon hebat itu.
name: MST_SPHERES_31300_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A pearl with the power to heal injured lifeforms, found deep in the forests at the eastern end of the Principality of Vriksha. It's said that the pearl comes from millenial trees which infuse their vitality into these pearls in order to protect the creatures of the forest. Creatures who have been healed by their powers are eternally grateful to those magnificent trees.

raw.en: A pearl with the power to heal injured lifeforms, found deep in the forests at the eastern end of the Principality of Vriksha. It's said that the pearl comes from millenial trees which infuse their vitality into these pearls in order to protect the creatures of the forest. Creatures who have been healed by their powers are eternally grateful to those magnificent trees.
raw.es: Una perla con propiedades curativas que proviene de las profundidades de los bosques que hay en el extremo más oriental del Principado de Vriksha. Se dice que esta clase de perlas nace de unos árboles milenarios que las imbuyen de su vitalidad para proteger a los seres que habitan el bosque. Aquellos que han recuperado la salud gracias a sus poderes guardan gratitud eterna a estos árboles.

raw.pt: Uma pérola com o poder de curar vidas feridas, encontrada nas profundezas das florestas do leste do Principado de Viliksha. Dizem que a pérola vem das árvores milenares que colocam suas vitalidades nessas pérolas para proteger as criaturas da floresta. Criaturas curadas por esses poderes são eternamente gratas a essas árvores majestosas.
raw.th: ไข่มุกที่มีอำนาจรักษาสิ่งมีชีวิตที่ได้รับบาดเจ็บ ถูกพบลึกลงไปในป่าทางด้านตะวันออกอาณาเขตของพฤกษา กล่าวกันว่าไข่มุกนี้มาจากต้นไม้พันปี ที่ใส่พลังลงไปในไข่มุกเหล่านี้เพื่อที่จะปกป้องสิ่งมีชีวิตในป่า สิ่งมีชีวิตที่ได้รับการรักษาให้หายโดยอำนาจของพวกเขา ขอขอบคุณต้นไม้ที่สวยงามเหล่านี้ไปตลอดกาล
raw.vi: Viên ngọc trai có năng lực chữa lành cho những sinh vật đang bị thương, được tìm thấy tận sâu trong các khu rừng cuối phía Đông của Lãnh địa Vuliksha. Người ta đồn rằng viên ngọc trai này đến từ những cây cổ thụ ngàn năm tuổi, những cây cổ thụ này đã truyền sinh khí vào viên ngọc để bảo vệ các sinh vật của khu rừng. Các sinh vật đã từng được chữa trị bằng năng lực này phải vĩnh viễn biết ơn những cây cổ thụ ngàn năm tuổi kia.

id: Kapak ini telah menyaksikan kematian beberapa pemiliknya, masing-masing sangat menyukai dan berhati-hati menggunakan kekuatan kapak. Melalui banyak kematian, Kapak Maut telah dikenal sebagai tanda kegelapan. Kekuatan gelapnya menambah ampuh penggunanya, meski selalu ada kans si kapak akan lebih panjang umur.
name: MST_SPHERES_31500_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This axe has seen the deaths of several owners, each of whom took a great liking to its power and used it with great care. Through these countless deaths, the lifeless Death Axe came to be known as an omen of darkness. Its dark powers enhance its user, though there is always the chance it will outlive him.

raw.en: This axe has seen the deaths of several owners, each of whom took a great liking to its power and used it with great care. Through these countless deaths, the lifeless Death Axe came to be known as an omen of darkness. Its dark powers enhance its user, though there is always the chance it will outlive him.
raw.es: Esta hacha ha pasado por muchas manos. Cada uno de sus difuntos propietarios sintió gran aprecio por ella y la trató con sumo cuidado. Sin embargo, el estar asociada con la muerte ha hecho que esta adquiera una fama oscura. Sus poderes potencian los de quien la usa, pero cabe la posibilidad de que no viva para contarlo.
