raw.pt: Este machado já viu a morte de vários que o usaram, cada um apreciava o poder do machado e o usava com muito cuidado. Por essas mortes incontáveis, o Machado da Morte ficou conhecido como um prenúncio da escuridão. Seus poderes sombrios aprimoram quem usa, mas sempre há a chance de que o machado viva mais do que o usuário.
raw.th: ขวานนี้ได้เห็นการเสียชีวิตของผู้เป็นเจ้าของหลายต่อหลายคน ซึ่งแต่ละคนชื่นชอบในพลังของมันและดูแลมันเป็นอย่างดี การตายนับไม่ถ้วนเหล่านี้ทำให้ขวานแห่งความตายอันไร้ซึ่งชีวิต เป็นที่รู้จักกันในนามเครื่องรางแห่งความมืดมด โดยอำนาจมืดของมันจะเสริมพลังให้กับผู้ใช้ แต่ก็มีโอกาสที่จะเอาชีวิตของผู้ใช้ด้วยเช่นเดียวกัน
raw.vi: Chiếc rìu này đã chứng kiến cái chết của không chỉ một người sở hữu nó, và mỗi một người trong số đó đều yêu thích quyền năng của chiếc rìu cũng như sử dụng quyền năng đó vô cùng cẩn trọng.Qua số người chết còn chưa đếm được này mà Chiếc rìu Tử thần đã được biết đến như là dấu hiệu của bóng tối. Quyền năng đen tối của chiếc rìu giúp người sử dụng tăng thêm sức mạnh, cho dù lúc nào chiếc rìu này cũng sống sót lâu hơn chủ nhân.

id: Belati dengan tombol tersembunyi dalam hulunya, saat ditekan mengisi bilahnya dengan racun. Aslinya dirancang sebagai senjata ahli pedang yang lemah, namun penggunaannya yang mudah membuatnya populer di kalangan pembunuh. Pengguna bisa bebas mengganti jenis racun di dalamnya, jadi pembunuh veteran sering membawa beberapa Pisau Racun berisi berbagai racun.
name: MST_SPHERES_31600_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A dagger with a button hidden in its hilt, which when pressed fills its blade with poison. Originally designed as a weapon for weaker swordsmen, its ease of use made it a popular choice of weapon among assasins as well. The user can freely change the type of poison embedded in it, thus veteran assasins often carry several Poison Shivs containing varied poisons.

raw.en: A dagger with a button hidden in its hilt, which when pressed fills its blade with poison. Originally designed as a weapon for weaker swordsmen, its ease of use made it a popular choice of weapon among assasins as well. The user can freely change the type of poison embedded in it, thus veteran assasins often carry several Poison Shivs containing varied poisons.
raw.es: Esta daga cuenta con un botón oculto en el mango que impregna su hoja de veneno si se pulsa. Se concibió como un arma para espadachines débiles pero, por su sencillo uso, pronto se hizo famosa entre los asesinos. Como se puede cambiar el tipo de veneno oculto en ella, los asesinos veteranos siempre llevan consigo varias dagas con venenos distintos.
raw.id: Belati dengan tombol tersembunyi dalam hulunya, saat ditekan mengisi bilahnya dengan racun. Aslinya dirancang sebagai senjata ahli pedang yang lemah, namun penggunaannya yang mudah membuatnya populer di kalangan pembunuh. Pengguna bisa bebas mengganti jenis racun di dalamnya, jadi pembunuh veteran sering membawa beberapa Pisau Racun berisi berbagai racun.
raw.pt: Uma adaga com um botão escondido no cabo que enche a lâmina de veneno ao ser pressionado. Originalmente, foi feita como uma arma para espadachins mais fracos e a facilidade de uso a tornou uma escolha popular entre assassinos. Quem usa pode alterar o tipo de veneno da lâmina quando quiser, por isso assassinos veteranos carregam várias Lâminas Peçonhentas com venenos diferentes.
raw.th: กริชพิษ' มีปุ่มที่ซ่อนอยู่ในด้ามจับ ซึ่งเมื่อกดก็จะอาบพิษลงไปที่ใบมีด ดั้งเดิมถูกออกแบบสำหรับนักดาบที่อ่อนแอ ความสะดวกในการใช้งาน ทำให้มันเป็นอาวุธยอดนิยมสำหรับมือสังหารเช่นเดียวกัน ผู้ใช้สามารถเปลี่ยนชนิดของยาพิษที่อยู่ในนั้นได้อย่างอิสระ มือสังหารผู้มีประสบการณ์จึงมักจะพก กริชพิษหลายเล่มที่มีพิษแตกต่างกัน
raw.vi: Một con dao găm có nút bấm ẩn trên cán dao, khi bấm nút này lưỡi dao sẽ phủ đầy chất độc. Ban đầu con dao được thiết kế để làm vũ khí cho những kiếm sĩ non tay nhưng cách sử dụng dễ dàng đã khiến cho con dao này được rất nhiều sát thủ chọn làm vũ khí. Người sử dụng có thể thoải mái thay đổi loại độc dược gắn trong dao, do đó các sát thủ kỳ cựu thường mang theo nhiều Dao độc chứa nhiều loại độc khác nhau.

id: Senapan sihir yang dikembangkan zaman Republik Atalva kuno, terinspirasi oleh senapan milik pengunjung dari dunia lain. Dimanterai sihir hitam sehingga menimbulkan status lemah pada korbannya. Aslinya dirancang untuk memburu setan besar, fungsinya ternyata efektif untuk semua spesies, jadi digunakan dalam berbagai situasi. Cacatnya hanyalah waktu pembuatan amunisi sangat lama.
name: MST_SPHERES_31700_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A magic gun developed in the ancient Atalva Republilc, inspired by a gun belonging to a visitor from another world. Black magic was cast on it so that it inflicts the weak status on its victims. Originally designed for hunting down large demons, its functionality turned out to be effective on all species and thus was used in a wide range of situations. Its only flaw is how long it takes to make ammunition for it.

raw.en: A magic gun developed in the ancient Atalva Republilc, inspired by a gun belonging to a visitor from another world. Black magic was cast on it so that it inflicts the weak status on its victims. Originally designed for hunting down large demons, its functionality turned out to be effective on all species and thus was used in a wide range of situations. Its only flaw is how long it takes to make ammunition for it.
raw.es: Un arma mágica de la antigua república de Atalva cuyo diseño está inspirado en el de un fusil propiedad de un visitante de otro mundo. El fusil se imbuyó de magia negra para provocar Flaqueza en sus enemigos. Al principio se usaba para cazar demonios de gran tamaño, pero al probarse efectivo contra el resto de seres, su uso pronto se hizo extensivo a toda clase de enfrentamientos. Su único defecto es que tarda demasiado en recargarse.
raw.id: Senapan sihir yang dikembangkan zaman Republik Atalva kuno, terinspirasi oleh senapan milik pengunjung dari dunia lain. Dimanterai sihir hitam sehingga menimbulkan status lemah pada korbannya. Aslinya dirancang untuk memburu setan besar, fungsinya ternyata efektif untuk semua spesies, jadi digunakan dalam berbagai situasi. Cacatnya hanyalah waktu pembuatan amunisi sangat lama.
raw.pt: Uma arma mágica feita na antiga República de Atavla e inspirada por uma arma de um visitante de outro mundo. Magia negra foi colocada nela para causar fraqueza em suas vítimas. Originalmente foi feita para caçar grandes demônios, sua funcionalidade se mostrou eficiente contra qualquer espécie, então passou a ser usada em muitas situações. Seu único problema é o tempo que demora para fazer sua munição.
raw.th: ปืนเวทมนตร์ที่พัฒนาขึ้นในสมัยสาธารณรัฐอธาวาโบราณ ได้รับแรงบันดาลใจมาจากปืนของผู้มาเยือนจากโลกอื่น เวทมนตร์ดำถูกร่ายลงบนมัน เพื่อให้มันก่อสถานะอ่อนแอในเหยื่อ ดั้งเดิมถูกออกแบบมาสำหรับการล่าสัตว์ปีศาจขนาดใหญ่ แต่การทำงานของมันกลับมีประสิทธิภาพสำหรับทุกเผ่าพันธุ์ จึงถูกนำมาใช้ในหลากหลายสถานการณ์ มีข้อบกพร่องเพียงอย่างเดียวคือมันใช้เวลาที่นานมากที่จะผลิตกระสุนสำหรับมัน
raw.vi: Cây súng ma thuật được chế tác vào thời Cộng hòa Atalva cổ xưa, được lây cảm hứng từ một cây súng thuộc về một du khách đến từ thế giới khác. Phép thuật hắc ám đã được ếm lên cây súng để làm suy yếu nạn nhân. Ban đầu cây súng này được thiết kế để săn những con quỷ lớn, nhưng chức năng của nó còn có hiệu quả đối với tất cả các loài và do đó đã được sử dụng trong rất nhiều tình huống. Khuyết điểm duy nhất của cây súng này đó là khoảng thời gian dành để lên đạn.

id: Macheid adalah dokter yang mencoba menyelamatkan orang sebanyak mungkin. Ia membantu banyak pasien yang sakit dan terluka di medan perang. Sayangnya, ia tergoda untuk mengaku kalah saat para dewa menyerang. Yang ia selamatkan segera diambil dalam sekejap mata. Ketika akhirnya ia pulih dari putus asa, ia memakai semua pengetahuannya untuk membuat senjata mengerikan yang akan menginfeksi korbannya dengan penyakit mengerikan.
name: MST_SPHERES_31800_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Macheid was a doctor who strived to save as many people as he could. He helped countless patients who fell sick and got injured on the battle field. Unfortunately, even he was tempted to throw in the towel when the gods attacked. Those he saved were soon taken in the blink of an eye. When he finally recovered from this despair, he put all his knowledge into making a terrifying weapon which could infect its victim with a terrible disease.

raw.en: Macheid was a doctor who strived to save as many people as he could. He helped countless patients who fell sick and got injured on the battle field. Unfortunately, even he was tempted to throw in the towel when the gods attacked. Those he saved were soon taken in the blink of an eye. When he finally recovered from this despair, he put all his knowledge into making a terrifying weapon which could infect its victim with a terrible disease.
raw.es: Macheid fue un médico afanado en salvar vidas que curaba a quienes enfermaban o resultaban heridos en combate. Por desgracia, estuvo a punto de tirar la toalla cuando los dioses atacaron, pues estos aniquilaron en un abrir y cerrar de ojos a los pacientes que él había salvado. Cuando se recuperó de aquello, usó sus vastos conocimientos para crear un arma terrorífica que infecta al enemigo de una espantosa enfermedad.
raw.id: Macheid adalah dokter yang mencoba menyelamatkan orang sebanyak mungkin. Ia membantu banyak pasien yang sakit dan terluka di medan perang. Sayangnya, ia tergoda untuk mengaku kalah saat para dewa menyerang. Yang ia selamatkan segera diambil dalam sekejap mata. Ketika akhirnya ia pulih dari putus asa, ia memakai semua pengetahuannya untuk membuat senjata mengerikan yang akan menginfeksi korbannya dengan penyakit mengerikan.
raw.pt: Macheid foi um médico que queria salvar o máximo de vidas o possível. Ele ajudou inúmeros pacientes que adoeceram ou se feriram no campo de batalha. Infelizmente, até ele foi forçado a jogar a toalha quando os deuses atacaram. Aqueles que ele salvou foram mortos em um piscar de olhos. Quando ele finalmente se recuperou do sofrimento, aplicou todo seu conhecimento para fazer uma arma aterrorizante que poderia infectar as vítimas com uma doença horrível.
raw.th: มาเชด เป็นหมอที่พยายามจะช่วยคนจำนวนมากเท่าที่จะทำได้ เขาช่วยเหลือผู้ป่วยนับไม่ถ้วนที่ป่วยไข้และได้รับบาดเจ็บในสนามรบ แต่น่าเสียดายที่เขาถูกล่อลวงไปขังในหอคอยเมื่อถูกเทพเจ้าโจมตี ไม่นานพวกที่เขาช่วยเหลือก็ถูกกำจัดภายในชั่วพริบตา ในที่สุดเมื่อเขาฟื้นจากความสิ้นหวังนี้ เขาก็ได้นำความรู้ทั้งหมดมาสร้างอาวุธอันน่าสะพรึงกลัว ซึ่งทำให้เหยื่อนั้นติดเชื้อโรคร้าย
raw.vi: Macheid là một bác sĩ luôn cố gắng cật lực để cứu sống càng nhiều người càng tốt. Ông đã giúp đỡ không biết bao nhiêu bệnh nhân ốm đau và bị thương trên chiến trường. Tiếc thay, ngay cả ông cũng bị cuốn vào cuộc chiến với các vị thần. Những người từng được ông cứu sống đã sớm bị bắt chỉ trong nháy mắt. Khi ông cuối cùng cũng thoát khỏi nỗi tuyệt vọng, ông đã vận dụng toàn bộ hiểu biết của mình để chế tạo ra một vũ khí đáng sợ có thể lây nhiễm cho nạn nhân một căn bệnh vô cùng khủng khiếp

id: Dirancang dengan ujung berbentuk tidak biasa, tombak ini membuat gila orang yang menatapnya. Karena itu, orang-orang yang menghadapi tombak ini harus berusaha keras menghindarinya. Akibatnya, mereka menjadi cepat lelah. Asal Tombak Beast tidak diketahui, rumornya ini dibuat berdasarkan pengetahuan tentara yang berpengalaman.
name: MST_SPHERES_31900_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Designed with an unusually shaped tip, this spear is said to drive those who land their eyes on it mad. Because of this, those who face the spear must put forth extra effort in avoiding it which quickly tires them out. The Beast Spear's origins are unknown, but it's rumoured that it was crafted based on the knowledge of experienced soldiers.

raw.en: Designed with an unusually shaped tip, this spear is said to drive those who land their eyes on it mad. Because of this, those who face the spear must put forth extra effort in avoiding it which quickly tires them out. The Beast Spear's origins are unknown, but it's rumoured that it was crafted based on the knowledge of experienced soldiers.
raw.es: Se dice de esta lanza de punta curiosa que es capaz de hacer enloquecer a quienes posan sus ojos en ella. Por ese motivo, los enemigos de quien usa esta lanza en combate deben esforzarse en no mirarla, y acaban agotados. El origen de la lanza bestial es desconocido, pero se cuenta que para diseñarla se consultó a los soldados más curtidos en el campo de batalla.
raw.id: Dirancang dengan ujung berbentuk tidak biasa, tombak ini membuat gila orang yang menatapnya. Karena itu, orang-orang yang menghadapi tombak ini harus berusaha keras menghindarinya. Akibatnya, mereka menjadi cepat lelah. Asal Tombak Beast tidak diketahui, rumornya ini dibuat berdasarkan pengetahuan tentara yang berpengalaman.
raw.pt: Feita com uma ponta de forma estranha, dizem que esta lança enlouquece quem a vir. Por conta disso, quem enfrentar esta lança precisa se esforçar muito para evitá-la, o que é muito cansativo. A origem da Lança das Bestas é desconhecida, mas dizem que foi feita com base no conhecimento de soldados experientes.
raw.th: เป็นหอกที่ได้รับการออกแบบมา ด้วยรูปลักษณ์ปลายแหลมที่ไม่ปกติ ว่ากันว่ามันจะทำให้ใครก็ตามที่มองกลายเป็นบ้า ด้วยเหตุนี้ใครที่เผชิญหน้ากับหอกจะต้องใช้ความพยายามอย่างพิเศษในการหลีกเลี่ยงมัน ซึ่งทำให้พวกเขาอ่อนแรงอย่างรวดเร็ว ต้นกำเนิดของหอกสมิงยังไม่มีใครรู้ แต่มีข่าวลือว่ามันถูกสร้างขึ้นมาบนพื้นฐานความรู้ของทหารที่มีประสบการณ์
raw.vi: Được chế tạo với ngọn thương có hình dáng kỳ lạ, cây thương này được đồn đại là có thể khiến những ai nhìn vào nó phát điên. Chính bởi điều này mà những ai đối diện với cây thương này đều phải nỗ lực hết mình để tránh nhìn vào cây thương và điều này nhanh chóng khiến họ kiệt sức. Không ai biết nguồn gốc của Cây thương Quais vật, nhưng người ta đồn rằng cây thương này đã được chế tác dựa trên sự hiểu bết của những chiến binh lão luyện nhất.

id: Di Kekaisaran Bariula, sebelum dihancurkan para dewa, ada banyak kasus orang tak bersalah dieksekusi. Ragu Blaze, pemegang Sabel Kutuk, adalah salah satunya, namun kekuatan sihir istimewanya membuatnya unggul. Saat hampir dieksekusi, ia melemparkan kutukan yang membungkus pedang si algojo, dan lahirlah Sabel Kutuk.
name: MST_SPHERES_32000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: In the Bariula Empire, before the gods destroyed it, there were many cases of innocents being executed. Ragu Blaze, the wielder of the Cursed Sabre, was said to be one of them, but his extraordinary magic powers set him apart. At the brink of execution he set a curse which enveloped the executioner's sword, resulting in the birth of a Cursed Sabre.

raw.en: In the Bariula Empire, before the gods destroyed it, there were many cases of innocents being executed. Ragu Blaze, the wielder of the Cursed Sabre, was said to be one of them, but his extraordinary magic powers set him apart. At the brink of execution he set a curse which enveloped the executioner's sword, resulting in the birth of a Cursed Sabre.
raw.es: Antes de que los dioses arrasaran el imperio de Bariula, allí era común ajusticiar inocentes. Se cuenta que Ragu Blaze, creador del sable maldito y uno de estos falsos acusados, se libró de morir gracias a sus extraordinarios poderes mágicos. Cuando lo iban a ejecutar, lanzó un conjuro contra la espada de su ejecutor y la convirtió en el sable maldito.
raw.id: Di Kekaisaran Bariula, sebelum dihancurkan para dewa, ada banyak kasus orang tak bersalah dieksekusi. Ragu Blaze, pemegang Sabel Kutuk, adalah salah satunya, namun kekuatan sihir istimewanya membuatnya unggul. Saat hampir dieksekusi, ia melemparkan kutukan yang membungkus pedang si algojo, dan lahirlah Sabel Kutuk.
raw.pt: No Império Bariula, antes de ser destruído pelos deuses, houve muitos casos de execuções de inocentes. Dizem que Ragu Blaze, o dono do Sabre Maldito, foi um deles, mas seus poderes mágicos extraordinários o destacaram. Prestes a ser executado, ele lançou uma maldição que envolveu a espada do carrasco, resultando no nascimento de um Sabre Maldito.
raw.th: ในจักรวรรดิบาริอุละ ก่อนที่เทพเจ้าจะทำลายมัน มีหลายกรณีที่ผู้บริสุทธิ์ถูกสังหาร ว่ากันว่า รากู เบลซ ผู้ครอบครอง 'ดาบต้องสาป' เป็นหนึ่งในนั้นด้วย แต่ด้วยอำนาจเวทมนตร์ที่ไม่ธรรมดาทำให้เขาแตกต่างจากคนอื่นๆ ในช่วงวินาทีที่ถูกสังหาร เขาได้เอ่ยคำสาปแช่งซึ่งปกคลุมดาบเพชฌฆาตที่มีผลในการกำเนิดของดาบต้องสาป
raw.vi: Trong Đế chế Bariula, trước thời điểm bị các vị thần hủy diệt đã có rất nhiều trường hợp những người vô tội bị hành quyết. Ragu Blaze, người sử dụng Thanh đao bị Nguyền rủa, được đồn rằng cũng nằm trong số những người vô tội kia, nhưng những quyền năng pháp thuật kỳ diệu của ông đã cứu ông sống sót. Vào lúc cận kề miệng tử thần, ông đã đặt một lời nguyền bao bọc quanh thanh gươm của đao phủ, từ đó sinh ra Thanh đao bị Nguyền rủa.

id: Di tanah Republik Atarva kuno, ada ngarai yang terkena badai guntur sepanjang tahun. Hanya ada satu pria yang berani menghadapi bahaya untuk mencoba membuat busur legendarisnya. Busur yang ia buat dapat menyerap petir, masuk ke panahnya, sehingga menyebabkan lumpuh berkat kekuatan sambaran petirnya yang kuat.
name: MST_SPHERES_32100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: In the lands of the ancient Atarva Republic, there was a canyon that experienced thunderstorms year-round. There was only a single man willing to brave the danger there in attempts to forge his legendary bow. The bow he crafted could absorb lightning, embedding it into its arrows, inflicting paralysis with its powerful lightning bolt force.

raw.en: In the lands of the ancient Atarva Republic, there was a canyon that experienced thunderstorms year-round. There was only a single man willing to brave the danger there in attempts to forge his legendary bow. The bow he crafted could absorb lightning, embedding it into its arrows, inflicting paralysis with its powerful lightning bolt force.
raw.es: En la antigua república de Atalva existía un cañón donde todos los días se producían violentas tormentas. Hubo un valiente que se atrevió a desafiar aquellos peligrosos temporales para fabricar este arco legendario. El arma es capaz de absorber el poder del trueno para luego imbuir de él sus flechas y provocar Parálisis con sus potentes proyectiles.
raw.id: Di tanah Republik Atarva kuno, ada ngarai yang terkena badai guntur sepanjang tahun. Hanya ada satu pria yang berani menghadapi bahaya untuk mencoba membuat busur legendarisnya. Busur yang ia buat dapat menyerap petir, masuk ke panahnya, sehingga menyebabkan lumpuh berkat kekuatan sambaran petirnya yang kuat.
raw.pt: Nas terras da antiga República de Atarva, havia um cânion com tempestades elétricas o tempo todo. Só houve um homem que quis enfrentar o perigo para tentar criar seu arco lendário. O arco que ele fez pode absorver raios e transferí-los para as flechas, causando paralizia com sua grande potência elétrica.
raw.th: ในดินแดนของสาธารณรัฐอธาวาโบราณ มีหุบเขาที่เกิดเหตุการณ์พายุฝนฟ้าคะนองตลอดทั้งปี มีเพียงคนเดียวที่กล้าหาญ เต็มใจเสี่ยงอันตรายเพื่อไปหลอมคันธนูในตำนานของเขา คันธนูที่เขาสร้างขึ้นสามารถดูดซับสายฟ้า และส่งผ่านไปยังลูกศรของมัน ทำให้เกิดอาการอัมพาตด้วยพลังสายฟ้าที่มีประสิทธิภาพ
raw.vi: Tại những vùng đất của Cộng hòa Atarva cổ xưa, có một hẻm núi quanh năm giông bão. Nơi đó chỉ có một người duy nhất cam lòng đối mặt với hiểm nguy, nỗ lực rèn nên cây cung huyền thoại. Cây cung này có thể hấp thụ tia sét, gắn tia sét đó lên mũi tên, gây tê liệt đối phương với sức mạnh tia chớp đầy quyền uy.

id: Baju khusus yang dikembangkan di Kekaisaran Bariula yang dihancurkan para dewa. Biasanya berbentuk tameng, begitu dipasang, menyerap kekuatan pemakainya dan selubuh sihir terbentuk, membungkus tubuh si pemakai. Selubung ini melindungi dan menambah pertahanan si pemakai terhadap semua serangan. Produksi massal sulit dilakukan, sehingga ini adalah barang langka dan hanya dimiliki oleh beberapa institusi di Kekaisaran.
name: MST_SPHERES_32200_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A special robe developed in the Bariula Empire that the gods violently destroyed. It usually takes the form of a shield, but once equipped it absorbs the power of its user and a magic veil forms and envelopes the user's body. The veil protects and boosts the user's defence against all attacks. However, mass producing it proved to be difficult, making it a rare item that only a few institutions in the Empire could own.

raw.en: A special robe developed in the Bariula Empire that the gods violently destroyed. It usually takes the form of a shield, but once equipped it absorbs the power of its user and a magic veil forms and envelopes the user's body. The veil protects and boosts the user's defence against all attacks. However, mass producing it proved to be difficult, making it a rare item that only a few institutions in the Empire could own.
raw.es: Una capa especial confeccionada en el destrozado imperio de Bariula. Suele adoptar la forma de un escudo, pero cuando alguien se la pone, la capa absorbe el poder de su portador y forma con él un velo protector que envuelve su cuerpo. Este velo lo protege y aumenta su defensa ante cualquier ataque. Es muy difícil confeccionarla en grandes cantidades, lo que la convierte en un objeto inusual que pocos en el imperio han logrado ponerse.
raw.id: Baju khusus yang dikembangkan di Kekaisaran Bariula yang dihancurkan para dewa. Biasanya berbentuk tameng, begitu dipasang, menyerap kekuatan pemakainya dan selubuh sihir terbentuk, membungkus tubuh si pemakai. Selubung ini melindungi dan menambah pertahanan si pemakai terhadap semua serangan. Produksi massal sulit dilakukan, sehingga ini adalah barang langka dan hanya dimiliki oleh beberapa institusi di Kekaisaran.
raw.pt: Uma túnica especial desenvolvida no Império Bariula que os deuses destruíram com violência. Ela normalmente assume a forma de um escudo, mas depois de equipada, ela absorve o poder do usuário e forma um véu mágico que envolve o corpo. Esse véu protege e melhora a defesa do usuário contra todos os ataques. No entanto, a produção em massa dela se provou difícil, tornando-a um item raro que poucas instituições do império podiam ter.
raw.th: เสื้อคลุมพิเศษที่พัฒนาขึ้นในจักรวรรดิบาริอุละที่ถูกเทพเจ้าทำลายอย่างรุนแรง รูปลักษณ์ปกติของมันจะมีลักษณะเป็นโล่ แต่เมื่อถูกสวมใส่จะมีการดูดซับพลังงานของผู้ใช้ และห่อหุ้มปกคลุมร่างกายในรูปแบบผ้าคลุมวิเศษ ทำให้มีม่านพลังปกป้องและช่วยเพิ่มการป้องกันผู้ใช้จากการโจมตีทั้งหมด แต่อย่างไรก็ตามการผลิตจำนวนมากนั้นทำได้ยากลำบาก ทำให้มันเป็นของหายาก และมีเพียงไม่กี่หน่วยงานในราชอาณาจักรสามารถเป็นเจ้าของมันได้
raw.vi: Một chiếc áo choàng đặc biệt được chế tác tại Đế chế Bariula, nơi đã bị các vị thần hủy dệt một cách thô bạo. Chiếc áo choàng này thường mang hình dạng một tấm khiên, nhưng một khi mang trên người nó sẽ hấp thụ sức mạnh của người sử dụng, tạo nên một lớp màn ma thuật và bao bọc cơ thể của người sử dụng. Tuy nhiên, việc sản xuất hàng loạt chiếc áo choàng này không hề dễ dàng do đó đây là một món đồ hiếm mà chỉ có một vài thể chế trong Đế chế mới có thể sở hữu

id: Kain khusus yang dianggap pusaka nasional dari Kekaisaran Agni yang dihancurkan pada dewa. Biasanya berbentuk tameng, namun jika diberi mantera ningrat, berubah menjadi tameng tak tertembus di sekitar tubuh pemakainya. Tameng khusus ini mengeluarkan kekuatan hebat, mengurangi kerusakan akibat serangan fisik oleh pedang, panah, sihir, dan kutukan, meski saksi mata bentuk aslinya sedikit.
name: MST_SPHERES_32201_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A special cloth that is regarded as a national treasure of the destroyed Agni Empire. It usually takes the form of a shield, but when the royal spell is chanted, it transforms into an impenetrable armor around the user's body. It's said that this special armor exudes incredible power, reducing damage received from physical attacks by swords, arrows, magic and even curses, though few have witnessed its actual form.

raw.en: A special cloth that is regarded as a national treasure of the destroyed Agni Empire. It usually takes the form of a shield, but when the royal spell is chanted, it transforms into an impenetrable armor around the user's body. It's said that this special armor exudes incredible power, reducing damage received from physical attacks by swords, arrows, magic and even curses, though few have witnessed its actual form.
raw.es: Una tela especial que se considera  tesoro nacional en el destruido imperio de Agní. Suele adoptar la forma de un escudo pero, cuando se lanza el hechizo real, se transforma en una armadura impenetrable que envuelve el cuerpo de quien la lleva puesta. Se dice que el poder de esta armadura es tal que logra reducir el daño provocado por espadas, flechas, magia y maldiciones. Sin embargo, pocos han logrado verla en acción.
raw.id: Kain khusus yang dianggap pusaka nasional dari Kekaisaran Agni yang dihancurkan pada dewa. Biasanya berbentuk tameng, namun jika diberi mantera ningrat, berubah menjadi tameng tak tertembus di sekitar tubuh pemakainya. Tameng khusus ini mengeluarkan kekuatan hebat, mengurangi kerusakan akibat serangan fisik oleh pedang, panah, sihir, dan kutukan, meski saksi mata bentuk aslinya sedikit.
raw.pt: Um tecido especial considerado tesouro nacional do antigo Império Agni. Normalmente assume a forma de um escudo, mas quando o encanto real é usado, ela se transforma em uma armadura impenetrável em torno do usuário. Dizem que esta armadura tem um poder incrível que reduz o dano recebido de ataques físicos que usam espadas, flechas, magia e até maldições. Poucos já viram sua forma real.
raw.th: เสื้อพิเศษที่ถือได้ว่าเป็นสมบัติของจักรวรรดิแอคนีที่ถูกทำลาย รูปลักษณ์ปกติของจะมีลักษณะเป็นโล่ แต่เมื่อสวดคาถาหลวง มันจะเปลี่ยนเป็นเกราะล้อมรอบร่างกายของผู้ใช้ที่ไม่มีทางจะทะลุทะลวงได้ ว่ากันว่าชุดเกราะพิเศษนี้แผ่พลังอำนาจอย่างไม่น่าเชื่อ และลดความเสียหายที่ได้รับจากการโจมตีทางกายภาพไม่ว่าจะเป็นดาบ, ลูกศร, เวทมนตร์ และแม้แต่คำสาป แต่มีเพียงไม่กี่คนได้เห็นรูปลักษณ์ที่แท้จริงของมัน
raw.vi: Một bộ phục trang đặc biệt, được xem là bảo vật quốc gia của Đế chế đã bị hủy diệt Agni. Bộ phục trang này thường mang hình dạng của một chiếc khiên nhưng khi câu thần chú hoàng gia được hô vang, sẽ biến hình thành một bộ giáp bất khả xâm phạm bao quanh cơ thể người mặc. Người ta đồn rằng bộ giáo đặc biệt này có khả năng vô cùng kỳ diệu, giảm thương tổn gây ra từ những đòn tấn công vào thân thể bởi gươm, cung tên, phép thuật và thậm chí cả lời nguyền, mặc dù gần như chưa ai từng được thấy hình dạng thật của nó.

id: Saat Pisau Astro dilahirkan, bukan sekedar pedang panjang biasa. Melalui banyak perang, pisau memproduksi sinar langit, membuka kekuatan tersembunyi dari dalam ahli pedang yang memakainya. Karena itu ia dikenal sebagai Pisau Astro. Namun setelah si ahli pedang menemui takdirnya, sejak itu tidak ada pemegang yang mampu mengeluarkan sinar langitnya.
name: MST_SPHERES_32900_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: When the Star Blade was born, it was little more than a common long sword. However, it is said that through numerous battles the blade produced a celestial glow, unlocking a hidden power from within the swordsman who wielded it. For that reason it came to be known as the Star Blade, but after the swordsman met his fate, from that point forward no one who wielded it was able to unleash it's heavenly glow.

raw.en: When the Star Blade was born, it was little more than a common long sword. However, it is said that through numerous battles the blade produced a celestial glow, unlocking a hidden power from within the swordsman who wielded it. For that reason it came to be known as the Star Blade, but after the swordsman met his fate, from that point forward no one who wielded it was able to unleash it's heavenly glow.
raw.es: La hoja estelar tiene el aspecto de una espada común y corriente, pero las apariencias engañan. Su dueño luchó en numerosas batallas, en las que la hoja desprendía un brillo celestial que desataba un poder oculto en el espadachín. De ahí tomó su nombre. Por desgracia, desde que el espadachín pasó a mejor vida, nadie ha vuelto a hacerla refulgir.
raw.id: Saat Pisau Astro dilahirkan, bukan sekedar pedang panjang biasa. Melalui banyak perang, pisau memproduksi sinar langit, membuka kekuatan tersembunyi dari dalam ahli pedang yang memakainya. Karena itu ia dikenal sebagai Pisau Astro. Namun setelah si ahli pedang menemui takdirnya, sejak itu tidak ada pemegang yang mampu mengeluarkan sinar langitnya.
raw.pt: Quando a Lâmina Estelar estelar nasceu, não era muito mais do que uma espada longa comum. No entanto, dizem que ela adquiriu um brilho celestial depois de passar por muitas batalhas, liberando um poder oculto do espadachim que a usava. Por este motivo ela ficou conhecida como Lâmina Estelar, mas ninguém mais conseguiu liberar seu brilho celestial depois da morte do espadachim.
raw.th: เมื่อ 'สตาร์เบลด' ถือกำเนิดขึ้น มันก็ไม่ต่างจากดาบยาวที่พบได้ทั่วไป อย่างไรก็ตามว่ากันว่าเมื่อผ่านการต่อสู้เป็นจำนวนมาก คมของมันจะส่องประกายแสงสวรรค์ ปลดปล่อยพลังที่ซ่อนอยู่ภายในของนักดาบที่ใช้มัน และเป็นเหตุผลที่มันรู้จักกันในนามของสตาร์เบลด แต่หลังจากที่นักดาบได้พบกับจุดจบ หลังจากนั้นเป็นต้นมาก็ไม่มีผู้ใดสามารถทำให้มันปลดปล่อยแสงสวรรค์ได้อีกต่อไป
raw.vi: Khi Thanh gươm Ngôi sao ra đời, nó chỉ là một thanh gươm dài thông thường. Tuy nhiên, người ta đồn rằng qua hàng loạt trận chiến thanh gươm này đã tỏa ánh sáng rực rỡ từ thiên đường, giải phóng sức mạnh tiềm ẩn bên trong kiếm sĩ. Vì lý do này mà thanh gươm được biết đến với cái tên Thanh gươm Ngôi sao, nhưng sau khi kiếm sĩ sử dụng thanh kiếm này gặp được định mệnh của mình thì kể từ đó về sau không một ai sử dụng thanh gươm có thể giải phóng ánh sáng rực rỡ thiên đường ngày nào.

id: Ketika para dewa menginvasi tanah manusia, banyak orang yang terlalu takut untuk bertindak. Namun ada Enam Pahlawan yang mencari kemenangan melalui serial perang berskala kecil. Logo kemenangan mereka tersebar di seluruh negeri, memacu rakyat di mana saja. Selanjutnya, logo tersebut dibawa ke setiap medan perang, menjadi sumber inspirasi para tentara.
name: MST_SPHERES_33000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: When the gods invaded the land of humans many people were too afraid to take action. However, among those people existed the Six Heroes who sought victory through a series of small scale battles. Their crest of victory was spread throughout the lands, encouraging people everywhere. Later it would be carried onto every battlefield, becoming a source of inspiration for soldiers.

raw.en: When the gods invaded the land of humans many people were too afraid to take action. However, among those people existed the Six Heroes who sought victory through a series of small scale battles. Their crest of victory was spread throughout the lands, encouraging people everywhere. Later it would be carried onto every battlefield, becoming a source of inspiration for soldiers.
raw.es: Cuando los dioses invadieron el mundo de los humanos, muchos fueron incapaces de reaccionar. Sin embargo, hubo un grupo de valientes, los Seis Héroes, que se enfrentaron a los invasores en batallas a pequeña escala. El blasón conmemorativo de sus victorias se extendió por varios territorios como símbolo de esperanza para los humanos. Más adelante, se hizo costumbre portarlo al campo de batalla para servir de inspiración a los soldados.
raw.id: Ketika para dewa menginvasi tanah manusia, banyak orang yang terlalu takut untuk bertindak. Namun ada Enam Pahlawan yang mencari kemenangan melalui serial perang berskala kecil. Logo kemenangan mereka tersebar di seluruh negeri, memacu rakyat di mana saja. Selanjutnya, logo tersebut dibawa ke setiap medan perang, menjadi sumber inspirasi para tentara.
raw.pt: Quando os deuses invadiram a terra dos humanos, muitos tinham muito medo de agir. No entanto, entre essas pessoas existia um grupo de Seis Heróis que buscaram a vitória com uma série de batalhas de pequena escala. Seu brasão da vitória foi espalhado por todos os lados, encorajando as pessoas. Depois ela seria levada para todas as batalhas, se tornando uma fonte de inspiração para os soldados.
raw.th: เมื่อเทพเจ้าบุกดินแดนของมนุษย์ หลายคนกลัวที่จะทำการใดๆ แต่ในหมู่คนเหล่านั้นมีอยู่หกวีรบุรุษที่แสวงหาชัยชนะ ผ่านการสู้รบขนาดเล็ก ชัยชนะของพวกได้แพร่กระจายไปยังทั่วดินแดน และเป็นกำลังใจให้กับผู้คน หลังจากนั้นตราแห่งชัยชนะของพวกเขา ก็จะได้รับการกล่าวขานไปยังทุกสนามรบ และกลายเป็นแหล่งที่มาของแรงบันดาลใจสำหรับเหล่าทหาร
raw.vi: Khi các vị thần xâm chiếm vùng đất mà loài người sinh sống, rất nhiều người đã quá sợ hãi mà không phản kháng. Tuy nhiên, trong số đó có Sáu vị Anh hùng đã nỗ lực giành chiến thắng qua hàng loạt các trận đánh ở quy mô nhỏ. Lời ca ngợi về chiến thắng của họ đã vang xa khắp các vùng đất, cổ vũ mọi người từ khắp nơi nơi. Sau đó nó còn được nói đến trong mọi trận chiến, trở thành nguồn cảm hứng cho các chiến binh.

id: Akhir perang dengan para dewa sudah dekat, Kekaisaran Agni perlahan sadar akan kekalahan yang tak dapat dihindari. Ketakutan ini menyebar dari komandan ke tentara, ke petani, dan kekaisaran mulai panik. Sang ratu waktu itu menaikkan benderanya dan menginspirasi rakyat. Ketahanan teguh sang ratu mengingatkan rakyat akan kesucian kemanusiaan dan itulah kekuatan di balik serangan balik mereka.
name: MST_SPHERES_33001_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: As the end of the battle with the gods drew near, the Agni Empire slowly became aware of their inevitable defeat. As this fear spread spread from commander, to soldier, to peasant, and the empire was in the grips of panic, it was the queen at the time who raised her flag and inspired the people. The queen's firm resilience reminded the people of the sanctity of their humanity, and was the force behind their final counterattack.

raw.en: As the end of the battle with the gods drew near, the Agni Empire slowly became aware of their inevitable defeat. As this fear spread spread from commander, to soldier, to peasant, and the empire was in the grips of panic, it was the queen at the time who raised her flag and inspired the people. The queen's firm resilience reminded the people of the sanctity of their humanity, and was the force behind their final counterattack.
raw.es: A medida que el fin de la guerra contra los dioses se acercaba, el imperio de Agní tuvo que asumir su derrota. El miedo atenazó los corazones de comandantes, soldados y campesinos, y dejó el imperio paralizado. Fue entonces cuando la emperatriz de la época se irguió como inspiración de su pueblo, blasón en mano. Su firme determinación recordó a su pueblo la inviolabilidad de su condición humana y sirvió de aliciente para el contraataque.
raw.id: Akhir perang dengan para dewa sudah dekat, Kekaisaran Agni perlahan sadar akan kekalahan yang tak dapat dihindari. Ketakutan ini menyebar dari komandan ke tentara, ke petani, dan kekaisaran mulai panik. Sang ratu waktu itu menaikkan benderanya dan menginspirasi rakyat. Ketahanan teguh sang ratu mengingatkan rakyat akan kesucian kemanusiaan dan itulah kekuatan di balik serangan balik mereka.
raw.pt: Com o final da batalha contra os deuses chegando ao fim, o Império Agni conseguiu compreender que sua derrota era inevitável. Conforme o medo se espalhou entre todos e o império estava dominado pelo pânico, a rainha foi quem ergueu a bandeira e inspirou seu povo. A grande resistência da rainha lembrou o povo da santidade de sua humanidade e foi a força por trás do seu último contra-ataque.
raw.th: เมื่อจุดสิ้นสุดของการต่อสู้กับเทพเจ้าใกล้เข้ามา จักรวรรดิแอคนีเริ่มตระหนักถึงความพ่ายแพ้ที่หลีกเลี่ยงไม่ได้ของพวกเขา ในขณะที่ความกลัวแพร่กระจายจากผู้บัญชาการสู่ทหาร สู่ประชาชนและอาณาจักร ทั้งหมดก็ตกอยู่ในห้วงความตื่นตระหนก ในตอนนั้นเองที่ราชินีโบกธงของเธอ และสร้างแรงบันดาลใจให้กับผู้คน ความเชื่อมั่นของราชินี ย้ำเตือนผู้คนถึงศักดิ์ศรีของความเป็นมนุษย์ของพวกเขา และเป็นแรงผลักดันให้เหล่ามนุษย์ตอบโต้กลับเป็นครั้งสุดท้าย
raw.vi: Khi cuộc chiến với các bị thần đã đến ngày vãn hồi, Đế chế Agni dần dần nhận thức được sự thất bại không thể chối cãi của mình. Và khi nỗi sợ hãi này lan rộng từ những người chỉ huy, sang những chiến binh, những người nông dân, và đế chế chìm trong nỗi hoảng loạn, thì vào thời điểm đó chính nữ hoàng đỡ giương cao ngọn cờ và truyền cảm hứng cho người dân. Sự bền bỉ vững chãi của nữ hoàng đã nhắc nhở người dân về sự thiêng liêng của lòng nhân đạo, và là động lực của trận phản công cuối cùng.

id: Zaman dahulu, ada komandan agung bernama Ares, pria yang kehadirannya saja sudah memberi dirinya energi pasukannya dan ketakutan para musuhnya. Tujuannya adalah menggunakan kekuatannya untuk menang tanpa perang, dan inilah motivasi yang ditaruhnya saat membuat logo. Katanya, saat logo ini dinaikkan, pasukan musuh akan kabur, takut karena inferior.
name: MST_SPHERES_33400_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Long ago, there was a great commander known as Ares, a man whose presence alone granted him both the energy of his troops, and the fear of his enemies. His aim was to use his power to bring victory without battle, and it's this motivation he put into making his crest. It is told that when this crest was raised, enemy troops would flee in fear of their own inferiority.

raw.en: Long ago, there was a great commander known as Ares, a man whose presence alone granted him both the energy of his troops, and the fear of his enemies. His aim was to use his power to bring victory without battle, and it's this motivation he put into making his crest. It is told that when this crest was raised, enemy troops would flee in fear of their own inferiority.
raw.es: Hace mucho vivió un gran comandante llamado Ares, cuya imponente presencia inspiraba confianza entre sus soldados y miedo entre sus enemigos. Tenía como objetivo lograr victorias sin combatir, y quiso que ese afán se viera reflejado en su blasón. Cuentan que, cuando el blasón aparece en el campo de batalla, los enemigos huyen temiendo ser inferiores.
raw.id: Zaman dahulu, ada komandan agung bernama Ares, pria yang kehadirannya saja sudah memberi dirinya energi pasukannya dan ketakutan para musuhnya. Tujuannya adalah menggunakan kekuatannya untuk menang tanpa perang, dan inilah motivasi yang ditaruhnya saat membuat logo. Katanya, saat logo ini dinaikkan, pasukan musuh akan kabur, takut karena inferior.
raw.pt: Há muito tempo houve um grande comandante chamado Ares, um homem cuja presença por si só já gerava energia em suas tropas e medo em seus inimigos. O objetivo dele era usar seu poder para vencer sem batalhar e foi esta motivação que ele usou ao fazer o próprio brasão. Dizem que quando este brasão é erguido, tropas inimigas fogem de medo por sua inferioridade.
raw.th: นานมาแล้วมีผู้บัญชาการที่ยิ่งใหญ่รู้จักกันในนามของ เอรีส ยามที่เขาปรากฏตัวกองทัพของเขาก็จะได้รับพลัง รวมไปถึงสร้างความหวาดกลัวให้กับศัตรูของเขาจุดมุ่งหมายของเขาคือการใช้อำนาจเพื่อนำชัยชนะโดยไม่ต้องต่อสู้ และเป็นแรงจูงใจที่ทำให้เขาสร้าง 'ตราเอรีส' ขึ้นมา ว่ากันว่ามันเมื่อตรานี้ถูกชูขึ้น เหล่าทัพของศัตรู ก็จะแตกทัพหนีไปด้วยความหวาดกลัวในความอ่อนแอของตัวเอง
raw.vi: Rất lâu trước kia, có một vị chỉ huy vĩ đại tên Ares, người mà sự hiện diện của chỉ mình ông thôi cũng tượng trưng cho sức mạnh của cả binh đoàn do ông chỉ huy và là nỗi sợ hãi của mọi kẻ thù. Mục đích của ông là sử dụng quyền lực của mình để mang lại chiến thắng mà không phải trải qua chiến trận, và chính độc lực này đã thúc đẩy ông giương cao gia huy. Truyện kể lại rằng khi gia huy của ông được giương cao, những binh đoàn kẻ thù chạy trốn trong nỗi sợ hãi  về sự thua kém của chính binh đoàn mình.

id: Baju unik dengan kemampuan khusus menyerap sisa terakhir vitalitas musuh yang jatuh. Meski mirip baju yang dipakai penyihir dari Kekaisaran Bariula, tidak ada catatan sejarah tentang baju khusus ini. Oleh karena itu, baju ini diduga dibuat oleh grup rahasia di dalam kekaisaran, walau tidak ada bukti grup semacam itu memang ada.
name: MST_SPHERES_33500_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A unique robe with the special ability to soak up the last remaining vitality of fallen enemies. Though it looks similar to robes worn by sorcerers from the long lost Bariula Empire, there is no record of this specific robe. Because of this it is thought that the robe was created by a secret group within the empire, though no proof of such an organization exists.

raw.en: A unique robe with the special ability to soak up the last remaining vitality of fallen enemies. Though it looks similar to robes worn by sorcerers from the long lost Bariula Empire, there is no record of this specific robe. Because of this it is thought that the robe was created by a secret group within the empire, though no proof of such an organization exists.
raw.es: Una extraordinaria capa que se empapa de la poca vitalidad que le quede a un enemigo caído. Se parece a las capas que llevaban los hechiceros del antiguo imperio de Bariula, aunque de esta no hay constancia en ningún archivo. Por eso, se cree que fue confeccionada por una organización secreta dentro del imperio, aunque no hay pruebas de su existencia.
raw.id: Baju unik dengan kemampuan khusus menyerap sisa terakhir vitalitas musuh yang jatuh. Meski mirip baju yang dipakai penyihir dari Kekaisaran Bariula, tidak ada catatan sejarah tentang baju khusus ini. Oleh karena itu, baju ini diduga dibuat oleh grup rahasia di dalam kekaisaran, walau tidak ada bukti grup semacam itu memang ada.
raw.pt: Uma túnica única com a habilidade especial de absorver a última gota de vitalidade de inimigos derrotados. Embora pareça com túnicas usadas pelos feiticeiros do antigo Império Bariula, não há registros sobre esta túnica específica. Por conta disso, acham que ela foi criada por um grupo secreto do império, embota não haja provas da existência dessa organização.
raw.th: เสื้อคลุมที่มีเอกลักษณ์ที่พิเศษมีความสามารถในการดูดซับพลังสุดท้ายที่เหลือของศัตรูที่พ่ายแพ้ แม้ว่ามันจะมีลักษณะคล้ายกับเสื้อคลุมที่สวมใส่โดยพ่อมดจากจักรวรรดิบาริอุละที่หายไปนาน  มันก็ไม่มีบันทึกของเสื้อคลุมที่ตัวดังกล่าวนี้ ด้วยเหตุนี้ มันจึงถูกคิดว่าเป็นเสื้อคลุมที่ถูกสร้างขึ้นโดยกลุ่มลับภายในอาณาจักร แต่ก็ไม่มีหลักฐานขององค์กรดังกล่าวปรากฏให้เห็น
raw.vi: Chiếc áo choàng độc nhất vô nhị với khả năng đặc biệt đó là rút cạn chút sinh khí còn sót lại sau cùng của kẻ bại trận. Mặc dù chiếc áo choàng này nhìn giống với những chiếc mà các thầy phù thủy từ Đế chế lâu đời Bariula thường mặc, nhưng không có bất kỳ ghi chép nào về chiếc áo này. Bởi lý do này mà người ta cho rằng chiếc áo choàng được tạo ra bởi một hội kín trong đế chế, cho dù không hề có bằng chứng nào cho thấy sự tồn tại của hội này.

id: Baju berornamen mengerikan ini ketat membungkus pemakainya, menyamarkan identitas si pemakai. Katanya dikirim dari dunia bawah karena direndam sihir jahat yang memulihkan vitalitas pemakainya saat musuh dikalahkan. Mungkin dianggap setan, tetapi banyak dicari karena langka.
name: MST_SPHERES_33501_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This ominously ornamented robe tightly wraps its wearer with it's unique fit, completely concealing their identity. It's said to have been sent from the underworld due to it being soaked in a malicious magic that recovers the wearer's vitality when an enemy is defeated. It may be considered demonic, but there are still many who search for it due to how rare it is.

raw.en: This ominously ornamented robe tightly wraps its wearer with it's unique fit, completely concealing their identity. It's said to have been sent from the underworld due to it being soaked in a malicious magic that recovers the wearer's vitality when an enemy is defeated. It may be considered demonic, but there are still many who search for it due to how rare it is.
raw.es: Esta capa de aspecto ominoso envuelve a quien se la pone para ocultar completamente su identidad. Cuentan que fue enviada aquí desde el inframundo porque sobre ella pesaba un maléfico sortilegio. Quien la lleva puesta recupera vitalidad cuando derrota a un enemigo. Por ello, muchos ansían tenerla aunque esté considerada como un objeto demoníaco.
raw.id: Baju berornamen mengerikan ini ketat membungkus pemakainya, menyamarkan identitas si pemakai. Katanya dikirim dari dunia bawah karena direndam sihir jahat yang memulihkan vitalitas pemakainya saat musuh dikalahkan. Mungkin dianggap setan, tetapi banyak dicari karena langka.
raw.pt: Esta túnica adornada assustadoramente envolve o usuário com ajuste único, ocultando totalmente sua identidade. Dizem que foi enviada do submundo por ser banhada por magia maligna que recupera a vitalidade do usuário quando derrota um inimigo. Pode ser considerada demoníaca, mas ainda há muitos que procuram por ela devido a sua raridade.
raw.th: เสื้อคลุมที่ห่อหุ่มผู้สวมใส่อย่างแน่นหนา ด้วยความพอดีที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์ ปกปิดตัวตนของพวกเขาอย่างสมบูรณ์แบบ ว่ากันว่ามันถูกส่งมาจากนรกเพราะมันชุ่มไปด้วยเวทมนตร์ที่เป็นอันตราย ซึ่งฟื้นฟูพลังชีวิตให้กับผู้สวมใส่ เมื่อศัตรูพ่ายแพ้ มันอาจจะถือว่าเป็นปีศาจ แต่ยังคงมีหลายคนที่เฝ้าค้นหา เนื่องจากความหายากของมัน
raw.vi: Chiếc áo choàng này quấn chặt quanh người mặc một cách vừa vặn mà không chiếc áo nào có được, che dấu hoàn toàn nhân dạng của người mặc. Người ta đồn rằng chiếc áo này đã được gửi từ thế giới ngầm do nó đã được bao trùm trong ma thuật hiểm độc, hồi phục sinh khí của người mặc khi kẻ thù bị đánh bại. Chiếc áo này có thể được xem là xuất quỷ nhập thần, nhưng vẫn có nhiều người tìm kiếm nó chính bởi sự quý hiếm của nó.

id: Tombak sihir dengan kekuatan menyerap vitalitas musuh. Tombak biasa bisa berubah menjadi Tombak Jiwa setelah menyerap cukup darah di medan perang. Katanya, si pemilik juga tunduk pada kekuatan gelap. Perubahannya lama, beberapa melepaskan muatan sebelum terlambat.
name: MST_SPHERES_33600_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A magical spear with the power to absorb vitality from your enemies. A normal spear can turn into a Soul Spear after it's absorbed enough blood on the battlefield. It is said that the possessor as well is subject to its dark power. This change is said to be slow, with few releasing the change before it's too late.

raw.en: A magical spear with the power to absorb vitality from your enemies. A normal spear can turn into a Soul Spear after it's absorbed enough blood on the battlefield. It is said that the possessor as well is subject to its dark power. This change is said to be slow, with few releasing the change before it's too late.
raw.es: Una lanza mágica capaz de absorber la vitalidad del enemigo. Cualquier lanza normal se puede transformar en lanza anímica tras haber absorbido suficiente sangre en combate. Se dice que quien la porta queda progresivamente sometido a su oscuro poder, y pocos son los que se dan cuenta antes de que los subyugue.
raw.id: Tombak sihir dengan kekuatan menyerap vitalitas musuh. Tombak biasa bisa berubah menjadi Tombak Jiwa setelah menyerap cukup darah di medan perang. Katanya, si pemilik juga tunduk pada kekuatan gelap. Perubahannya lama, beberapa melepaskan muatan sebelum terlambat.
raw.pt: Uma lança mágica com poder de absorver vitalidade dos inimigos. Uma lança normal pode se transformar em uma Lança da Alma depois de absorver sangue suficiente em batalha. Dizem que o dono dela também está sujeito ao seu poder sombrio. Dizem que a mudança é lenta e que poucos conseguem revertê-la antes de ser tarde demais.
raw.th: หอกวิเศษที่มีอำนาจในการดูดซับพลังจากศัตรู หอกปกติสามารถเปลี่ยนไปเป็นหอกวิญญาณ หลังจากที่มันดูดซึมเลือดได้มากพอในสนามรบ ว่ากันว่าผู้ครอบครองจะตกอยู่ภายใต้อำนาจมืดของมัน การเปลี่ยนแปลงนี้จะเกิดขึ้นอย่างช้าๆ ซึ่งน้อยคนจะยอมละทิ้งมันก่อนที่จะสายเกินไป
raw.vi: Một cây thương ma thuật có năng lực hấp thụ sinh khí từ kẻ thù. Một cây thương thông thường có thể biến hình thành Cây thương Linh hồn sau khi nó đã hấp thụ đủ máu trên chiến trường. Người ta đồn rằng người sở hữu nó cũng sẽ bị phụ thuộc vào sức mạnh đen tối của nó. Sự thay đổi này được đồn rằng diễn ra rất chậm và gần như không ai kịp nhận ra trước khi quá muộn.

id: Alat ganjil yang diaktifkan saat menempel di badan makhluk hidup. Roh tarung pemakainya bertambah dengan setiap serangan. Dibuat dengan teknik tak diketahui di Gaia Besar, hanya diketahui metode penggunaan dan efeknya. Sampai baru-baru ini, keberadaannya tidak diketahui. Dilaporkan terakhir dilihat di brankas Kerajaan Sama.
name: MST_SPHERES_33700_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An odd device which is activated when it's stuck to the torso of a living creature. The bearer's fighting spirit grows with each attack. Crafted using a method unknown of in Grand Gaia, only the method of use and its effects are known. Until recently, its whereabouts had been unknown, reportedly last being seen in the Sama Kingdom vault.

raw.en: An odd device which is activated when it's stuck to the torso of a living creature. The bearer's fighting spirit grows with each attack. Crafted using a method unknown of in Grand Gaia, only the method of use and its effects are known. Until recently, its whereabouts had been unknown, reportedly last being seen in the Sama Kingdom vault.
raw.es: Un extraño artilugio que se activa al colocarse en el antebrazo y provoca que el espíritu combativo de quien lo lleva puesto aumente cada vez que ataca. Está fabricado mediante una técnica desconocida en Gran Gaia, donde solo su uso y efectos son conocidos. Hasta hace poco, se creía perdido, y las últimas noticias sobre su paradero lo ubicaban en la cámara del tesoro del reino de Sama.
raw.id: Alat ganjil yang diaktifkan saat menempel di badan makhluk hidup. Roh tarung pemakainya bertambah dengan setiap serangan. Dibuat dengan teknik tak diketahui di Gaia Besar, hanya diketahui metode penggunaan dan efeknya. Sampai baru-baru ini, keberadaannya tidak diketahui. Dilaporkan terakhir dilihat di brankas Kerajaan Sama.
raw.pt: Um dispositivo estranho que é ativado ao ser colocado no torso de uma criatura viva. O espírito de luta de quem usa aumenta com cada ataque. Feito com um método desconhecido em Grand Gaia, só se conhece sua foma de uso e seus efeitos. Até recentemente, seu paradeiro era desconhecido, com rumores de ter sido vista no cofre do Reino de Sama.
raw.th: อุปกรณ์แปลกประหลาด ที่ทำงานเมื่อติดอยู่กับลำตัวของสิ่งมีชีวิต จิตวิญญาณในการต่อสู้ของผู้ครอบครอง จะเติบโตขึ้นจากการโจมตีแต่ละครั้ง มันถูกสร้างขึ้นโดยใช้วิธีการซึ่งไม่เป็นที่รู้จักในแกรนด์ไกอา มีเพียงวิธีการใช้งานและผลกระทบของมันเท่านั้นที่รู้กันอยู่ จนกระทั่งเมื่อเร็วๆ ไม่มีใครรู้ที่อยู่ของมัน แต่ข่าวล่าสุดรายงานว่ามันถูกพบเห็นในห้องนิรภัยของราชอาณาจักรซามะ
raw.vi: Một thiết bị kỳ quặc được kích hoạt khi được kết hợp với bán thân của một sinh vật sống. Tinh thần chiến đấu của người mang thiết bị này sẽ tăng lên sau mỗi đòn tấn công. Thiết bị được chế tác bằng một phương pháp chưa từng có ai biết đến ở Grand Gaia, người ta chỉ được biết cách sử dụng và khả năng của thiết bị này. Cho đến thời điểm hiện tại, vị trí cất giữ thiết bị này vẫn còn là bí ẩn, lần cuối người ta nhìn thấy nó là trong hầm mộ của vương quốc Sama.

id: Alat ganjil yang diaktifkan saat menempel di badan makhluk hidup. Pemakainya menerima boost vitalitas dengan setiap serangan. Bahkan para sarjana Republik La Veda, yang tekniknya amat berbeda dengan Gaia Besar, juga tidak bisa mencopotnya. Hilang waktu perang dengan dewa, dan keberadaannya sejak itu tidak diketahui.
name: MST_SPHERES_33800_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An odd device which is activated when it's stuck to the torso of a living creature. The bearer receives a boost in vitality with each attack. Even amongst the scholars of the La Veda Republic, whose techniques greatly differ from those used in Grand Gaia, were unable to even take it apart. It was lost during the battle with the gods, and its whereabouts since then were unknown.

raw.en: An odd device which is activated when it's stuck to the torso of a living creature. The bearer receives a boost in vitality with each attack. Even amongst the scholars of the La Veda Republic, whose techniques greatly differ from those used in Grand Gaia, were unable to even take it apart. It was lost during the battle with the gods, and its whereabouts since then were unknown.
raw.es: Un extraño artilugio que se activa al colocarse en el antebrazo y provoca que la vitalidad de quien lo lleva puesto aumente cada vez que ataca. Hasta los eruditos de la república de Laveda, cuyas técnicas son muy distintas a las usadas en Gran Gaia, han sido incapaces de desmontarlo. Se perdió durante la guerra contra los dioses y permaneció en paradero desconocido desde entonces.
raw.id: Alat ganjil yang diaktifkan saat menempel di badan makhluk hidup. Pemakainya menerima boost vitalitas dengan setiap serangan. Bahkan para sarjana Republik La Veda, yang tekniknya amat berbeda dengan Gaia Besar, juga tidak bisa mencopotnya. Hilang waktu perang dengan dewa, dan keberadaannya sejak itu tidak diketahui.
raw.pt: Um dispositivo estranho que é ativado ao ser colocado no torso de uma criatura viva. O usuário recebe uma melhora na vitalidade com cada ataque. Até os sábios da República de La Veda, que tinham técnicas muito diferentes das usadas em Grand Gaia, não conseguiram desmontá-lo. Foi perdido durante a batalha contra os deuses e seu paradeiro era desconhecido.
raw.th: อุปกรณ์แปลกประหลาด ที่ทำงานเมื่อติดอยู่กับลำตัวของสิ่งมีชีวิต พลังชีวิตของผู้สวมใส่จะเพิ่มขึ้นในแต่ละครั้งของการโจมตี แม้แต่ในหมู่นักวิชาการของ สาธารณรัฐลาเวด้าที่มีเทคโนโลยีแตกต่างจากที่ใช้ในแกรนด์ไกอาอย่างมาก ยังไม่สามารถเอามันออกจากกัน จากนั้นมันก็หายไปในระหว่างการสู้รบกับเทพเจ้าและมันหายไปอยู่ที่ไหนก็ไม่มีผู้ใดทราบได้
raw.vi: Một thiết bị kỳ quặc được kích hoạt khi được kết hợp với bán thân của một sinh vật sống. Tinh thần chiến đấu của người mang thiết bị này sẽ tăng lên sau mỗi đòn tấn công. Ngay cả trong giới học giả của Nền Cộng hòa La veda, nơi mà những kỹ nghệ khác xa rất nhiều so với Grand Gaia, cũng không ai biết thiết bị này. Thiết bị này đã thất lạc trong trận chiến với các vị thần, và cho đến giờ vẫn không ai biết nơi cất giữ nó.

id: Gelang yang terkenal memiliki kekuatan merampas jiwa. Bentuknya yang buruk seperti mulut setan terbuka lebar, tempat bukaan gelang. Katanya ini mungkin milik pendeta pemuja berhala yang membuatnya untuk persembahan bagi dewa jahat. Rumornya, gelang ini masih punya sisa kekuatan jemaat gelap.
name: MST_SPHERES_34000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A bracer the wearer of which is infamously known to have the power to seize souls. It's ominous shape looks like a demon's mouth opened wide, into which one's hand is placed. It's also said that it may have belonged to a pagan minister who, long ago, created it to make sacrifices to his evil god. This has lead to rumors that it holds the remaining power of the dark congregation.

raw.en: A bracer the wearer of which is infamously known to have the power to seize souls. It's ominous shape looks like a demon's mouth opened wide, into which one's hand is placed. raw.es: El dueño de este brazal ha pasado tristemente a la historia por ser capaz de robar el alma a sus enemigos. El brazal tiene forma de boca de demonio; para colocarlo, el antebrazo se introduce por esta ominosa apertura. Cuenta la leyenda que un clérigo pagano lo fabricó hace años para realizar sacrificios a su malvado dios. Por ello, hay quien todavía piensa que sigue imbuido del poder de aquel oscuro culto.

raw.pt: Uma manopla que torna o dono infame por ter o poder de capturar almas. O formato ameaçador parece a boca aberta de um demônio, que é onde o usuário coloca a mão. Também dizem que ela pode ter sido de um sacerdote pagão que, há muito tempo, a criou para fazer sacrifícios em nome do seu deus maligno. Isso levou a rumores de que ela tem o poder restante da congregação sombria.
raw.th: กำไลที่ผู้สวมใส่ซึ่งเป็นที่รู้จักในทางอื้อฉาว ด้วยอำนาจที่ยึดจิตวิญญาณ รูปร่างอันไม่เป็นมงคลของมันที่ดูเหมือนว่าปากของปีศาจเปิดกว้างซึ่งสามารถยื่นมือเข้าไปได้ นอกจากนี้ยังกล่าวว่ามันอาจจะเป็นของพวกเจ้าลัทธินอกรีต ที่สร้างมันขึ้นมาเพื่อการบูชาเทพเจ้าชั่วร้ายของเขาเมื่อนานมาแล้ว สิ่งนี้นำไปสู่​​ข่าวลือที่ว่ามันครอบครองอำนาจที่รวบรวมมาจากความมืด
raw.vi: Chiếc bao tay mà người mang được cho là có quyền năng nắm giữ linh hồn. Hình dáng của chiếc bao tay này trông giống miệng của một con quỷ mở to, và người mang phải xỏ tay qua đó. Người ta đồn rằng chiếc bao tay này có thể thuộc về một vị mục sư ngoại giáo, người mà rất lâu trước kia đã chế tác ra chiếc bao tay này để hiến cho ác thần ông ta tôn thờ. Điều này đã dẫn đến nhiều lời đồn đại rằng chiếc bao tay mang sức mạnh tập hợp quỷ dữ.

id: Tutup kepala yang ditemukan di kuil kuno, bertahun-tahun bermandikan cahaya matahari bersama dengan kuil, terisi kekuatan suci. Siapa pun yang memakainya, saat terluka, akan ditenangkan oleh kekuatan terang di dalamnya. Dinamai Celtion sesuai kuil tempat penemuannya, walau siapa dewa di kuil tersebut juga masih tidak diketahui.
name: MST_SPHERES_34300_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A headpiece found in an ancient shrine, for many years bathed in and soaked up the light from the sun along with the shrine, filling it with a holy power. It's said that anyone who wears it, when injured, are soothed by the power of light it holds within it. It is called Celtion after the shrine in which it was found, though to which god that shrine was dedicated remains unknown.

raw.en: A headpiece found in an ancient shrine, for many years bathed in and soaked up the light from the sun along with the shrine, filling it with a holy power. It's said that anyone who wears it, when injured, are soothed by the power of light it holds within it. It is called Celtion after the shrine in which it was found, though to which god that shrine was dedicated remains unknown.
raw.es: Hallado en un antiguo santuario, durante años este yelmo se empapó de la luz de sol que bañaba el lugar, imbuyéndose así de un poder sacro. Dicen que, si quien lo lleva puesto y resulta herido, el poder de la luz que el yelmo alberga palía sus heridas. Se le dio el nombre de Celtión en honor al santuario donde lo encontraron. Se desconoce a qué divinidad está dedicado dicho lugar.
raw.id: Tutup kepala yang ditemukan di kuil kuno, bertahun-tahun bermandikan cahaya matahari bersama dengan kuil, terisi kekuatan suci. Siapa pun yang memakainya, saat terluka, akan ditenangkan oleh kekuatan terang di dalamnya. Dinamai Celtion sesuai kuil tempat penemuannya, walau siapa dewa di kuil tersebut juga masih tidak diketahui.
raw.pt: Um elmo encontrado em um templo antigo. Foi banhada por anos com a luz do sol junto com o templo, o que o encheu de poder sagrado. Dizem que todos que usarem, quando se ferirem, são confortados pelo poder da luz que possui. É chamado de Celtion por causa do templo em que foi encontrado, mas ainda não se sabe a que deus o templo era dedicado.
raw.th: ชิ้นส่วนหมวกที่ถูกพบในวิหารเก่าแก่ และอาบได้อาบแสงจากดวงอาทิตย์ด้วยพลังศักดิ์สิทธิ์พร้อมกับวิหารมานานนับปี ว่ากันว่าทุกคนที่สวมมันหากได้รับบาดเจ็บ จะได้รับการรักษาโดยอำนาจของแสงที่มันครอบครองอยู่ภายใน มันถูกเรียกว่า เซลเทียน ตามชื่อของวิหารที่มันถูกค้นพบ ซึ่งเป็นวิหารของเทพองค์ไหนก็ไม่มีผู้ใดรู้
raw.vi: Một chiếc mũ giáp được tìm thấy trong một điện thờ cổ, sau bao nhiêu năm chìm trong ánh sáng từ mặt trời tỏa xuống điện thờ, mang đầy quyền năng thần thánh. Người ta đồn rằng bất cứ ai mang chiếc mũ giáp này khi bị thương sẽ được xoa dịu bởi sức mạnh của ánh sáng bên trong chiếc mũ. Chiếc mũ này được đặt theo tên của điện thờ Celtion nơi nó được tìm thấy, cho dù không ai biết điện thờ này thờ vị thần nào.

id: Suatu hari, sebuah bintang jatuh dari surga, dan dengan ledakan besar meninggalkan batu seukuran kepala manusia. Mengabaikan jeritan para pendeta, dan berteriak bahwa itu sejenis retribusi ilahi, seorang pandai besi mencurinya dan membuat helm dari batu itu. Helm ini disebut Andromeda. Katanya yang memakai helm ini punya proteksi bintang.
name: MST_SPHERES_34301_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: One day, a star fell from the heavens, and with a great explosion it left behind a stone about the size of a human head. Putting aside the cries of the priests, screaming that it was some kind of divine retribution, a blacksmith stole it away and made a helmet from it. The star-powered helmet was named Andromeda, and it is said he who bears it has the protection of the stars.

raw.en: One day, a star fell from the heavens, and with a great explosion it left behind a stone about the size of a human head. Putting aside the cries of the priests, screaming that it was some kind of divine retribution, a blacksmith stole it away and made a helmet from it. The star-powered helmet was named Andromeda, and it is said he who bears it has the protection of the stars.
raw.es: Una estrella cayó del cielo en una ocasión; de la gran explosión que provocó su impacto solo quedó una roca del tamaño de una cabeza. Haciendo caso omiso de las protestas de los clérigos que afirmaban que el suceso era un castigo divino, un herrero se la llevó para hacer con ella un yelmo. Llamó a su obra venida de los cielos Andrómeda; dicen que quien se lo pone recibe la protección de las estrellas.
raw.id: Suatu hari, sebuah bintang jatuh dari surga, dan dengan ledakan besar meninggalkan batu seukuran kepala manusia. Mengabaikan jeritan para pendeta, dan berteriak bahwa itu sejenis retribusi ilahi, seorang pandai besi mencurinya dan membuat helm dari batu itu. Helm ini disebut Andromeda. Katanya yang memakai helm ini punya proteksi bintang.
raw.pt: Um dia, uma estrela caiu dos céus, causando uma grande explosão e gerando uma pedra do tamanho aproximado de uma cabeça humana. Ignorando os brados de sacerdotes, que diziam que isso era uma retribuição divina, um ferreiro a roubou e criou o elmo. Esse elmo com poderes estelares foi chamado de Andrômeda e dizem que quem usar terá a proteção das estrelas.
raw.th: อยู่มาวันหนึ่งดาวตกลงมาจากสรวงสวรรค์ และด้วยการระเบิดที่ยิ่งใหญ่มันได้ทิ้งหินที่มีขนาดเท่ากับหัวมนุษย์เอาไว้เบื้องหลัง ถ้าไม่นับเสียงคร่ำครวญของเหล่านักบวชที่กรีดร้องว่า มันเป็นผลกรรมตามสนองจากสิ่งศักดิ์สิทธิ์ ช่างตีเหล็กคนหนึ่งขโมยมันไปและได้เอามันไปทำเป็นหมวกเกราะ หมวกเกราะที่มีพลังแห่งดวงดาว มีชื่อว่า อันโดรเมด้า และว่ากันว่าใครก็ตามที่สวมใส่มันจะได้รับการคุ้มครองจากดวงดาว
raw.vi: Một ngày kia, có một ngôi sao rơi xuống từ cõi thiên đường, và sau một vụ nổ lớn chỉ còn lại một viên đá có kích cỡ bằng đầu người. Bỏ ngoài tai những lời than khóc của các giáo sĩ rằng đó sự trừng phạt của thần, một thợ rèn đã ăn cắp viên đã này và chế tạo ra một chiếc mũ giáp. Chiếc mũ giáp mang quyền năng của ột vì sao được đặt tên là Andromeda và người ta đồn rằng những ai mang chiếc mũ này sẽ được các vì sao bảo vệ.
