id: Topeng wanita dengan tampang sirik dan sedih. Siapa yang melihatnya akan takut dan ingin menyerang. Meski tidak dikutuk atau dipengaruhi sihir, pemakainya merasakan kehadiran yang besar dari dalam topeng, dan banyak pemakainya yang ingin bersembunyi dari publik. Sepertinya dipakai di drama-drama di dunia lain, meski itu bukan kasus untuk topeng yang satu ini.
name: MST_SPHERES_34500_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A mask of a woman with an otherwordly look of jealousy and grief. Those who see it are filled with fear and the urge to attack. Despite not being cursed or affected by magic, wearers feel a great presence eminating from it, and there are many who wear it when they wish to hide themselves in public. It seems it was worn in plays in another world, though that is not the case in this one.

raw.en: A mask of a woman with an otherwordly look of jealousy and grief. Those who see it are filled with fear and the urge to attack. Despite not being cursed or affected by magic, wearers feel a great presence eminating from it, and there are many who wear it when they wish to hide themselves in public. It seems it was worn in plays in another world, though that is not the case in this one.
raw.es: Una máscara de un rostro femenino con una mirada mística y un gesto de envidia y dolor. Infunde terror en quienes la ven y los insta a atacar. A pesar de no quedar bajo la influencia de las maldiciones o de la magia, quienes llevan la máscara sienten una poderosa presencia que emana de ella. Muchos se la ponen para pasar desapercibidos. Parece ser que en otros mundos se usaba como máscara de teatro, pero no en este.
raw.id: Topeng wanita dengan tampang sirik dan sedih. Siapa yang melihatnya akan takut dan ingin menyerang. Meski tidak dikutuk atau dipengaruhi sihir, pemakainya merasakan kehadiran yang besar dari dalam topeng, dan banyak pemakainya yang ingin bersembunyi dari publik. Sepertinya dipakai di drama-drama di dunia lain, meski itu bukan kasus untuk topeng yang satu ini.
raw.pt: A máscara de uma mulher com uma aparência de inveja e dor. Quem olhar para ela se enche de medo e de vontade de atacar. Apesar de não ser amaldiçoada ou afetada por magia, quem a usa sente uma grande presença emanada por ela, e muitos a usam quando querem se esconder em público. Parece que foi usada em peças de outro mundo, mas não é o caso desta.
raw.th: หน้ากากของผู้หญิงที่มีลักษณะกังวลเกี่ยวกับชีวิต จากความหึงหวงและความเศร้าโศก บรรดาผู้ที่เห็นมันนั้นเต็มไปด้วยความกลัว และถูกกระตุ้นให้ทำการโจมตี แม้จะไม่ได้รับการสาปแช่งหรือรับผลกระทบจากเวทมนตร์ แต่ทำให้ผู้สวมใส่รู้สึกถึงวิญญาณที่ยิ่งใหญ่หลั่งไหลออกมาจากมัน และมีหลายคนที่สวมใส่มันเมื่อพวกเขาต้องการที่จะซ่อนตัวในที่สาธารณะ ดูเหมือนว่ามันจะถูกสวมใส่ในการแสดงของอีกโลกหนึ่ง แต่มันไม่ใช่สำหรับกรณีนี้
raw.vi: Chiếc mặt nạ của một người phụ nữ mang diện mạo đố ky và sầu khổ của thế giới bên kia. Những ai đã từng nhìn thấy chiếc mặt nạ này đều vô cùng sợ hãi và ngập tràn nỗi thôi thúc phải tấn công đối phương. Cho dù không hề bị nguyền rủa hay mang sức mạnh ma thuật nhưng người mang mặt nạ có thể cảm thấy sự hiện hữu mạnh mẽ tỏa ta từ chiếc mặt nạ này và đã có rất nhiều người mang chiếc mặt nạ khi muốn ẩn mình trong đám đông. Có vẻ như chiếc mặt nạ này được mang trong các vở kịch ở một thế giới khác, nhưng không phải là trường hợp này.

id: Perlengkapan standar untuk tentara spesial Kerajaan Bariula. Selain menyamarkan si pemakai dengan kain gelap, juga diisi sihir yang menyamarkan keberadaan si pemakai dalam keadaan bahaya. Pasukan juga takut musuh mengetahui rahasia baju ini saat pasukan ditangkap, jadi mereka selain bunuh diri, juga menghancurkan semua perlengkapannya.
name: MST_SPHERES_34600_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Standard issue equipment for special forces from the Bariula Empire. On top of concealing the wearer with it's dark fabric, it is also infused with magic that conceals their presence when they're in danger. These troops are so afraid of enemies learning the secrets of the robe that when they are captured, not only do they kill themselves, they go as far as destroying all of their equipment.

raw.en: Standard issue equipment for special forces from the Bariula Empire. On top of concealing the wearer with it's dark fabric, it is also infused with magic that conceals their presence when they're in danger. These troops are so afraid of enemies learning the secrets of the robe that when they are captured, not only do they kill themselves, they go as far as destroying all of their equipment.
raw.es: Pieza de equipo estándar de las fuerzas especiales del imperio de Bariula. Está confeccionada con un tejido oscuro que ayuda a ocultar a quien la lleva. En caso de hallarse en peligro, la magia de la que está imbuida esconde a quien la lleva puesta. Los soldados de Bariula tienen tanto miedo de que sus enemigos descubran los secretos de esta capa que, si los capturan, destruyen todo su equipo y se suicidan.
raw.id: Perlengkapan standar untuk tentara spesial Kerajaan Bariula. Selain menyamarkan si pemakai dengan kain gelap, juga diisi sihir yang menyamarkan keberadaan si pemakai dalam keadaan bahaya. Pasukan juga takut musuh mengetahui rahasia baju ini saat pasukan ditangkap, jadi mereka selain bunuh diri, juga menghancurkan semua perlengkapannya.
raw.pt: Equipamento comum para forças especiais do Império Bariula. Além de envolver o usuário com tecido sombrio, também contém magia que oculta sua presença quando está em perigo. Essas tropas tem tanto medo de que os inimigos aprendam os segredos da túnica que, quando são capturadas, não só se matam, mas também chegam ao extremo de destruírem o próprio equipamento.
raw.th: ชุดมาตรฐานสำหรับกองกำลังพิเศษของจักรวรรดิบาริอุละ ด้านบนของผู้สวมใส่ปกปิดด้วยผ้าสีดำมัน และมันยังซึมซับเวทมนตร์ที่สามารถซ่อนเร้นสถานะของพวกเขา กองกำลังเหล่าหวาดกลัวศัตรูจะรู้ความลับของเสื้อคลุม ดังนั้นเมื่อพวกเขาตกอยู่ในอันตรายหรือถูกจับกุม พวกเขาก็จะฆ่าตัวตายไม่ก็ทำลายเสื้อคลุมนี้ทิ้งไปเสีย
raw.vi: Trang bị tiêu chuẩn được cấp cho các lực lượng đặc biệt từ Đế chế Bariula. Là một trong những trang bị hàng đầu trong việc che dấu người mặc trong lớp vải tối màu, tấm áo choàng này đồng thời cũng được truyền phép thuật, che giấu sự hiện hữu của người mặc khi người này gặp nguy hiểm. Những binh đoàn này lo sợ kẻ thù học được bí kíp của chiếc áo choàng đến nỗi khi họ bị bắt, họ không chỉ tự sát mà còn phá hủy toàn bộ những chiếc áo choàng này.

id: Ada seorang raja yang tidak pernah marah karena ia diajarkan dengan demikian, kekuatan emosionalnya yang berharga akan dikeluarkan bersamanya. Namun, kemarahan mengalir dalam dirinya sendiri, masuk ke mahkotanya. Meski demikian, orang-orang memuji si raja yang tidak pernah marah, tidak tahu bahwa kemarahan mengisi mahkotanya.
name: MST_SPHERES_34700_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There once was a king who never lost his temper, because he thought by doing so his precious emotional strength would be expelled along with it. However, instead of his anger floating around inside himself, it flowed into his crown. Despite this, the people praised the king who never got angry, ignorant of the rage that filled his crown.

raw.en: There once was a king who never lost his temper, because he thought by doing so his precious emotional strength would be expelled along with it. However, instead of his anger floating around inside himself, it flowed into his crown. Despite this, the people praised the king who never got angry, ignorant of the rage that filled his crown.
raw.es: Existió una vez un rey que jamás perdía la compostura, pues pensaba que si se permitía hacerlo perdería su valiosa resistencia emocional. En lugar de guardar dentro la ira que a veces sentía, esta impregnaba su corona. Sus súbditos aclamaban al rey que jamás se enfadaba, ignorantes de la gran rabia que contenía su corona.
raw.id: Ada seorang raja yang tidak pernah marah karena ia diajarkan dengan demikian, kekuatan emosionalnya yang berharga akan dikeluarkan bersamanya. Namun, kemarahan mengalir dalam dirinya sendiri, masuk ke mahkotanya. Meski demikian, orang-orang memuji si raja yang tidak pernah marah, tidak tahu bahwa kemarahan mengisi mahkotanya.
raw.pt: Havia um rei que nunca perdia a compostura porque pensava que, se perdesse, sua força emocional seria expelida com a irritação. No entanto, ao invés de sua raiva ficar dentro dele mesmo, ela foi para a coroa. Apesar disso, o povo adorava o rei que nunca se irritava, isso sem saber da fúria que preenchia a coroa.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีกษัตริย์ผู้ไม่เคยโกรธ เพราะเขาคิดว่าการทำเช่นนั้น ความรุนแรงของอารมณ์อาจจะถูกปลดปล่อยออกไปพร้อมกับมัน อย่างไรก็ตามแทนที่จะให้ความโกรธไหลเวียนอยู่ในตัวเขา มันกลับไหลรวมไปอยู่ที่มงกุฏของเขาแทน แต่เรื่องนี้ทำให้ผู้คนต่างให้การยกย่องกษัตริย์ที่ไม่เคยโกรธของพวกตน โดยไม่ได้สนใจความโกรธที่ถูกเติมเต็มอยู่ในมงกุฏ
raw.vi: Trước kia từng có một vị hoàng đế không bao giờ nóng giận, bởi ông cho rằng nếu nóng giận thì sức mạnh cảm xúc quý giá của mình cũng sẽ theo đó thoát ra ngoài. Tuy nhiên, thay vì tồn lại trong cơ thể ông thì những cơn giận của ông lại chuyển sang chiếc vương miện. Cho dù vậy thì người dân vẫn luôn tán dương vị hoàng đế không bao giờ nổi giận mà chẳng hay biết về cơn thịnh nộ đã lấp đầy chiếc vương miện của ông.

id: Pandai Besi Banbelk menambahkan kekuatan untuk menyerang balik siapa pun yang merugikan pemakai tutup kepala ini. Ia sangat mencintai semua karyanya, maka ia membuat satu dengan kemampuan membela diri. Mahkota ini mampu menerima kerusakan dan melempar balik ke penyerangnya. Vanbelk, bersama dengan tutup kepala yang sepertinya dimantera ini, selamanya diingat oleh orang-orang.
name: MST_SPHERES_34800_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The blacksmith Vanbelk built into this headpiece the power to counterattack anyone who harms it's wearer. He deeply loved all his works, therefore he made one with the ability to defend itself. This crown was able to take the damage it received and throw it right back at its attacker. Vanbelk, along with his seemingly enchanted headpiece, were to be forever remembered by the people.

raw.en: The blacksmith Vanbelk built into this headpiece the power to counterattack anyone who harms it's wearer. He deeply loved all his works, therefore he made one with the ability to defend itself. This crown was able to take the damage it received and throw it right back at its attacker. Vanbelk, along with his seemingly enchanted headpiece, were to be forever remembered by the people.
raw.es: El herrero Vanbelk imbuyó esta corona del poder para contraatacar en caso de que su portador resultara herido. Este herrero sentía verdadero amor por todas sus obras, y por ello creó una capaz de defenderse. La corona puede desviar parte del daño recibido y hacer que recaiga sobre el enemigo. Vanbelk y su corona encantada permanecieron por siempre en la memoria de su pueblo.
raw.id: Pandai Besi Banbelk menambahkan kekuatan untuk menyerang balik siapa pun yang merugikan pemakai tutup kepala ini. Ia sangat mencintai semua karyanya, maka ia membuat satu dengan kemampuan membela diri. Mahkota ini mampu menerima kerusakan dan melempar balik ke penyerangnya. Vanbelk, bersama dengan tutup kepala yang sepertinya dimantera ini, selamanya diingat oleh orang-orang.
raw.pt: O ferreiro Vanbelk embutiu nesta coroa o poder de contra-atacar qualquer um que ferisse o usuário. Ele adorava todos os seus trabalhos, então fez uma com a habilidade de defender a si mesma. Esta coroa conseguia absorver o dano recebido e lançá-lo de volta ao agressor. Valbelk e sua coroa encantada serão sempre lembrados por todos.
raw.th: ช่างตีเหล็ก แวนเบล สร้างอุปกรณ์สวมหัว ซึ่งมีอำนาจในการสะท้อนการโจมตีต่อทุกคนที่ทำอันตรายต่อผู้สวมใส่มัน เขารักผลงานทั้งหมดของเขาอย่างสุดซึ้ง จึงได้สร้างผลงานชิ้นหนึ่ง ซึ่งมีความสามารถในการป้องกันตัวเอง มงกุฎนี้สามารถรับความเสียหายและสะท้อนมันมันกลับไปยังผู้ที่โจมตี แวนเบลและอุปกรณ์สวมหัวของเขาถูกจดจำโดยผู้คนไปตลอดกาล
raw.vi: Thợ rèn Vanbelk đã tích hợp cho chiếc vương miện này khả năng phản công bất kỳ ai làm hại người mang vương miện. Ông có một niềm yêu thương sâu đậm với tất cả những tác phẩm do mình làm ra, vì thế mà ông đã chế tạo ra chúng với khả năng tự bảo vệ mình. Chiếc vương miện này có thể ném trả lại kẻ tấn công những tổn hại mà nó gánh chịu. Vanbelk, cùng với chiếc vương miện có vẻ bề ngoài như bị bỏ bùa của mình, sẽ được ghi nhớ mãi mãi.

id: Alat aneh yang Alat Tekno yang dioptimalkan. Dengan mengubah pembatas pengeluaran di belakang kepalanya, alat yang diperbarui mengubah penggunanya menjadi mesin petarung. Keberadaannya masih tidak diketahui, dan instruksi untuk menggunakannya maupun sejarahnya masih tertutup rapat di ruang penyimpanan Kerajaan Sama.
name: MST_SPHERES_34803_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An odd device made from an optimized Tech Gizmo. By modifying the output limiter on the back of the head, this upgraded piece turns its wearer into a fighting machine. It's whereabouts are still unknown, and instructions on its use as well as its history are sealed up tight within the vaults of the Sama Kingdom.

raw.en: An odd device made from an optimized Tech Gizmo. By modifying the output limiter on the back of the head, this upgraded piece turns its wearer into a fighting machine. It's whereabouts are still unknown, and instructions on its use as well as its history are sealed up tight within the vaults of the Sama Kingdom.
raw.es: Extraño dispositivo creado con un artefacto optimizado. Al modificar el limitador de salida atrás de la cabeza, esta pieza mejorada convierte a su portador en una máquina de pelea. Su paradero aún se desconoce, y las instrucciones de uso al igual que su historia están bien resguardados dentro de las bóvedas del reino Sama.
raw.id: Alat aneh yang Alat Tekno yang dioptimalkan. Dengan mengubah pembatas pengeluaran di belakang kepalanya, alat yang diperbarui mengubah penggunanya menjadi mesin petarung. Keberadaannya masih tidak diketahui, dan instruksi untuk menggunakannya maupun sejarahnya masih tertutup rapat di ruang penyimpanan Kerajaan Sama.
raw.pt: Um dispositivo estranho feito com uma engenhoca tecnológica melhorada. Ao modificar o limitador de saída na parte de trás da cabeça, esta peça melhorada transforma o usuário em uma máquina de combate. Ninguém sabe onde está, e as instruções de uso estão lacradas nos cofres do Reino de Sama, junto com sua história.
raw.th: อุปกรณ์ประหลาดที่ทำจาก เทคกิซโม่ ที่ดีที่สุด โดยการปรับเปลี่ยนตัวจำกัดการส่งออกที่อยู่ด้านหลังหัว อุปกรณ์ชิ้นนี้เปลี่ยนผู้สวมใส่ให้กลายเป็นเครื่องจักรต่อสู้ มันอยู่ที่ไหนไม่มีใครทราบ และคู่มือการใช้และประวัติที่มาของมันก็ถูกผนึกเอาไว้อย่างหนาแน่นภายในกรุสมบัติของราชอาณาจักรซามะ
raw.vi: Một thiết bị kỳ lạ được làm từ một Tech Gizmo. Bằng cách điều chỉnh nút giới hạn ở sau đầu, nó sẽ biến người đeo nó thành một cỗ máy chiến đấu. Sức mạnh của nó vẫn còn là điều bí ẩn và những hướng dẫn sử dụng  cũng như nguồn gốc của nó vẫn còn ẩn chứa trong các ngôi mộ vua Sama.

id: Alat aneh yang Alat Obat yang dioptimalkan. Dengan mengubah pembatas pengeluaran di di dada depan jantung, alat yang diperbarui membantu penggunanya untuk merasa lebih nyaman dalam perang. Tidak diketahui bagaimana alat yang sangat rumit ini dikembangkan, dan kenapa ditemukan di Republik La Veda.
name: MST_SPHERES_34804_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An odd device made from an optimized Cure Gizmo. By modifying the output limiter on the chest in front of the heart, this upgraded piece helps its user to ease comfortably through battles. It is unknown as to how this incredibly intricate piece was developed, and also why it was found in the La Veda Republic.

raw.en: An odd device made from an optimized Cure Gizmo. By modifying the output limiter on the chest in front of the heart, this upgraded piece helps its user to ease comfortably through battles. It is unknown as to how this incredibly intricate piece was developed, and also why it was found in the La Veda Republic.
raw.es: Extraño dispositivo creado con un artefacto curativo optimizado. Al modificar el limitador de salida en el pecho, frente al corazón, esta pieza mejorada ayuda a su usuario a descansar cómodamente en las batallas. Se desconoce cómo fue desarrollada esta intrincada pieza y cómo fue encontrada en la república La Veda.
raw.id: Alat aneh yang Alat Obat yang dioptimalkan. Dengan mengubah pembatas pengeluaran di di dada depan jantung, alat yang diperbarui membantu penggunanya untuk merasa lebih nyaman dalam perang. Tidak diketahui bagaimana alat yang sangat rumit ini dikembangkan, dan kenapa ditemukan di Republik La Veda.
raw.pt: Um dispositivo estranho feito com uma engenhoca de cura melhorada. Ao modificar o limitador de saída no peitoral, na frente do coração, esta peça melhorada ajuda o usuário a passar pelas batalhas com conforto. Não se sabe como essa peça incrivelmente complexa foi criada e nem por que foi encontrada na República de La Veda.
raw.th: อุปกรณ์ประหลาดที่ทำจาก กิซโม่รักษา ที่ดีที่สุด โดยการปรับเปลี่ยนตัวจำกัดการส่งออกที่อยู่บนหน้าอกด้านหน้าหัวใจ ชิ้นส่วนอัพเกรดนี้ถูกใช้เพื่อช่วยให้ผู้ใช้มีความสะดวกสบายในการต่อสู้  ไม่มีใครรู้ว่าชิ้นส่วนที่ซับซ้อนอย่างมากชิ้นนี้ถูกพัฒนามาอย่างไร และทำไมมันถึงถูกพบในสาธารณรัฐลาวิดา
raw.vi: Một thiết bị kỳ lạ được làm từ Cure Gizmo . Bằng cách điều chỉnh nút giới hạn đầu ra ở phía ngực, nó sẽ giúp người đeo nó dễ dàng chiến thắng trong mọi trận đấu. Cách sử dụng nó và tại sao nó lại được tìm thấy ở La Veda vẫn còn là điều bí ẩn.

id: Dahulu, seorang ratu jatuh cinta dengan tipe bunga yang aneh. Dia merawatnya secara spesial agar mereka dapat air bersih dan sinar yang cukup. Katanya bahkan dia juga berkata-kata dengan manis kepada mereka. Lalu suatu hari yang hangat, bunga-bunga itu punya kekuatan sendiri. Siapapun yang mendapatkan satu dari bunga-bunga ini katanya akan menerima kebaikan ratu, dan kekuatan untuk melepaskan perasaan mereka yang terdalam dengan mudah.
name: MST_SPHERES_34805_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Long ago, there was a queen who fell in love with a strange type of flower. She took special care to make sure they had clean water and got just enough light. It's said that she would even speak kind words to them. Then on one warm day, the flowers came to hold a power of their own. Anyone who obtains one of these flowers is said to receive both the queen's kindness, and the power to unleash their innermost feelings with ease.

raw.en: Long ago, there was a queen who fell in love with a strange type of flower. She took special care to make sure they had clean water and got just enough light. It's said that she would even speak kind words to them. Then on one warm day, the flowers came to hold a power of their own. Anyone who obtains one of these flowers is said to receive both the queen's kindness, and the power to unleash their innermost feelings with ease.
raw.es: Hace mucho, había una reina quien se enamoró de un extraño tipo de flor. Puso especial cuidado en asegurarse de que tuviera agua limpia y suficiente luz. Se dice que incluso le decía dulces palabras. Entonces, un cálido día, las flores cobraron poder propio. Dicen que cualquiera que consiga una de estas flores recibe tanto el favor de la reina como el poder de liberar con facilidad sus sentimientos más profundos.
raw.id: Dahulu, seorang ratu jatuh cinta dengan tipe bunga yang aneh. Dia merawatnya secara spesial agar mereka dapat air bersih dan sinar yang cukup. Katanya bahkan dia juga berkata-kata dengan manis kepada mereka. Lalu suatu hari yang hangat, bunga-bunga itu punya kekuatan sendiri. Siapapun yang mendapatkan satu dari bunga-bunga ini katanya akan menerima kebaikan ratu, dan kekuatan untuk melepaskan perasaan mereka yang terdalam dengan mudah.
raw.pt: Há muito tempo, houve uma rainha que se apaixonou por um tipo estrano de flor. Ela teve um cuidado especial para garantir que as flores tivessem água limpa e a quantidade certa de luz. Dizem que ela até dizia palavras gentis para as flores. Então, em um dia quente, as flores desenvolveram poder próprio. Dizem que qualquer um que obtivesse uma das flores receberia tanto a gentileza da rainha quanto o poder de libertar os sentimentos mais interiores com facilidade.
raw.th: นานมาแล้ว มีราชินีที่ตกหลุมรักดอกไม้ชนิดประหลาด นางดูแลเป็นพิเศษเพื่อให้มั่นใจว่าพวกมันจะได้รับน้ำสะอาดและแสงที่เพียงพอ ว่ากันว่านางพูดกับพวกมันด้วยถ้อยคำหวานอีกด้วย จนในวันที่อุ่นวันหนึ่งดอกไม้ได้มีพลังขึ้นมา ใครก็ตามที่ได้รับดอกไม้เหล่านี้ว่ากันว่าจะได้รับทั้งความเมตตาจากราชนีและพลังที่จะปล่อยความรู้สึกด้านในสุดของพวกเขาออกมาอย่างง่ายดาย
raw.vi: Ngày xưa, có một nữ hoàng rất thích một loài hoa lạ. Cô luôn chú ý tới việc tưới nước và có đủ ánh sáng cho loài hoa đó. Cô thường hay nói chuyện với chúng. Sau đó vào một ngày ấm áp, các bông hoa đó bộc lộ sức mạnh của mình. Bất kỳ ai có được một trong số những bông hoa này sẽ được hoàng hậu đối xử tốt và đó là cách để họ thể hiện những cảm xúc bên trong mình được dễ dàng.

id: Otoritas Rameldria sebagai satu dari naga terkuat sangat dikenal bahkan di antara para manusia. Cincin ini, yang memberikan perlindungan Rameldria yang setara dengan para dewa sendiri, sepertinya memberikan penggunanya keberanian dan percaya diri. Perasaan ini meningkat dengan setiap pertempuran, kekuatan yang dihasilkan adalah inti dari cincin ini.
name: MST_SPHERES_34806_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Rameldria's authority as one of the strongest dragons around is widely known even among humans. This ring, which provides the protection of Rameldria who rivals the gods themselves, seems to grant its bearer courage and confidence. These feelings elevate with every battle, the resulting power of which makes up the true essence of the ring.

raw.en: Rameldria's authority as one of the strongest dragons around is widely known even among humans. This ring, which provides the protection of Rameldria who rivals the gods themselves, seems to grant its bearer courage and confidence. These feelings elevate with every battle, the resulting power of which makes up the true essence of the ring.
raw.es: La autoridad de Rameldria como uno de los dragones más fuertes es bien conocida entre los humanos. Este anillo, que ofrece una protección de Rameldria equiparable a la de los dioses, parece conceder al portador valentía y seguridad. Estos sentimientos se elevan con cada batalla, y el poder resultante conforma la verdadera esencia del anillo.
raw.id: Otoritas Rameldria sebagai satu dari naga terkuat sangat dikenal bahkan di antara para manusia. Cincin ini, yang memberikan perlindungan Rameldria yang setara dengan para dewa sendiri, sepertinya memberikan penggunanya keberanian dan percaya diri. Perasaan ini meningkat dengan setiap pertempuran, kekuatan yang dihasilkan adalah inti dari cincin ini.
raw.pt: A autoridade de Rameldria como um dos dragões mais poderosos da região é conhecida até entre os humanos. Este anel dá a proteção de Rameldria, que é comparável aos deuses, e parece dar coragem e confiança ao usuário. Esses sentimentos se elevam a cada batalha e o poder resultante deles forma a verdadeira essência do anel.
raw.th: อำนาจของราเมลเดรีย นับเป็นหนึ่งในมังกรที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุดที่มีอยู่ เป็นที่รู้จักกันไปทั่วแม้แต่ในบรรดามนุษย์ แหวนนี้ซึ่งมอบพลังคุ้มครองจากราเมลเดรียผู้เป็นศัตรูกับเหล่าเทพเจ้าเอง ดูเหมือนว่ามันจะมอบความกล้าและมั่นใจให้กับผู้สวมใส่มัน ความรู้สึกนี้ยกระดับขึ้นในทุกการต่อสู้ ซึ่งเป็นสาระสำคัญที่ทำให้เกิดพลังนี้
raw.vi: Rameldria là một trong những con rồng mạnh nhất được loài người biết tới. Chiếc vòng này giúp bảo vệ nó khỏi kẻ thù, tăng sức mạnh và lòng tự tin cho nó. Các cảm giác này luôn thăng hóa trong mọi trận đấu, kết quả của các trận đấu đã chứng minh cho sự cần thiết thực sự của cái vòng này!

id: Tombak magis, disebut dalam legenda dari dunia lain di mana konon tombak ini menusuk mereka yang ditarget beberapa kali dalam sekali tusukan, mempunyai kekuatan yang tidak bisa dikeluarkan seluruhnya di Gaia Besar dan hanya bisa dipakai kalau seseorang merasa kekuatan asing bergelora dalam dirinya. Tapi, kekuatan besar yang dikeluarkan kalau dia diaktifkan sangat kuat sehingga dia membuat penggunanya bisa menembus semua pertahanan musuh.
name: MST_SPHERES_34807_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This magical lance, spoken of in otherworldly legends where it's said to pierce through those it's aimed at multiple times in a single thrust, holds a power that can't fully be unlocked in Grand Gaia and only becomes available when one feels its alien power surge from within. However, the tremendous power that is unleashed when it is activated is so strong that it enables its bearer to break through their enemies defenses.

raw.en: This magical lance, spoken of in otherworldly legends where it's said to pierce through those it's aimed at multiple times in a single thrust, holds a power that can't fully be unlocked in Grand Gaia and only becomes available when one feels its alien power surge from within. However, the tremendous power that is unleashed when it is activated is so strong that it enables its bearer to break through their enemies defenses.
raw.es: Esta lanza mágica, mencionada en leyendas sobrenaturales donde se dice que atraviesa múltiples veces a quien se ataca en un solo golpe, posee un poder que no puede liberarse totalmente en Gran Gaia y solo está disponible cuando se siente su poder alienígena surgir desde dentro. Sin embargo, el enorme poder que se libera al activarse es tan fuerte que permite a su portador atravesar las defensas de sus enemigos.

raw.pt: Lendas de outros mundos diziam que essa lança podia perfurar várias vezes seus alvos com um único golpe. Também dizem que ela tem um poder impossível de liberar completamente em Grand Gaia e só se torna disponível quando o usuário sente seu poder extraterrestre expandir dentro de si. No entanto, o poder incrível que é liberado quando ela é ativada é tão forte que permite ao usuário atravessar as defesas inimigas.
raw.th: หอกวิเศษ ถูกกล่าวถึงในตำนานของโลกอื่น ว่าแทงทะลุเป้าหมายของมันหลายครั้งในการจ้วงแทงครั้งเดียว และมีพลังที่ไม่สามารถปลดปล่อยได้เต็มที่ในแกรนด์ไกอา และจะใช้ได้ก็ต่อเมื่อผู้ใช้สัมผัสถึงพลังต่างโลกที่เอ่อล้นภายใน อย่างไรก็ตามพลังมหาศาลของมันที่ปลดปล่อยออกมาเมื่อมันถูกใช้งานก็แข็งแกร่งมากจนทำให้ผู้ใช้สามารถทำลายการป้องกันของศัตรูได้
raw.vi: Truyền thuyết cho rằng cây giáo này có thể chọc thủng nhiều mục tiêu một lúc và được coi là một sức mạnh không thể nào cản được ở miền Grand Gaia và chỉ phát huy tác dụng khi người ta cảm nhận được sức mạnh bên trong nó. Tuy nhiên, sức mạnh lớn nhất của nó một khi đã được kích hoạt thì sẽ không một kẻ thù nào có thể đánh bại được

id: Katanya dengan memakan jantung Phoenix, burung yang memerintah atas kelahiran kembali, seseorang bisa mendapatkan hidup abadi. Berdasarkan legenda itu, kristal ini dinamakan "Mata Phoenix." Tidak jelas diketahui bagaimana kristal ini, yang menambah vitalitas mahkluk hidup dan meningkatkan kecepatan pemulihan mereka secara berlipat, dibuat. Untuk alasan itu, dispekulasikan bahwa dia dibuat dari mata Phoenix yang menjadi kristal.
name: MST_SPHERES_34808_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: It is said that by consuming the heart of a Phoenix, the bird that rules over rebirth, one can gain eternal life. Based on that legend, this crystal was named the "Phoenix Eye." It wasn't clearly known how this crystal, which enhances the vitality of living creatures and increases their recovery rate many fold, was produced. For that reason, it has come to be speculated that it was formed from a crystalized Phoenix eye.

raw.en: It is said that by consuming the heart of a Phoenix, the bird that rules over rebirth, one can gain eternal life. Based on that legend, this crystal was named the "Phoenix Eye." It wasn't clearly known how this crystal, which enhances the vitality of living creatures and increases their recovery rate many fold, was produced. For that reason, it has come to be speculated that it was formed from a crystalized Phoenix eye.
raw.es: Se dice que ingerir el corazón de un Fénix, el ave reina del renacimiento, puede ganarse vida eterna. Con base en esa leyenda, este cristal fue nombrado "Ojo de fénix". No se sabe con claridad cómo se creó este cristal, que aumenta la vitalidad de las criaturas vivientes y aumenta muchas veces la velocidad de recuperación. Por esa razón, se especula que fue formado de un ojo de Fénix cristalizado.

Tidak jelas diketahui bagaimana kristal ini, yang menambah vitalitas mahkluk hidup dan meningkatkan kecepatan pemulihan mereka secara berlipat, dibuat. raw.pt: Dizem que é possível obter a vida eterna ao cosumir o coração de uma Fênix, o pássado que domina o renascimento. Com base nessa lenda, esse cristal recebeu o nome de “Olho da Fênix”. Não se sabe como este cristal foi produzido, mas ele aprimora a vitalidade e aumenta em muitas vezes a capacidade de recuperação de criaturas vivas. Por esse motivo, alguns especulam que ele tenha se formado a partir do olho cristalizado de uma Fênix.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าการกินหัวใจของฟินิกซ์ นกที่เป็นจ้าวแห่งการกำเนิดใหม่ จะทำให้ได้รับชีวิตนิรันดร์ ตามตำนานนั้นผลึกนี้ถูกเรียกว่า "ตาฟินิกซ์" คริสตัลซึ่งเสริมพลังให้กับสิ่งมีชีวิตและเพิ่มอัตราฟื้นฟูหลายเท่า ไม่มีใครรู้ว่ามันถูกผลิตมาอย่างไร จึงทำให้คาดการณ์ว่ามันก่อตัวขึ้นมาจากลูกตาฟินิกซ์เปลี่ยนเป็นผลึก
raw.vi: Người ta nói rằng với trái tim phượng hoàng, các loài chim sẽ được trường thọ. Dựa trên truyền thuyết, vật thể này được gọi là "Mắt phượng hoàng". Người ta vẫn chưa biết rõ vật thể này như thế nào, nó giúp tạo ra sự sống của các loài sinh vật sống và tăng tỷ lệ hồi sinh cho chúng. Vì lý do đó mà nó được cho rằng nó hình thành từ mắt của một Phượng Hoàng.

id:
Aku bertanya padamu.
"Mengapa aku harus memberikanmu kekuatan lalu harus menyelamatkanmu?"
Aku menantangmu.
"Kenapa aku bukan dari terang, dan juga bukan dari gelap?"
name: MST_SPHERES_34809_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc:
I ask you.
"Why must I grant you strength then have to save you?"
I challenge you.
"Why am I not of light, nor of darkness?"

raw.en:

raw.es:
Te pregunto.
"¿Por qué habría de concederte fuerza y luego tener que salvarte?"
Te reto.
"¿Por qué no soy de luz ni oscuridad?"

raw.th:
ข้าถามเจ้า
"ทำไมข้าต้องมอบพลังให้เจ้าจากนั้นต้องไปช่วยเหลือเจ้า?"
ข้าท้าทายเจ้า
"ทำไมข้าถึงไม่ใช่ทั้งแสงสว่าง หรือทั้งความมืด?"
raw.vi:
Tôi hỏi bạn.
"Tại sao tôi phải truyền sức mạnh cho bạn, rồi sau dó lại phải cứu bạn?"
Tôi đố bạn đấy
"Tại sao tôi không phải là ánh sáng hay bóng tối?"

id: Tombak suci legendaris, ujungnya bisa mengabaikan semua pertahanan dan langsung menusuk segala material. Banyak yang mengharap bisa dipakai untuk melawan dewa, dengan semua keyakinan atas pertahanan mereka sendiri, namun sayang tidak ada yang bisa memakainya. Oleh karena itu, banyak sarjana yang berkata si tombak itu hidup dan memutuskan sendiri kapan dan lokasi pengaktifannya.
name: MST_SPHERES_34900_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A legendary holy spear, the tip of which is said to ignore all defenses and penetrate straight through any material. Many expected that it could be used even against the gods, with all the confidence they had in their own defenses, but unfortunately not just anyone could wield it. Due to this, there are many scholars who say the spear is alive and decides on its own where and when to activate.

raw.en: A legendary holy spear, the tip of which is said to ignore all defenses and penetrate straight through any material. Many expected that it could be used even against the gods, with all the confidence they had in their own defenses, but unfortunately not just anyone could wield it. Due to this, there are many scholars who say the spear is alive and decides on its own where and when to activate.
raw.es: Una legendaria lanza sagrada cuya punta es capaz de atravesar cualquier defensa o material que se interpongan en su camino. Muchos creyeron que se podría usar contra los dioses que confiaban en exceso en la fiabilidad de sus defensas. Por desgracia, la lanza no se deja portar por cualquiera. De hecho, hay eruditos que afirman que la lanza tiene vida propia y decide sola cuándo pasar a la acción.
raw.id: Tombak suci legendaris, ujungnya bisa mengabaikan semua pertahanan dan langsung menusuk segala material. Banyak yang mengharap bisa dipakai untuk melawan dewa, dengan semua keyakinan atas pertahanan mereka sendiri, namun sayang tidak ada yang bisa memakainya. Oleh karena itu, banyak sarjana yang berkata si tombak itu hidup dan memutuskan sendiri kapan dan lokasi pengaktifannya.
raw.pt: Uma lança sagrada lendária cuja ponta é conhecida por ignorar qualquer defesa e atravessar qualquer material. Muitos esperavam que ela pudesse ser usada até contra deuses, com toda a confiança que eles tinham em suas defesas, mas infelizmente ela não podia ser usada por qualquer um. Por conta disso, muitos sábios dizem que a lança está viva e decide quando e onde é ativada.
raw.th: หอกศักดิ์สิทธิ์ในตำนาน ซึ่งว่ากันว่าส่วนปลายของมันสามารถทะลวงผ่านทุกวัสดุโดยไม่สนใจการป้องกัน หลายคนคาดหวังว่ามันจะสามารถใช้งานกับเทพเจ้าได้ ด้วยความเชื่อมั่นที่พวกเขามีอยู่ในการป้องกันตัวเอง แต่น่าเสียดายที่ไม่ใช่ทุกคนจะสามารถใช้มันได้ เพราะเหตุนี้ผู้มีปัญญาหลายคนได้กล่าวไว้ว่า หอกนี้มีชีวิตและมันตัดสินใจได้ด้วยตัวเองว่าที่ไหน และเมื่อไหร่ถึงจะเปิดใช้งาน
raw.vi: Cây thương thánh trong truyền thuyết, người ta đồn rằng đầu cây thương có thể xiên qua mọi lớp phòng vệ và đâm thẳng vào bất kỳ chất liệu nào. Rất nhiều người hi vọng rằng cây thương này có thể dùng để chống lại ngay cả những vị thần, với sự tự tin tuyệt đối rằng mình là bất khả xâm phạm, nhưng đáng tiếc chẳng có ai có thể sử dụng cây thương này. Do đó mà có nhiều học giả cho rằng cây thương này có linh hồn và có thể tự quyết định rằng ở đâu và khi nào thì nó được kích hoạt.

id: Ada seorang ahli alkemis yang penasaran apakah ia bisa membuka kekuatan laten manusia dengan item sihir. Akhirnya ia menciptakan itu, memakai kekuatan piliran manusia, memanipulasi potensi dalamnya. Saat orang yang dipasangi item ini mencapai pikiran yang lebih tinggi, kemampuannya meningkat. Namun katanya si ahli alkemis tidak puas dengan hasilnya dan melanjutkan risetnya.
name: MST_SPHERES_35000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There once was an alchemist who wondered if, with magical items, he could unlock the latent powers of people. He ended up creating one that, using a person's state of mind, could manipulate their inner potential. When one who has equipped this item achieves an uplifted state of mind, their abilities are enhanced. It is said, however, that he was unsatisfied with the results and continued his research.

raw.en: There once was an alchemist who wondered if, with magical items, he could unlock the latent powers of people. He ended up creating one that, using a person's state of mind, could manipulate their inner potential. When one who has equipped this item achieves an uplifted state of mind, their abilities are enhanced. It is said, however, that he was unsatisfied with the results and continued his research.
raw.es: Existió un alquimista que se preguntaba si podría liberar los poderes latentes en las personas con ayuda de objetos mágicos. Para resolver su duda, creó uno capaz de manipular el potencial de las personas recurriendo a su estado de ánimo. Quien equipa esta roca siente su ánimo ensalzado y mejora así sus talentos. Curiosamente, se dice que el alquimista no quedó satisfecho con su creación, así que siguió investigando.
raw.id: Ada seorang ahli alkemis yang penasaran apakah ia bisa membuka kekuatan laten manusia dengan item sihir. Akhirnya ia menciptakan itu, memakai kekuatan piliran manusia, memanipulasi potensi dalamnya. Saat orang yang dipasangi item ini mencapai pikiran yang lebih tinggi, kemampuannya meningkat. Namun katanya si ahli alkemis tidak puas dengan hasilnya dan melanjutkan risetnya.
raw.pt: Houve um alquimista que se perguntava se podia liberar os poderes ocultos das pessoas com itens mágicos. Ele acabou criando um item que conseguia manipular o potencial interior de uma pessoa usando o estado mental dela. Quando quem utiliza o item alcança um estado mental elevado, suas habilidades são melhoradas. No entanto, dizem que ele não se satisfez com os resultados e continuou suas pesquisas.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีนักเล่นแร่แปรธาตุ ซึ่งสงสัยว่าด้วยไอเทมวิเศษ เขาอาจจะสามารถปลดปล่อยพลังที่ซ่อนเร้นของผู้คน เขาจบลงด้วยการสร้างไอเทมชิ้นหนึ่งที่ใช้สถานะจิตใจของบุคคล และสามารถควบคุมศักยภาพภายในของพวกเขาได้ เมื่อมีคนสวมใส่ไอเทมนี้ ความสามารถของพวกเขาก็จะเพิ่มขึ้น อย่างไรก็ดีมีการกล่าวว่าเขายังไม่พอใจกับผลลัพธ์ที่ได้ และยังคงวิจัยงานของเขาต่อไป
raw.vi: Trước kia từng có một nhà giả kim muốn biết rằng nếu như có những món đồ mang phép thuật liệu ông ta có thể giải phóng những sức mạnh tiềm tàng của con người. Và ông đã quyết định chế tạo một vật bằng tâm trí con người, có khả năng điều khiển năng lực tiềm tàng bên trong con người đó. Khi người sở hữu vật này đạt đến giới hạn cực cao của tâm trí, thì năng lực của họ sẽ tăng cao. Tuy nhiên người ta cũng đồn rằng nhà giả kim học kia chưa hài lòng với những kết quả mình đạt được và tiếp tục nghiên cứu của mình.

id: Meski memiliki kekuatan besar sebagai pejuang, ada banyak cerita tentang kegagalan Log Node. Satu, ia sangat fobia sosial. Katanya batu yang ia sayangi punya kekuatan membuka potensi tersembunyi siapa pun yang memiliki batu ini. Namun batu ini membawa kelemahan pemilik awalnya, efeknya jadi sia-sia saat pemilik barunya mencapai kondisi pikiran yang senang.
name: MST_SPHERES_35001_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Despite the great power he possesed as a warrior, there are many stories of Log Node's failures. For one, he had extreme social phobias. It's said that stone he treasured had the power to unlock the hidden potential of whoever possessed it. However, it retained the flaws of its original owner, rendering its effects useless when the person holding it reaches a pleasant state of mind.

raw.en: Despite the great power he possesed as a warrior, there are many stories of Log Node's failures. For one, he had extreme social phobias. It's said that stone he treasured had the power to unlock the hidden potential of whoever possessed it. However, it retained the flaws of its original owner, rendering its effects useless when the person holding it reaches a pleasant state of mind.
raw.es: A pesar de su excelencia como guerrero, muchas historias narran los fracasos de Log Node, un hombre con terribles problemas para socializar. Se dice que guardaba como oro en paño una roca capaz de liberar el potencial oculto de quien la poseyera. Por desgracia, la roca tenía fallos, como su dueño, y no funcionaba si la persona que la llevaba no estaba de buen ánimo.
raw.id: Meski memiliki kekuatan besar sebagai pejuang, ada banyak cerita tentang kegagalan Log Node. Satu, ia sangat fobia sosial. Katanya batu yang ia sayangi punya kekuatan membuka potensi tersembunyi siapa pun yang memiliki batu ini. Namun batu ini membawa kelemahan pemilik awalnya, efeknya jadi sia-sia saat pemilik barunya mencapai kondisi pikiran yang senang.
raw.pt: Apesar do grande poder que tinha como guerreiro, há muitos relatos de fracassos de Log Node. Um deles era sua série de fobias sociais extremas. Dizem que a pedra que ele guardava tinha o poder de liberar o potencial oculto de quem a usasse. No entanto, ela mantinha os defeitos do dono original, anulando os efeitos quando o usuário estiver com um estado mental elevado.
raw.th: แม้จะมีพลังอันยิ่งใหญ่ที่เขาได้ครอบครองในฐานะนักรบ มันมีเรื่องราวมากมายเกี่ยวกับความล้มเหลวของ 'ล็อกนอท' หนึ่งในนั้นคือโรคกลัวการเข้าสังคมอย่างมาก ว่ากันว่าหินที่เขารักมีอำนาจที่จะปลดปล่อยศักยภาพที่ซ่อนอยู่ของใครก็ตามที่ครอบครองมัน แต่มันก็ยังคงมีข้อบกพร่องของเจ้าของเดิมที่ยังแสดงผลกระทบอยู่
raw.vi: Mặc dù sở hữu quyền năng vĩ đại với tư cách là một chiến binh nhưng vẫn có rất nhiều câu chuyện kể về những lần thất bại của Log Node. Một trong số đó là câu chuyện kể rằng ông bị ám ảnh cùng cực bởi mối quan hệ giữa con người với con người. Người ta đồn rằng viên đá mà ông có được sở hữu quyền năng có thể giải phóng sức mạnh tiềm ẩn của bất kỳ ai sở hữu nó. Tuy nhiên, viên đá này vẫn giữ lại những khuyết điểm của người sở hữu đầu tiên, đó là trở nên vô hiệu khi người sở hữu nó đạt đến cảnh giới tâm trí tối cao.

id: Juga dikenal sebagai Loglas Mana, batu ini diisi kebijaksanaan dewa-dewa yang meminta pikiran pemiliknya dalam kondisi puncak. Meski permintaannya besar, jika dipenuhi, pemiliknya akan mengalami perubahan drastis. Bukan hanya diberikan kebijaksanaan agung, mereka juga diperkenalkan pada sisi yang benar-benar baru dari diri sendiri.
name: MST_SPHERES_35002_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Also known as Loglas Mana, this stone infused with the wisdom of the gods requires that the owners state of mind be at its peak. Though its requirements are large, when they are met, the owner experiences immense change. Not only are they granted great wisdom, they're introduced to an entirely new side of themselves.

raw.en: Also known as Loglas Mana, this stone infused with the wisdom of the gods requires that the owners state of mind be at its peak. Though its requirements are large, when they are met, the owner experiences immense change. Not only are they granted great wisdom, they're introduced to an entirely new side of themselves.
raw.es: Esta roca, que también recibe el nombre de Maná de Loglas, está imbuida de la sabiduría de los dioses. Por ello, para usarla se ha de tener un estado de ánimo excelente. Cuando sus exigencias de uso se cumplen, quien la tiene experimenta un inmenso cambio: además de otorgar el don de la sabiduría, la roca da a conocer a quien la usa una faceta oculta de sí mismo.
raw.id: Juga dikenal sebagai Loglas Mana, batu ini diisi kebijaksanaan dewa-dewa yang meminta pikiran pemiliknya dalam kondisi puncak. Meski permintaannya besar, jika dipenuhi, pemiliknya akan mengalami perubahan drastis. Bukan hanya diberikan kebijaksanaan agung, mereka juga diperkenalkan pada sisi yang benar-benar baru dari diri sendiri.
raw.pt: Também conhecida como Loglas Mana, esta pedra foi injetada com a sabedoria dos deuses e requer que o estado mental do usuário esteja no auge. Apesar de ter altos requisitos, quando eles são cumpridos o usuário sente uma mudança extrema. Ele não somente ganha grande sabedoria, mas também é apresentado a um lado totalmente novo de si mesmo.
raw.th: รู้จักกันในอีกชื่อหนึ่งว่า 'ล็อกลาส มานา'  หินที่อาบไปด้วยภูมิปัญญาของพระเจ้าที่ต้องการให้สภาวะทางจิตใจของผู้เป็นเจ้าของอยู่ที่จุดสูงสุด แม้ความต้องการของมันจะดูมากมาย แต่ถ้าหากทำได้ผู้ครอบครองมันก็จะมีการเปลี่ยนแปลงอย่างมหาศาล ไม่เพียงแต่พวกเขาจะได้รับภูมิปัญญาอันยิ่งใหญ่ พวกเขายังได้รู้จักกับด้านใหม่ทั้งหมดของตัวเอง
raw.vi: Còn được biết đến với cái tên Leoglas Mana, viên đá này được truyền sự thông thái của các vị thần, đòi hỏi tâm trí của người sở hữu phải ở mức đỉnh điểm. Mặc dù yêu cầu khó khăn như vậy, nhưng khi đã đáp ứng được thì người sở hữu sẽ trải nghiệm được sự thay đổi vô cùng to lớn. Không chỉ được ban cho sự thông thái, mà người sở hữu còn được khám phá khía cạnh hoàn toàn mới của chính bản thân mình

id: Ada kisah lama tentang bahtera yang menyelamatkan banyak orang selagi dunia dihancurkan oleh banjir. Setelah mendengar kisah itu, ada ahli alkimia yang memutuskan untuk membuat sesuatu yang serupa, melindungi pemiliknya dari bencana yang sama, jadi ia mulai mengerjakan mantranya. Selesai tepat sebelum wafat, produk akhir ini, permata yang dia poles sepenuh hati, dinamai dirinya, Lignes.
name: MST_SPHERES_35100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There's an old story about an ark that saved many people as the world was being destroyed by a flood. Upon hearing this story, there was an alchemist who decided he wanted to make something similar that would protect its owner from similar disasters, so he began work on his charm. He finished it right before his death, and the final product, the gem he'd so passionately polished, was given his name, Lignes.

raw.en: There's an old story about an ark that saved many people as the world was being destroyed by a flood. Upon hearing this story, there was an alchemist who decided he wanted to make something similar that would protect its owner from similar disasters, so he began work on his charm. He finished it right before his death, and the final product, the gem he'd so passionately polished, was given his name, Lignes.
raw.es: Cuenta una vieja historia que un arca salvo a mucha gente de morir ahogada durante una gran inundación. Tras escuchar esta historia, un alquimista decidió hacer algo similar y comenzó a trabajar en un talismán capaz de proteger a su dueño de desastres similares. Lo acabó justo antes de morir. La bella gema en la que tanto esfuerzo puso el alquimista recibió por ello su nombre: Lignes.
raw.id: Ada kisah lama tentang bahtera yang menyelamatkan banyak orang selagi dunia dihancurkan oleh banjir. Setelah mendengar kisah itu, ada ahli alkimia yang memutuskan untuk membuat sesuatu yang serupa, melindungi pemiliknya dari bencana yang sama, jadi ia mulai mengerjakan mantranya. Selesai tepat sebelum wafat, produk akhir ini, permata yang dia poles sepenuh hati, dinamai dirinya, Lignes.
raw.pt: Há uma antiga história sobre uma arca que salvou muitas pessoas quando o mundo estava sendo destruído por um dilúvio. Ao ouvir essa história, um alquimista decidiu que queria fazer algo semelhante para proteger o usuário de desastres parecidos. Então ele começou a trabalhar em um amuleto. Ele concluiu o trabalho pouco antes de morrer e o produto final, a gema que ele poliu com tanto amor, recebeu seu nome: Lignes.
raw.th: มีเรื่องเก่าเกี่ยวกับเรือที่ช่วยคนจำนวนมาก ในขณะที่โลกกำลังถูกทำลายโดยน้ำท่วม เมื่อได้ยินเรื่องนี้ก็มีนักเล่นแร่แปรธาตุที่ตัดสินใจว่าเขาต้องการทำอะไรบางอย่างที่คล้ายกัน เพื่อปกป้องเจ้าของจากภัยพิบัติที่คล้ายกัน ดังนั้นเขาจึงเริ่มสร้างเครื่องรางของเขา เขาได้สร้างมันเสร็จก่อนที่เขาจะตาย และผลงานขั้นสุดท้ายก็คืออัญมณีที่เขาขัดถูมันด้วยความลุ่มหลง โดยมันถูกตั้งชื่อว่า 'ลิกเนส'
raw.vi: Có một câu chuyện xưa kể về một con thuyền lớn đã cứu sống rất nhiều người khi thế giới bị nhấn chìm bởi một cơn đại hồng thủy. Sau khi nghe câu chuyện này, một nhà giả kim đã quyết định chế tạo một thứ tương tự có thể bảo vệ người sở hữu khỏi những thiên tai tương tự, vì thế ông bắt đầu làm việc hăng say. Ông hoàn thành vật đó ngay trước khi qua đời, và vật phẩm do ông tạo ra,  viên ngọc được ông đánh bóng bằng tất cả niềm sy mê, đã được đặt theo tên ông, Lignes.

id: Pedang panjang yang dibuat memakai teknik yang tidak seperti pedang temuan di Gaia Besar. Pedang ini dilengkapi alat khusus, jika diaktifkan, menyelubungi total si pedang dan pemakainya dalam membran tipis. Item langka ini diinginkan banyak ahli pedang karena kemampuan orang yang terbungkus membran ini sangat bertambah.
name: MST_SPHERES_35200_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A long sword made using techniques unlike those found in Grand Gaia. The sword is equipped with a special device that, when activated, completely envelopes both the sword and the user in a thin membrane. This rare item is desired by legions of swordsman as it is said that the abilities of those wrapped in this membrane are greatly increased.

raw.en: A long sword made using techniques unlike those found in Grand Gaia. The sword is equipped with a special device that, when activated, completely envelopes both the sword and the user in a thin membrane. This rare item is desired by legions of swordsman as it is said that the abilities of those wrapped in this membrane are greatly increased.
raw.es: Una espada larga fabricada siguiendo unas técnicas completamente distintas a las de Gran Gaia. Cuenta con un mecanismo especial que, al activarse, recubre tanto la espada como a quien la empuña en una fina membrana que potencia sus talentos. Por ello, esta extraña arma es el objeto de deseo de miles de espadachines.
raw.id: Pedang panjang yang dibuat memakai teknik yang tidak seperti pedang temuan di Gaia Besar. Pedang ini dilengkapi alat khusus, jika diaktifkan, menyelubungi total si pedang dan pemakainya dalam membran tipis. Item langka ini diinginkan banyak ahli pedang karena kemampuan orang yang terbungkus membran ini sangat bertambah.
raw.pt: Uma espada longa feita com técnicas diferentes das vistas em Grand Gaia. A espada é equipada com um dispositivo especial que, quando é ativado, envolve completamente a espada e o usuário com uma membrana fina. Este item raro é desejado por legiões de espadachins, já que dizem que as habilidades dos envoltos pela membrana melhoram muito.
raw.th: ดาบยาวซึ่งถูกทำขึ้นด้วยเทคนิคที่แตกต่างจากที่พบในแกรนด์ไกอา  ตัวดาบถูกสวมด้วยอุปกรณ์พิเศษ ที่เมื่อเปิดใช้งานทั้งดาบและผู้ใช้จะถูกหุ้มด้วยเยื่อบางๆ อย่างสมบูรณ์แบบ ของหายากชิ้นนี้เป็นที่ต้องการโดยกองทหารของพวกนักดาบ เพราะมีการกล่าวว่า ความสามารถของผู้ที่ถูกห่อหุ้มอยู่ในเยื่อนี้ จะเพิ่มขึ้นอย่างมากมาย
raw.vi: Một thanh gươm dài được chế tạo bằng những kỹ nghệ không giống với bất kỳ kỹ nghệ nào tại Grand Gaia. Thanh gươm này được trang bị một thiết bị đặc biệt mà khi kích hoạt sẽ bao bọc toàn bộ thanh gươm lẫn người mang gươm trong một lớp màng mỏng. Món đồ hiếm này là mỏ ước của vô số kiếm sĩ bởi người ta đồn rằng năng lực của người được bao bọc trong lớp màng này sẽ tăng lên rất nhiều.

id: Tameng ini, dinamai dari Abaddon, dewa penghancur, selain menambah pertahanan, juga diisi sihir unik yang menambah HP pengguna. Setelah melihat mulut terbuka yang menghiasinya, ada beberapa yang enggan memasangnya, meski tameng ini sangat kuat.
name: MST_SPHERES_35201_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This armor, named after Abaddon the god of destruction, on top of boosting defense is also infused with a unique magic that increases the user. However, upon seeing the ominous gaping mouth that adorns it, there are some who hesitate to equip it no matter how powerful it is.

raw.en: This armor, named after Abaddon the god of destruction, on top of boosting defense is also infused with a unique magic that increases the user. However, upon seeing the ominous gaping mouth that adorns it, there are some who hesitate to equip it no matter how powerful it is.
raw.es: Esta coraza creada en honor a Abaddon, el dios de la destrucción, está imbuida de una magia sin igual que mejora tanto la defensa de quien la lleva como al propio portador. Sin embargo, la ominosa boca que la adorna hace que muchos duden en ponérsela a pesar de lo poderosa que es.
raw.id: Tameng ini, dinamai dari Abaddon, dewa penghancur, selain menambah pertahanan, juga diisi sihir unik yang menambah HP pengguna. Setelah melihat mulut terbuka yang menghiasinya, ada beberapa yang enggan memasangnya, meski tameng ini sangat kuat.
raw.pt: Esta armadura, que teve o nome inspirado em Abaddon, o deus da destruição, além de melhorar a defesa, também possui uma magia única que melhora o usuário. No entanto, ao ver a grande boca assustadora que a enfeita, há alguns que exitam em usá-la, independente de todo seu poder.
raw.th: เกราะนี้ตั้งชื่อตาม แอ๊บบาดอน เทพเจ้าแห่งการทำลายล้าง นอกเหนือจากการเพิ่มพลังป้องกัน คือการอาบด้วยพลังเวทย์ที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์ที่ทำให้เพิ่มพลังของผู้ใช้ แต่เมื่อเห็นปากที่อ้าปากค้างเป็นลางไม่ดีตกแต่งเอาไว้ของมัน ก็มีบางคนที่ลังเลจะสวมใส่มัน โดยไม่สนว่ามันจะมีพลังมากแค่ไหน
raw.vi: Bộ áo giáp này được theo tên của thần hủy diệt Abaddon, nằm trong số những bộ áo giáp có khả năng tăng sức phòng thủ lên cao nhất, đồng thời cũng được truyền sức mạnh ma thuật độc nhất vô nhị có khả năng phóng đại những ai mang bộ giáp. Tuy nhiên, sau khi thấy được khe hở đáng ngại trên bộ giáp, một số người đã do dự không sử dụng bộ giáp này bất kể sức mạnh của nó.

¿Por qué me quieres?... ¿Qué buscas?

Por que precisa de mim... O que está procurando?

raw.th:
ข้าขอให้เจ้า
ทำไมท่านถึงต้องการให้ข้าทำ ... มันคืออะไรที่ท่านค้นหา?
ข้าท้าทายเจ้า
ทำไมข้าอยู่ที่นี่ ... ทำไมข้าถึงต้องมีตัวตน?
raw.vi: Ta hỏi ngươi. "Tại sao ngươi muốn ta...Điều ngươi tìm kiếm là gì?" Vậy ta hỏi ngươi. "Tại sao ta lại ở đây...Lý do mà ta tồn tại là gì"

id: Jimat yang dipanggil "Sinar Tiara", dinamakan dari dua sinar yang katanya dipancarkan oleh raja-raja. Katanya sinar ini punya kekuatan untuk melindungi pemimpin dunia dari semua racun, sakit, dan kutukan. Di belakang jimat ini tertulis nama penciptanya, Luva, dengan sebuah kutipan darinya yang berbunyi, "Median, tidak mungkin menciptakan dunia yang damai hanya dengan cita-cita saja."
name: MST_SPHERES_35300_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An amulet called the "Crown Light," named after one of the two lights said to be given off by kings. It is said that this light has the power to protect the ruler of the world from all deadly poisons, illnesses, and curses. On the back of the amulet is inscribed its creator's name, Luva, along with a quote from him which reads, "Median, it's impossible to create a world of peace on ideals alone."

raw.en: An amulet called the "Crown Light," named after one of the two lights said to be given off by kings. It is said that this light has the power to protect the ruler of the world from all deadly poisons, illnesses, and curses. On the back of the amulet is inscribed its creator's name, Luva, along with a quote from him which reads, "Median, it's impossible to create a world of peace on ideals alone."
raw.es: Amuleto llamado "Luz coronada", nombrado por una de las dos luces que se dice fueron otorgadas por los reyes. Se dice que esta luz tiene el poder de proteger al gobernante del mundo de todos los venenos, enfermedades y maldiciones. En el reverso del amuleto está inscrito el nombre de su creador, Luva, junto con una cita suya que dice: "Median, es imposible crear un mundo de paz basado solo en ideales".
raw.id: Jimat yang dipanggil "Sinar Tiara", dinamakan dari dua sinar yang katanya dipancarkan oleh raja-raja. Katanya sinar ini punya kekuatan untuk melindungi pemimpin dunia dari semua racun, sakit, dan kutukan. Di belakang jimat ini tertulis nama penciptanya, Luva, dengan sebuah kutipan darinya yang berbunyi, "Median, tidak mungkin menciptakan dunia yang damai hanya dengan cita-cita saja."
raw.pt: Um amuleto chamado de “Luz da Coroa”, que tem o nome de uma das duas luzes que dizem que os reis davam. Dizem que essa luz tem o poder de proteger o senhor do mundo de todos os venenos, doenças e maldições mortais. A parte de trás do amuleto é gravada com o nome de quem o criou, Luva, e uma frase dela que diz, “Median, é impossível criar um mundo de paz somente com ideais”.
raw.th: เครื่องรางที่เรียกว่า "คราวน์ไลท์" ตั้งชื่อตามหนึ่งในแสงทั้งสองที่ว่ากันว่าถูกมอบให้โดยพระราชา กล่าวกันว่าแสงนั้นมีพลังคุ้มครองผู้ปกครองโลก จากพิษร้าย ความเจ็บป่วย และ คำสาปทั้งหมด ด้านหลังเครื่องรางมีการสลักชื่อของผู้สร้างมันขึ้น ลูวา และคำพูดของเขาซึ่งเขียนเอาไว้ว่า "มีเดียน, มันไม่มีทางเป็นไปได้ที่จะสร้างโลกที่สงบสุข ด้วยอุดมคติเพียงอย่างเดียว"
raw.vi: Một bùa hộ mệnh được gọi là "Hào quang mũ", đặt theo tên của một trong hai ánh sáng của các vị vua. Người ta nói rằng những ánh sáng này có sức mạnh bảo vệ kẻ thống trị thế giới khỏi bị thuốc độc, ốm đau, tai họa. Ở phía sau nó là tên của người tạo ra nó là Luva cùng với những dẫn "Median, bạn sẽ không thể tạo ra một thế giới hòa bình nếu chỉ dùng chính sức mình"

id: Jimat yang dipanggil "Sinar Raja", dinamakan dari dua sinar yang katanya dipancarkan oleh raja-raja. Katanya sinar ini melindungi semua yang memerintah dunia dari kelemahan, luka, dan kelumpuhan. Sisa-sida dari kata-kata yang terukir di belakangnya oleh pencipta jimat ini, Median, terbaca, "Aku... mengejar... cita-cita. Di... ...Aku percaya."

Remnants of what was engraved on the back by the amulet's creator, Median, read, "I... chase... ideals. In... ...I believe."

Se dice que su luz protege a quien gobierna al mundo de debilidad, heridas y parálisis. Los restos del grabado que su creador, Median, colocó en el reverso del amuleto, dice: "Yo... perseguir... ideales. En... yo creo".

Sisa-sida dari kata-kata yang terukir di belakangnya oleh pencipta jimat ini, Median, terbaca, "Aku... mengejar... cita-cita. Di... ...Aku percaya."
raw.pt: Um amuleto chamado de “Luz Real”, que tem o nome de uma das duas luzes que dizem que os reis davam. Dizem que essa luz protege aquele que governa o mundo de fraqueza, lesão e paralisia. Resquícios do que foi gravado na parte de trás por Median, o criador do amuleto, dizem “Eu... busco... ideais. Em... ...acredito."
raw.th: เครื่องรางที่เรียกว่า "รอยัลไลท์" ตั้งชื่อตามหนึ่งในแสงทั้งสองที่ว่ากันว่าถูกมอบให้โดยพระราชา กล่าวกันว่าแสงนี้คุ้มครองผู้ที่ดูแลโลก จากความอ่อนแอ บาดเจ็บ และอัมพาต ร่องรอยของคำที่สลักอยู่ด้านหลังโดยผู้สร้างเครื่องราง มีเดียน อ่านได้ว่า "ข้า... ไล่ล่า... อุดมคติ ที่... ...ข้าเชื่อ"
raw.vi: Một bùa hộ mệnh được gọi là "Ánh sáng hoàng gia", đặt theo tên của một trong hai ánh sáng của các vị vua. Người ta nói rằng những ánh sáng này có sức mạnh bảo vệ kẻ thống trị thế giới khỏi ốm đau, thương tích và tê liệt. Lời ghi chú được khắc ở phía lưng của người lập ra bùa đó "Tôi đi theo các lý tưởng và tôi tin vào chúng"

id: Intan yang dinamakan dari pulau yang ada di Gaia Besar. Dikenal karena legenda para raksasa, merupakan tempat tinggal dari banyak monster yang sangat kuat. Meskipun para raksasa menciptakan intan ini untuk membantu mereka melawan monster-monster ini, untuk orang biasa, diperlukan kekuatan yang setara dengan seorang raksasa untuk menggunakannya. Sepertinya mereka yang bisa mengeluarkan kekuatannya diberikan kekuatan para raksasa.
name: MST_SPHERES_35400_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A jewel named after an island that exists in Grand Gaia. Known for its legend of giants, it's home to countless incredibly strong monsters. Though giants created this jewel to help them oppose these monsters, for a normal person to unleash its power they too must have the energy of a giant. It seems those who are able to unleash its power are granted the strength of the giants.

raw.en: A jewel named after an island that exists in Grand Gaia. Known for its legend of giants, it's home to countless incredibly strong monsters. Though giants created this jewel to help them oppose these monsters, for a normal person to unleash its power they too must have the energy of a giant. It seems those who are able to unleash its power are granted the strength of the giants.
raw.es: Una joya nombrada por una isla de Gran Gaia. Conocida por su leyenda de gigantes, es hogar de innumerables monstruos de asombrosa fuerza. Aunque los gigantes crearon esta joya para ayudarles a enfrentar a los monstruos, para que una persona normal libere su poder debe tener la energía de un gigante. Parece que a aquellos que son capaces de liberar su poder se les concede la fuerza de los gigantes.
raw.id: Intan yang dinamakan dari pulau yang ada di Gaia Besar. Dikenal karena legenda para raksasa, merupakan tempat tinggal dari banyak monster yang sangat kuat. Meskipun para raksasa menciptakan intan ini untuk membantu mereka melawan monster-monster ini, untuk orang biasa, diperlukan kekuatan yang setara dengan seorang raksasa untuk menggunakannya. Sepertinya mereka yang bisa mengeluarkan kekuatannya diberikan kekuatan para raksasa.
raw.pt: Uma joia que recebeu o nome de uma ilha de Grand Gaia. Conhecida pela lenda dos gigantes, é terra de inúmeros monstros incrivelmente fortes. Apesar de gigantes terem criado esta joia para ajudá-los a enfrentar esses monstros, para uma pessoa normal poder liberar o poder dela, também precisa ter a energia de um gigante. Parece que aqueles que conseguem liberar o poder recebem a força dos gigantes.
raw.th: อัญมณีที่ตั้งชื่อตามเกาะที่มีอยู่ในแกรนด์ไกอา เป็นที่รู้จักกันเพราะตำนานเกี่ยวกับยักษ์ของมัน เป็นแหล่งอาศัยของมอนสเตอร์ที่แข็งแกร่งอย่างไม่น่าเชื่อนับไม่ถ้วน แต่ยักษ์ใหญ่สร้างอัญมณีนี้เพื่อช่วยให้พวกเขาต่อต้านมอนสเตอร์เหล่านี้ สำหรับคนปกติที่จะปลดปล่อยพลังของพวกเขาก็จะต้องมีการใช้พลังงานของยักษ์ ดูเหมือนว่าผู้ที่จะสามารถปลดปล่อยพลังของจะได้รับความแข็งแรงของยักษ์ใหญ่
raw.vi: Một đồ trang sức đặt theo tên của một hòn đảo ở Grand Gaia. Nó nổi tiếng với những huyền thoại: Nó là nhà của những con ma có sức mạnh vô biên.Đồ trang sức này được tạo ra để giúp những người khổng lồ chống lại lũ ma đó. Những người có khả năng lấy sức mạnh của đồ trang sức đó sẽ có được sức mạnh của các vị khổng lồ.

id: Tidak direkam siapa yang menamakan pedang aneh ini "Bilah Ubah." Tapi siapaun yang melihat bentuknya bisa mengerti kenapa dia dinamakan seperti itu. Terlihat sangat berbeda dari pedang biasa, sehingga banyak yang bertanya pada pemiliknya, El Bueler, "Ini bukan sebuah pedang tapi ular, betul kan?"Tapi, dia selalu menjawab tegas, "Tidak, ini memang sebuah pedang."
name: MST_SPHERES_35500_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: It is not recorded as to who gave this strange sword the name of "Alter Blade." However, anyone who looks at its shape can understand why it was named that. It looks completely different from normal swords, leading many to ask its owner, El Bueler, "This isn't a sword but a snake, is it not?" However, he always answers firmly, "Nay, it is in fact a sword."

raw.en: It is not recorded as to who gave this strange sword the name of "Alter Blade." However, anyone who looks at its shape can understand why it was named that. It looks completely different from normal swords, leading many to ask its owner, El Bueler, "This isn't a sword but a snake, is it not?" However, he always answers firmly, "Nay, it is in fact a sword."
raw.es: No existen registros de quién le dio esta rara espada el nombre de "Alterespada". Sin embargo, cualquiera que mire su forma puede entenderá porqué fue nombrada así. Tiene un aspecto totalmente distinto de una espada normal, lo que hace que muchos pregunten a su dueño, El Bueler, "Esta no es una espada sino una serpiente, ¿verdad?" Sin embargo, él siempre responde con firmeza, "Nah, es una espada de verdad".
raw.id: Tidak direkam siapa yang menamakan pedang aneh ini "Bilah Ubah." Tapi siapaun yang melihat bentuknya bisa mengerti kenapa dia dinamakan seperti itu. Terlihat sangat berbeda dari pedang biasa, sehingga banyak yang bertanya pada pemiliknya, El Bueler, "Ini bukan sebuah pedang tapi ular, betul kan?"Tapi, dia selalu menjawab tegas, "Tidak, ini memang sebuah pedang."
raw.pt: Não há registros sobre quem deu o nome de “Lâmina Alterada” para esta espada. No entanto, quem olhar para o formato dela consegue entender o motivo de ter esse nome. Ela parece diferente das espadas normais, levando muitos a perguntarem ao dono, El Bueler, “Isso não é uma espada, é uma cobra, não é?”. Mas ele sempre respondia com firmeza, “Não, é uma espada mesmo”.
raw.th: มันไม่ได้บันทึกไว้ว่าใครเป็นคนตั้งชื่อให้ดาบประหลาดนี้ว่า "อัลเทอร์เบลด" แต่อย่างไรก็ดี ใครก็ตามที่ได้เห็นรูปร่างของมันก็จะเข้าใจได้ว่าทำไมมันถึงถูกเรียกแบบนั้น มันดูแตกต่างจากดาบธรรมอย่างสิ้นเชิง ทำให้หลายคนไปถาม เอล บูเลอร์ เจ้าของมันว่า "นี่มันไม่ช่ดาบแต่เป็นงูใช่หรือไม่?" แต่เขามักจะตอบอย่างเชื่อมั่นว่า "ม่ายยย มันก็แค่ดาบนั่นแหละ"
raw.vi: Chưa có sách ghi chép về ai là người đặt tên cho thanh kiếm lạ này là "Kiếm xoay chuyển". Tuy nhiên,  nếu nhìn vào dáng ngoài của nó thì có thể hiểu được tại sao lại có tên đó. Nó hoàn toàn khác với những thanh kiếm bình thường, nhiều câu hỏi đặt ra cho chủ của nó là "Đây không phải là thanh kiếm mà là một con rắn có phải không ?" Câu trả lời là "Không, nó là một thanh kiếm thực thụ đây!"

id: Pedang yang menarik ini dikenal karena kekuatannya untuk memerintah naga datang dari keberadaan beast yang mencari naga untuk dimakan, membuatnya berubah menjadi pedang setelah dia kehabisan tenaga. Disebut sebagai pedang legendaris, tapi bendaunik ini bergabung dengan tangan penggunanya. Katanya ketika vitalitas dari pemilik pedang penuh, tangan itu akan membuat pedang bersinar seperti punya kepribadian sendiri, melepaskan kekuatan supranatural seperti naga.
name: MST_SPHERES_35501_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This fascinating sword known for its power to command dragons came to existence after a beast sought to eat a dragon, leading it to transform into a blade when it exhausted its life force. It has been referred to as a sword in legends, but this unique object merges with the arm of its wielder. It is said that when the vitality of this blade's owner is completely full, the arm turned sword shines as if it held a will of its own, unleashing a supernatural dragon-like power.

raw.en: This fascinating sword known for its power to command dragons came to existence after a beast sought to eat a dragon, leading it to transform into a blade when it exhausted its life force. It has been referred to as a sword in legends, but this unique object merges with the arm of its wielder. It is said that when the vitality of this blade's owner is completely full, the arm turned sword shines as if it held a will of its own, unleashing a supernatural dragon-like power.
raw.es: Esta fascinante espada, conocida por tener el poder de comandar dragones, llegó al mundo luego de que una bestia buscó devorar a un dragón y terminó transformándolo en una espada cuando su fuerza vital se agotó. Se la ha llamado espada en las leyendas, pero este objeto único se fusiona con el brazo del usuario. Se dice que cuando el usuario del arma está vitalmente completo, el brazo-espada brilla como si tuviera voluntad propia y libera poderes sobrenaturales similares a los de un dragón.
raw.id: Pedang yang menarik ini dikenal karena kekuatannya untuk memerintah naga datang dari keberadaan beast yang mencari naga untuk dimakan, membuatnya berubah menjadi pedang setelah dia kehabisan tenaga. Disebut sebagai pedang legendaris, tapi bendaunik ini bergabung dengan tangan penggunanya. Katanya ketika vitalitas dari pemilik pedang penuh, tangan itu akan membuat pedang bersinar seperti punya kepribadian sendiri, melepaskan kekuatan supranatural seperti naga.
raw.pt: Esta espada fascinante, conhecida pelo poder de comandar dragões, passou a existir depois que uma fera tentou devorar um dragão, fazendo com que ela se transformasse em uma lâmina quando exauriu sua força vital. Já foi citada como uma espada nas lendas, mas este objeto único se funde ao braço do usuário. Dizem que, quando a vitalidade do dono da lâmina está completa, o braço transformado em espada brilha como se tivesse vontade própria, libertando um poder sobrenatural como o dos dragões.
raw.th: ดาบสวยงามนี้เป็นที่รู้จักกันว่าอำนาจของมันสามารถควบคุมมังกรที่ปรากฏตัวขึ้น หลังจากที่สัตว์พยายามจะกินมังกร ทำให้มันเปลี่ยนร่างเป็นดาบเมื่อพลังชีวิตของมันหมดลง มันถูกเรียกขานว่าเป็นดาบในตำนาน แต่วัตถุที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์นี้ได้หลอมรวมกับแขนของผู้ใช้ ว่ากันว่าเมื่อพลังชีวิตของผู้ใช้ดาบนี้เต็ม แขนนั้นจะเปลี่ยนดาบให้ส่องสว่าง ขณะที่มันมีเจตจำนงของเจ้าของ และปลดปล่อยพลังที่เหนือธรรมชาติคล้ายกับมังกร
raw.vi: Thanh kiếm hấp dẫn này nổi tiếng bởi sức mạnh của nó có thể điều khiển các con rồng vẫn tồn tại sau khi một con quái vật ăn thịt con rồng, khiến nó biến thành một lưỡi kiếm khi nó đã cạn kiệt sức lực của mình. Nó được gọi là một thanh kiếm trong truyền thuyết, nhưng bảo vật độc đáo này sẽ kết hợp với cánh tay chủ nhân của nó. Người ta nói rằng khi chủ nhân lưỡi kiếm này tràn đầy sức mạnh, thanh kiếm đã biến vào cánh tay sẽ tỏa sáng như thể nó có linh tính của riêng mình, giải phóng sức mạnh siêu nhiên của loài rồng.

id: Zaman dahulu, ada prajurit tombak yang dikenal sebagai "Grumes." Dia sangat bangga atas tombaknya yang bisa mencuri darah dari orang. Takut terluka oleh tombaknya, katanya banyak yang melawannya mengaku kalah sebelum mereka menyerang. Mendapatkan berbagai kemenangan, Grumes dikutip berkata, "Ini hanyalah tombak biasa," meskipun yang mendengar tidak ada yang mempercayainya.
name: MST_SPHERES_35600_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Long ago, there was a pikeman known as "Grumes." He was especially proud of his spear which was able to steal blood from people. Fearing being injured by his spear, it is said that all who fought with him were defeated before they even threw a punch. Claiming victory after victory, Grumes was once quoted as saying, "This is but an ordinary spear," though none who heard believed him.

raw.en: Long ago, there was a pikeman known as "Grumes." He was especially proud of his spear which was able to steal blood from people. Fearing being injured by his spear, it is said that all who fought with him were defeated before they even threw a punch. Claiming victory after victory, Grumes was once quoted as saying, "This is but an ordinary spear," though none who heard believed him.
raw.es: Hace mucho tiempo existía un piquero conocido como "Grumes". Estaba particularmente orgulloso de su pica que era capaz de robarle sangre a la gente. Con temor a ser heridos por su pica, se dice que todo aquel que peleaba con él era derrotado aún antes de lanzar un golpe. Celebrando victoria tras victoria, Grumes una fue citado diciendo: "Esta no es una pica ordinaria", aunque nadie que lo escuchó le creyó.
raw.id: Zaman dahulu, ada prajurit tombak yang dikenal sebagai "Grumes." Dia sangat bangga atas tombaknya yang bisa mencuri darah dari orang. Takut terluka oleh tombaknya, katanya banyak yang melawannya mengaku kalah sebelum mereka menyerang. Mendapatkan berbagai kemenangan, Grumes dikutip berkata, "Ini hanyalah tombak biasa," meskipun yang mendengar tidak ada yang mempercayainya.
raw.pt: Há muito tempo havia um piqueiro conhecido como “Grumes”. Ele tinha um orgulho especial da própria lança, que podia roubar o sangue das pessoas. Com o medo de serem feridos pela lança dele, dizem que seus adversários eram derrotados mesmo antes de darem um só soco. Acumulando vitória após vitória, Grumes uma vez disse, “Esta lança não é nada além de normal”, mas ninguém acreditou nele.
raw.th: นานมาแล้วมีพลหอกที่รู้จักในนามว่า "กรูเมส" เขาเป็นที่มีความภาคภูมิใจในหอกของเขาเป็นพิเศษซึ่งสามารถที่จะขโมยเลือดจากคน ผู้คนกลัวจะได้รับบาดเจ็บจากหอกนั้น จนทุกคนที่ต่อสู้กับเขาเลือกที่จะแพ้ก่อนที่จะได้ออกหมัดด้วยซ้ำ และเขาก็ได้รับชัยชนะมาเรื่อยๆ กรูเมส เคยอ้างว่า "แต่นี้เป็นแค่หอกธรรมดา" กระนั้นก็ไม่มีใครเชื่อคำเขา
raw.vi: Nhiều năm trước đây, có một người thợ mỏ được biết tới là "Grumes". Anh ta đặc biệt tự hào về thanh giáo của mình vì nó có thể lấy máu từ người. Do sợ bị tổn thương bởi nó, nên hầu hết những ai chiến đấu với anh ta đều bị thất bại ngay trước khi tung ra cú đấm đầu tiên. Với những chiến thắng liên tiếp của mình, Grumes đã nói rằng "Đây không phải là một ngọn giáo bình thường" mặc dù không ai tin như thế

id: Konon tombak ini memakan jiwa manusia. Ksatria mengira tombak ini jahat, tidak ada yang berani memakainya sendiri. Suatu hari, ksatria pengelana, yang berzirah hitam, mencoba membawanya. Ketika mereka yang ada di sekitarnya mencoba mencegahnya, ksatria hitam itu berkata, "Tombak ini seperti aku. Tidak ada yang tahu kekuatannya. Makanya aku akan membawanya."
name: MST_SPHERES_35700_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: It's been told that this spear eats peoples' souls. Knights thought of it as wicked, none daring to take it for their own. Then one day, a traveling knight, dressed in black armor, tried carrying it away. As those around him tried to stop him, the black knight spoke, "This spear is like me. No one knows the power it holds. That is why I am taking it."

raw.en: It's been told that this spear eats peoples' souls. Knights thought of it as wicked, none daring to take it for their own. Then one day, a traveling knight, dressed in black armor, tried carrying it away. As those around him tried to stop him, the black knight spoke, "This spear is like me. No one knows the power it holds. That is why I am taking it."
raw.es: Se cuenta que esta pica se alimenta del alma de la gente. Los caballeros la consideraban malévola, y ninguno se atrevía a tomarla. Entonces un día, un caballero errante de negra armadura, intentó llevársela. Ya que los que lo rodeaban trataron de detenerlo, el caballero negro dijo: "Esta pica es como yo. Nadie sabe el poder que posee. Por eso me la llevo".
raw.id: Konon tombak ini memakan jiwa manusia. Ksatria mengira tombak ini jahat, tidak ada yang berani memakainya sendiri. Suatu hari, ksatria pengelana, yang berzirah hitam, mencoba membawanya. Ketika mereka yang ada di sekitarnya mencoba mencegahnya, ksatria hitam itu berkata, "Tombak ini seperti aku. Tidak ada yang tahu kekuatannya. Makanya aku akan membawanya."
raw.pt: Dizem que essa lança devora a alma das pessoas. Cavaleiros a achavam maligna e ninguém tinha coragem de tomá-la para si. Então, um dia, um cavaleiro viajante de armadura preta tentou levar a lança. Quando quem estava por perto tentaram impedir, o cavaleiro negro falou, “Esta lança é parecida comigo. Ninguém sabe o poder que tem. É por isso que vou levá-la.”
raw.th: เล่ากันว่าหอกเล่มนี้กินวิญญาณมนุษย์ เหล่าอัศวินต่างคิดว่ามันชั่วร้ายและไม่มีผู้ใดกล้ารับมันมาเป็นเจ้าของ จนวันหนึ่งอัศวินพเนจรในชุดเกราะสีดำพยายามจะนำมันไป ขณะที่ผู้คนทั้งหลายพยายามจะหยุดยั้งเขา อัศวินดำก็พูดขึ้นมาว่า "หอกนี้ก็เหมือนกับข้า ไม่มีผู้ใดรู้ถึงพลังที่มันมีอยู่ ฉะนั้นข้าถึงจะเอามันไป"
raw.vi: Đây là ngọn giáo ăn thịt người. Các hiệp sỹ đều không dám mang nó theo mình. Rồi một ngày, có một hiệp sĩ hành khất, mặc bộ áo giáp đen đã cố tình vứt nó đi xa. Mọi người xung quanh đã ngăn cản anh ta và anh ta nói rằng "Ngọn giáo này giống tôi. Không ai biết sức mạnh của nó. Vì thế mà tôi cần phải mang nó đi xa".

id:
Aku bertanya padamu.
"Kenapa manusia harus membenci dan bertempur satu sama lain?"
Aku menantangmu
"Kenapa orang mencintai dan berkorban untuk orang lain?"
name: MST_SPHERES_35800_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc:
I ask you.
"Why must humans hate and struggle against each other?"
I challenge you.
"Why do people love and sacrifice themselves for each other?"

raw.en:
I ask you.
"Why must humans hate and struggle against each other?"
I challenge you.
"Why do people love and sacrifice themselves for each other?"
raw.es:
Te pregunto.
"¿Por qué los humanos se odian y pelean entre ellos?"
Te reto.
"¿Por qué las personas se aman y se sacrifican las unas por las otras?"
raw.id:
Aku bertanya padamu.
"Kenapa manusia harus membenci dan bertempur satu sama lain?"
Aku menantangmu
"Kenapa orang mencintai dan berkorban untuk orang lain?"
raw.pt:
Eu pergunto a você.
“Por que humanos precisam se odiar e lutar uns contra os outros?”
Eu desafio.
“Por que as pessoas se amam e se sacrificam umas pelas outras?”
raw.th:
ข้าถามเจ้า
"ทำไมมนุษย์ถึงเกลียดชังและเข่นฆ่ากันและกัน?"
ข้าท้าทายเจ้า
"ทำไมผู้คนถึงรักและเสียสละตัวเองเพื่อกันและกัน?"
raw.vi: Ta hỏi ngươi. "Tại sao loài người lại ghét bỏ và đấu đá lẫn nhau". Vậy ta hỏi ngươi. "Tại sao con người lại yêu thương và hi sinh bản thân mình vì nhau?"

id:

id: Alat mekanik yang aneh teraktivasi dengan meletakkannya di atas kepala makhluk hidup. Bagian ini menampilkan karakteristik dari Alat Tekno dan Alat Obat. Nama dan kemampuannya tercatat di buku sejarah, tapi asal-usulnya, termasuk di mana dibuat dan siapa pemiliknya, masih diliputi misteri. Tapi sekarang keberadaannya banyak diketahui, bahkan di Elgaia.
name: MST_SPHERES_36000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A strange mechanical piece of equipment activated by placing it on a living creature's head. This piece features characteristics of both the Tech Gizmo and Cure Gizmo. Its name abilities are recorded in history books, but its origin, including where it was created and who owned it, is shrouded in mystery. However, nowadays its existence is widely known even in Elgaia.

raw.en: A strange mechanical piece of equipment activated by placing it on a living creature's head. This piece features characteristics of both the Tech Gizmo and Cure Gizmo. Its name abilities are recorded in history books, but its origin, including where it was created and who owned it, is shrouded in mystery. However, nowadays its existence is widely known even in Elgaia.
raw.es: Una extraña pieza mecánica activada al colocarla en la cabeza de una criatura viviente. Esta pieza presenta características tanto de Artefacto como de Artefacto curativo. Sus habilidades están registradas en los libros de historias, pero su origen, incluyendo dónde y quién lo creo, continúa siendo un misterio. No obstante, hoy en día su existencia es ampliamente conocida incluso en Elgaia.

Nama dan kemampuannya tercatat di buku sejarah, tapi asal-usulnya, termasuk di mana dibuat dan siapa pemiliknya, masih diliputi misteri. Tapi sekarang keberadaannya banyak diketahui, bahkan di Elgaia.
raw.pt: Um equipamento mecânico estranho ativado ao ser colocado na cabeça de uma criatura viva. Este aparelho possui características tanto da Engenhoca Tecnológica, quanto da Engenhoca de Cura. Suas habilidades estão registradas em livros de história, mas sua origem, incluindo onde foi criado e quem era o dono, é um mistério. No entanto, hoje sua existência é muito conhecida, até mesmo em Elgaia.
raw.th: ชิ้นส่วนเครื่องจักรกลที่แปลกประหลาดที่ใช้งานด้วยการวางไว้บนศีรษะของสิ่งที่มีชีวิต ชิ้นส่วนนี้มีลักษณะของทั้งกลไกเทคและกลไกรักษา ความสามารถในชื่อของมันถูกบันทึกในหนังสือประวัติศาสตร์, แต่ที่มาของมัน, รวมถึงสถานที่สร้างขึ้นและใครเจ้าของมัน, ยังคงปกคลุมไปด้วยปริศนา อย่างไรก็ตาม ทุกวันนี้มันเป็นที่รู้จักกันทั่วไปแม้แต่ในเอลไกอา
raw.vi: Một thiết bị cơ học kỳ lạ được kích hoạt bằng cách đặt lên đầu của một sinh vật sống. Thiết bị này mang đặc điểm của cả Tech Gizmo và Cure Gizmo. Những khả năng của thiết bị này đã được ghi lại trong sử sách, nhưng nguồn gốc của nó, kể cả việc ai đã tạo ra nó và ai sở hữu nó vẫn còn là bí ẩn.  Tuy nhiên, ngày nay sự tồn tại của thiết bị này đã được mọi người biết đến rộng rãi ngay cảở Elgaia.

id: Alat spesial yang konon digunakan untuk ritual di Republik La Veda yang dihancurkan oleh para dewa. Biasanya, bentuknya adalah patung dewi, tapi dengan mengucapkan doa tertentu yang diketahui pendeta tinggi, berubah menjadi jubah panjang. Katanya jubah ini, yang bisa mengurangi kerusakan dari serangan apapun, sebenarnya akan digunakan melawan para dewa, tapi tidak pernah digunakan di perang besar.
name: MST_SPHERES_36100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A special piece of equipment said to have been used in rituals in the La Veda Republic which was destroyed by the gods. Normally, it takes the form of a goddess statue, but by chanting a special prayer handed down from the high priests, it changes into a full body robe. It is said that this robe, which is able to decrease damage taken from any attack, was to be used against the gods, but it was never used in the great war.

raw.en: A special piece of equipment said to have been used in rituals in the La Veda Republic which was destroyed by the gods. Normally, it takes the form of a goddess statue, but by chanting a special prayer handed down from the high priests, it changes into a full body robe. It is said that this robe, which is able to decrease damage taken from any attack, was to be used against the gods, but it was never used in the great war.
raw.es: Una pieza de equipo especial que se dice ha sido usada en rituales en la república La Veda que fue destruida por los dioses. Normalmente, toma la forma de una estatua de diosa, pero al decir una oración especial entregado por los altos sacerdotes, se transforma en una túnica. Se dice que esta túnica, que es capaz de disminuir el daño recibido en cualquier ataque, debía ser usada contra los dioses, pero nunca fue usada en la gran guerra.
