raw.pt: Um velho cajado que foi encontrado por um garoto e sua irmã mais nova, dentro de um poço de uma cidade. Embora as crianças digam que ouviam vozes vindo do cajado, adultos ao seu redor o viam como um porrete velho e comum e decidiram jogá-lo fora. Ouvindo a voz pedindo a eles para sair da cidade, os dois acataram e partiram. Conforme andaram guiados pelo cajado, um som trovejante veio dele e uma chama poderosa tingiu o céu noturno de vermelho.
raw.th: ไม้เท้าเก่าแก่ที่ถูกพบโดยเด็กชายและน้องสาวของเขาในบ่อน้ำของเมือง แม้ว่าเด็กจะบอกว่าพวกเขาสามารถได้ยินเสียงที่มาจากด้ามของมัน แต่พวกผู้ใหญ่รอบตัวพวกเขากลับคิดว่ามันเป็นไม้เก่าสกปรกและตัดสินใจที่จะโยนมันทิ้งไป เสียงนั้นขอให้พวกเขาออกจากเมือง ทั้งสองคนทำตามและรีบจากไป ขณะที่พวกเขาถูกนำทางโดยด้ามไม้เท้า เสียงของฟ้าฝ่าก็ดังสนั่นออกมาจากมัน และเปลวไฟที่ลุกโชติก็ย้อมสีท้องฟ้าในยามค่ำคืนให้กลายเป็นสีแดง
raw.vi: Một cây quyền trượng cũ đã được tìm thấy bởi một cậu bé và em gái của cậu ở trong giếng nước của thị trấn. Mặc dù bạn trẻ nó rằng chúng nghe thấy tiếng nói từ chiếc gậy, nhưng người lớn quanh chúng nghĩ rằng đó chỉ là một chiếc gậy cũ bình thường, bẩn thỉu và quyết định ném nó đi. Sau khi nghe thấy giọng nói yêu cầu họ rời khỏi thị trấn, hai người trong số họ đã nghe theo và bị bỏ lại. Khi họ đi theo sự chỉ dẫn của cây gậy, âm thanh như sấm phát ra từ nó và ngọn lửa sáng rực nhuộm đỏ bầu trời đêm.

id: Tongkat yang katanya dibuat oleh dewi bumi Rakneshi dari tulangnya sendiri. Mempunyai banyak kekuatan yang terhubung dengan aliran kehidupan, banyak yang percaya anugrah ini bukan hanya untuk manusia, tapi juga untuk lingkungan. Cerita tentang seorang santo yang menggunakan tongkat ini untuk mengubah tanah gersang menjadi lembah hijau, dan membersihkan danau beracun menjadi jernih dan penuh dengan kehidupan menjadi terkenal di Elgaia.
name: MST_SPHERES_30207_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A staff said to have been made by the earth goddess Rakneshi from her own bones. Possessing many powers connected to the flow of life, many believe that its gifts not only affects humans, but the environment as well. The tales of a saint using this staff to convert a deserted wasteland into a verdant meadow, and to cleanse a poisonous lake until it was crystal clear and full of life anew are very famous in Elgaia.

raw.en: A staff said to have been made by the earth goddess Rakneshi from her own bones. Possessing many powers connected to the flow of life, many believe that its gifts not only affects humans, but the environment as well. The tales of a saint using this staff to convert a deserted wasteland into a verdant meadow, and to cleanse a poisonous lake until it was crystal clear and full of life anew are very famous in Elgaia.
raw.es: Se dice que la diosa de la tierra Rakneshi creó este báculo con sus propios huesos. Dado que posee muchos poderes relacionados con el flujo de la vida, muchos creen que sus dones no solo afectan a los humanos, sino también al medio ambiente. Los relatos que cuentan sobre un santo que usó el báculo para convertir un páramo seco en un prado verde, y para limpiar un lago venenoso hasta dejarlo transparente y rebosante de nueva vida son muy populares en Elgaia.
raw.id: Tongkat yang katanya dibuat oleh dewi bumi Rakneshi dari tulangnya sendiri. Mempunyai banyak kekuatan yang terhubung dengan aliran kehidupan, banyak yang percaya anugrah ini bukan hanya untuk manusia, tapi juga untuk lingkungan. Cerita tentang seorang santo yang menggunakan tongkat ini untuk mengubah tanah gersang menjadi lembah hijau, dan membersihkan danau beracun menjadi jernih dan penuh dengan kehidupan menjadi terkenal di Elgaia.
raw.pt: Um cajado que dizem ter sido feito pela deusa da terra Rakneshi, a partir de seus próprios ossos. Possuindo muitos poderes conectados ao fluxo da vida, muitos acreditam que suas vantagens não afetam somente humanos, mas também o ambiente. Os contos sobre ele são famosos em Elgaia, incluindo o que um santo teria usado o cajado para converter um deserto desolado em um campo verdejante e para purificar um lago venenoso até que ficasse cristalino e cheio de vidas novas.
raw.th: ไม้เท้าที่ว่ากันว่าสร้างจากกระดูกของ ราเนสชี เทพีแห่งโลก เปี่ยมไปด้วยพลังมากมายที่เชื่อมต่อกับพลังชีวิตที่ไหลเวียนอยู่ได้ หลายคนเชื่อว่านี่ไม่เพียงเป็นของขวัญแก่มนุษย์ แต่ยังมีผลต่อสิ่งแวดล้อมด้วย ปรัมปราที่กล่าวถึงนักบุญผู้ใช้ไม้เท้านี้เปลี่ยนพื้นที่ทะเลทรายกลายเป็นทุ่งหญ้าเขียวขจี และชะล้างทะเลสาบพิษจนใสสะอาด และก่อเกิดสิ่งมีชีวิตมากมายขึ้นในเอลไกอา
raw.vi: Một đội quân cho là đã được tạo ra bởi nữ thần đất Rakneshi từ xương cốt nàng. Sở hữu nhiều quyền năng được kết nối với dòng chảy sinh mệnh, nhiều người tin rằng món quà của nó không chỉ ảnh hưởng đến con người mà còn tới môi trường. Các câu chuyện rất nổi tiếng ở Elgaia về một vị thánh sử dụng đội quân này để biến một vùng đất hoang vắng thành đồng cỏ xanh tươi và làm trong lành một hồ nước độc tới khi nó trong suốt như pha lê và tràn đầy sự sống mới.

id: Tongkat untuk memandu rakyat dengan memperpanjang hidup raja yang memilikinya, dan menjaga rakyat dari kelaparan. Namun raja yang diberi oleh para dewa adalah kaisar negara Bariura, yang dikenal sepanjang sejarah, terobsesi dengan perang. Meski penerus kaisar berumur panjang atau berumur pendek, mereka semua hobi perang. Tongkat jadi kehilangan tujuan aslinya, dan masih menjadi sumber diskusi sarjana sampai hari ini.
name: MST_SPHERES_30208_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A staff meant to guide the people by prolonging the life of the monarch who possesses it, and thus keeping the ruled class from starvation. However, the person the gods decided to bestow the staff upon happened to be none other than the emperor of the nation of Bariura, an empire known throughout history for its long obsession with war. Regardless of whether the successors of the emperor lived for a short or long time after him, they all waged war incessantly either way. This led the staff to lose its initial purpose, and is still the source of much scholarly discussion today.

raw.en: A staff meant to guide the people by prolonging the life of the monarch who possesses it, and thus keeping the ruled class from starvation. However, the person the gods decided to bestow the staff upon happened to be none other than the emperor of the nation of Bariura, an empire known throughout history for its long obsession with war. Regardless of whether the successors of the emperor lived for a short or long time after him, they all waged war incessantly either way. This led the staff to lose its initial purpose, and is still the source of much scholarly discussion today.
raw.es: Este báculo tenía el propósito de prolongar la vida del monarca poseedor y, por ende, de guiar al pueblo, lo que evitaría que la clase dominante muriera de hambre. Sin embargo, la persona elegida por los dioses para poseer el báculo resultó no ser otra que el emperador de la nación de Bariura, un imperio conocido a lo largo de la historia por su obsesión con la guerra. Independientemente de si los sucesores del emperador vivieron mucho o poco tiempo, todos hicieron la guerra de forma incesante. Esto hizo que el báculo perdiera su propósito inicial, y hasta la fecha sigue siendo objeto de numerosos debates en la academia.
raw.id: Tongkat untuk memandu rakyat dengan memperpanjang hidup raja yang memilikinya, dan menjaga rakyat dari kelaparan. Namun raja yang diberi oleh para dewa adalah kaisar negara Bariura, yang dikenal sepanjang sejarah, terobsesi dengan perang. Meski penerus kaisar berumur panjang atau berumur pendek, mereka semua hobi perang. Tongkat jadi kehilangan tujuan aslinya, dan masih menjadi sumber diskusi sarjana sampai hari ini.
raw.pt: Um cajado feito para guiar as pessoas prolongando a vida do monarca que o possui, assim evitando a fome da classe governada. No entanto, a pessoa que os deuses escolheram para conceder o cajado era nada mais do que o imperador da nação de Bariura, um império conhecido ao longo da história por sua antiga obsessão pela guerra. Independente da duração da vida dos sucessores do imperador, todos eles guerrearam incessantemente de qualquer forma. Isso fez com que o cajado perdesse seu propósito inicial e é motivo de muita discussão entre os estudiosos atualmente.
raw.th: ไม้เท้าที่สร้างขึ้นเพื่อชี้นำผู้คนด้วยการยืดอายุขัยของกษัตริย์ผู้ครอบครองมัน, และถึงแม้ว่ามันจะช่วยไม่ให้ชนชั้นปกครองอดอยาก อย่างไรก็ตาม,บุคคลที่เทพเจ้าตัดสินใจจะมอบไม้เท้าให้นั้นกลับไม่ใช่ใครอื่นที่ไหนนอกจากจักรพรรดิ์แห่งบาริอุระ, จักรวรรดิที่รู้กันดีในประวัติศาสตร์ว่าฝักใฝ่ในการทำสงคราม ไม่ว่าผู้ทายาทของจักรพรรดิจะมีอายุยืนยาวหรือสั้นหลังจากเขาก็ตาม, พวกนั้นทั้งหมดก็ดิ้นรนหาสงครามอย่างไม่หยุดหย่อนไม่ทางใดก็ททางหนึ่ง สิ่งนี้ทำให้ไม้เท้านั้นสูญเสียวัตถุประสงค์ดั้งเดิมของมันไป, และมันยังคงเป็นหัวเรื่องให้ใช้ปัญญาถกกันอย่างแพร่หลายในทุกวันนี้
raw.vi: Cây quyền trường dẫn lối mọi người bằng cách kéo dài cuộc sống của người sở hữu nó, và giúp cho tầng lớp cai trị không chết đói. Tuy nhiên, người các vị thần quyết định ban tặng quyền trượng này không phải ai khác hơn ngoài vị hoàng đế nước Bariura, một đế chế nổi tiếng trong lịch sử bởi nỗi ám ảnh lâu dài với chiến tranh. Bất kể người kế vị của hoàng đế sống cách ông một thời gian dài hay ngắn, tất cả bọn họ đều tiến hành chiến tranh không ngừng. Điều này đã làm quyền trượng mất đi mục đích ban đầu của nó, và vẫn là nguồn gốc nhiều tranh luận học thuật ngày nay.

id: Dulu ada jago pedang bernama Lediver Max. Meski kemahirannya berpedang hanya pas-pasan, staminanya melebihi orang biasa. Katanya siapa pun yang melawannya takut akan berapa banyak luka yang bisa ia tanggung, banyak yang menyerah. Zirah yang ia pakai tertutup bekas luka, dan terus bersinar terang.
name: MST_SPHERES_30303_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There once was a swordsman known as Lediver Max. Though his skills as a swordsman were average, he had far more stamina than anyone else. It is said that those who fought against him feared him for how much damage he could take, many hopelessly giving up. It is said that the armor he wore, as covered in scars as it was, continued to shine brightly.

raw.en: There once was a swordsman known as Lediver Max. Though his skills as a swordsman were average, he had far more stamina than anyone else. It is said that those who fought against him feared him for how much damage he could take, many hopelessly giving up. It is said that the armor he wore, as covered in scars as it was, continued to shine brightly.
raw.es: Había una vez un espadachín conocido como Lediver Max. Aunque su habilidad como espadachín era ordinaria, tenía mucha más resistencia que cualquier otro. Se dice que aquellos que pelearon contra él le temían por todo lo que podía soportar, muchos se rindieron sin esperanza. Cuentan que la armadura que usaba, cubierta de marcas como estaba, continuaba brillando con intensidad.
raw.id: Dulu ada jago pedang bernama Lediver Max. Meski kemahirannya berpedang hanya pas-pasan, staminanya melebihi orang biasa. Katanya siapa pun yang melawannya takut akan berapa banyak luka yang bisa ia tanggung, banyak yang menyerah. Zirah yang ia pakai tertutup bekas luka, dan terus bersinar terang.
raw.pt: Existiu um espadachim conhecido como Lediver Max. Apesar de ter habilidade mediana como espadachim, ele tinha muito mais resistência do que qualquer outra pessoa. Dizem que aqueles que lutaram contra ele o temiam pela quantidade de dano que ele aguentava e muitos acabavam simplesmente desistindo. Dizem que a armadura que ele usava, mesmo que coberta de marcas, continuava brilhando intensamente.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีนักดาบที่ชื่อว่า เลดิเวอร์ แม็กซ์ แม้ว่าฝีมือดาบของเขาจะธรรมดา แต่เขามีความทรหดมากกว่าผู้อื่นเป็นไหนๆ ว่ากันว่าคู่ต่อของเขาต่างหวาดกลัวความแข็งแกร่งนี้จนหลายคนต้องยอมแพ้อย่างสิ้นหวัง ว่ากันว่าเกราะที่เขาสวมใส่นั้นแม้จะมีร่องรอยจากการต่อสู้แต่มันก็ยังคงเปล่งประกายสว่าง
raw.vi: Ngày xưa từng có một kiếm sĩ nổi tiếng với tên gọi Lediver Max. Mặc dù kiếm thuật chỉ ở mức trung bình, nhưng anh có sức chịu đựng nhiều hơn bất cứ ai khác. Người ta nói rằng những ai đã từng đánh với anh đều khiếp sợ bởi cho dù bị thiệt hại bao nhiêu thì mọi người càng vô vọng bỏ cuộc bấy nhiêu. Nghe đồn rằng chiếc áo giáp anh mặc, được bao phủ bởi chằng chịt những vết sẹo, vẫn tiếp tục tỏa sáng rực rỡ.

id: Dulu ada perang melawan beast yang membawa musibah untuk Kerajaan Sama. Beberapa penyihir yang menyaksikan perang ini sangat terkesan dengan zirah si beast es yang menebal saat ruasak, sehingga mereka mempertaruhkan nyawa untuk menyingkapkan rahasianya. Namun manusia tidak bisa mereproduksi kekuatan dari dewa, dan risetnya ditutup awal. Salah satu teknik yang dibuat dalam proses ini melahirkan zirah yang sangat keras dan langka.
name: MST_SPHERES_30304_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There was once a battle against a beast that brought calamity to the Sama Kingdom. Some of the magicians who witnessed this battle were so impressed by the armor of the ice beast as it grew thicker while it was damaged, that they risked their lives to uncover its secrets. However, humans were unable to reproduce this power from the gods, and its research was shut down prematurely. Nonetheless, one of the techniques created during this process gave birth to this incredibly hard and rare armor.

raw.en: There was once a battle against a beast that brought calamity to the Sama Kingdom. Some of the magicians who witnessed this battle were so impressed by the armor of the ice beast as it grew thicker while it was damaged, that they risked their lives to uncover its secrets. However, humans were unable to reproduce this power from the gods, and its research was shut down prematurely. Nonetheless, one of the techniques created during this process gave birth to this incredibly hard and rare armor.
raw.es: Antaño se libró una batalla contra una bestia que sembró el caos en el reino de Sama. Algunos de los taumaturgos que fueron testigos de esta batalla quedaron tan anonadados por cómo la armadura de la bestia gélida se fortalecía mientras más daño recibía que pusieron en juego su propio pellejo para descubrir sus secretos. Sin embargo, los humanos no lograron reproducir este poder divino, y la investigación se detuvo precipitadamente. No obstante, una de las técnicas que se descubrieron durante este proceso dio como resultado esta peculiar e increíblemente dura armadura.
raw.id: Dulu ada perang melawan beast yang membawa musibah untuk Kerajaan Sama. Beberapa penyihir yang menyaksikan perang ini sangat terkesan dengan zirah si beast es yang menebal saat ruasak, sehingga mereka mempertaruhkan nyawa untuk menyingkapkan rahasianya. Namun manusia tidak bisa mereproduksi kekuatan dari dewa, dan risetnya ditutup awal. Salah satu teknik yang dibuat dalam proses ini melahirkan zirah yang sangat keras dan langka.
raw.pt: Uma vez ocorreu uma batalha contra um monstro que trouxe destruição ao Reino de Sama. A armadura da fera de gelo ficava mais grossa quando era danificada e isso deixou os magos que testemunharam tão impressionados, que eles arriscaram as próprias vidas para descobrir os segredos dela. No entanto, humanos não conseguiram reproduzir esse poder divino e a pesquisa foi encerrada prematuramente. Apesar disso, uma das técnicas criadas durante o processo gerou esta armadura incrivelmente resistente e rara.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีการต่อสู้กับสัตว์ร้ายที่นำความหายนะมาสู่ราชอาณาจักรซามะ จอมเวทย์บางส่วนที่ได้ที่ได้เป็นสักขีพยานในการต่อสู้นี้ต่างประทับใจกับเกราะของอสูรกายน้ำแข็งซึ่งโตหนาขึ้นเมื่อมันถูกทำให้เสียหาย จนถึงขั้นยอมเสี่ยงชีวิตของพวกเขาเพื่อไขปริศนาความลับของมัน อย่างไรก็ตาม มนุษย์ไม่สามารถสร้างพลังที่เลียนแบบพลังจากเทพเจ้านี้ได้ และการวิจัยก็ได้ถูกปิดตัวลงในที่สุด แต่อย่างน้อย หนึ่งในเทคนิคที่ถูกสร้างขึ้นระหว่างขึ้นตอนนี้ ได้กำเนิดเกราะหายากที่แข็งอย่างน่าอัศจรรย์
raw.vi: Một lần nọ đã diễn ra cuộc chiến chống lại một con quái thú gieo rắc tai họa cho Vương quốc Sama. Một số pháp sư chứng kiến ​​trận chiến này đã vô cùng ấn tượng bởi chiếc áo giáp của loài băng thú này bởi nó càng dày lên khi bị hư hỏng, họ đã mạo hiểm tính mạng của mình để phát hiện ra bí mật của nó. Tuy nhiên, con người đã không thể tái tạo lại quyền năng này từ các vị thần, và nghiên cứu của họ đã bị hủy bỏ giữa chừng. Tuy nhiên, một trong những kỹ thuật được tạo ra trong quá trình này đã sản sinh ra chiếc áo giáp vô cùng rắn chắc và hiếm hoi này.

id: Zaman mitos, ada beast yang bulunya mengeras tergantung sinar bulan. Bulu akan jadi paling keras saat purnama, susah ditembus senjata buatan para dewa sendiri. Kulit dari beast itu diambil saat purnama dan dijadikan zirah saat bulan baru. Kekakuannya tak terbayangkan, namun cara mengambil dan memproses kulit ini masih misteri.
name: MST_SPHERES_30305_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: In mythical times, there was once a beast whose fur grew harder depending on the radiance of the moonlight. The fur would be hardest on nights when the moon was full, making it impermeable to damage from weapons made by the gods themselves. This pelt was collected from that beast during a full moon, and made into armor by the time of the new moon. Its rigidness is unfathomable, but how to collect this pelt, and its manufacturing process, still remain a total mystery.

raw.en: In mythical times, there was once a beast whose fur grew harder depending on the radiance of the moonlight. The fur would be hardest on nights when the moon was full, making it impermeable to damage from weapons made by the gods themselves. This pelt was collected from that beast during a full moon, and made into armor by the time of the new moon. Its rigidness is unfathomable, but how to collect this pelt, and its manufacturing process, still remain a total mystery.
raw.es: En épocas míticas existió una bestia cuyo pelaje crecía más fuerte según el resplandor de la luna. El pelaje lograba su punto máximo cuando había luna llena. Durante esas noches, era inmune incluso al daño de las armas creadas por los mismísimos dioses. Este pelaje se recolectó de la bestia un día de luna llena y con él se creó una armadura una noche de luna nueva. Su rigidez es inconmensurable, pero la forma de recolección del pelaje y su proceso de manufactura siguen siendo un misterio.
raw.id: Zaman mitos, ada beast yang bulunya mengeras tergantung sinar bulan. Bulu akan jadi paling keras saat purnama, susah ditembus senjata buatan para dewa sendiri. Kulit dari beast itu diambil saat purnama dan dijadikan zirah saat bulan baru. Kekakuannya tak terbayangkan, namun cara mengambil dan memproses kulit ini masih misteri.
raw.pt: Em tempos míticos, houve uma besta cujo pelo ficava mais duro conforme a luz do luar. O pelo ficava mais duro em noites de lua cheia, tornando-o impermeável a danos causados por armas dos próprios deuses. Este couro foi coletado da beta durante a lua cheia, e transformado em armadura durante a lua nova. Sua rigidez é insondável, mas como coletar o couro, e o processo de produção, ainda são um mistério completo.
raw.th: ในสมัยเรื่องเล่าตำนาน ยังมีอสัตว์ที่ขนของมันจะยาวแข็งขึ้น ขึ้นอยู่กับรัศมีของแสงจันทร์ ขนจะแข็งมากที่สุดในคืนที่พระจันทร์เต็มดวง ทำให้แม้แต่อาวุธที่สร้างโดยเหล่าเทพเจ้าก็ไม่สามารถสร้างความเสียหายให้กับมันได้ หนังสัตว์นี้ถูกเก็บจากเจ้าสัตว์นั่นในช่วงพระจันทร์เต็มดวง  และถูกทำเป็นเกราะก่อนที่พระจันทร์ใหม่มาจะถึง ความแน่นหนาคงทนของมันไม่อาจประมาณได้ แต่วิธีการเก็บหนังนี้ และขั้นตอนการนำไปใช้นั้นยังคงเป็นเรื่องที่ลึกลับ
raw.vi: Trong thời đại thần thoại, đã từng có một con quái thú có bộ lông trở nên cứng hơn tùy thuộc vào độ tỏa sáng của ánh trăng. Bộ lông sẽ cứng nhất vào những đêm trăng tròn, giúp cho nó không bị các vũ khí do chính các vị thần tạo ra gây hại. Tấm da lông này đã được thu thập từ con quái thú đó trong đêm trăng tròn và làm thành bộ giáp vào thời gian trăng non. Độ cứng của nó không thể đo được, nhưng cách thu thập tấm da lông này và quy trình sản xuất nó, vẫn hoàn toàn là một bí ẩn.

id: Ada tentara yang diundang ke dunia bawah selagi masih hidup. Ia memakai sihir hitam untuk mengalahkan mayat yang berjalan, termasuk pemimpinnya, sehingga ia dipanggil raja dunia bawah. Si tentara merasa jengah bertarung tiada henti melawan banyak mayat, tapi zirah yang diberikan raja dunia bawah memiliki kekuatan tersembunyi yang memberinya kekuatan tiada batas, seperti makhluk abadi. Kekuatan yang terus bersamanya sampai tugasnya selesai.
name: MST_SPHERES_30306_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There was a soldier who was invited to the underworld while he still lived. He used dark magic to exterminate the dead bodies walking around, including their ring leader, and thus was summoned by the king of the underworld. The soldier felt somewhat uneasy fighting endless hordes of the unliving, but the armor given to him by the king of the underworld had magic powers hidden within it that gave the soldier limitless amount of strength, like an immortal being. This strength would remain with him until his task was completed.

raw.en: There was a soldier who was invited to the underworld while he still lived. He used dark magic to exterminate the dead bodies walking around, including their ring leader, and thus was summoned by the king of the underworld. The soldier felt somewhat uneasy fighting endless hordes of the unliving, but the armor given to him by the king of the underworld had magic powers hidden within it that gave the soldier limitless amount of strength, like an immortal being. This strength would remain with him until his task was completed.
raw.es: Existió un soldado que recibió una invitación del inframundo mientras estaba con vida. Usó magia oscura para exterminar los cadáveres que caminaban junto a él, incluido el líder del ring, por lo que el rey del inframundo lo invocó. El soldado se sintió un poco inquieto al tener que luchar contra hordas interminables de muertos vivos. Sin embargo, la armadura que el rey del inframundo le había entregado tenía poderes mágicos ocultos que le otorgaban una cantidad infinita de energía, como si fuera un ser inmortal. Esta fuerza lo acompañó hasta que terminó su tarea.
raw.id: Ada tentara yang diundang ke dunia bawah selagi masih hidup. Ia memakai sihir hitam untuk mengalahkan mayat yang berjalan, termasuk pemimpinnya, sehingga ia dipanggil raja dunia bawah. Si tentara merasa jengah bertarung tiada henti melawan banyak mayat, tapi zirah yang diberikan raja dunia bawah memiliki kekuatan tersembunyi yang memberinya kekuatan tiada batas, seperti makhluk abadi. Kekuatan yang terus bersamanya sampai tugasnya selesai.
raw.pt: Houve um soldado que foi convidado ao mundo dos mortos enquanto ainda vivo. Ele usou magia negra para exterminar os defuntos caminhando à sua volta, incluindo o líder, sendo invocado pelo rei do submundo. O soldado se sentiu inquieto lutando contra incontáveis hordas dos de zumbis, mas a armadura que havia recebido do rei do submundo tinha poderes mágicos ocultos que deram ao soldado força ilimitada, como um imortal. Essa força continuaria com ele até que cumprisse a tarefa.
raw.th: มีทหารที่ได้รับเชิญไปโลกข้างใต้ในขณะที่เขายังมีชีวิตอยู่ เขาใช้มนต์ดำที่จะกำจัดศพที่เดินอยู่รอบๆ รวมทั้งผู้นำแหวนของพวกเขา และจึงถูกเรียกโดยจ้าวแห่งโลกเบื้องล่าง ทหารรู้สึกว่ามันไม่ง่ายเลยที่จะต่อสู้กับพวกที่ไม่มีชีวิตโดยไม่มีที่สิ้นสุด แต่เกราะที่ได้รับจากจ้าวแห่งโลกเบื้องล่างนั้น มีอำนาจเวทมนตร์ซ่อนอยู่ภายในที่ทำให้ทหารมีความแข็งแกร่งอย่างไร้ซึ่งขีดจำกัด ของความแข็งแรงเช่นเดียวกับความเป็นอมตะ ซึ่งความแข็งแกร่งนี้จะยังคงอยู่กับเขาจนกว่าภารกิจของเขาจะเสร็จสิ้นเป็นที่เรียบร้อย
raw.vi: Có một người lính đã được mời xuống thế giới bên kia khi anh vẫn sống. Anh đã sử dụng ma thuật bóng tối để tiêu diệt các xác sống đi lại xung quanh, bao gồm cả chỉ huy vành đai của họ, và do đó đã bị vua của thế giới bên kia triệu hồi. Người lính cảm thấy hơi khó chịu khi chiến đấu với đám xác sống nhiều vô tận này, nhưng chiếc áo giáp do vua của thế giới bên kia ban cho anh có sức mạnh ma thuật ẩn dấu trong nó mang đến cho người lính sức mạnh không giới hạn, như một con người bất tử. Sức mạnh này sẽ duy trì trong anh cho đến khi nhiệm vụ của anh hoàn thành.

id: Zirah pelindung kuat yang dibuat dengan teknik dari dunia lain oleh Garnan, dari Republik Atharva, di bawah perintah jenderal Pell Intyz dalam ekspedisi bersama. Ketika Pell mencoba zirah ini, dia sangat senang karena vitalitasnya bertambah banyak, tapi kecewa karena Garnan tidak bisa meningkatkan pertahanan zirah ini. Katanya mulai saat ini, si jenderal mencari cara untuk meningkatkan kemampuan zirah ini.
name: MST_SPHERES_30307_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A strong piece of armor forged by the otherworldly technique expert Garnan, from the Atharva Republic, under the orders of general Pell Intyz whilst in an expedition together. When Pell tried on the armor he was delighted to find out that his vitality had been greatly increased, but was disappointed that Garnan was unable to improve the armor's actual defense. It is said that from then on the general sought to improve the armor's abilities.

raw.en: A strong piece of armor forged by the otherworldly technique expert Garnan, from the Atharva Republic, under the orders of general Pell Intyz whilst in an expedition together. When Pell tried on the armor he was delighted to find out that his vitality had been greatly increased, but was disappointed that Garnan was unable to improve the armor's actual defense. It is said that from then on the general sought to improve the armor's abilities.
raw.es: Una armadura resistente forjada por Garnan que el general Pell Intyz encargó al experto en técnica de la extranjera república de Atharva mientras estaban juntos en una expedición. Cuando Pell se probó la armadura quedó encantado con el aumento que experimentó en su vitalidad, pero se decepcionó al darse cuenta de que Garnan no había podido mejorar la defensa de la armadura propiamente dicha. Se dice que, desde ese entonces, el general intentó incansablemente mejorar las habilidades de la armadura.
raw.id: Zirah pelindung kuat yang dibuat dengan teknik dari dunia lain oleh Garnan, dari Republik Atharva, di bawah perintah jenderal Pell Intyz dalam ekspedisi bersama. Ketika Pell mencoba zirah ini, dia sangat senang karena vitalitasnya bertambah banyak, tapi kecewa karena Garnan tidak bisa meningkatkan pertahanan zirah ini. Katanya mulai saat ini, si jenderal mencari cara untuk meningkatkan kemampuan zirah ini.
raw.pt: Uma peça forte de armadura forjada pelo especialista em técnicas de outros mundos Garnan, da República de Atharva, sob as ordens do general Pell Intyz durante uma expedição juntos. Quando Pell experimentou a armadura, ficou admirado ao descobrir que sua vitalidade tinha sido aumentada consideravelmente, mas se decepcionou porque Garnan não conseguiu melhorar a defesa dela. Dizem que, dali em diante, o general buscou melhorar as habilidades da armadura.
raw.th: เกราะแข็งแกร่งที่หลอมโดยผู้เชี่ยวชาญวิทยาการจากต่างโลกชื่อการ์นัน จากสาธารณรัฐอาร์ธาวา ภายใต้คำสั่งของนายพลเพล อินทิซขณะออกเดินทาง fเมื่อนายพลเพลลองใส่เกราะตัวนี้แล้วรู้สึกได้ว่ามีพละกำลังเพิ่มขึ้น แต่น่าเสียดายที่เพิ่มค่า ป้องกันไม่ได้ ว่ากันว่านายพลอยากจะทำเพื่อพิสูจน์ความพิเศษของเกราะ
raw.vi: Một mảnh giáp mạnh mẽ được tôi rèn bởi các chuyên gia kỹ thuật Garnan đến từ thế giới khác, Cộng hòa Atharva, theo lệnh Tướng Pell Intyz trong khi cùng tham gia một cuộc thám hiểm. Khi Pell thử mặc chiếc áo giáp, ông rất vui mừng khi nhận ra rằng sinh khí của ông đã tăng lên rất nhiều, nhưng cũng thất vọng khi Garnan không thể cải thiện được khả năng phòng thủ thực tế của áo giáp. Người ta nói rằng từ đó về sau vị tướng luôn tìm cách cải thiện khả năng áo giáp.

id: Tadinya ada dewa berpangkat tinggi yang tertarik pada hal-hal yang dihasilkan manusia. Meski tidak sempurna, ia mengagumi usaha manusia dan memutuskan untuk iseng membuat satu zirah bagi dirinya sendiri. Zirah buatannya bersinar terang, dan kekuatan spesialnya mencegah zirah agar tidak rusak atau jangan sampai hancur. Zirah hebat ini terlahir dari kebosanan seorang dewa.
name: MST_SPHERES_30308_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There was once a high ranking god who became interested in the things that humans produced. Though imperfect, he admired the effort they put into their trades and decided to fool around by trying to make a piece of armor himself. The armor he made shone brightly, and its special powers prevented it from suffering any damage, or even being destroyed. One could say that this amazing piece or armor was born from the boredom of a god.

raw.en: There was once a high ranking god who became interested in the things that humans produced. Though imperfect, he admired the effort they put into their trades and decided to fool around by trying to make a piece of armor himself. The armor he made shone brightly, and its special powers prevented it from suffering any damage, or even being destroyed. One could say that this amazing piece or armor was born from the boredom of a god.
raw.es: Hubo una vez un sumo dios que se interesó por las cosas que los humanos producían. Aunque imperfectas, admiraba el esfuerzo que los humanos invertían en ellas y decidió jugarles una broma fabricando una pieza de armadura él mismo. La armadura que creó brillaba con fuerza y sus poderes especiales evitaban que pudiera recibir daño o ser destruida. Podría decirse que esta increíble pieza de armadura nació del aburrimiento de un dios.
raw.id: Tadinya ada dewa berpangkat tinggi yang tertarik pada hal-hal yang dihasilkan manusia. Meski tidak sempurna, ia mengagumi usaha manusia dan memutuskan untuk iseng membuat satu zirah bagi dirinya sendiri. Zirah buatannya bersinar terang, dan kekuatan spesialnya mencegah zirah agar tidak rusak atau jangan sampai hancur. Zirah hebat ini terlahir dari kebosanan seorang dewa.
raw.pt: Havia um deus de alto posto que se interessou nas coisas que humanos produziam. Embora fosse imperfeito, ele admirava o esforço que eles empregava em seus trabalhos e decidiu fazer uma armadura para si mesmo sem compromisso. A armadura que ele criou brilhava fortemente e seus poderes especiais evitavam o sofrimento de qualquer dano ou mesmo a destruição. É possível dizer que essa armadura incrível nasceu do tédio de um deus.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งมีเทพระดับสูงที่สนใจในสิ่งที่มนุษย์สร้างขึ้น แม้จะยังไม่สมบูรณ์แต่เขาก็นับถือในความพยายามของมนุษย์ และลองสร้างเกราะขึ้นมาด้วยตนเอง เกราะที่เขาสร้างนั้นส่องประกายสว่าง และมีพลังพิเศษในการป้องกันความเจ็บปวดจากการโจมตีหรือถูกทำลาย หรือกล่าวได้ว่าเกราะนี้ถูกสร้างขึ้นด้วยความยากลำบากของเทพตนหนึ่ง
raw.vi: Có một lần, một vị thần ở cấp tối cao quan tâm đến những điều con người tạo ra. Dù không hoàn hảo, ông ngưỡng mộ nỗ lực của họ trong công việc và đã quyết định đùa cợt bằng cách tự mình tạo một mảnh áo giáp. Áo giáp ông tạo ra tỏa sáng rực rỡ, và quyền năng đặc biệt giúp nó không bị bất cứ hư hỏng nào, cũng như chẳng thể bị phá hủy. Có thể nói mảnh áo giáp tuyệt vời này được tạo ra bởi sự nhàm chán của một vị thần.

id: Kapak ini memiliki gairah kejam untuk menodai diri dengan merahnya darah siapa saja yang ditemuinya. Ia berisi kekuatan besar untuk membuka potensi tersembunyi dari pembawanya dan memenuhi keinginan terdalam si pembawa. Ternoda merah darah dan panjang, tanpa jiwa, dedikasi tiada henti untuk memenuhi gairahnya sendiri membuatnya disebut "Kapak Kacau."
name: MST_SPHERES_30402_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This axe harbors a cruel desire to stain red with blood all those it comes across. It also carries with it great power. The power to unlock its wielder's hidden potential and fulfill their deepest desires. Stained crimson red and long without a soul, its unending dedication to fulfilling its own desires has led to it being called the "Havoc Axe."

raw.en: This axe harbors a cruel desire to stain red with blood all those it comes across. It also carries with it great power. The power to unlock its wielder's hidden potential and fulfill their deepest desires. Stained crimson red and long without a soul, its unending dedication to fulfilling its own desires has led to it being called the "Havoc Axe."
raw.es: Esta hacha alberga un cruel deseo de teñir de rojo sangre a todos aquellos que encuentra a su paso. También lleva consigo gran poder. El poder de liberar el potencial oculto de su portador y cumplir sus más profundos deseos. Teñida de rojo carmesí y sin alma, su infinita dedicación a cumplir sus propios deseos ha originado su nombre, "Hacha destructora".
raw.id: Kapak ini memiliki gairah kejam untuk menodai diri dengan merahnya darah siapa saja yang ditemuinya. Ia berisi kekuatan besar untuk membuka potensi tersembunyi dari pembawanya dan memenuhi keinginan terdalam si pembawa. Ternoda merah darah dan panjang, tanpa jiwa, dedikasi tiada henti untuk memenuhi gairahnya sendiri membuatnya disebut "Kapak Kacau."
raw.pt: Este machado possui um desejo cruel de manchar de sangue todos os que enfrenta. Ele também tem grande poder. O poder de liberar o potencial oculto do usuário e de tornar realidade seus desejos mais profundos. Manchado de um vermelho escarlate e sem alma, sua dedicação interminável de satisfazer os próprios desejos fez com que fosse chamado de “Machado Devastador”.
raw.th: ขวานที่เก็บเกี่ยวแรงปรารถนาอันโหดเหี้ยมเพื่ออาบเลือดของผู้ที่เข้ามาเกี่ยวข้อง มันยังมาพร้อมกับอำนาจที่ยิ่งใหญ่ อำนาจที่จะปลดลป่อยศักยภาพซึ่งซ่อนเร้นอยู่ในตัวของผู้ถือและเติมเต็มความต้องการที่อยู่ลึกสุดภายในใจ ด้วยสีแดงดุจเลือดและไร้ซึ่งวิญญาณ การอุทิศตัวอย่างเต็มที่ในการเติมเต็มปรารถนาของผู้ใช้ทำให้มันถูกเรียกว่า "ขวานหายนะ"
raw.vi: Chiếc rìu này ẩn chứa khao khát tàn nhẫn muốn nhuộm đỏ bằng máu tất cả những gì nó đi qua. Nó cũng mang theo mình sức mạnh tuyệt vời. Sức mạnh để khai phá tiềm năng bí ẩn của chủ nhân nó cũng như thỏa mãn khát khao sâu xa nhất của họ. Với màu đỏ thẫm và dài nhưng không có linh hồn, khả năng cống hiến vô tận để hoàn thành những mong muốn của riêng nó đã khiến nó được gọi là "Chiếc rìu tàn phá".

id: Pedang besar yang katanya dibuat berdasarkan citra bilah yang muncul dari ekor naga berkepala 8 di dongeng dunia lain. Tidak bisa dibandingkan dengan aslinya, tapi kemampuannya kuat. Seperti reproduksi lainnya, kurang stamina dan tidak bisa dipakai lama. Ada yang bilang ini bukan hanya reproduksi, tapi katalis yang menarik kekuatan aktual dari pedang yang dibuat di dunia lain.
name: MST_SPHERES_31001_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A large sword said to be made in the image of a blade that emerged from the tail of an eight-headed dragon spoken of in otherworldly tales. Though it doesn't compare to the original, it still boasts powerful abilities. However, much like any reproduction it lacks stamina and cannot be used for long periods of time. There are some who even say that it is not a mere reproduction, and was in fact built as a catalyst which draws the actual force from which it was created from the other world.

raw.en: A large sword said to be made in the image of a blade that emerged from the tail of an eight-headed dragon spoken of in otherworldly tales. Though it doesn't compare to the original, it still boasts powerful abilities. However, much like any reproduction it lacks stamina and cannot be used for long periods of time. There are some who even say that it is not a mere reproduction, and was in fact built as a catalyst which draws the actual force from which it was created from the other world.
raw.es: Una gran espada que se dice fue creada a la imagen de una espada surgida de la cola de un dragón de ocho cabezas del que se habla en relatos místicos. Aunque no se compara con la original, aun así ostenta poderosas habilidades. Pero al igual que cualquier otra reproducción carece de resistencia y no puede usarse por largos periodos de tiempo. Hay quienes dicen que no es solo una reproducción, y que fue creada como un catalizador que extrae la fuerza de la cual fue creada desde el otro mundo.
raw.id: Pedang besar yang katanya dibuat berdasarkan citra bilah yang muncul dari ekor naga berkepala 8 di dongeng dunia lain. Tidak bisa dibandingkan dengan aslinya, tapi kemampuannya kuat. Seperti reproduksi lainnya, kurang stamina dan tidak bisa dipakai lama. Ada yang bilang ini bukan hanya reproduksi, tapi katalis yang menarik kekuatan aktual dari pedang yang dibuat di dunia lain.
raw.pt: Uma grande espada que dizem ser feita a partir da imagem de uma lâmina que surgiu da cauda de um dragão de oito cabeças citado em contos de outros mundos. Apesar de não se comparar à original, ela ainda tem habilidades poderosas. No entanto, assim como qualquer reprodução, ela tem pouca resistência e não pode ser usada por longos períodos. Muitos até dizem que não é só uma reprodução e que na verdade foi feita como um catalisador que absorve a força do outro mundo, a partir da qual foi criada.
raw.th: ดาบใหญ่ที่ว่ากันว่าสร้างเลียนแบบคมดาบที่โผล่มาจากหางของมังกรแปดหัวที่กล่าวถึงกันในเรื่องเล่าของโลกอื่น แม้ว่าจะเทียบไม่ได้กับของแท้ดั้งเดิมมันก็ยังช่วยเพิ่มพลังและความสามารถ อย่างไรก็ตามก็เหมือนกับของที่ทำเลียนแบบอื่น มันขาดซึ่งความทนทานและไม่สามารถใช้ได้เป็นเวลานานๆ มีบางคนถึงขนาดพูดว่ามันไม่ใช่ของที่ทำตามแบบ แต่อันที่จริงกลับเป็นสิ่งของที่สร้างขึ้นเพื่อเร่งปฏิกริยา สำหรับใช้ดึงพลังที่แท้จริงซึ่งถูกสร้างขึ้นจากโลกอื่น
raw.vi: Một thanh cự kiếm đồn rằng đã được tạo nên theo hình ảnh lưỡi kiếm nổi lên từ đuôi một con rồng tám đầu được nhắc đến trong những câu chuyện kể của giới khác. Mặc dù nó không thể sánh với bản gốc, nó vẫn tự hào có được những khả năng mạnh mẽ. Tuy nhiên, giống như bất cứ bản tái tạo nào, nó thiếu khả năng chịu đựng và không thể sử dụng được trong thời gian dài. Vài người thậm chí còn nói rằng nó không phải là bản sao đơn thuần, và trên thực tế được chế tạo làm chất xúc tác, giúp rút bớt công lực thực sự từ cái đã tạo ra nó trong thế giới khác.

id: Pedang yang dimodel menurut orang dari dongeng dunia lain yang katanya telah melenyapkan naga mitos berkepala 8. Anehnya, dibuat di Gaia Besar. Bentuknya panjang dan bermata dua. Mungkin orang itu datang dari dunia lain dan memproduksi pedang di sana. Karena ini hanya tiruan, efeknya hanya aktif sebentar.
name: MST_SPHERES_31002_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A sword modeled after one spoken of in otherworldly tales that was said to have vanquished a mythical eight-headed dragon. Oddly enough, however, it was made in Grand Gaia, and its shape is long and double-edged. This suggests that maybe someone came from the otherworld and produced swords there. However, since these items are copies, their effects are only active for a short period of time.

raw.en: A sword modeled after one spoken of in otherworldly tales that was said to have vanquished a mythical eight-headed dragon. Oddly enough, however, it was made in Grand Gaia, and its shape is long and double-edged. This suggests that maybe someone came from the otherworld and produced swords there. However, since these items are copies, their effects are only active for a short period of time.
raw.es: Espada moldeada a partir de otra a la que se hacía referencia en cuentos de otro mundo y que, aparentemente, se había usado para matar a un dragón mítico de ocho cabezas. Lo que resulta extraño es que haya sido forjada en Gran Gaia. Es larga y tiene filo en ambos lados. Esto sugiere que quizá alguien vino de otro mundo y creó la espada allí. Sin embargo, dado que estos objetos son copias, sus efectos solo se activan durante un breve período.
raw.id: Pedang yang dimodel menurut orang dari dongeng dunia lain yang katanya telah melenyapkan naga mitos berkepala 8. Anehnya, dibuat di Gaia Besar. Bentuknya panjang dan bermata dua. Mungkin orang itu datang dari dunia lain dan memproduksi pedang di sana. Karena ini hanya tiruan, efeknya hanya aktif sebentar.
raw.pt: Uma espada modelada em outra presente em contos de outros mundos, que dizem ter aniquilado um mítico dragão de oito cabeças. Estranhamente, ela foi feita em Grand Gaia, de forma longa e lâmina dupla. Isso sugere que talvez alguém veio de outro mundo e produziu espadas aqui. Porém, como estes itens são cópias, seus efeitos só duram um curto período.
raw.th: ดาบที่ถูกสร้างขึ้นตามแบบ ของดาบที่เคยถูกพูดถึงในเรื่องเล่าของโลกอื่น ที่ว่ากันว่าใช้กำจัดมังกรแปดหัว น่าแปลกแต่มันถูกสร้างขึ้นในแกรนด์ไกอา รูปร่างของมันมีความยาวและมีคมสองด้าน แสดงให้เห็นว่าสิ่งนี้อาจหมายถึงว่ามีบางคนที่อาจจะมาจากโลกอื่นและผลิตดาบที่นั่น แต่เนื่องจากของเหล่านี้เป็นของเลียนแบบ ผลของพวกมันจึงเกิดขึ้นแค่เพียงระยะเวลาสั้นๆ เท่านั้น
raw.vi: Một thanh kiếm được làm theo một thanh kiếm được nói đến trong các câu chuyện về thế giới khác được cho rằng đã đánh bại con rồng tám đầu thần thoại. Tuy nhiên, kỳ lạ thay, nó được làm tại Grand Gaia và nó có hình dạng dài và có hai lưỡi. Điều này cho thấy có thể có ai đó đến từ thế giới khác và đã chế tạo những thanh kiếm ở đó. Tuy nhiên, do những vật phẩm này chỉ là bản sao, hiệu ứng của chúng chỉ hoạt động trong một khoảng thời gian ngắn.

id: Meski diejek pengecut, PM Darvahnshel dengan perisainya menyelamatkan sang raja dari percobaan pembunuhan. Memuji kesetiaan dan kebijaksanaannya, Raja Kerajaan Sama menganugerahinya perisai baru, yang ia minta Darvahnshel menamai tameng itu. Karena terlihat kokoh dan cantik, tanpa ragu, ia menamainya dengan nama sang istri.
name: MST_SPHERES_31101_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Though taunted as being a coward, it was Prime Minister Darvahnshel with his shield that saved the king from an assassination attempt. In praising his loyalty and wisdom, the King of the Sama Kingdom bestowed him with a new shield, upon which he requested that Darvahnshel give it a name. Appreciative of not just how sturdy it looked but also how beautiful it was, without hesitation he gave it the name of his wife.

raw.en: Though taunted as being a coward, it was Prime Minister Darvahnshel with his shield that saved the king from an assassination attempt. In praising his loyalty and wisdom, the King of the Sama Kingdom bestowed him with a new shield, upon which he requested that Darvahnshel give it a name. Appreciative of not just how sturdy it looked but also how beautiful it was, without hesitation he gave it the name of his wife.
raw.es: A pesar de haber sido acusado de cobarde, fue el Primer Ministro Darvahnshel con su escudo quien salvó al rey de un intento de asesinato. Elogiando su lealtad y sabiduría, el rey de Sama le confirió un nuevo escudo, tras lo cual le pidió que Darvahnshel le diese nombre. Agradecido no solo por su robustez sino también por su belleza, sin dudarlo le dio el nombre de su esposa.
raw.id: Meski diejek pengecut, PM Darvahnshel dengan perisainya menyelamatkan sang raja dari percobaan pembunuhan. Memuji kesetiaan dan kebijaksanaannya, Raja Kerajaan Sama menganugerahinya perisai baru, yang ia minta Darvahnshel menamai tameng itu. Karena terlihat kokoh dan cantik, tanpa ragu, ia menamainya dengan nama sang istri.
raw.pt: Apesar de ser chamado de covarde, foi o Primeiro Ministro Darvahnshel que salvou o rei de uma tentativa de assassinato com seu escudo. Reconhecendo sua lealdade e sabedoria, o Rei do Reino de Sama o presenteou com um novo escudo, ao qual pediu que Darvahnshel desse um nome. Agradecido pela aparente resistência e pela beleza do escudo, sem hesitar ele deu o nome de sua mulher ao escudo.
raw.th: แม้จะถูกล้อเลียนว่าเป็นคนขี้ขลาด แต่สมุหนายกดาร์วานเชลและโล่ห์ของเขาก็เป็นผู้ที่ปกป้องกษัตริย์จากการถูกลอบปลงพระชนม์ เพื่อเป็นการยกย่องความซื่อสัตย์และความฉลาดของเขา กษัตริย์ราชอาณาจักรซามะได้มอบโล่ห์อันใหม่แก่เขาซึ่งพระองค์ก็ได้ขอให้ตั้งชื่อแก่โล่ห์นี่ว่า "ดาร์วานเชล"  ด้วยความชื่นชอบลักษณะที่ดูทนทานและความสวยงามของมัน เขาจึงขอใช้ชื่อภรรยาตั้งเป็นชื่อของมันโดยไม่ลังเล
raw.vi: Mặc dù bị chế giễu là thứ hèn nhát, chính Thống tướng Darvahnshel cùng với tấm khiên của mình đã cứu nhà vua khỏi một vụ ám sát. Để ca ngợi lòng trung thành và trí tuệ của ông, Nhà vua Vương quốc Sama đã ban cho ông một tấm khiên mới, theo đó yêu cầu Darvahnshel đặt cho nó một cái tên. Được đánh giá cao không chỉ bởi sự kiên cố của nó mà còn trông rất đẹp, ông đã không do dự đặt ngay cho nó cái tên của vợ ông.

id: Ada dewi yang meski kejam dan pemarah, sangat menghargai manusia. Tameng ini berisi kekuatan besar, namun tidak seperti temperamen si dewi, periode efektifnya pendek. Menurut si dewi, jika pemegang tameng gugur dalam perang, ia akan kembali sekali lagi dalam kesakitan dan penderitaan. Tidak ada pilihan selain menguji teori ini karena tidak ada yang tahu apakah si dewi mengatakan yang sebenarnya.
name: MST_SPHERES_31102_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There was a goddess who, though cruel and short tempered, cherished humans. This shield holds a great amount of power, but, not unlike the goddess's temper, its effective time period is short. Also according to the goddess, if one bearing the shield should perish in battle, they would return once again manifested in pain and agony. One has no choice but to test this theory, as no one knows whether or not the goddess speaks the truth.

raw.en: There was a goddess who, though cruel and short tempered, cherished humans. This shield holds a great amount of power, but, not unlike the goddess's temper, its effective time period is short. Also according to the goddess, if one bearing the shield should perish in battle, they would return once again manifested in pain and agony. One has no choice but to test this theory, as no one knows whether or not the goddess speaks the truth.
raw.es: Existía una diosa que, a pesar de ser cruel y enfadarse rápido, amaba a los humanos. Este escudo contiene una gran cantidad de poder, pero al igual que el temperamento de la diosa, su período de efectividad es corto. Además, según la diosa, si quien llevara el escudo muriera en el campo de batalla, volvería a la tierra como la manifestación del dolor y la agonía. Nadie sabe a ciencia cierta si lo que dijo la diosa es verdad o no, porque nadie ha probado esta teoría.
raw.id: Ada dewi yang meski kejam dan pemarah, sangat menghargai manusia. Tameng ini berisi kekuatan besar, namun tidak seperti temperamen si dewi, periode efektifnya pendek. Menurut si dewi, jika pemegang tameng gugur dalam perang, ia akan kembali sekali lagi dalam kesakitan dan penderitaan. Tidak ada pilihan selain menguji teori ini karena tidak ada yang tahu apakah si dewi mengatakan yang sebenarnya.
raw.pt: Houve uma deusa que, apesar de cruel e geniosa, gostava dos humanos. Esse escudo possui grande poder mas, talvez como o temperamento da deusa, dura pouco tempo. Também com relação à deusa, se alguém de posse do escudo perecer em batalha, retornará manifestado em dor e agonia. Não há opção a não ser testar a teoria, pois ninguém sabe se a deusa fala ou não a verdade.
raw.th: เคยมีเทพธิดาผู้ที่ถึงแม้ว่าจะโหดร้ายและโมโหง่าย แต่ก็มีความรักให้กับมนุษย์ โล่นี้มีพลังอยู่จำนวนมาก แต่ก็ไม่มากเท่ากับอารมณ์ของเทพธิดาผลระยะเวลาของมันจึงสั้น และตามที่เทพธิดากล่าวเอาไว้ ว่าใครก็ตามที่ถือโล่ห์นี้และตายในสนามรบ พวกเขาจะกลับมาอีกครั้งท่ามกลางความเจ็บปวดและความทุกข์ทรมาน ไม่มีใครมีทางเลือกที่จะทดสอบทฤษฎีนี้ เพราะไม่มีใครรู้ว่าสิ่งที่เทพธิดาพูดมานั้นเป็นความจริงหรือไม่
raw.vi: Có một nữ thần, mặc dù dữ tợn và nóng tính, nhưng lại yêu mến con người. Chiếc khiên này nắm giữ một sức mạnh to lớn, nhưng chẳng khác nào cơn giận của nữ thần, thời gian hiệu ứng của nó cũng ngắn. Mặc dù theo lời nữ thần, nếu người mang chiếc khiên này tử trận, thì họ sẽ trở lại một lần nữa được biểu hiện trong đau đớn và khổ sở. Người ta không có lựa chọn nào ngoài việc thử nghiệm lý thuyết này, vì không ai biết liệu nữ thần có nói sự thật hay không.

id: Versi bagus dari Belati Racun pendek. Dengan tambahan kekuatan terbagi dalam dua bilah, kini mudah menangani serbuan beracun pada musuh. Karena butuh dua tangan untuk memegang, senjata ini membatasi pergerakan si pemegang. Kemampuan memegang pisau ini secara bebas adalah tanda pembunuh bayaran yang terampil.
name: MST_SPHERES_31601_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An improved version of the short bladed Poison Shiv. With increased power split up into two blades, it is now easier to deal a venomous strike on one's opponent. However, as a result of requiring both hands to wield, this weapon considerably restricts its wielder otherwise. The ability to wield these knives freely is the sign of a skilled assassin.

raw.en: An improved version of the short bladed Poison Shiv. With increased power split up into two blades, it is now easier to deal a venomous strike on one's opponent. However, as a result of requiring both hands to wield, this weapon considerably restricts its wielder otherwise. The ability to wield these knives freely is the sign of a skilled assassin.
raw.es: Versión mejorada de la Daga ponzoñosa de hoja corta. Con un poder mejorado dividido en dos hojas, ahora es más fácil infligir un golpe venenoso en el oponente. Sin embargo, como resultado de requerir ambas manos para empuñarse, esta arma también restringe considerablemente a su usuario. La capacidad de blandir estas cuchillas libremente es señal de un asesino experto.
raw.id: Versi bagus dari Belati Racun pendek. Dengan tambahan kekuatan terbagi dalam dua bilah, kini mudah menangani serbuan beracun pada musuh. Karena butuh dua tangan untuk memegang, senjata ini membatasi pergerakan si pemegang. Kemampuan memegang pisau ini secara bebas adalah tanda pembunuh bayaran yang terampil.
raw.pt: Uma versão melhorada da Lâmina Peçonhenta curta. Com força aprimorada dividida entre duas lâminas, agora é mais fácil atingir o inimigo com um ataque venenoso. Mas, como resultado de precisar ser usada com as duas mãos, esta lâmina restringe as opções do usuário. A habilidade de usar essas facas livremente é sinal de um assassino habilidoso.
raw.th: เวอร์ชั่นที่พัฒนาขึ้นของมีดสั้นอาบยาพิษ ด้วยพังที่เพิ่มขึ้นแยกเป็นสองใบมีดมันง่ายที่จะโจมศัตรูให้ติดพิษ อย่างไรก็ตามเนื่องจากว่าต้องใช้สองมือในการถืออาวะนี้จึงค่อนข้างจำกัดผู้ใช้ ผู้ใดที่มีทักษะในการใช้มันได้อย่างคล่องจัดเป็นมือสังหารชั้นยอด
raw.vi: Một phiên bản cải tiến của Dao găm độc. Với sức mạnh tăng cường được chia thành hai lưỡi, giờ đây càng dễ dàng hơn để tung đòn kịch độc vào đối thủ. Tuy nhiên, do phải dùng cả hai tay, vũ khí này hạn chế đáng kể khả năng sử dụng những thứ khác của chủ nhân nó. Khả năng sử dụng tự do những lưỡi dao này là dấu hiệu của một sát thủ lành nghề.

id: Senjata mematikan yang dibuat dari miasma beracun. Sering ditemukan di sebuah bunga, itulah asal namanya. Senjata ini tidak dibuat untuk melumpuhkan musuh, tapi untuk membunuh mereka, efeknya sangat kuat. Maka dari itu, ketika menggunakannya, kita harus berhati-hati akan lingkungan sekitar, seperti kecepatan angin dan arah angin. Hanya pembunuh yang mempunyai keahlian bisa menggunakan senjata berbahaya seperti ini.
name: MST_SPHERES_31602_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A concealed lethal weapon made from poisonous miasma. It is most commonly found within a particular flower, hence the origin of its name. This weapon which is not meant to incapacitate foes, but kill them, has a very potent effect. Therefore, when using it one must be very aware of their surroundings, taking such things as wind speed and direction in mind. Only the most skilled assassins can handle such a dangerous weapon.

raw.en: A concealed lethal weapon made from poisonous miasma. It is most commonly found within a particular flower, hence the origin of its name. This weapon which is not meant to incapacitate foes, but kill them, has a very potent effect. Therefore, when using it one must be very aware of their surroundings, taking such things as wind speed and direction in mind. Only the most skilled assassins can handle such a dangerous weapon.
raw.es: Un arma letal y oculta creada con miasma venenoso. Generalmente se la encuentra dentro de una flor particular, de ahí su nombre. Esta arma, que no está pensada para incapacitar a los enemigos sino para matarlos, tiene un efecto muy potente. Por esa razón, uno debe estar muy atento al entorno cuando intenta usarla, y tener en cuenta, por ejemplo, la velocidad y la dirección del viento. Solo los asesinos más habilidosos pueden usar un arma tan poderosa.
raw.id: Senjata mematikan yang dibuat dari miasma beracun. Sering ditemukan di sebuah bunga, itulah asal namanya. Senjata ini tidak dibuat untuk melumpuhkan musuh, tapi untuk membunuh mereka, efeknya sangat kuat. Maka dari itu, ketika menggunakannya, kita harus berhati-hati akan lingkungan sekitar, seperti kecepatan angin dan arah angin. Hanya pembunuh yang mempunyai keahlian bisa menggunakan senjata berbahaya seperti ini.
raw.pt: Uma arma letal oculta feita com um odor venenoso. É normalmente encontrado em uma flor específica; daí vem a origem de seu nome. Esta arma, que não é feita para incapacitar inimigos, mas para matá-los, tem um efeito muito potente. Portanto o usuário precisa estar muito atento aos arredores ao usá-la, levando em conta coisas como direção e velocidade do vento. Somente os assassinos mais habilidosos podem manusear uma arma tão perigosa.
raw.th: อาวุธร้ายแรงที่ถูกปกปิดไว้ สร้างจากพิษของสิ่งมีพิษ หาได้ทั่วไปในดอกไม้ซึ่งเป็นที่มาของชื่อ อาวุธนี้ไม่ได้ใช้ทำให้ศัตรูอ่อนแอลง แต่ใช้เพื่อสังหาร มีฤทธิ์ร้ายแรง ดังนั้น เมื่อจะใช้สักครั้งจำเป็นต้องระวังโดยรอบให้ดี สำรวจความเร็วลมและทิศทางให้แน่ชัด มีเพียงนักฆ่าชั้นเยี่ยมเท่านั้นที่จะใช้อาวุธนี้ได้
raw.vi: Một loại vũ khí chết người được ẩn giấu làm từ độc khí. Nó thường được tìm thấy ở một loài hoa đặc biệt, là nguồn gốc tên gọi của nó. Vũ khí này không dùng để vô hiệu hóa kẻ thù mà là giết chúng, có tác dụng rất mạnh. Vì vậy, khi dùng nó phải rất ý thức về môi trường xung quanh, cân nhắc đến những thứ như tốc độ và hướng gió. Chỉ các sát thủ lành nghề nhất mới có thể dùng thứ vũ khí nguy hiểm như vậy.

id: Senjata besar proyektil setan didasarkan dari Senapan Setan termodifikasi. Republik Atharva, setelah mampu memproduksi massal senjata yang diisi dengan sihir hitam yang melemahkan, mulai mengembangkan senjata dengan kekuatan api yang bertambah dan kemampuan menembak yang cepat, Meriam Maut. Setelah meraup banyak pengalaman, hasil akhirnya adalah senjata hebat yang lebih dari sekedar mampu mendukung komradnya.
name: MST_SPHERES_31701_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A large demonic projectile weapon based on a modified Demon Rifle. The Atharva Republic, upon achieving the ability to produce mass quantities of arms fused with dark weakening magic, began the development of a weapon with increased firepower and rapid-fire capabilities, the Death Cannon. After countless experiences, the final result was an outstanding weapon capable of much more than simply supporting its comrades.

raw.en: A large demonic projectile weapon based on a modified Demon Rifle. The Atharva Republic, upon achieving the ability to produce mass quantities of arms fused with dark weakening magic, began the development of a weapon with increased firepower and rapid-fire capabilities, the Death Cannon. After countless experiences, the final result was an outstanding weapon capable of much more than simply supporting its comrades.
raw.es: Arma proyectil demoniaca basada en un fusil demoniaco modificado. La república de Atharva, tras lograr producir en masa armas fundidas con magia debilitante, comenzó el desarrollo de un arma con poder de fuego aumentado y capacidad de disparo más rápido, el cañón mortífero. Tras innumerables experiencias, el resultado final fue un arma notable capaz de mucho más que solo apoyar a los compañeros.
raw.id: Senjata besar proyektil setan didasarkan dari Senapan Setan termodifikasi. Republik Atharva, setelah mampu memproduksi massal senjata yang diisi dengan sihir hitam yang melemahkan, mulai mengembangkan senjata dengan kekuatan api yang bertambah dan kemampuan menembak yang cepat, Meriam Maut. Setelah meraup banyak pengalaman, hasil akhirnya adalah senjata hebat yang lebih dari sekedar mampu mendukung komradnya.
raw.pt: Uma grande arma de projéteis demoníacos baseada em um Rifle Demoníaco modificado. A República de Atharva, depois de conseguir o poder de produzir quantidades enormes de armas fundidas com magia negra debilitante, começou a desenvolver uma arma com poder de fogo e cadência de tiro melhorados, o Canhão da Morte. Depois de inúmeras experiências, o resultado final foi uma arma incrível capaz de muito mais do que simplesmente apoiar os companheiros em batalha.
raw.th: อาวุธกระสุนปีศาจขนาดใหญ่ที่ดัดแลงมาจากปืนไรเฟิลปีศาจ ระหว่างที่สาธารณะรัฐอธาวาประสบความสำเร็จในการผลิตอาวุธที่อาบด้วยพลังเวทย์ด้านมืดแบบอ่อนๆ เป็นปริมาณมาก ก็ได้เริ่มพัฒนา เดธแคนนอน อาวุธที่เพิ่มพลังการและความถี่ในการยิง หลังจากการทดลองนับครั้งไม่ถ้วนผลที่ได้คืออาวุธชั้นเลิศที่ทำได้มากกว่าการยิงสนับสนุนให้กับเพื่อนร่วมรบ
raw.vi: Một vũ khí phóng đạn ma quỷ cỡ lớn dựa trên Cây súng quỷ dữ được sửa đổi. Cộng hòa Atharva, sau khi có năng lực sản xuất với số lượng lớn các vũ khí được kết hợp với phép thuật làm suy yếu hắc ám, đã bắt đầu phát triển một loại vũ khí với hỏa lực tăng cường và khả năng khạc lửa liên tục, Đại bác Tử thần. Sau vô số kinh nghiệm, kết quả cuối cùng là một vũ khí xuất sắc mang lại nhiều khả năng hơn so với việc chỉ hỗ trợ đồng đội của mình.

id: Pistol yang dibuat oleh Republik Atharva dalam penelitian mereka tentang senjata api. Digunakan untuk membantu sekutu melawan monster dalam misi, tapi awalnya diciptakan untuk menjinakkan monster. Karena itu, kemampuannya untuk menembak dengan cepat sangat menakjubkan. Tapi, ukuran barelnya yang besar dan jumlah amunisi yang diperlukan untuk menembakkan pistol ini dianggap sebagai masalah, dan hanya beberapa yang menyukainya.
name: MST_SPHERES_31702_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A gun created by the Republic of Atharva in its search to explore the possibilities of firearms. It was used to aide allies against monsters during missions, but it was originally created for the purpose of subjugating monsters. Because of this, its ability for rapid-fire was quite impressive. However, the gigantic size of the barrel and the huge amounts of ammunition required to fire this gun were considered quite the problem, and thus it had very few admirers.

raw.en: A gun created by the Republic of Atharva in its search to explore the possibilities of firearms. It was used to aide allies against monsters during missions, but it was originally created for the purpose of subjugating monsters. Because of this, its ability for rapid-fire was quite impressive. However, the gigantic size of the barrel and the huge amounts of ammunition required to fire this gun were considered quite the problem, and thus it had very few admirers.
raw.es: Un arma creada por la república de Atharva durante sus investigaciones de las armas de fuego. Se usó para ayudar a los aliados a luchar contra los monstruos en las misiones, pero originalmente se la creó para subyugar a los monstruos. Debido a esto, su habilidad de disparo rápido era impresionante. Sin embargo, el tamaño gigante de su barril y la gran cantidad de municiones necesaria para disparar esta arma eran un verdadero problema, por lo que tenía muy pocos admiradores.

raw.pt: Uma arma criada na República de Atharva em sua pesquisa para explorar as possibilidades das armas de fogo. Ela foi usada para ajudar os aliados contra monstros durante missões, mas foi criada originalmente para subjugar monstros. Por conta disso, sua habilidade de tiros rápidos era bastante impressionante. No entanto, o tamanho exagerado do cano e as quantidades enormes de munição exigidas para atirar com essa arma eram considerados grandes problemas, o que fez com que ela tivesse poucos admiradores.
raw.th: ปืนที่สร้างจากสาธารณรัฐอาธาวาห์เพื่อใช้ค้นหาศักยภาพของปืนขนาดเล็ก ใช้ต่อสู้กับมอนสเตอร์ระหว่างทำภารกิจ แต่จุดประสงค์หลักในการสร้างคือใช้ปราบปรามมอนสเตอร์ ด้วยเหตุนี้ ประสิทธิภาพของมันจึงเป็นที่น่าประทับใจ อย่างไรก็ตาม ด้วยขนาดลำกล้องที่ใหญ่และความต้องการในการใช้ยุทโธปกรณ์นี้จำนวนมหาศาลทำให้เกิดปัญหา แต่ก็ยังมีคนจำนวนหนึ่งให้การชื่นชม
raw.vi: Một khẩu súng do Cộng hòa Atharva tạo ra khi tìm kiếm nhằm khám phá các khả năng của vũ khí. Được dùng hỗ trợ đồng minh chống lại quái vật trong nhiệm vụ, nhưng ban đầu nó đã được tạo ra nhằm hàng phục lũ quái vật. Bởi điều đó, khả năng bắn nhanh của nó khá ấn tượng. Tuy nhiên, kích cỡ khổng lồ của nòng súng và một lượng lớn đạn dược cần thiết để bắn khẩu súng này lại là vấn đề khó xử, và khiến rất ít người ngưỡng mộ nó.

id: Granloyd, sebagai kepala departemen senjata, terbagi antara tanggung jawabnya dalam memajukan senjata negaranya secara tepat waktu untuk perang yang tidak dapat dihindari, dan sebagai anak yang merawat ayahnya yang sakit. Menghabiskan hari-harinya frustrasi karena tidak mampu menjalan kedua tugas tersebut, ia menemukan tombak di kamar ayahnya. Mengambil tombak yang berdebu, ia lalu menyadari apa sebenarnya tugasnya.
name: MST_SPHERES_31801_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Granloyd, as the arms department head, was torn over his responsibilities in improving his countries weapons in time for the inevitable battle it would face, and caring for his father who had fallen ill. Spending his days frustrated by his inability to carry out both duties, he stumbled upon a pike in his father's room. Taking up the dusty pike, he then realized exactly what it was he was meant to do.

raw.pt: Granloyd, como chefe do departamento de armas, estava preocupado pela responsabilidade de melhorar as armas de seu país a tempo da inevitável batalha que enfrentaria e também cuidava do pai doente. Passando os dias frustrado por não conseguir conciliar os dois deveres, ele tropeçou em uma lança no quarto do pai. Ao pegar a lança empoeirada, ele percebeu exatamente o que ele tinha que fazer.
raw.th: ในฐานะหัวหน้าของแผนกอาวุธ แกรนลอยด์ ได้ละทิ้งความรับผิดชอบในการพัฒนาอาวุธ ในช่วงเวลาการต่อสู้ที่ไม่สามารถหลีกเลี่ยงได้ให้กับประเทศของตน และไปดูแลพ่อที่ล้มป่วยของตนเองแทน ขณะที่เขาใช้เวลาในแต่ละวันด้วยความผิดหวังที่ไร้ความสามารถที่จะทำหน้าที่ทั้งสองอย่าง เขาก็ไปสะดุดเข้ากับหอกในห้องของพ่อเขา เมื่อหยิบหอกที่เต็มไปด้วยฝุ่นนั่นขึ้นมา เขาก็ได้รับรู้ว่ามันและหน้าที่ที่แท้จริงที่เขาควรจะทำคืออะไร
raw.vi: Granloyd, người đứng đầu bộ phận vũ khí, bị giằng xé bởi trách nhiệm cải tiến các vũ khí quốc gia của mình kịp cho cuộc chiến không thể tránh khỏi họ sẽ phải đối mặt, và việc chăm sóc cho người cha đau ốm. Khi ngày càng thất vọng bởi không thể thực hiện cả hai nhiệm vụ, ông tình cờ gặp một cây thương trong căn phòng cổ của cha mình. Phủi sạch bụi đất trên thương, ông nhận ra chính xác những gì ông muốn làm nên.

id: Tombak yang telah ditusukkan ke lempengan batu sejak zaman dahulu. Katanya ketika pahlawan Aragon menariknya, warna ujungnya berubah seperti zamrud. Siapapun yang terluka oleh tombak ini akan menjadi sakit dalam waktu beberapa hari, dan akhirnya mati. Riset terbaru menemukan bahwa sebuah virus tak dikenal telah berkumpul di ujung tombak itu, memberi kesan bahwa itu hanyalah karat.
name: MST_SPHERES_31802_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A lance that had been pierced into bedrock since ancient times. It is said that when the hero Agaron pulled it out, the color of its point had changed to an emerald tone. Any person injured by this lance would fall ill in a matter of days, ultimately leading to their death. Recent research has discovered that an unknown virus had probably established its colony at the tip of the lance, giving the impression that it was mere corrosion.

raw.en: A lance that had been pierced into bedrock since ancient times. It is said that when the hero Agaron pulled it out, the color of its point had changed to an emerald tone. Recent research has discovered that an unknown virus had probably established its colony at the tip of the lance, giving the impression that it was mere corrosion.
raw.es: Una lanza que había atravesado un lecho de roca sólida en épocas inmemoriales. Se dice que cuando el héroe Agaron la sacó, el color de la punta de la lanza se volvió verde esmeralda. Toda persona alcanzada por esta lanza caía enferma en cuestión de días y finalmente era presa de la muerte. Recientes investigaciones han demostrado que es probable que un virus desconocido haya establecido una colonia en la punta de la lanza, por lo que se piensa que el color es parte de un proceso corrosivo.

raw.pt: Uma lança que tinha sido encravada em rocha matriz desde tempos antigos. Dizem que, quando o herói Agaron a tirou da rocha, a cor de sua ponta mudou para uma tonalidade esmeralda. Qualquer um ferido por esta lança adoeceria em uma questão de dias, morrendo finalmente. Pesquisas recentes descobriram que um vírus desconhecido tenha provavelmente estabelecido uma colônia na ponta da lança, dando a impressão de uma simples corrosão.
raw.th: หอกที่ปักอยู่ในชั้นหินมาแต่กาลนาน ว่ากันว่า เมื่อวีรบุรุษอาการอนดึงมันออกมา สีของมันเปลี่ยนเป็นโทนเขียวมรกต ใครที่ถูกหอกนี้แทงจะมีอาการสาหัสอยู่หลายวัน จากนั้นจึงถุกนำไปสู่ความตาย จากการวิจัยล่าสุดพบว่ามีเชื้อไวรัสที่ผู้สร้างทำไว้เป็นเทคนิคของหอกนี้ สร้างความประทับใจอย่างมากที่มันค่อยๆ กัดกร่อนชีวิตผู้ถูกลงหอก
raw.vi: Một cây thương đã bị cắm vào nền đá từ thời cổ đại xa xưa. Nghe nói khi vị anh hùng Agaron kéo nó ra, màu sắc của mũi thương đã chuyển sang màu ngọc lục bảo. Bất kỳ người nào bị thương bởi cây thương này sẽ ốm trong vài ngày, cuối cùng là tử vong. Nghiên cứu gần đây đã phát hiện ra một loại virus chưa rõ có thể đã tạo lập hang ổ của nó ở mũi thương, tạo cảm giác rằng đó là chỉ ăn mòn.

id: Ada seorang jenderal yang sangat ahli membawa Tombak Beast. Mencapai banyak prestasi memegang tombak ini, jenderal dianugerahi tombak khusus sebagai tanda jasa. Tombaknya bengkok dan tidak seimbang. Karena itu, siapa yang di sisi satunya menganggapnya lamban, dan saat itu juga, bilah tombak akan menacap tajam di badannya.
name: MST_SPHERES_31901_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There was a general who was especially skilled at wielding the Beast Spear. Having accomplished many great deeds while wielding this spear, the general was bestowed a special lance in thanks of his service. This lance was both crooked and oddly balanced for what it was. Because of this, those on the receiving end perceived it as slow moving, though in that very instant its blade would have already pierced deep into their body.

raw.pt: Havia um general especialmente habilidoso no uso da Lança das Bestas. Tendo conseguido grandes feitos usando essa lança o general recebeu uma lança especial como agradecimento pelos serviços prestados. Essa lança era torta e estranhamente equilibrada. Por isso, as vítimas pensavam que era uma lança lenta, mas nesse instante a lâmina dela já teria penetrado seus corpos.
raw.th: เคยมีแม่ทัพอยู่คนหนึ่งซึ่งเชียวชาญการใช้หอกอสูร เมื่อประสบความสำเร็จมากมายในขณะที่ใช้หอกนี้ แม่ทัพผู้นั้นก็ได้รับหอกเพื่อตอบแทนการรับใช้ของเขา หอกนี้เป็นทั้งคดเคี้ยวและมีความสมดุลอย่างผิดปกติผิดกับรูปร่างของมัน และด้วยเหตุนี้ผู้ที่จบชีวิตด้วยหอกนี้เพราะถูกหลอกด้วยรูปลักษณ์ที่ดูเทอะทะ โดยไม่ทันรู้ตัวคมหอกนี้ก็ได้แทงทะลุลึกเข้าไปในร่างแล้วของพวกเขาแล้ว
raw.vi: Có là một vị tướng là người đặc biệt thiện nghệ trong việc sử dụng Cây thương quái thú. Có được nhiều chiến công hiển hách cùng với cây thương này, tướng quân đã được ban cho một cây thương đặc biệt cho những gì ông đã cống hiến. Cây thương này vừa cong lại vừa cân bằng một cách kỳ lạ để biết nó là cái gì. Bởi vậy, những người bị thương đâm sẽ thấy như nó di chuyển chậm, mặc dù trong nháy mắt lưỡi của nó đã đâm sâu vào cơ thể họ.

id: Tombak tercinta dari jenderal perang yang telah mengalahkan pemimpin dari berbagai pasukan musuh. Senjata ini, yang dikenal sebagai "Tombak Gelap," terlihat seperti tombak biasa, tapi pisau di ujungnya sebenarnya bergerigi halus. Karena itu, mereka yang terluka oleh tombak ini menderita sakit yang tidak biasa dan lukanya sangat sulit sembuh. Kebanyakan orang yang tertusuk kehilangan nyawanya.
name: MST_SPHERES_31902_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The beloved spear of a war general who defeated the leader of a numerous troop of enemies. This weapon, which he referred to as the "Dark Spear," may look like a regular spear, but the blade at its point is actually very finely serrated. Due to this, those injured by this spear would suffer of irregular pain and cuts very difficult to heal in nature. Most people who met the end of this weapon lost their lives in the process.

raw.en: The beloved spear of a war general who defeated the leader of a numerous troop of enemies. This weapon, which he referred to as the "Dark Spear," may look like a regular spear, but the blade at its point is actually very finely serrated. Due to this, those injured by this spear would suffer of irregular pain and cuts very difficult to heal in nature. Most people who met the end of this weapon lost their lives in the process.
raw.es: La amada lanza de un general de guerra que derrotó al líder de una numerosa tropa de enemigos. Esta arma, a la que el general se refería como "Lanza oscura", puede verse como una lanza común y corriente, pero la punta de la hoja está levemente dentada. Debido a esto, aquellos alcanzados por la lanza sufrían un dolor irregular y heridas muy difíciles de curar de forma natural. La mayoría de la gente que se encontró con la punta de esta arma perdió la vida.
raw.id: Tombak tercinta dari jenderal perang yang telah mengalahkan pemimpin dari berbagai pasukan musuh. Senjata ini, yang dikenal sebagai "Tombak Gelap," terlihat seperti tombak biasa, tapi pisau di ujungnya sebenarnya bergerigi halus. Karena itu, mereka yang terluka oleh tombak ini menderita sakit yang tidak biasa dan lukanya sangat sulit sembuh. Kebanyakan orang yang tertusuk kehilangan nyawanya.
raw.pt: A querida lança de um general de guerra que derrotou o líder de uma grande tropa de inimigos. Esta arma, que é conhecida como “Lança Sombria”, pode até parecer uma lança comum, mas a lâmina em sua ponta na verdade é finamente serrilhada. Por conta disso, os feridos por esta lança sofreriam dores e cortes irregulares e muito difíceis de serem curados. A maioria das pessoas que encararam a ponta desta arma perdeu a vida no processo.
raw.th: หอกอันเป็นที่หลงใหลของขุนพลนักรบ ผู้กำจัดหัวหน้าของกลุ่มสัตรูได้เป็นจำนวนมาก อาวุธนี้ หรือที่เขาเรียกว่าเป็น "หอกทมิฬ" นั้นอาจเป็นหอกธรรมดา แต่คมหอกนั้นดูคล้ายฟันเลื่อย ด้วยเหตุนี้ ใครที่ถูกหอกนี้ทิ่มแทงจะได้รับความเจ็บปวดอย่างสาหัสและใช้วิธีรักษาตามธรรมชาติไม่หายขาด ใครที่เผชิญหน้ากับหอกเล่มนี้จึงต้องพบกับความตาย
raw.vi: Cây thương yêu quý của một vị tướng, người đã đánh bại kẻ cầm đầu một đội quân kẻ thù đông đảo. Vũ khí này, được ông gọi là "Cây Thương Hắc Ám", trông như một cây thương bình thường, nhưng lưỡi ở mũi thương có răng cưa rất sắc mịn. Do đó, những kẻ bị thương dưới mũi thương này sẽ bị đau thường xuyên và vết cắt rất khó chữa lành bình thường. Hầu hết những ai chạm phải đầu vũ khí này đều mất mạng ở quá trình đó.

id: Sabel Terkutuk yang telah dipakai dalam eksekusi Ragu Blaze, dibawa oleh si algojo. Rumor menyebar bahwa setelah semua pembunuhan yang disaksikan si sabel, ia langsung menyerap emosi penggunanya. Pemimpin istana langsung menyegel si pedang, tapi ia sudah menghilang. Sekitar kurun waktu yang sama, pria bertampang sinis membawa pedang panjang muncul di kekaisaran.
name: MST_SPHERES_32001_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The Cursed Sabre which had been used in Ragu Blaze's execution was afterwards wielded by the one who had carried out the execution. A rumor has also spread that after all the bloodshed this blade had seen, it was soon able to absorb its user's emotions. Getting word of this, imperial leaders decided to seal the sword away, but upon checking the armory it was nowhere to be found. Around the same time a sinister-looking man brandishing a long sword appeared in the empire.

raw.en: The Cursed Sabre which had been used in Ragu Blaze's execution was afterwards wielded by the one who had carried out the execution. Getting word of this, imperial leaders decided to seal the sword away, but upon checking the armory it was nowhere to be found. Around the same time a sinister-looking man brandishing a long sword appeared in the empire.
