raw.pt: O Sabre Maldito que foi usado na execução de Ragu Blaze passou a ser usado depois pelo executor. Um rumor se espalhou dizendo que, depois de todo o derramamento de sangue que a lâmina presenciou, ela passou a ter o poder de absorver as emoções do usuário. Ao saberem disso, os líderes do império decidiram isolar a espada, mas, ao verificarem o arsenal, ela não estava mais lá. Por volta da mesma época, um homem de aparência sinistra usando uma espada longa apareceu no império.
raw.th: ดาบต้องสาปซึ่งถูกใช้ในการประหาร ลากู เบลซ ซึ่งภายหลังถูกใช้โดยคนที่เป็นมือสังหาร มีข่าวลือไปทั่วว่าเลือดที่ดาบนี้ได้ทำให้หลั่งไปมากมาย ไม่นานก็จะดูดซับอารมณ์ของผู้ใช้ เมื่อได้ยินข่าวนี้ผู้นำจักรวรรดิจึงตัดสินใจที่จะผนึกดาบเล่มนี้ แต่ในขณะที่ตรวจสอบคลังอาวุธดาบเล่มนี้ก็หายไปแล้ว ในช่วงเวลาประมาณเดียวกันเป็นชายน่ากลัวคนหนึ่งที่กวัดแกว่งดาบยาวก็ปรากฏอยู่ในอาณาจักร
raw.vi: Thanh kiếm bị nguyền rủa đã được sử dụng để hành quyết Ragu Blaze về sau đã được sử dụng bởi người đã thực hiện cuộc hành quyết. Một tin đồn cũng đã lan rộng rằng sau tất cả những cảnh đổ máu mà lưỡi kiếm này đã chứng kiến, nó đã sớm có thể hấp thụ những cảm xúc của người sử dụng nó. Hiểu được điều này, các thủ lĩnh đế chế đã quyết định phong ấn thanh kiếm này, nhưng khi kiểm tra kho vũ khí, họ đã không tìm thấy thanh kiếm. Trùng với thời gian đó, một người đàn ông trông nham hiểm vung một thanh kiếm dài đã xuất hiện trong đế chế.

id: Setelah Ragu Blaze dieksekusi, seorang pembunuh muncul di sebuah provinsi, menirukan eksekusi yang sama melalui beberapa pembunuhan. Setelah penjahat itu ditangkap, katanya dia mengeklaim sebagai "penerus dari kutukan Ragu Blaze, bersama dengan pedangnya." Sampai hari ini hubngan antara kejadian ini dan kutukan Ragu Blaze tidak jelas, tapi catatan menyebut bahwa setelah eksekusi kriminal itu, pedang yang digunakan untuk kejahatannya disegel untuk waktu yang lama.
name: MST_SPHERES_32002_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: After the execution of Ragu Blaze, an assassin appeared in a certain province, imitating the same execution through a series of murders. After the criminal was captured, he is said to have claimed to be the "heir of Ragu Blaze's curse, along with his sword." To this day the relationship between these incidents and the curse of Ragu Blaze remains unclear, but records state that after the execution of the criminal, the blade he used for his crimes was sealed away for a very long time.

raw.en: After the execution of Ragu Blaze, an assassin appeared in a certain province, imitating the same execution through a series of murders. After the criminal was captured, he is said to have claimed to be the "heir of Ragu Blaze's curse, along with his sword." To this day the relationship between these incidents and the curse of Ragu Blaze remains unclear, but records state that after the execution of the criminal, the blade he used for his crimes was sealed away for a very long time.
raw.es: Tras la ejecución de Ragu Blaze, un asesino apareció en cierta provincia e imitó la misma ejecución a través de una serie de asesinatos. Cuando capturaron al asesino, se cuenta que aseguró que él era el "heredero de la maldición de Ragu Blaze junto con su espada". Hasta el día de hoy, la relación entre estos incidentes y la maldición de Ragu Blaze siguen siendo un misterio. Sin embargo, los informes dicen que tras la ejecución del asesino, la hoja que usó para cometer sus delitos se guardó durante muchísimo tiempo.
raw.id: Setelah Ragu Blaze dieksekusi, seorang pembunuh muncul di sebuah provinsi, menirukan eksekusi yang sama melalui beberapa pembunuhan. Setelah penjahat itu ditangkap, katanya dia mengeklaim sebagai "penerus dari kutukan Ragu Blaze, bersama dengan pedangnya." Sampai hari ini hubngan antara kejadian ini dan kutukan Ragu Blaze tidak jelas, tapi catatan menyebut bahwa setelah eksekusi kriminal itu, pedang yang digunakan untuk kejahatannya disegel untuk waktu yang lama.
raw.pt: Depois da execução de Ragu Blaze, um assassino apareceu em uma certa província imitando a mesma execução em uma série de assassinatos. Depois da captura do criminoso, dizem que ele dizia ser o “herdeiro da maldição de Ragu Blaze e de sua espada”. Até hoje, a relação entre esses incidentes e a maldição de Ragu Blaze continua obscura, mas registros dizem que, depois da execução do criminoso, a lâmina usada nos crimes foi isolada durante muito tempo.
raw.th: ภายหลังการประหารรากุ เบลซ นักฆ่าที่ปรากฎตัวในเขตนั้นแล้วกระทำการฆาตกรรมต่อเนื่อง หลังจากอาชญากรถูกจับตัว เขากล่าวว่าเป็น "คำสาปแห่งทายาทของรากุ เบลซ กับดาบของเขา" จนถึงวันนี้ความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างเหตุการณ์นั้นกับคำสาปของรากุ เบลซก็ยังไม่เป็นที่แน่ขัด แต่มีการบันทึกไว้ว่า หลังการประหารอาชญากรผู้นั้น ดาบที่เขาใช้ฆาตกรรมก็ถูกผนึกไว้เรื่อยมา
raw.vi: Sau khi hành quyết Ragu Blaze, một sát thủ đã xuất hiện ở vài tỉnh, bắt chước kiểu hành quyết tương tự qua một loạt các vụ giết người. Sau khi tên tội phạm đã bị bắt, nghe nói ông đã tự xưng là "người thừa kế lời nguyền Ragu Blaze, cùng với thanh kiếm của hắn." Cho đến nay mối quan hệ giữa các sự cố này và lời nguyền của Ragu Blaze vẫn chưa rõ ràng, nhưng các ghi chép nói rằng sau khi hành quyết tên tội phạm, lưỡi kiếm hắn dùng gây tội ác đã được phong ấn lại rất lâu.

id: Pembuat busur yang menciptakan Busur Guntur mengasingkan dirinya di ngarai untuk meriset busur baru. Suatu malam, mengunjungi hutan untuk mengumpulkan bahan busur, ia tersambar petir. Ia menaikkan busur yang membelah petir menjadi dua, dan menyadari dirinya sudah aman, ia sangat bahagia. Ia mengisi anak panah dengan kekuatan sihir. Akhirnya, baik busur maupun anak panah diisi dengan kekuatan guntur.
name: MST_SPHERES_32101_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The bow craftsman who created the Thunder Bow secluded himself in a canyon in order to research a new bow. Then one night while visiting a forest to collect material for arrows, he was struck by lightning. He raised up an arrow which split the lightning in two, and upon realizing he was safe he was overcome with happiness. He had infused his arrow with magical powers. At last he had both a bow and arrow infused with the power of thunder.

raw.en: The bow craftsman who created the Thunder Bow secluded himself in a canyon in order to research a new bow. Then one night while visiting a forest to collect material for arrows, he was struck by lightning. He raised up an arrow which split the lightning in two, and upon realizing he was safe he was overcome with happiness. He had infused his arrow with magical powers. At last he had both a bow and arrow infused with the power of thunder.
raw.es: A special robe developed in the Bariula Empire that the gods violently destroyed. It usually takes the form of a shield, but once equipped it absorbs the power of its user and a magic veil forms and envelopes the user's body. The veil protects and boosts the user's defence against all attacks. However, mass producing it proved to be difficult, making it a rare item that only a few institutions in the Empire could own.
raw.id: Pembuat busur yang menciptakan Busur Guntur mengasingkan dirinya di ngarai untuk meriset busur baru. Suatu malam, mengunjungi hutan untuk mengumpulkan bahan busur, ia tersambar petir. Ia menaikkan busur yang membelah petir menjadi dua, dan menyadari dirinya sudah aman, ia sangat bahagia. Ia mengisi anak panah dengan kekuatan sihir. Akhirnya, baik busur maupun anak panah diisi dengan kekuatan guntur.
raw.pt: O artesão de arcos que criou o Arco do Trovão se isolou em um cânion para desenvolver um novo arco. Então, em certa noite, quando estava em uma floresta para coletar material para as flechas, ele foi atingido por um raio. Ele ergueu uma flecha que partiu o raio em dois e, ao perceber que estava bem, se encheu de felicidade. Ele tinha adicionado poderes mágicos à flecha. No fim das contas ele conseguiu criar arco e flecha com o poder do trovão.
raw.th: ช่างทำธนูผู้สร้างธนูสายฟ้าได้เก็บตัวเงียบอยู่ในหุบเขาเพื่อค้นคว้าธรูแบบใหม่ จนกระทั่งวันหนึ่งที่เขาเข้าป่าเพื่อค้นหาวัตถุดิบสำหรับทำลูกธนูเขาก็ถูกฟ้าผ่า ในวินาทีนั้นเขาได้ชูลูกศรขึ้นซึ่มมันได้แยกสายฟ้าออกเป็นสอง และเมื่อได้รู้ว่าตนเองรอดตายเขาก็รู้สึกดีใจอย่างมาก เขาได้อาบลูกศรของเขาด้วยพลังเวทมนตร์ ท้ายสุดเขาก็ได้ทั้งธนูและลูกศรที่อาบไปด้วยพลังของสายฟ้า
raw.vi: Thợ chế tạo cung người đã tạo ra cây Lôi cung đã lui vào ở ẩn trong một hẻm núi để nghiên cứu về một cây cung mới. Sau đó, một đêm khi đến một khu rừng để thu thập vật liệu để làm tên, anh đã bị sét đánh. Ông đã giương mũi tên lên chẻ tia sét làm đôi và khi nhận ra mình đã an toàn, ông cảm thấy vô cùng hạnh phúc. Ông đã truyền cho mũi tên của mình sức mạnh thần kỳ. Cuối cùng, ông đã truyền được cho cả cung và tên sức mạnh của sét.

id: Dulu ada pembuat busur yang berkelana ke berbagai negara untuk membuat busur baru. Selagi mendaki gunung di mana dewa guntur dipuja, seorang lelaki aneh tiba-tiba muncul dan menantangnya duel dengan busur dan panah. Setelah kompetisi yang sengit, pembuat busur itu menang tipis, tapi sebelum dia sadar, lelaki aneh itu hilang, dengan hanya meninggalkan busurnya. Punya kekuatan untuk menyimpan listrik, busur ini katanya membuat musuh yang terkena panahnya lumpuh.
name: MST_SPHERES_32102_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Once there was a bow maker who traveled to various countries in order to create more bows. Whilst climbing the mountain where the thunder god is said to have been deified, a strange man suddenly appeared and challenged him to a bow and arrow duel. After their fierce competition, the bow maker won by a very slight margin, but before he knew it the strange man had disappeared, leaving behind nothing but his bow. Having the power to store electricity, this bow is said to paralyze the enemies it pierces with its arrows.

raw.en: Once there was a bow maker who traveled to various countries in order to create more bows. Whilst climbing the mountain where the thunder god is said to have been deified, a strange man suddenly appeared and challenged him to a bow and arrow duel. After their fierce competition, the bow maker won by a very slight margin, but before he knew it the strange man had disappeared, leaving behind nothing but his bow. Having the power to store electricity, this bow is said to paralyze the enemies it pierces with its arrows.
raw.es: Antaño existió un fabricante de arcos que viajó a varias naciones para crear más armas de este tipo. Mientras trepaba la montaña que supuestamente el dios atronador había deificado, un hombre extraño apareció y lo desafío a un duelo de arco y flecha. Tras una dura batalla, el fabricante de arcos se quedó con la victoria por un margen muy corto. Sin embargo, antes de darse cuenta, el hombre extraño había desaparecido y solo había dejado su arco. Se dice que este arco, que tiene el poder de almacenar la electricidad, paraliza a los enemigos que perfora con sus flechas.
raw.id: Dulu ada pembuat busur yang berkelana ke berbagai negara untuk membuat busur baru. Selagi mendaki gunung di mana dewa guntur dipuja, seorang lelaki aneh tiba-tiba muncul dan menantangnya duel dengan busur dan panah. Setelah kompetisi yang sengit, pembuat busur itu menang tipis, tapi sebelum dia sadar, lelaki aneh itu hilang, dengan hanya meninggalkan busurnya. Punya kekuatan untuk menyimpan listrik, busur ini katanya membuat musuh yang terkena panahnya lumpuh.
raw.pt: Havia um criador de arcos que viajava por diversos países para criar mais arcos. Enquanto escalava a montanha onde dizem que o deus do trovão foi transformado em deus, um estranho homem apareceu e o desafiou para um duelo de arco e flecha. Depois de sua competição acirrada, o criador de arcos venceu por uma diferença muito pequena mas, antes que ele pudesse notar, o estranho homem tinha desaparecido, deixando para trás nada além de seu arco. Com o poder de armazenar eletricidade, dizem que esse arco paralisa os inimigos que fere com suas flechas.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีช่างทำธนูผู้ออกเดินทางไปยังเมืองต่างๆ เพื่อสร้างธนูขึ้นมามากมาย ขณะที่เขากำลังไต่ภูเขาที่มีผู้ถูกเรียกว่าเทพเจ้าสายฟ้า ก็มีชายลึกลับปรากฎตัวขึ้นและท้าดวลธนูกับเขา หลังการต่อสู้อันดุเดือด ช่างทำธนูเป็นผู้ชนะอย่างฉิวเฉียด แต่เมื่อเขารู้ตัวอีกที ชายผู้นั้นก็หายไปแล้ว ทิ้งไว้เพียงธนูคันนั้น ซึ่งมีพลังในการกักเก็บสายฟ้า ว่ากันว่าเมื่อศัตรูถูกยิงด้วยธนูนี้จะทำให้เป็นอัมพาต
raw.vi: Xưa có một người chế tạo cung đã rong ruổi đến nhiều quốc gia để chế tạo thêm nhiều loại cung. Khi trèo lên ngọn núi nghe nói lôi thần đã được phong thần, một người lạ mặt đột nhiên xuất hiện thách thứ ông bằng một cây cung và song tiễn. Sau khi họ tranh đua dữ dội, người chế tạo cung đã thắng một chút, nhưng trước khi ông biết điều đó người lạ đã biến mất, chẳng để gì lại ngoài chiếc cung của mình. Có khả năng tích trữ lôi điện, nghe nói chiếc cung này sẽ làm kẻ thù tê liệt khi mũi tên của nó xuyên qua.

desc:

Revised Anti-Poison Modus Operandi
"Block my enemy's poison!"

id: Roh beast, seperti diriset di Kekaisaran Bariura kuno, katanya sepadat segerombolan orang. Gelang ini dibuat dari kekuatan yang diambil dari beast tersebut untuk menganugerahkan kemampuannya kepada si pemakai. Mengeluarkan kekuatan yang belum pernah dilihat sebelumnya, gelang ini dipakai untuk melukai jiwa para dewa.
name: MST_SPHERES_34001_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A beast's spirit, as researched in the old Bariura Empire, is said to be as dense as a group of people combined. This bracer was created from powers extracted from such a beast for the purpose of bestowing said powers to its bearer. Unleashing powers never seen before, this bracer was used to inflict damage upon the very souls of the gods.

raw.pt: Dizem que o espírito de um monstro, como pesquisado no antigo Império de Bariura, é tão denso quanto os espíritos de várias pessoas juntas. Este braçal foi criado a partir dos poderes extraídos desse monstro para poder conceder tais poderes ao usuário. Liberando poderes nunca antes vistos, este braçal foi usado para danificar as almas dos deuses.
raw.th: วิญญาณของอสูร การค้นคว้าในจักรวรรดิบาริอุระเก่ารายงานไว้ว่ามีความหนาแน่นเหมือนกับกลุ่มคนรวมกัน สายรั้งนี้ถูกสร้างจากพลังของสัตว์ดังกล่าวเพื่อมอบพลังให้ผู้สวมใส่ สายรั้งนี้ถูกใช้เพื่อสร้างความเสียหายกับวิญยาณของเทพเจ้าและปล่อยพลังในแบบที่ไม่เคยเห็นมาก่อน
raw.vi: Một linh hồn của quái thú, như được nghiên cứu trong Đế chế Bariura cổ xưa, được cho là dày đặc như một nhóm người kết hợp lại. Chiếc bao cổ tay này được tạo từ sức mạnh được lấy từ một con quái thú như vậy vì mục đích ban sức mạnh như đã nói cho người đeo nó. Phát huy sức mạnh chưa từng thấy trước đó, chiếc bao cổ tay này được sử dụng để gây thiệt hại cho chính linh hồn của các vị thần.

id: Kota yang tadinya diinvasi, rakyatnya putus asa, dan hanya satu ksatria muda tinggal untuk membelanya. Tidak peduli bahwa dirinya kalah banyak atau terluka parah, setiap kali ia jatuh, kristal di dadanya akan bersinar dan dia langsung berdiri tegak. Ksatria tersebut tidak tahu bahwa kristal ini memiliki kekuatan burung phantom yang terbakar menyala dengan api yang tak terkalahkan.
name: MST_SPHERES_36600_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A city was once invaded, it's people left helpless, and only one young knight stayed behind to protect them. It's said that no matter how badly he was outnumbered or how many wounds he bore, every time he fell the crystal on his chest would shine and he'd be immediately back on his feet. Little did the knight know that this crystal harnessed the power of a phantom bird burning bright with the flames of invincibility.

raw.en: A city was once invaded, it's people left helpless, and only one young knight stayed behind to protect them. It's said that no matter how badly he was outnumbered or how many wounds he bore, every time he fell the crystal on his chest would shine and he'd be immediately back on his feet. Little did the knight know that this crystal harnessed the power of a phantom bird burning bright with the flames of invincibility.
raw.es: Una vez una ciudad fue invadida, su gente quedó desamparada, y solo un joven caballero quedó para protegerlos. Se dice que sin importar que tanto era superado por sus enemigos o cuántas heridas tenía, cada vez que caía el cristal en su pecho resplandecía e inmediatamente volvía a ponerse en pie. Poco sabía el caballero que este cristal poseía el poder de un ave fantasma ardiendo con las llamas de la invencibilidad.
raw.id: Kota yang tadinya diinvasi, rakyatnya putus asa, dan hanya satu ksatria muda tinggal untuk membelanya. Tidak peduli bahwa dirinya kalah banyak atau terluka parah, setiap kali ia jatuh, kristal di dadanya akan bersinar dan dia langsung berdiri tegak. Ksatria tersebut tidak tahu bahwa kristal ini memiliki kekuatan burung phantom yang terbakar menyala dengan api yang tak terkalahkan.
raw.pt: Certa vez uma cidade foi invadida, seu povo foi deixado desamparado, e só um jovem cavaleiro ficou para trás para protegê-lo. Dizem que não importava quantos soldados ele tinha que enfrentar ou quantos ferimentos já tinha sofrido, sempre que ele caía, o cristal do seu peito brilhava e ele ficava de pé imediatamente. Mal sabia o cavaleiro que o cristal tinha o poder de um pássaro fantasmagórico que brilhava intensamente com as chamas da invencibilidade.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเมืองเคยถูกุกราน ประชาชนถูกทิ้งไว้โดยช่วยเหลือตัวเองไม่ได้ และมีเพียงอัศวินหนุ่มคนเดียวที่ยังคอยอยู่เพื่อปกป้องพวกเขา ว่ากันว่าไม่ว่าเขาจะตกอยู่กลางวงล้อมหรือเต็มไปด้วยบาดแผลขนาดไหน ทุกๆ ครั้งที่เขาล้มลง คริสตัลบนอกเขาก็จะส่องแสงและเขาก็จะกลับมาลุกขึ้นยืนอยู่บนสองเท้าอีกครั้ง อัศวินไม่ได้รู้เลยแม้แต่น้อยว่าคริสตัลนั้นเก็บพลังของนกลึกลับที่เผาไหม้ส่องสว่างด้วยไฟแห่งความเป็นอมตะ
raw.vi: Một thành phố đã từng bị xâm chiếm, mọi người trong đó bị bỏ lại không ai giúp đỡ, và chỉ có một hiệp sĩ trẻ ở lại để bảo vệ họ. Người ta nói rằng cho dù kẻ thù đông hơn hoặc phải chịu bao nhiêu vết thương trên mình, mỗi khi anh gục xuống viên pha lê trên ngực anh sẽ tỏa sáng và ngay lập tức anh lại đứng vững trên đôi chân mình. Hiệp sĩ này không hề biết rằng viên pha lê đã khai thác sức mạnh từ một ma điểu cháy sáng với ngọn lửa vô địch.

Você, comandante da estratégia que segue um caminho de coragem.

Para você, que fez uma trilha pela fronteira inexplorada, é com a maior honra e o maior respeito que gostaríamos de presenteá-lo com este tesouro.

Salão de Invocadores de Akras
raw.th:
เจ้า ผู้บัญชาการนักวางกลยุทธผู้เดินบนเส้นทางที่กล้าหาญ

สำหรับเจ้าผู้จุดประกายเส้นทางไปสู่ดินแดนลึกลับ ด้วยเกียรติอันสูงสุดและความเคารพ เราขอมอบสมบัติชิ้นนี้ให้กับเจ้า

raw.vi:
Ngươi, kẻ chỉ huy về chiến lược đang dấn bước trên con đường dũng cảm.

Tặng cho ngươi, kẻ đã khai sáng con đường vào trong ranh giới chưa có trên bản đồ, với vinh dự và lòng tôn trọng cao nhất chúng ta muốn trao cho ngươi kho báu này.

Đại Sảnh Người Triệu Hồi Akras

id: Dahulu ada bocah yang bertualang ke gunung tempat tinggal naga untuk mencari rumput obat bagi ibunya yang sakit. Ia naik melalui terusan gunung yang liar, mencapai tujuannya. Namun setelahnya, ia terluka dan tidak sanggup turun gunung. Melihat perjuangan si bocah, si naga memberinya anting yang akan mengubah keberanian dalam dirinya menjadi kekuatan fisik.

desc:

บุกทะลวงอย่างไร้ซึ่งความกลัว ผู้นำชั้นดีสำหรับการรุกราน

สภาซัมมอนเนอร์แห่งอาคราส
raw.vi:
Tấn công không sợ hãi về phía trước, người lãnh đạo tài tình cuộc xâm lược.

Tặng cho ngươi, kẻ đã vượt qua những nơi xa xăm nhất trong ranh giới chưa có trên bản đồ, với vinh dự và lòng tôn trọng cao nhất chúng ta xin trao cho ngươi kho báu này.

id: Dahulu kala hiduplah seorang bangsawan yang dicintai oleh rakyat Alzeon. Tanahnya juga dimangsa para dewa, dan ia tidak sanggup melawan, rakyatnya mati. Mendengar teriakan memilukan dari rakyatnya, ia marah. Kemurkaannya mengalir tiada henti, tertuang ke dalam mutiara yang dipakainya, dan tiba-tiba meledak, membakar para dewa bersama sisa-sisa Alzeon.
name: MST_SPHERES_36800_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There once was a boy who ventured up a mountain where a dragon lived to get medicinal grass for his sick mother. He ascended the treacherous mountain pass, eventually completing his objective. However, upon doing so he found himself covered in injuries and unable to descend. Seeing the boy struggle to push on, the dragon granted him with an earring that would turn his inner courage into physical power.

raw.en: There once was a boy who ventured up a mountain where a dragon lived to get medicinal grass for his sick mother. He ascended the treacherous mountain pass, eventually completing his objective. However, upon doing so he found himself covered in injuries and unable to descend. Seeing the boy struggle to push on, the dragon granted him with an earring that would turn his inner courage into physical power.
raw.es: Había una vez un chico que se aventuró en una montaña donde vivía un dragón para conseguir hierba medicinal para su madre enferma. Subió por paso traicionero, logrando eventualmente su objetivo. Sin embargo, al hacerlo se encontró cubierto de heridas e incapaz de descender. Viendo al padecer al chico, el dragón le obsequió un pendiente que convertiría su valor interior en poder físico.
raw.id: Dahulu kala hiduplah seorang bangsawan yang dicintai oleh rakyat Alzeon. Tanahnya juga dimangsa para dewa, dan ia tidak sanggup melawan, rakyatnya mati. Mendengar teriakan memilukan dari rakyatnya, ia marah. Kemurkaannya mengalir tiada henti, tertuang ke dalam mutiara yang dipakainya, dan tiba-tiba meledak, membakar para dewa bersama sisa-sisa Alzeon.
raw.pt: Certa vez, um garoto se aventurou montanha acima, onde um dragão vivia, para buscar ervas medicinais para sua mãe adoecida. Ele escalou pelas passagens traiçoeiras da montanha, eventualmente conseguindo o que queria. No entanto, ao conseguir as ervas, ele se viu coberto de ferimentos e impossibilitado de descer. Vendo o garoto lutando para continuar, o dragão o concedeu um brinco que transformaria sua coragem interior em força.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีเด็กชายผุ้เดินทางขึ้นเขาที่ซึ่งมังกรอาศัยอยู่เพื่อนำสมุนไพรมารักษาแม่ที่เจ็บป่วยของเขา เขาขึ้นไปถึงบนภูเขาที่เต็มไปด้วยความยากลำบากและในที่สุดเขาก็ทำภารกิจสำเร็จ อย่างไรก็ตามขณะที่ทำแบบนั้นเขาก็เกิดบาดเจ็บและลงเขาไม่ไหว เมื่อมองเห็นเด็กชายยังคงพยายามต่อสู้ มังกรจึงได้มอบต่างหูที่สามารถเปลี่ยนแรงใจข้างในให้เป็นแรงกายได้
raw.vi: Có một cậu bé mạo hiểm lên một ngọn núi nơi con rồng sống để lấy được loại cỏ làm thuốc cho người mẹ bệnh tật của mình. Cậu đã vượt qua vô số nguy hiểm, và cuối cùng đã hoàn thành mục tiêu của mình. Tuy nhiên, sau khi làm được, cậu thấy mình thương tích khắp người và không thể đi xuống. Thấy cậu bé nỗ lực chống chọi, rồng thiêng đã tặng cho cậu một chiếc khuyên tai có thể biến can đảm của mình thành sức mạnh thể chất.

id: Dahulu kala ada seorang jenderal di Kekaisaran Bariura yang ditakuti karena ia dewa. Ia memerintah medan perang dengan kapak di tangan. Ambisinya mengancam, mengikat para musuh yang ketakutan, memacu pasukannya sendiri untuk bertarung seperti orang gila. Geldnite, jenderal yang menginspirasi rasa takut, dan kapak tercintanya menjadi pembicaraan dari generasi ke generasi.
name: MST_SPHERES_36900_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There once lived a lord who was loved by the people of Alzeon. However, his land was also ravaged by the gods, and, unable to fight back, his people lost their lives. Hearing the dreadful screams of his people, the lord grew angry. His rage endlessly pouring into the pearl he wore, it suddenly exploded, incinerating the gods along with the rest of Alzeon.

raw.en: There once lived a lord who was loved by the people of Alzeon. However, his land was also ravaged by the gods, and, unable to fight back, his people lost their lives. Hearing the dreadful screams of his people, the lord grew angry. His rage endlessly pouring into the pearl he wore, it suddenly exploded, incinerating the gods along with the rest of Alzeon.
raw.es: Ahí vivía una vez un señor que era amado por la gente de Alzeon. Sin embargo, su tierra era saqueada por los dioses, e incapaces de defenderse, la gente pereció. Al escuchar los horribles gritos de su gente, el señor enfureció. Su furia brotó se vertió sin parar en la perla que llevaba, explotando súbitamente, incinerando a los dioses junto con el resto de Alzeon.
raw.id: Dahulu kala ada seorang jenderal di Kekaisaran Bariura yang ditakuti karena ia dewa. Ia memerintah medan perang dengan kapak di tangan. Ambisinya mengancam, mengikat para musuh yang ketakutan, memacu pasukannya sendiri untuk bertarung seperti orang gila. Geldnite, jenderal yang menginspirasi rasa takut, dan kapak tercintanya menjadi pembicaraan dari generasi ke generasi.
raw.pt: Havia um lorde há muito tempo que era amado pelo povo de Alzeon. Mas sua terra também foi destruída pelos deuses e, sem poder revidar, seu povo perdeu a vida. Ouvindo os gritos desesperados do seu povo, o lorde ficou enfurecido. Sua fúria acabou inundando a pérola que ele usava e explodiu repentinamente, incinerando os deuses e o que restou de Alzeon.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีเจ้าเมืองผู้เป็นที่รักของประชาชนแห่งอัลซีออน อย่างไรก็ตามดินแดนของเขาก็ถูกย่ำยีโดยเทพเจ้าและไม่สามารถสู้กลับได้ ประชาชนของเขาต่างล้มตาย เมื่อได้ยินเสียงกรีดร้องที่น่ากลัวจากประชาชนของเขา เจ้าเมืองโกรธจัด ความโกรธของเขาเติมใส่มุกที่เขาสวมใส่ ทันใดนั้นมันก็ระเบิดและเผาผลาญเทพเจ้ารวมไปถึงส่วนที่เหลือของอัลซีออนทั้งหมด
raw.vi: Từng có một vị lãnh chúa được người dân Alzeon rất thương yêu. Tuy nhiên, mảnh đất của ông cũng bị tàn phá bởi các vị thần, và bởi không thể chống lại, người dân của ông chết rất nhiều. Nghe những tiếng gào thét khủng khiếp của người dân, vị lãnh chúa vô cùng tức giận. Cơn thịnh nộ của ông không ngừng đổ vào viên ngọc trai ông đang mang, đột nhiên nó phát nổ, thiêu cháy các vị thần cùng với phần còn lại của Alzeon.

id:
Maju tanpa gentar, pemimpin hebat invasi.

Untukmu yang mencapai wilayah terjauh yang belum dipetakan, dengan rasa hormat tertinggi, kami persembahkan harta karun ini.

Aula Pemanggil Akras
name: MST_SPHERES_37000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There once was a general in the Bariura Empire who was feared as a god. He lorded over the battlefield with his axe in his hand. It's said his intimidating ambition bound his enemies with fear while encouraging his own troops to fight on like mad men. Geldnite, the fear inspiring general, and his beloved axe would be talked about for generations to come.

raw.en: There once was a general in the Bariura Empire who was feared as a god. He lorded over the battlefield with his axe in his hand. It's said his intimidating ambition bound his enemies with fear while encouraging his own troops to fight on like mad men. Geldnite, the fear inspiring general, and his beloved axe would be talked about for generations to come.
raw.es: Había una vez un general en el Imperio Bariura que era temido como un dios. Mandaba en el campo de batalla con su hacha en mano. Se dice que su ambición intimidante conducía a sus enemigos con miedo mientras alentaba a sus propias tropas a luchar como dementes. Se hablaría de Geldnite, el general temible, y su amada hacha por generaciones venideras.
raw.id:
Maju tanpa gentar, pemimpin hebat invasi.

Untukmu yang mencapai wilayah terjauh yang belum dipetakan, dengan rasa hormat tertinggi, kami persembahkan harta karun ini.

Aula Pemanggil Akras
raw.pt: Houve um general do Império de Beriura que era temido como um deus. Ele comandou o campo de batalha empunhando seu machado. Dizem que sua ambição ameaçadora enchia os inimigos de medo enquanto encorajava as próprias tropas a lutarem como loucos. Geldnite, o general que inspirava medo, e seu amado machado seriam citados por gerações.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีแม่ทัพในจักรวรรดิบาริอุระผู้เป็นที่เกรงกลัวดุจเทพเจ้า เขาครอบครองสนามรบด้วยขวานของเขาในมือ ว่ากันว่าความทะเยอะทะยานที่น่าเกรงขามของเขาทำให้ศัตรูตกอยู่ในความหวาดกลัวขณะที่เขากำลังปลุกขวัญให้กับกองทัพของตนราวกับชายคลั่ง เจลไนท์ แม่ทัพผู้น่าหวาดกลัวและขวานสุดรักของเขาจะเป็นที่กล่าวขวัญถึงไปอีกหลายชั่วคน
raw.vi: Từng có một vị tướng trong Đế chế Bariura rất lo sợ một vị thần. Ông thống lĩnh chiến trường với chiếc rìu trong tay. Người ta nói tham vọng đáng sợ của ông đã buộc kẻ thù trong nỗi sợ hãi và cổ vũ đội quân của ông chiến đấu như điên. Geldnite, viên tướng lấy cảm hứng từ nỗi sợ hãi, và chiếc rìu yêu quý của ông sẽ vẫn còn được nhắc đến qua nhiều thế hệ.

id: Pembuat pedang Masamune katanya mengeluarkan segalanya untuk pedang ini. Bilah mengerikan memiliki kekuatan untuk membunuh para dewa meski sebagai gantinya perlu konsentrasi spiritual yang besar. Karena itu, sulit untuk dipakai lama, meski banyak pejuang mencarinya, percaya atas kekuatannya.
name: MST_SPHERES_37100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The legendary swordsmith Masamune is said to have put all he had into this sword. It's said that Masamune's ghastly blade has the power to kill gods, though in exchange it requires great spiritual concentration. Because of this it is difficult to use it for too long, but there are many warriors who search it out, believing in its power.

raw.en: The legendary swordsmith Masamune is said to have put all he had into this sword. It's said that Masamune's ghastly blade has the power to kill gods, though in exchange it requires great spiritual concentration. Because of this it is difficult to use it for too long, but there are many warriors who search it out, believing in its power.
raw.es: Dicen que el legendario herrero Masamune puso todo cuanto tenía en su espada. Se cuenta que la horrenda espada de Masamune tiene el poder de matar dioses, aunque a cambio requiere de gran concentración espiritual. Debido a esto es difícil de usar por mucho tiempo, pero hay muchos guerreros que la buscan, creyendo en su poder.
raw.id: Pembuat pedang Masamune katanya mengeluarkan segalanya untuk pedang ini. Bilah mengerikan memiliki kekuatan untuk membunuh para dewa meski sebagai gantinya perlu konsentrasi spiritual yang besar. Karena itu, sulit untuk dipakai lama, meski banyak pejuang mencarinya, percaya atas kekuatannya.
raw.pt: Dizem que o lendário ferreiro Masamune tinha depositado tudo o que tinha nesta espada. Dizem que a lâmina fantasmagórica de Masamune tem o poder de matar deuses mas, em troca, requer uma grande concentração espiritual. Por causa disso é difícil usá-la por muito tempo, mas muitos guerreiros já procuraram por ela acreditando em seu poder.
raw.th: ช่างตีดาบในตำนาน มาซามุเนะ ได้ทุ่มเททุกอย่างที่เขามีลงไปในดาบเล่มนี้ ว่ากันว่าดาบที่น่ากลัวของเขาเล่มนี้มีพลังที่จะสังหารเทพเจ้า แต่จะต้องแลกเปลี่ยนมาด้วยจิตวิญญาณจำนวนมาก ด้วยเหตุนี้จึงยากที่จะใช้มันได้เป็นระยะเวลานานๆ แต่ก็มีนักรบหลายคนไปตามค้นหาเพราะศรัทธาในพลังของมัน
raw.vi: Thợ rèn kiếm huyền thoại Masamune được cho là đã dồn tất cả những gì ông có vào thanh kiếm này. Đồn rằng lưỡi kiếm khủng khiếp của Masamune ẩn chứa sức mạnh tiêu diệt các vị thần, dù đổi lại nó đòi hỏi sự tập trung tinh thần rất lớn. Bởi thế rất khó để sử dụng nó quá lâu, nhưng có rất nhiều chiến binh tìm ra và tin tưởng vào sức mạnh của nó.

id: Ada cerita tentang bintang tersesat yang debunya jatuh dari surga. Debu perlahan meredup selagi beterbangan dengan sedih. Seorang pandai besi menyaksikan ini dan melambaikan palunya, menyuruh si cahaya untuk pulang. Bintang yang mengawasi langit malam bernyanyi dan menari dalam harmoni dengan palu yang berdansa. Bersinar terang, bintang yang tersesat akhirnya kembali ke surga, meninggalkan pecahan debu sebagai jejaknya.
name: MST_SPHERES_37200_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There's a story about a lost star whose dust fell down from the heavens. The dust gradually grew dim as it sadly fluttered about. A blacksmith saw this, and, waving his hammer, told the light to return home. The stars that watched over the night sky sang and danced in harmony with the dancing hammer. Shining brightly, the lost star finally made its way back to the heavens, leaving behind fragments of dust as it went.

raw.en: There's a story about a lost star whose dust fell down from the heavens. The dust gradually grew dim as it sadly fluttered about. A blacksmith saw this, and, waving his hammer, told the light to return home. The stars that watched over the night sky sang and danced in harmony with the dancing hammer. Shining brightly, the lost star finally made its way back to the heavens, leaving behind fragments of dust as it went.
raw.es: Hay una historia sobre una estrella perdida cuyo polvo cayó desde el cielo. El polvo gradualmente se debilitó tras revolotear tristemente por ahí. Un herrero vio esto y agitando su mazo, le dijo a la luz que regresara a casa. Las estrellas que observaban el cielo nocturno cantaron y bailaron en harmonía con el mazo danzante. Brillando intensamente, la estrella perdida finalmente regresó a los cielos, dejando tras de sí partículas de polvo.
raw.id: Ada cerita tentang bintang tersesat yang debunya jatuh dari surga. Debu perlahan meredup selagi beterbangan dengan sedih. Seorang pandai besi menyaksikan ini dan melambaikan palunya, menyuruh si cahaya untuk pulang. Bintang yang mengawasi langit malam bernyanyi dan menari dalam harmoni dengan palu yang berdansa. Bersinar terang, bintang yang tersesat akhirnya kembali ke surga, meninggalkan pecahan debu sebagai jejaknya.
raw.pt: Há uma história sobre uma estrela perdida cuja poeira caiu dos céus. A poeira foi ficando mais fraca enquanto era dispersada. Um ferreiro viu isso e, balançando seu martelo, falou para a luz voltar para casa. As estrelas que observavam o seu noturno cantaram e dançaram em harmonia com o martelo. Brilhando intensamente, a estrela perdida finalmente voltou ao céu, deixando fragmentos de poeira no caminho.
raw.th: มีเรื่องเล่าเกี่ยวกับดวงดาวที่หลงทางซึ่งผงของมันหล่นลงมาจากสวรรค์ ผงนั่นส่องแสงสลัวๆ และสลายไปอย่างรวดเร็ว ช่างตีเหล็กมองเห็นสิ่งนี้จึงกวัดแกว่งฆ้อนและบอกกับแสงนี้ว่าให้เดินทางกลับบ้าน ดวงดาวที่เฝ้ามองท้องฟ้าในราตรี ร้องเพลงและเต้นรำอย่างสมานฉันท์พร้อมกับฆ้อนที่เต้นรำ ในที่สุดดาวที่หลงทางก็สามารถหาทางกลับสวรรค์ได้ มันส่องแสงสว่างและทิ้งเศษฝุ่นเอาไว้ขณะจากไป
raw.vi: Có câu chuyện về một ngôi sao băng mà bụi của nó rơi xuống từ thiên giới. Đám bụi dần dần trở nên mờ nhạt khi nó dập dềnh buồn bã. Một người thợ rèn thấy vậy, và vung chiếc búa của mình lên, nói ánh sáng hãy trở về nhà. Các ngôi sao chứng kiến trên bầu trời đêm đã cùng hát và bay lượn nhịp nhàng với chiếc búa đang nhảy múa. Chiếu sáng rực rỡ hết mình, ngôi sao băng cuối cùng đã trở về trời theo cách của nó, để lại những mảnh bụi vỡ khi ra đi.

id:
Legenda dengan khidmat berkata.
"Bijih Sihir memperhalus hati seseorang.
Bijih Sihir memperhalus kebencian seseorang.
Bijih Sihir memperhalus keinginan jahat seseorang.
Inilah sumber kekuatan untuk menghancurkan dunia."
Sayangnya manusia berdosa tetap pahit, mengundang kekuatan jahat yang lebih besar ke dalam hati mereka.
name: MST_SPHERES_37300_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc:
The legend solemnly speaks.
"The Magic Ore refines one's heart.
The Magic Ore refines one's hate.
The Magic Ore refines one's ill will.
It is the source of the power to destroy worlds."
Pitifully sinful humans hold on to bitterness, inviting an even greater evil into their hearts as they do.

raw.en:
The legend solemnly speaks.
"The Magic Ore refines one's heart.
The Magic Ore refines one's hate.
The Magic Ore refines one's ill will.
It is the source of the power to destroy worlds."
Pitifully sinful humans hold on to bitterness, inviting an even greater evil into their hearts as they do.
raw.es:
Relata solemnemente la leyenda.
"La Mena Mágica purifica el corazón.
La Mena Mágica purifica el odio.
La Mena Mágica purifica la mala voluntad.
Es la fuente del poder para destruir mundos".
Los humanos patéticos y corruptos se aferran a la desdicha, permitiendo la entrada a su corazón de un mal mayor.

"Bijih Sihir memperhalus hati seseorang.

raw.pt:
A lenda fala solenemente.
“O Minério Mágico refina o coração.
O Minério Mágico refina o ódio.
O Minério Mágico refina a hostilidade.
Ele é a fonte do poder de destruir mundos.”
De forma desprezível, humanos pecadores se agarram à amargura, chamando um mal ainda maior para dentro de seus corações.
raw.th:
ตำนานได้กล่าวไว้อย่างเคร่งขรึม
"แร่เวทมนตร์ที่ทำให้หัวใจคนบริสุทธิ์ขึ้น
แร่เวทมนตร์ที่ทำให้ความเกลียดบริสุทธิ์ขึ้น
แร่เวทมนตร์ที่ทำให้เจตจำนงของคนบริสุทธิ์ขึ้น
มันเป็นแหล่งพลังที่ทำลายโลก"
ความสังเวช ผิดบาปที่มนุษย์มีอยู่อย่างขมขื่น ยิ่งชักชวนสิ่งที่ชั่วร้ายกว่าเดิมเข้าสู่หัวใจขณะที่เขาเป็นแบบนั้น
raw.vi:
Truyền thuyết long trọng nói.
"Quặng ma thuật sẽ tôi luyện trái tim của ngươi.
Quặng ma thuật sẽ tôi luyện hận thù của ngươi.
Quặng ma thuật sẽ tôi luyện ý chí của người.
Nó là nguồn gốc của sức mạnh để tiêu diệt thế giới."
Nhân loại đáng thương tội lỗi hãy cứ giữ lấy đau khổ, dẫn lối ác quỷ lớn hơn vào trái tim như họ đang làm.

id:
Aku bertanya kepadamu.
"Mengapa orang bertarung demi nama mereka, memuji yang menang?"
Aku menantangmu.
"Mengapa orang bertarung demi kebenaran, memuji yang telah wafat?"
name: MST_SPHERES_37400_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc:
I ask you.
"Why do people fight for their own name's sake, giving praise to those who win?"
I challenge you.
"Why do people fight for righteousness, giving praise to those who have passed?"

raw.en:
I ask you.
"Why do people fight for their own name's sake, giving praise to those who win?"
I challenge you.
"Why do people fight for righteousness, giving praise to those who have passed?"
raw.es:
Te pregunto.
"¿Por qué las personas pelean para hacerse un nombre, honrando a quienes triunfan?"
Te reto.
"¿Por qué las personas luchan por la justicia, honrando a quienes han muerto?"
raw.id:
Aku bertanya kepadamu.
"Mengapa orang bertarung demi nama mereka, memuji yang menang?"
Aku menantangmu.
"Mengapa orang bertarung demi kebenaran, memuji yang telah wafat?"
raw.pt:
Eu o pergunto.
“Por que as pessoas lutam pelo próprio nome e admiram os vencedores?”
Eu desafio.
“Por que as pessoas lutam pela justiça e admiram aqueles que já se foram?”
raw.th:
ข้าถามเจ้า
"ทำไมผู้คนถึงต่อสู้เพื่อชื่อเสียง และชื่นชมผู้ที่ได้รับชัยชนะ?"
ข้าท้าทายเจ้า
"ทำไมผู้คนถึงต่อสู้เพื่อความถูกต้อง และมอบความชื่นชมให้กับผู้ที่จากไป?"
raw.vi:
Tôi yêu cầu bạn.
"Tại sao người ta chiến đấu vì danh riêng của họ, cho lời khen ngợi cho những người giành chiến thắng?"
Tôi thách thức bạn.
"Tại sao người ta đấu tranh cho sự công bình, cho lời khen ngợi cho những người đã được thông qua?"

id: Meski semua orang tahu nama pedang ini, tidak ada yang tahu siapa yang telah bertarung memakainya. Meski kekuatan besarnya melegenda di seluruh dunia, tidak ada nama yang didokumentasikan. Orang percaya keberadaannya dan terus mewariskan legenda ini, "Tidak ada yang tidak bisa dibelah Bilah Ragna menjadi dua, bahkan juga dewa!"
name: MST_SPHERES_37500_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Though everyone knew this sword's name, none knew anyone who fought with it. Even though its great power is spoken of in legends across the world, nowhere can its name be found in documents. Regardless, people believe in its existence and continue to pass its legend down, saying "There is nothing the Ragna Blade can't split in two, not even a god!"

raw.en: Though everyone knew this sword's name, none knew anyone who fought with it. Even though its great power is spoken of in legends across the world, nowhere can its name be found in documents. Regardless, people believe in its existence and continue to pass its legend down, saying "There is nothing the Ragna Blade can't split in two, not even a god!"
raw.es: Aunque todos sabían el nombre de esta espada, ninguno supo de nadie que hubiera luchado con ella. A pesar de que su gran poder es legendario a lo largo y ancho del mundo, en ningún lugar consta su nombre en documentos. No obstante, la gente cree en su existencia y continúa contando la leyenda, con el dicho "No hay nada que la Espada Ragna no pueda cortar en dos, ¡ni siquiera un dios!"
raw.id: Meski semua orang tahu nama pedang ini, tidak ada yang tahu siapa yang telah bertarung memakainya. Meski kekuatan besarnya melegenda di seluruh dunia, tidak ada nama yang didokumentasikan. Orang percaya keberadaannya dan terus mewariskan legenda ini, "Tidak ada yang tidak bisa dibelah Bilah Ragna menjadi dua, bahkan juga dewa!"
raw.pt: Embora todos soubessem o nome desta espada, ninguém conhecia alguém que tivesse lutado com ela. Mesmo que seu grande poder seja citado em lendas pelo mundo todo, seu nome nunca foi encontrado em documentos. Apesar disso, as pessoas acreditam na existência dela e continuam repassando a lenda dizendo “Não há nada que a Lâmina de Ragna não possa cortar em dois, nem mesmo um deus!”
raw.th: แม้ว่าทุกคนจะรู้จักชื่อของดาบนี้ แต่ไม่มีใครรู้ว่าใครเป็นคนใช้มันสู้ ถึงอย่างนั้นพลังที่ยิ่งใหญ่ของมันก็เป็นที่กล่าวขานไปทั่วโลก แต่กลับไม่พบชื่อของมันในบันทึกใดๆ ที่ไหนเลย ถึงอย่างนั้น ผู้คนก็ยังเชื่อถึงการมีอยู่ของมันและยังคงสืบทอดเรื่องราวของมันต่อไป โดยบอกว่า "ไม่มีสิ่งใดที่ดาบแร็กน่าผ่าแยกเป็นสองไม่ได้ แม้แต่เทพเจ้า!"
raw.vi: Mặc dù mọi người đều biết tên của thanh kiếm này, những chẳng ai biết kẻ nào đã chiến đấu với nó. Mặc dù sức mạnh tuyệt vời của nó được nói đến trong các huyền thoại khắp giới, lại chẳng thể tìm ra tên nó trong tài liệu nào. Bất kể như vậy, mọi người tin vào sự tồn tại của nó và tiếp tục lan truyền huyền thoại của mình, nói rằng "Chẳng có gì Lưỡi kiếm Ragna không thể cắt đôi, ngay cả một vị thần!"

id: Pedang hebat milik Vargas, salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Katanya pandai besi dari Kekaisaran Agni membuatnya dari bijih besi spesial dengan panas dari volkano. Dengan bilah terbungkus api, katanya meningkatkan roh pembawanya. Vargas mulai memakai pedang ini saat perang dengan para dewa dimulai, dan kontribusi besar telah tercatat di berbagai arsip.
name: MST_SPHERES_37600_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A great sword that belonged to Vargas, one of the Six Heroes. It is said that a blacksmith from the Agni Empire forged it with a special ore using the heat from a volcano. With a blade enveloped in flames, it is said to boost its wielder's spirit. Vargas started using this sword when the war with the gods broke out and its notable contributions throughout have been recorded in countless archives.

raw.en: A great sword that belonged to Vargas, one of the Six Heroes. It is said that a blacksmith from the Agni Empire forged it with a special ore using the heat from a volcano. With a blade enveloped in flames, it is said to boost its wielder's spirit. Vargas started using this sword when the war with the gods broke out and its notable contributions throughout have been recorded in countless archives.
raw.es: Una gran espada que perteneció a Vargas, uno de los Seis héroes. Se dice que un herrero del imperio de Agní la forjó con un mineral especial usando el calor de un volcán. Los rumores dicen que esta espada cubierta de fuego fortalece el espíritu de su dueño. Vargas comenzó a usar esta espada cuando estalló la guerra contra los dioses, y sus notables contribuciones se han registrado en innumerables archivos.
raw.id: Pedang hebat milik Vargas, salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Katanya pandai besi dari Kekaisaran Agni membuatnya dari bijih besi spesial dengan panas dari volkano. Dengan bilah terbungkus api, katanya meningkatkan roh pembawanya. Vargas mulai memakai pedang ini saat perang dengan para dewa dimulai, dan kontribusi besar telah tercatat di berbagai arsip.
raw.pt: Uma grande espada que pertenceu a Vargas, um dos Seis Heróis. Dizem que um ferreiro do Império Agni a forjou com um minério especial, usando o calor de um vulcão. Com a lâminha envolta por chamas, dizem que ela reforça o espírito de quem a empunha. Vargas começou a usar essa espada quando a guerra com os deuses eclodiu e suas notáveis contribuições foram registradas em inúmeros arquivos.
raw.th: ดาบใหญ่ของวาร์กัส หนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ เล่ากันว่าช่างตีเหล็กจากจักรวรรดิแอ็กนี่ตีมันขึ้นมาด้วยแร่พิเศษโดยใช้ความร้อนจากภูเขาไฟ และเล่ากันอีกว่าดาบที่ห่อหุ้มด้วยเปลวไฟช่วยเพิ่มจิตวิญญาณให้กับผู้ใช้ วาร์กัสเริ่มใช้ดาบนี้เมื่อสงครามกับเทพเจ้าประทุขึ้น และผลงานที่โดดเด่นของมันก็ถูกบันทึกเอาไว้ในหอจดหมายเหตุมากมายนับไม่ถ้วน
raw.vi: Một thanh kiếm tuyệt vời thuộc về Vargas, một trong Sáu Vị Anh Hùng. Nghe đồn rằng một người thợ rèn đến từ Đế Chế Agni đã rèn thanh kiếm này từ một loại kim lại đặc biệt bằng sức nóng của núi lửa. Với lưỡi kiếm được bao bọc trong lửa đỏ, được cho là để gia tăng tinh thần của người nắm giữ. Vargas đã bắt đầu sử dụng thanh kiếm này khi cuộc chiến với các vị thần nổ ra và đóng góp thầm lặng của nó đã được ghi lại trong vô số các ghi chép.

id: Tombak setan milik Lance, salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Aslinya dari Vriksha Duchy dan katanya memberi si pengguna kekuatan alam. Ada kutukan yang memfusi pengguna dan tombak seutuhnya. Rumornya, Lance bisa mendengar suara si tombak setan, ada banyak teori apa yang dikatakan si tombak kepadanya.
name: MST_SPHERES_37610_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A demon pike that belonged to Lance, one of the Six Heroes. This pike originated from the Vriksha Duchy and is said to bestow its user with the power of nature. However, it bears a curse that completely fuses the pike to its user over time. It is rumored that Lance could hear the voice of the demon pike, but there are various theories as to what the pike told him.

raw.en: A demon pike that belonged to Lance, one of the Six Heroes. This pike originated from the Vriksha Duchy and is said to bestow its user with the power of nature. However, it bears a curse that completely fuses the pike to its user over time. It is rumored that Lance could hear the voice of the demon pike, but there are various theories as to what the pike told him.
raw.es: Un pico demoníaco que perteneció a Lance, uno de los Seis héroes. Este pico es originario del principado de Vriksha, y se dice que confiere el poder de la naturaleza a su portador. Sin embargo, el pico está maldito y con el tiempo se fusiona completamente con su dueño. Se dice que Lance pudo oír la voz del pico demoníaco. Hay varias teorías sobre las palabras exactas del arma.
raw.id: Tombak setan milik Lance, salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Aslinya dari Vriksha Duchy dan katanya memberi si pengguna kekuatan alam. Ada kutukan yang memfusi pengguna dan tombak seutuhnya. Rumornya, Lance bisa mendengar suara si tombak setan, ada banyak teori apa yang dikatakan si tombak kepadanya.
raw.pt: Um pique demoníaco que pertenceu a Lance, um dos Seis Heróis. Esse pique teve origem no Ducado de Vriksha e dizem que dá a seu usuário o poder da natureza. Porém, ela possui uma maldição que aos poucos funde completamente o pique a seu usuário. Rumores dizem que Lance podia ouvir a voz do pique demoníaco, mas há muitas teorias sobre o que o pique dizia.
raw.th: หอกปีศาจที่เป็นของแลนซ์ หนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ หอกนี้มีพื้นเพมาจากมนฑลรัฐพฤกษาและกล่าวกันว่าจะมอบพลังแห่งธรรมชาติให้กับผู้ใช้ อย่างไรก็ตามตัวของมันก็มีคำสาบที่จะหลอมรวมหอกกับผู้ใช้เข้าด้วยกันจนสมบูรณ์เมื่อเวลาล่วงเลยผ่านไป มีข่าวลือว่าแลนซ์ได้ยินเสียงของหอกปีศาจ แต่มีหลายทฤษฎีว่าหอกได้พูดอะไรกับเข้าบ้าง
raw.vi: Ma thương thuộc về Lance, một trong Sáu vị anh hùng. Cây thương này có nguồn gốc từ Công quốc Vriksha và được cho rằng sẽ ban cho người nắm giữ nó sức mạnh của thiên nhiên. Tuy nhiên, nó mang một lời nguyền rằng sẽ hoàn toàn tiến nhập vào người dùng nó sau một thời gian. Nghe đồn rằng Lance có thể nghe được giọng nói của cây ma thương này, tuy nhiên, có nhiều lời đồn khác nhau về nội dung những gì cây ma thương này đã kể cho Lance.

id: Pedang lebar salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan, Eze. Diperoleh saat mengalahkan beast guntur, Behemoth. Terlihat tua, tapi dengan memengaruhi roh apa pun yang menghuninya, pedang ini memberikan kemampuan mengeluarkan guntur. Tidak hanya untuk menyerang, tapi juga membangkitkan kemampuan fisik Eze, mengisi Eze dengan kekuatan perusak yang ditakuti para dewa. Ada laporan bahwa pemilik pedang guntur ini akan berubah penampilannya karena pedang akan bertumbuh dengannya.
name: MST_SPHERES_37620_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The broadsword of one of the Six Heroes, Eze. He acquired it when he defeated the thunderous beast Behemoth. It may look like an old broadsword, but by influencing the spirit of whomever has equipped it, it grants one the ability to release thunder. Not only does this thunder serve to attack enemies, but it also awakened Eze's physical ability, infusing him with destructive power that even the gods themselves feared. Furthermore, there are reports left that state that the master of this thunder sword will change in appearance as the sword grows with him.

raw.en: The broadsword of one of the Six Heroes, Eze. He acquired it when he defeated the thunderous beast Behemoth. It may look like an old broadsword, but by influencing the spirit of whomever has equipped it, it grants one the ability to release thunder. Not only does this thunder serve to attack enemies, but it also awakened Eze's physical ability, infusing him with destructive power that even the gods themselves feared. Furthermore, there are reports left that state that the master of this thunder sword will change in appearance as the sword grows with him.
raw.es: La espada ancha de Eze, uno de los Seis héroes. La consiguió tras derrotar a Bégimo, la bestia tormentosa. Quizá tenga la apariencia de una espada ancha ordinaria, pero esta arma influye el espíritu de quien se la equipa y le otorga la habilidad de liberar truenos. El trueno no solo sirve para atacar a los enemigos, sino que también despertó las habilidades físicas de Eze y lo insufló con un poder tan destructivo que incluso los dioses temían. Además, hay informes que aseguran que la apariencia del maestro de esta espada tormentosa cambiará según se fortalezca el vínculo entre el dueño y el arma.
raw.id: Pedang lebar salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan, Eze. Diperoleh saat mengalahkan beast guntur, Behemoth. Terlihat tua, tapi dengan memengaruhi roh apa pun yang menghuninya, pedang ini memberikan kemampuan mengeluarkan guntur. Tidak hanya untuk menyerang, tapi juga membangkitkan kemampuan fisik Eze, mengisi Eze dengan kekuatan perusak yang ditakuti para dewa. Ada laporan bahwa pemilik pedang guntur ini akan berubah penampilannya karena pedang akan bertumbuh dengannya.
raw.pt: A espada larga de um dos Seis Heróis, Eze. Ele a adquiriu quando derrotou a besta do trovão Behemoth. Pode parecer uma velha espada, mas influenciando o espírito de quem a equipar, dá ao portador o poder do trovão. Não somente o trovão ataca os inimigos, como também despertou a habilidade física de Eze, infundindo-o com um poder destrutivo que os próprios deuses temiam. Além disso, há relatos de que dizem que o mestre dessa espada do trovão muda de aparência conforme a espada cresce junto a ele.
raw.th: ดาบใหญ่ของหนึ่งในหกผู้กล้า อีเซ่ เขาได้รับมันเมื่อตอนที่เขาเอาชนะเบฮีโมธอสูรกายสายฟ้า มันอาจจะดูเหมือนดาบใหญ่เก่าๆ แต่ด้วยแรงผลักดันจากจิตวิญยาณของใครก็ตามที่ใช้มัน มันจะมอบพลังที่สามารถปลดปล่อยสายฟ้า ซึ่งสายฟ้านี้ไม่เพียงแต่ใช้เพื่อโจมตีศัตรูเท่านั้นแต่มันยังใช้เพื่อปลุกพลังทางกายภาพของอีเซ่ให้ตื่นขึ้นมาอีกด้วย เสริมพลังทำลายล้างให้กับเขาที่แม้แต่เทพเจ้าเองยังต้องหวาดกลัว ยิ่งไปกว่านั้น ยังมีรายงานที่เหลือที่กล่าวไว้ว่าเจ้านายของดาบสายฟ้านี้จะเปลี่ยนรูปลักษณ์ไปขณะที่ดาบนี่เติบโตไปพร้อมกับเขา
raw.vi: Đao của một trong Sáu vị anh hùng, Eze. Anh có được nó khi đánh bại lôi thú Behemoth. Trông nó như một cây đao cũ, nhưng nhờ ảnh hưởng đến tinh thần của bất kỳ ai sử dụng nó, nó ban cho người dùng có khả năng phát ra sấm sét. Không chỉ sấm sét này được dùng để tấn công kẻ thù, mà nó còn đánh thức khả năng thể chất của Eze, truyền cho anh sức mạnh hủy diệt mà ngay cả các vị thần cũng khiếp sợ. Ngoài ra, có những báo cáo còn lại cho rằng chủ nhân của thanh lôi kiếm này sẽ thay đổi ngoại hình khi thanh kiếm phát triển cùng với anh.

id: Pedang panjang yang dipakai Selena, salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Diturunkan dari generasi ke generasi rakyat Savat, katanya si pemegang pedang ini adalah pemimpin Savat. Meski dibuat ramping dan cantik, mirip dekorasi, faktanya pedang ini jauh lebih kuat daripada pedang biasa. Pedang ini memiliki kehendak sendiri, dan saat berpadu dengan Selena semakin mengeluarkan kekuatan Selena.
name: MST_SPHERES_37630_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A long sword used by Selena, one of the Six Heroes. Passed down through generation after generation of the people of Savat, it's said that whoever holds this sword is their leader. Though this beautifully crafted slender blade may look like a mere decorative piece, it is in fact far more powerful than your average sword. It's told that the sword has a will of its own, and that in melding with Selena herself further drew out her powers.

raw.en: A long sword used by Selena, one of the Six Heroes. Passed down through generation after generation of the people of Savat, it's said that whoever holds this sword is their leader. raw.es: La espada larga que usa Selena, un miembro de los Seis héroes. Se dice que quien posea esta espada, que pasó de generación en generación por los miembros de Savat, se convierte en el líder de esa nación. Si bien esta delgada espada creada con maestría puede parecer un objeto decorativo, es de hecho mucho más poderosa que una espada normal. Se comenta que la espada tiene voluntad propia, y que al unirse con la mismísima Selena, sus poderes se fortalecieron.

raw.pt: Uma espada longa usada por Selena, uma dos Seis Heróis. Passada de geração em geração pelo povo de Savat, dizem que aquele que empunhá-la será seu líder. Embora essa lâmina estreita de bela construção pareça uma peça meramente decorativa, na verdade ela é muito mais poderosa do que uma espada comum. Dizem que a espada possui vontade própria e que sua união com Selena acentuou seus poderes.
raw.th: ดาบยาวที่ใช้โดยเซเลน่าซึ่งเป็นหนึ่งในหกผู้กล้า ถูกส่งต่อลงมาจากรุ่นสู่รุ่นของผู้คนแห่งซาวัต ว่ากันว่าใครก็ตามที่ถือดาบนี้จะเป็นผู้นำของพวกเขา แม้ว่าดาบบางที่ถูกประดิษฐ์ขึ้นมาอย่างสวยงามนี้อาจจะดูเหมือนเป็นแค่ของประดับชิ้นหนึ่ง อันที่จริงมันมีพลังมากกว่าดาบทั่วไปของคุณ ว่ากันว่าดาบนั้นมีเจตจำนงของตนเอง และมันหลอมรวมกันกับเซเลนาซึ่งได้ดึงพลังของเธอออกมา
raw.vi: Một thanh kiếm dài được Selena, một trong Sáu vị anh hùng, sử dụng. Truyền qua các thế hệ người Savat, tương truyền rằng bất cứ ai nắm giữ thanh kiếm này sẽ chỉ huy của họ. Mặc dù lưỡi kiếm thon nhỏ được chế tạo tuyệt đẹp này có thể trong như một vật trang trí đơn thuần, nhưng thật ra nó mạnh hơn nhiều thanh kiếm loại trung của bạn. Tương truyền rằng thanh kiếm mang ý chí của chủ sở hữu nó và khi được chính Selena sử dụng sẽ phát huy nhiều hơn sức mạnh của cô.

id: Tombak yang dipakai Magress, satu dari Enam Pahlawan, pada zaman dulu. Tombak tajam ini diberikan kepada Magress dari ayahnya untuk merayakan kenaikan pangkatnya sebagai ksatria. Tombak yang dibuat sangat baik, awalnya adalah bilah besi biasa sampai bermandikan darah para dewa berkali-kali, memberinya kekuatan kegelapan. Terbungkus kekuatan para dewa, tombak pembunuh dewa Leomurg tumbuh dan berubah bersama dengan tuannya yang kejam.
name: MST_SPHERES_37640_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The lance that Magress, one of the Six Heroes, wielded long ago. This sharp lance was given to Magress by his father to celebrate his promotion to knighthood. A well manufactured lance, it was initially a common steel blade until it was showered in gods' blood over and over again, endowing it with dark forces. Enveloped in the gods' power, the god killing lance Leomurg grows and evolves alongside its sinister master.

raw.en: The lance that Magress, one of the Six Heroes, wielded long ago. This sharp lance was given to Magress by his father to celebrate his promotion to knighthood. raw.es: La lanza que Magress, uno de los Seis héroes, blandió hace mucho tiempo. El padre de Magress le dio esta afilada lanza para celebrar su promoción a caballero. Es una lanza de muy buena factura que inicialmente tenía una hoja de acero común hasta que fue bañada en sangre de dioses una y otra vez, lo que la insufló con fuerzas oscuras. Envuelta en el poder de las deidades, la lanza matadioses Leomurg crece y evoluciona junto a su siniestro maestro.
raw.id: Tombak yang dipakai Magress, satu dari Enam Pahlawan, pada zaman dulu. Tombak tajam ini diberikan kepada Magress dari ayahnya untuk merayakan kenaikan pangkatnya sebagai ksatria. Tombak yang dibuat sangat baik, awalnya adalah bilah besi biasa sampai bermandikan darah para dewa berkali-kali, memberinya kekuatan kegelapan. Terbungkus kekuatan para dewa, tombak pembunuh dewa Leomurg tumbuh dan berubah bersama dengan tuannya yang kejam.
raw.pt: A lança que Magress, um dos Seis Heróis, usou há muito tempo. Esta lança afiada foi dada a Magress pelo próprio pai, em comemoração à sua promoção a cavaleiro. Uma lança bem feita, ela era inicialmente uma lâmina de aço comum, até ser banhada no sangue dos deuses muitas vezes, enchendo-a de forças sombrias. Envolvida com o poder dos deuses, a lança assassina de deuses Leomurg cresce e evolui junto do seu mestre sinistro.
raw.th: หอกที่มาเกรสหนึ่งในหกผู้กล้าใช้นานมาแล้ว หอกคมนี้ถูกมอบให้กับมาเกรสโดยพ่อของเขา เพื่อเป็นการฉลองการเลื่อนตำแหน่งการเป็นอัศวิน เป็นหอกที่ถูกสร้างขึ้นมาเป็นอย่างดี ในตอนแรกมันเป็นคมเหล็กกล้าธรรมดา จนกระทั่งมันได้อาบเลือดของเทพเจ้ามานับครั้งไม่ถ้วน และมอบพลังมืดให้กับมัน ปกคลุมด้วยพลังของเทพเจ้า, หอกสังหารเทพเจ้าลีโอเมิร์กได้เติบโตและพัฒนาควบคู่ไปกับเจ้านายที่น่ากลัวของมัน
raw.vi: Cây thương mà Magress, một trong Sáu vị anh hùng, đã nắm giữ từ lâu. Cây thương sắc bén này đã được trao cho Magress từ người cha của ông để kỷ niệm khi ông trở thành hiệp sĩ. Một cây thương được chế tạo rất tốt, ban đầu đó là một lưỡi thép thông thường cho đến khi nó được tắm luyện trong máu các vị thần hết lần này đến lần khác, thấm nhuần các sức mạnh hắc ám. Được bao bọc bởi sức mạnh của các vị thần, cây thương sát thần Leomurg cũng phát triển và tiến hóa cùng với người chủ nham hiểm của nó.

id: Pedang yang dipakai oleh satu dari Enam Pahlawan legendaris. Pedang legendaris yang katanya disimpan di kota suci Lizeria. Kekuatannya membantu mengeluarkan potensi penuh dari pemiliknya, tapi tidak ada catatan pemilik sebelum Atro yang tersisa, membuat kemampuan ini diragukan. Legenda berkata bahwa para dewa lah yang bisa memberikan pedang suci ini kepada pemakainya, tapi riset baru tentang silsilah keluarga setelah Atro memakainya sedang berlangsung.
name: MST_SPHERES_37650_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The sword that one of the legendary Six Heroes, Atro, wielded. A legendary sword that is said to have been sheathed in the holy site of Lizeria. Its powers help to unleash the full potential of its possessor, but no record of any owners besides Atro remain, causing speculation about the truth of this ability. Legends say the gods were the ones to bestow this holy sword upon others, but new research concerning blood lineage has been carried out since Atro had it in his possession.

raw.en: The sword that one of the legendary Six Heroes, Atro, wielded. A legendary sword that is said to have been sheathed in the holy site of Lizeria. Its powers help to unleash the full potential of its possessor, but no record of any owners besides Atro remain, causing speculation about the truth of this ability. Legends say the gods were the ones to bestow this holy sword upon others, but new research concerning blood lineage has been carried out since Atro had it in his possession.
raw.es: La espada que blandió Atro, uno de los legendarios Seis héroes. Se dice que la espada se forjó en la ciudad bendita de Lizeria. Sus poderes ayudan a desatar el verdadero potencial de su dueño, pero dado que los anales de la historia no registran ningún otro portador además de Atro, muchos dudan de que sus poderes realmente existan. Las leyendas cuentan que esta espada estaba reservada para las luchas entre dioses, pero desde que se encontró en poder de Atro, se han llevado a cabo nuevas investigaciones en torno a su origen.

raw.pt: A espada que Atro, um dos lendários Seis Heróis, usava. Uma espada lendária que dizem ter sido feita no local sagrado de Lizeria. Seus poderes ajudam a libertar todo o potencial de quem a utiliza, mas não há registros de outros donos além de Atro, o que causa especulação sobre a realidade dessa habilidade. As lendas dizem que os deuses é que concediam essa espada sagrada a outros, mas uma nova pesquisa sobre linhagem de sangue foi realizada depois que Atro a possuiu.
raw.th: ดาบที่อาโทร หนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษในตำนานเป็นผู้ใช้ ว่ากันว่าฝักดาบของมันมีความศักดิ์สิทธิ์แห่งลิเซอเรีย พลังของมันจะช่วยดึงศักยภาพของผู้ครอบครอง แต่ไม่มีบันทึกของคนอื่นเหนือจากอาโทรเหลืออยู่เลย เพราะการไตร่ตรองถึงความจริงเกี่ยวกับความสามารถของมัน ตำนานกล่าวว่าเทพเป็นหนึ่งในผู้มอบดาบนี้ให้กับผู้อื่น แต่ผลวิจัยใหม่เกี่ยวกับสายเลือดนั้นก็เสร็จสิ้นตั้งแต่อาโทรเป็นผู้ถือครอง
raw.vi: Thanh kiếm đó nắm giữ bởi một trong Sáu Anh Hùng huyền thoại, Atro. Một thanh kiếm huyền thoại được cho là đã được bọc vỏ tại một vùng đất thánh tại Lizeria. Quyền năng nó giúp mở ra toàn bộ năng lực của người sở hữu nó, nhưng không có ghi chép nào về người sở hữu khác ngoài Atro, gây ra những lời đồn đoán về khả năng thật sự của thanh kiếm này. Truyền thuyết nói rằng các vị thần là người ban tặng thanh kiếm thánh này cho những người khác, nhưng nghiên cứu mới đây liên quan đến huyết thống đã được thực hiện kể từ thời Atro có nó thì nó vẫn thuộc sở hữu của ông.

id: Satu set zirah yang diwariskan oleh keluarga raja dari Palmyna. Terlihat seperti pedang lebar pada awalnya, dia berubah menjadi zirah dan pedang besar, terpisah, setelah didoakan secara khusus. Mengumpulkan kekuatannya dari Alam, menggunakannya akan meningkatkan vitalitas pengguna. Tidak ada informasi yang tertinggal tentang pembuat benda ini, tapi menurut legenda yang menceritakan pemilik sebelumnya, beberapa berasumsi bahwa dia adalah mahkluk dengan kehendak bebas.
name: MST_SPHERES_37660_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A set of armor passed down within the royal family of Palmyna. Though it looks like a broadsword at first glance, it transforms into both armor and a great sword, separately, after it is offered a special prayer. Gathering its power from the forces of Mother Nature, equipping it apparently increases the wearer's vitality. No information is left concerning the creator of this item, but according to the legends which tell of its presumed last owner, some suppose it was a creature of free will.

raw.en: A set of armor passed down within the royal family of Palmyna. raw.es: Una armadura que legó la familia real de Palmyna. A pesar de que se parece a una espada ancha apenas se la ve, este objeto se transforma en armadura o en espada luego de ofrecerle un rezo especial. Su poder viene de las fuerzas de la madre naturaleza. Aparentemente, al equiparla, la vitalidad del usuario aumenta. No existe información sobre el creador de este objeto, pero según las leyendas, que hablan de su presunto último dueño, se supone que era una criatura de voluntad libre.

raw.pt: Um conjunto de armadura passado de geração a geração da família real de Palmyna. Embora pareça uma espada longa à primeira vista, ela se transforma em uma armadura e uma espada em separado depois de receber uma oração especial. Reunindo seu poder das forças da mãe natureza, utilizá-la aparentemente aumenta a vitalidade do usuário. Nenhuma informação restou com relação ao criador do item mas, de acordo com as lendas que falam de seu suposto último dono, alguns dizem que foi uma criação do livre arbítrio.
raw.th: เช็ตเกราะที่สืบทอดมายังเชื้อพระวงศ์ของปัลมีน่า แม้ดูเหมือนดาบใหญ่ยักษ์ในครั้งแรก แต่มันสามารถเปลี่ยนรูปร่างเป็นทั้งชุดเกราะและดาบชั้นเยี่ยมได้ และถูกแยกจากกันเมื่อถูกนำไปไว้บูชา มันได้รับพลังมาจากเทพีผู้ก่อกำเนิด เมื่อสวมใส่จะได้รับพลังทนทานอย่างมาก ไม่มีข้อมูลของผู้สร้างมันขึ้นมา แต่จากตำนานที่กล่าวไว้เพียงผู้ที่น่าจะเป็นคนครอบครองมันเป็นรายสุดท้าย น่าจะเป็นผู้ที่ปรารถนาในอิสรภาพ
raw.vi: Một bộ áo giáp được truyền lại trong hoàng tộc Palmyna. Dù mới đầu trông như một thanh đao, nó sẽ biến đổi thành áo giáp lẫn một thanh cự kiếm riêng biệt, sau khi đọc lời khấn cho nó. Thu thập năng lượng từ các thế lực Siêu Nhiên, đeo nó vào dường như sẽ làm tăng sinh lực cho người mặc. Không còn thông tin nào liên quan đến người tạo ra vật phẩm này, nhưng theo truyền thuyết về chủ sở hữu phỏng đoán cuối cùng của nó, vài người cho rằng đó là tạo vật của ý chí tự do.

id: Melayang di udara seakan punya sayap sendiri, 8 pedang ini membabat musuh mana pun. Jelas ditempa untuk satu tujuan: mengusir pengganggu dari dunia lain, pedang ini mewarisi keinginan kuat dari pemiliknya, melindungi pemegangnya dari bahaya. Seperti namanya, serangannya hampir tidak mungkin dihindari, mengakibatkan kematian bagi petarung biasa.
name: MST_SPHERES_37670_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Floating in the air as if having a will of their own, these eight blades shred and tear through any enemy. Apparently forged for the single purpose of expelling intruders from other worlds, these blades inherited the strong will of their owner, striking to protect the wielder from harm. As the name of this group of blades suggests, their attack is almost impossible to dodge, spelling almost certain death for the average warrior.

raw.en: Floating in the air as if having a will of their own, these eight blades shred and tear through any enemy. raw.es: Flotando en el aire, como si tuvieran voluntad propia, estas ocho espadas trituran y atraviesan a todos los enemigos. Forjadas aparentemente con el único propósito de expulsar a los intrusos de otros mundos, estas espadas heredaron la fuerza de voluntad de su dueño y protegen a quien las blande de todo daño. Como el nombre de este grupo de espadas indica, su ataque es casi imposible de esquivar, y garantiza la muerte de los guerreros que no están preparados.

raw.pt: Flutuando no ar como se tivesse vontade própria, estas oito espadas cortam e destroem o inimigo. Aparentemente forjadas para o único propósito de afastar invasores de outros mundos, estas espadas herdaram a grande vontade de seu dono, protegendo quem as empunha do perigo. Como o nome delas sugere, seu ataque é quase impossível de desviar, oferecendo praticamente morte certa para uma guerreiro.
raw.th: ล่องลอยอยู่บนอากาศราวกับมีความปรารถนาเป็นของตัวเอง ดาบทั้งแปดนี้สามารถตัดฉีกร่างของศัตรูได้ ดาบเหล่านี้ถูกสร้างขึ้นเพื่อขับไล่ผู้รุกรานจากโลกต่างๆ และได้รับความปรารถนาอันแกร่งกล้าจากผู้เป็นเจ้าของในการปกป้องตนให้พ้นจากความชั่วร้าย เมื่อนึกถึงดาบเหล่านี้ การโจมตีนั้นแทบไม่อาจหลบหลีกได้เลย นำมาซึ่งความตายให้กับนักรบระดับกลางแทบจะในทันที
raw.vi: Trôi nổi trong không khí như thể chúng có ý chí riêng, tám lưỡi kiếm này xé và băm nhỏ bất kỳ kẻ thù nào. Rõ ràng được rèn với mục đích duy nhất là đánh đuổi những kẻ xâm lược đến từ thế giới khác, những lưỡi kiếm này thừa hưởng ý chí mạnh mẽ của chủ nhân chúng, tấn công để bảo vệ người sử dụng khỏi bị tổn hại. Như chính tên của nhóm những thanh kiếm này, đòn tấn công của chúng gần như không thể né tránh, báo hiệu cái chết gần như chắc chắn đối với những chiến binh trung bình.

id: Berasal dari dunia lain, hiasan rambut ini disebut "kanzashi". Katanya dulu dimiliki oleh perempuan muda menakutkan yang membunuh musuhnya selagi menari. Bunga cantik yang menghiasi jepit mewah ini membuatnya berharga secara moneter dan seni. Meski pemilik sebelumnya tidak segan-segan mencabut nyawa orang, ia merawat jepit ini. Tertumpah darah puluhan kali, perlu kekuatan sihir yang memberi pemakainya kewaspadaan ekstra di medan perang.
name: MST_SPHERES_37680_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Originating from another world, this hair ornament called a "kanzashi" is said to have belonged to a fearsome young lady who massacred her enemies as she danced. The beautiful flowers that adorn this luxurious hairpin make it a priceless object from both a monetary and artistic perspective. And although its previous owner never had a second thought about taking the lives of others, she took great care of this particular possession of hers. Drenched in blood countless of times, it acquired magical powers that give the wearer heightened senses on the battlefield.

raw.en: Originating from another world, this hair ornament called a "kanzashi" is said to have belonged to a fearsome young lady who massacred her enemies as she danced. The beautiful flowers that adorn this luxurious hairpin make it a priceless object from both a monetary and artistic perspective. And although its previous owner never had a second thought about taking the lives of others, she took great care of this particular possession of hers. Drenched in blood countless of times, it acquired magical powers that give the wearer heightened senses on the battlefield.
raw.es: Originario de otro mundo, se dice que este ornamento para el cabello llamado "kanzahshi" perteneció a una valiente joven que masacró a sus enemigos mientras bailaba. Las flores hermosas que adornan este lujoso prendedor lo convierten en un objeto invaluable tanto desde una perspectiva artística como monetaria. Y si bien su antigua dueña nunca dudó cuando de matar se trataba, la guerrera trató con sumo cariño a esta particular pieza. Bañado en sangre muchísimas veces, adquirió poderes mágicos que potenciaron los sentidos de la portadora en el campo de batalla.

Bunga cantik yang menghiasi jepit mewah ini membuatnya berharga secara moneter dan seni. Meski pemilik sebelumnya tidak segan-segan mencabut nyawa orang, ia merawat jepit ini. raw.pt: Vindo de outro mundo, dizem que este ornamento chamado de “kanzashi” pertenceu a uma assustadora jovem que massacrou seus inimigos enquanto dançava. As lindas flores que decoram este grampo de cabelo chique o tornam um objeto de muito valor monetário e artístico. E embora o seu dono anterior nunca hesitasse em tirar a vida dos outros, ela tomou muito cuidado com este item em particular. Lavado em sangue por muitas vezes, o grampo recebeu poderes mágicos que aumentam os sentidos de quem o usa durante a batalha.
raw.th: เครื่องประดับผมชิ้นนี้เรียกว่า "คานซาชิ" เป็นของจากต่างโลก ว่ากันว่ามันเป็นของสาวน้อยผู้น่ากลัวที่สังหารศัตรูทั้งกลุ่มด้วยการร่ายระบำของเธอ เพราะดอกไม้ที่สวยงามบนปิ่นอันหรูหรานี้จึงทำให้มันประเมินค่ามิได้ในแง่ของเงินตราและศิลปะ และแม้ว่าเจ้าของคนก่อนหน้าไม่เคยคิดจะมอบมันให้ใคร แต่เธอก็ยึดถือเป็นเจ้าของมันต่อไป เพราะชุ่มโชกไปด้วยเลือดมานับครั้งไม่ถ้วน มันจึงมีพลังเวทมนต์ที่ช่วยให้ผู้ใส่มันมีสัมผัสที่ดีขึ้นในสนามรบ
raw.vi: Có nguồn gốc từ thế giới khác, phụ kiện trang điểm tóc này được gọi là "kanzashi" được cho rằng thuộc về một cô gái trẻ đáng sợ đã tàn sát kẻ thù khi cô ta nhảy múa. Những bông hoa xinh đẹp tô điểm cho chiếc kẹp tóc sang trọng này làm cho nó trở thành một vật vô giá cả từ góc độ giá trị tiền và thẩm mỹ. Và mặc dù chủ nhân trước của nó chưa từng bận tâm khi lấy đi mạng sống của người khác, cô rất quan tâm đến tài sản đặc biệt này của mình. Đã ướt đẫm máu không biết bao nhiêu lần, nó có được sức mạnh ma thuật giúp tăng cường các giác quan cho người mang nó trên chiến trường.

id: Tiara aneh yang ditemukan saat dua pejuang bertarung di dunia lain. Katanya, saat dipakai, kemampuan pemakainya akan bertumbuh dengan cepat. Karena tekanan besar yang disebabkan tiara terhadap tubuh, tiara tidak boleh dipakai jika kondisi badan di bawah batas tertentu. Diketahui bahwa tiara ini menyegarkan pemakainya setelah digempur, kemampuan sihir yang dispekulasi berasal dari pengaruh dua pejuang yang menemukannya.
name: MST_SPHERES_37690_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A strange looking tiara believed to have been found when two warriors were fighting in another world. It is said that when placed on one's head, the wearer's abilities grow rapidly. However, due to the great stress that it causes upon the body, it should not be worn when one's condition is below a certain limit. It is also known for invigorating the wearer after having received damage, a magical ability speculated to have been born from the influence of the two fierce warriors who found it.

raw.en: A strange looking tiara believed to have been found when two warriors were fighting in another world. It is said that when placed on one's head, the wearer's abilities grow rapidly. However, due to the great stress that it causes upon the body, it should not be worn when one's condition is below a certain limit. It is also known for invigorating the wearer after having received damage, a magical ability speculated to have been born from the influence of the two fierce warriors who found it.
raw.es: Aparentemente, esta tiara peculiar se encontró durante la batalla entre dos guerreros de otros mundos. Se dice que cuando se posa sobre la cabeza de alguien, las habilidades del portador aumentan rápidamente. Sin embargo, debido al fuerte estrés que le provoca al cuerpo, se recomienda no utilizar este artefacto cuando el estado del individuo no es el apropiado. También se sabe que esta tiara vigoriza al portador luego de haber recibido daño, una habilidad mágica que, aparentemente, nació de la influencia de los dos fieros guerreros que la encontraron.
