Karena tekanan besar yang disebabkan tiara terhadap tubuh, tiara tidak boleh dipakai jika kondisi badan di bawah batas tertentu. Diketahui bahwa tiara ini menyegarkan pemakainya setelah digempur, kemampuan sihir yang dispekulasi berasal dari pengaruh dua pejuang yang menemukannya.
raw.pt: Uma tiara estranha que acreditam ter sido encontrada enquanto dois guerreiros lutavam em outro mundo. Dizem que ao ser colocada na cabeça de alguém, sua habilidades aumentam rapidamente. Porém, devido ao grande estresse que provoca no corpo, ela não deve ser usada quando sua condição estiver abaixo de um certo limite. Também é conhecida por revigorar quem a usa após sofrer algum dano, uma habilidade mágica que dizem ter nascido da influência de dois guerreiros ferozes que a encontraram.
raw.th: มงกุฎรูปร่างแปลกประหลาดที่เชื่อกันว่าถูกพบเมื่อนักรบสองคนกำลังต่อสู้กันอยู่ที่โลกอื่น ว่ากันว่าเมื่อสวมใส่ไว้บนหัวจะทำให้มีความสามารถเพิ่มขึ้นอย่างรวดเร็ว อย่างไรก็ตาม เพราะมันทำให้ร่างกายเกิดความตึงเครียด จึงไม่ช่วยให้ผู้สวมใส่ชนะหากเงื่อนไขต่ำกว่าเกณฑ์ และเป็นที่รู้กันว่ามันทำให้ผู้ใส่มีชีวิตชีวาขึ้นเมื่อถูกโจมตี พลังพิเศษนี้ก่อเกิดขึ้นจากการต่อสู้อันดุร้ายของนักรบทั้งสองที่พบมันเข้า
raw.vi: Một chiếc mũ tiara trông khác lạ được cho là đã được tìm thấy khi hai chiến binh chiến đấu ở một thế giới khác. Tương truyền rằng khi đội lên đầu của một người, khả năng của người đội sẽ tăng lên nhanh chóng. Tuy nhiên, do đòi hỏi về sức lực rất lớn nó gây ra đối với cơ thể người đội, không nên đội nó khi tình trạng của một người ở dưới mức giới hạn nhất định. Nó cũng được biết đến là sẽ tiếp thêm sinh lực cho người đội sau khi bị sát thương, người ta đoán rằng khả năng ma thuật của nó được sinh ra từ uy lực của hai chiến binh quyết liệt đã tìm thấy nó.

id: Jimat dinamai tempat ia ditemukan karena penciptanya masih misteri. Tidak sepenuhnya melindungi penggunanya dari semua status, namun dipercaya adalah produk sampingan hasil pembuatan aksesoris yang lebih baik. "Cinta sendiri tidak melindungi apa pun, dan kekuatan sendiri tidak membawa kedamaian" diukir di belakang jimat, membuat spekulasi siapa pembuatnya.
name: MST_SPHERES_37700_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An amulet named after the land it was found in as its creator remains a mystery. As it doesn't completely protect its user from all ailments, it is believed that it was a by-product produced when forging a better sphere. "Love alone protects nothing, and power alone never brings peace" was engraved on the back of the amulet, sparking speculation over its creator.

raw.en: An amulet named after the land it was found in as its creator remains a mystery. As it doesn't completely protect its user from all ailments, it is believed that it was a by-product produced when forging a better sphere. "Love alone protects nothing, and power alone never brings peace" was engraved on the back of the amulet, sparking speculation over its creator.
raw.es: Un amuleto que lleva el nombre de la tierra en que se encontró. Se desconoce quién lo creó. Ya que no protege al usuario completamente de todos los estados negativos, se cree que era un subproducto originado durante la forja de una esfera mejor. "El amor por sí solo no protege nada, y el poder por sí solo nunca trae la paz". Ese mensaje está grabado en el dorso del amuleto, y arroja más dudas sobre su creador.
raw.id: Jimat dinamai tempat ia ditemukan karena penciptanya masih misteri. Tidak sepenuhnya melindungi penggunanya dari semua status, namun dipercaya adalah produk sampingan hasil pembuatan aksesoris yang lebih baik. "Cinta sendiri tidak melindungi apa pun, dan kekuatan sendiri tidak membawa kedamaian" diukir di belakang jimat, membuat spekulasi siapa pembuatnya.
raw.pt: Um amuleto nomeado pelo lugar onde foi encontrado, seu criador permanece um mistério. Por não proteger completamente seu usuário de todos os status, acredita-se ser um protótipo produzido na pesquisa por uma esfera melhor. “O amor sozinho não protege nada, o poder sozinho nunca traz a paz” está gravado na parte de trás, fomentando a especulação sobre seu criador.
raw.th: เครื่องรางที่ตั้งชื่อตามดินแดนที่มันถูกค้นพบ เพราะว่าผู้สร้างคือใครนั้นก็ยังเป็นปริศนาอยู่ และเพราะว่ามันไม่สามารถป้องกันผู้ใช้จากสถานะผิดปกติได้อย่างสมบูรณ์ จึงเชื่อกันว่ามันเป็นเพียงแค่ต้นแบบของสเฟียร์ที่ถูกสร้างให้ดีกว่านี้ "ความรักเพียงอย่างเดียวไม่สามารถปกป้องอะไรได้ และพลังเพียงอย่างเดียวก็สร้างสันติสุขไม่ได้เช่นกัน" ถูกสลักไว้อยู่บนด้านหลังของเครื่องราง สะท้อนแนวคิดของผู้สร้าง
raw.vi: Một lá bùa được đặt tên theo vùng đất phát hiện được nó trong khi người sáng tạo ra nó vẫn còn là một bí ẩn. Bởi không hoàn toàn bảo vệ được người sử dụng nó tránh khỏi mọi loại bệnh tật, người ta tin rằng nó chỉ là một sản phẩm phụ được tạo ra khi đang rèn một quả cầu tốt hơn. “Tình yêu đơn phương không bảo vệ được điều gì và sức mạnh riêng rẽ không bao giờ mang lại hòa bình” đã được in dấu lên mặt sau của lá bùa này, làm dấy lên suy đoán về tác giả của nó.

id: Permata dengan nama pulau di Gaia Besar. Katanya itu adalah berkat dari dewa merayakan pendirian Republik La Veda. Biasanya disimpan di kuil, tapi diberikan ke pemimpin militer saat perang dimulai. Permata ini adalah simbol kekuatan militer, memberikan kekuatan kepada komandan republik dari generasi ke generasi untuk melindungi tanah air, namun lenyap saat perang dengan dewa.
name: MST_SPHERES_37800_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A gem that bears the name of an island in Grand Gaia. Word has it that it was a blessing from the gods in celebration of the founding of the La Veda Republic. It is usually stored in a shrine, but it was bestowed upon the military leaders when the war started. The gem was seen as a symbol of military power, granting the republic's generations of commanders with the power to protect their homeland, but it is believed to have vanished during the war with the gods.

raw.en: A gem that bears the name of an island in Grand Gaia. Word has it that it was a blessing from the gods in celebration of the founding of the La Veda Republic. It is usually stored in a shrine, but it was bestowed upon the military leaders when the war started. The gem was seen as a symbol of military power, granting the republic's generations of commanders with the power to protect their homeland, but it is believed to have vanished during the war with the gods.
raw.es: Una gema que lleva el nombre de una isla de Gran Gaia. Se cree que fue una bendición de los dioses para celebrar la creación de la república de La Veda. Generalmente se guarda en un sagrario, pero pasó a las manos de los líderes militares cuando comenzó la guerra. Esta gema es un símbolo del poder militar y les otorga a las generaciones de comandantes de la república el poder de proteger su tierra. Se cree que ha desaparecido durante la guerra contra los dioses.
raw.id: Permata dengan nama pulau di Gaia Besar. Katanya itu adalah berkat dari dewa merayakan pendirian Republik La Veda. Biasanya disimpan di kuil, tapi diberikan ke pemimpin militer saat perang dimulai. Permata ini adalah simbol kekuatan militer, memberikan kekuatan kepada komandan republik dari generasi ke generasi untuk melindungi tanah air, namun lenyap saat perang dengan dewa.
raw.pt: Uma joia que tem o nome de uma ilha em Grand Gaia. Dizem que ela foi uma bênção dos deuses em comemoração à fundação da República de La Veda. Ela era geralmente guardada em um santuário, mas foi entregue aos líderes militares no início da guerra. Essa joia era vista como símbolo do poder militar, dando às gerações de comandantes da república o poder de proteger seu lar, mas acreditava-se que ela desapareceu durante a guerra contra os deuses.
raw.th: อัญมณีตั้งชื่อตามเกาะนแกรนด์ไกอา กล่าวกันว่ามันเป็นพรที่ประทานจากเทพเจ้าเพื่อเป็นการเฉลิมฉลองการก่อตั้งสาธารณรัฐลา วีดา ปกติมันจะถูกเก็บไว้ที่วิหารแต่มันถูกส่งมอบให้กับผู้นำกองทัพเมื่อสงครามเริ่มขึ้น อัญมณ๊นี้ถูกมองว่าเป็นสัญลักษณ์ของอำนาจของกองทัพ และมอบพลังให้กับผู้บังคับบัญชาจากรุ่นสู่รุ่นเพื่อปกป้องบ้านเกิดเมืองนอน แต่เชื่อกันว่ามันได้หายในระหว่างสงครามกับเทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Một viên ngọc mang tên của một hòn đảo xứ Grand Gaia. Những từ ngữ trên đó là lời ban phúc từ các vị thần khi kỷ niệm ngày thành lập nền Cộng Hòa La Veda. Nó thường được cất giữa trong một đền thờ, tuy nhiên, viên ngọc này đã từng được ban cho người chỉ huy quân đội khi cuộc chiến nổ ra. Viên ngọc này đã được coi như là một biểu tượng sức mạnh của quân đội, trao cho các thế hệ chỉ huy của nền cộng hòa một sức mạnh bảo vệ quê nhà, tuy nhiên, người ta tin rằng viên ngọc đã biến mất trong cuộc chiến với các vị thần.

id: Permata yang katanya berisi kekuatan tersegel para dewa. Dikenal mengeluarkan kekuatan ledak besar saat penggunanya berada dalam kondisi mental puncak. Saat diaktifkan, kekuatan yang dikeluarkan melebihi level manusia, namun begitu ledakan habis, kekuatan penggunanya kembali normal sampai kondisi mentalnya memuncak lagi. Banyak yang percaya permata ini dibuat untuk menunjukkan kekuatan besar pada dewa agar orang-orang lebih beriman.
name: MST_SPHERES_37900_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A gem said to contain the sealed prowess of the gods. It is known for unleashing an immense burst of power when its user is at their peak mental state. When activated, the power it releases exceeds humanly possible levels, but once the burst is over, its user's powers return to normal levels until their mental state reaches a peak again. Many believe that the gem was created to demonstrate the great powers of the gods in order to increase the faith the people had in them.

raw.en: A gem said to contain the sealed prowess of the gods. It is known for unleashing an immense burst of power when its user is at their peak mental state. When activated, the power it releases exceeds humanly possible levels, but once the burst is over, its user's powers return to normal levels until their mental state reaches a peak again. Many believe that the gem was created to demonstrate the great powers of the gods in order to increase the faith the people had in them.
raw.es: Una gema que contiene el poder de los dioses. Se sabe que libera una gran ráfaga de poder cuando su usuario está en el pico máximo de su estado mental. Cuando se activa, el poder que libera excede la fuerza de cualquier ser humano. Sin embargo, cuando la energía se disipa, el poder del usuario vuelve a los niveles normales hasta que su estado mental llegue al punto máximo nuevamente. Muchos creen que esta gema se creó para demostrar los grandiosos poderes de los dioses para aumentar la fe que la gente tenía en ellos.

raw.pt: Uma joia que dizem conter a proeza selada dos deuses. É conhecida por liberar uma imensa explosão de poder quando o usuário está no seu melhor estado mental. Quando ativada, o poder que ela solta excede os níveis possivelmente humanos, mas assim que a explosão acaba, os poderes do seu usuário voltam ao normal até que seu estado mental chegue novamente ao pico. Muitos acreditam que ela foi criada para demonstrar os grandes poderes dos deuses, para aumentar a fé das pessoas neles.
raw.th: อัญมณีที่กล่าวกันว่ามีผนึกปิดความกล้าหาญของเทพเจ้าเอาไว้ เป็นที่รู้กันว่ามันปลดปล่อยพลังมหาศาลออกมาเมื่อผู้ใช้อยู่ในสภาวะทางอารมณ์ขั้นสูงสุด เมื่อใช้งานพลังที่มันปล่อยออกมาจะสูงเกิดขีดจำกัดของมนุษย์ แต่เมื่อการระเบิดพลังจบลง พลังของผู้ใช้ก็จะลดลงอยู่ในระดับปกติจนกว่าสภาวะทางอรมณ์จะพุ่งขึ้นอีกครั้ง หลายคนเชื่อว่าอัญมณีนั้นถูกสร้างเพื่อสาธิตพลังที่ยิ่งใหญ่ของเทพเจ้า เพื่อเพิ่มความศรัทธาของมนุษย์ที่มีต่อพวกนั้น
raw.vi: Viên ngọc được cho rằng ẩn chứa năng lực phong kín của các vị thần. Nó được biết đến với khả năng tạo ra sức mạnh bùng nổ khi người nắm giữ viên ngọc đạt đến trạng thái tinh thần đỉnh điểm. Khi được kích hoạt, sức mạnh nó giải phóng sẽ vượt xa các cấp độ có thể của loài người, nhưng sự bùng nổ chỉ xảy ra một lần, sức mạnh của người nắm giữ sẽ quay về cấp độ bình thường cho đến khi trạng thái tinh thần đạt đến đỉnh điểm một lần nữa. Nhiều người tin rằng viên ngọc này được tạo ra để minh chứng cho sức mạnh to lớn của các vị thần, nhằm tăng niềm tin của con người vào các vị thần.

id: Pecahan dari batu setan buatan manusia, katanya imitasi kristal jahat yang merupakan sumber kekuatan setan. Batu setan yang selesai tidaklah sekuat kristal kahat, namun dihancurkan karena merupakan ancaman untuk kedamaian dunia. Periset yang menciptakan batu mati misterius dan rumornya jiwa mereka diambil setan sebagai hukuman karena menciptakan batu setan.
name: MST_SPHERES_38000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A shard of a manmade demonic stone said to be an imitation of the evil crystal known to be a source of demon powers. The completed demonic stone wasn't thought to be as powerful as the dreaded evil crystal, but it was destroyed anyway as it was seen as a threat to world peace. The researchers who created the stone all ended up dying strange mysterious deaths and it was rumored that their souls were taken by demons as a punishment for creating the demonic stone.

raw.en: A shard of a manmade demonic stone said to be an imitation of the evil crystal known to be a source of demon powers. The completed demonic stone wasn't thought to be as powerful as the dreaded evil crystal, but it was destroyed anyway as it was seen as a threat to world peace. The researchers who created the stone all ended up dying strange mysterious deaths and it was rumored that their souls were taken by demons as a punishment for creating the demonic stone.
raw.es: Fragmento de una piedra demoníaca creada por los hombres. Se dice que imita el cristal maligno que actúa como fuente de poderes demoníacos. Se cree que la piedra demoníaca completa no es tan poderosa como el temible cristal maligno, pero fue destruida de igual modo porque se la consideraba como una amenaza para la paz mundial. Los investigadores que crearon la piedra terminaron muertos de maneras extrañas y misteriosas, y se cree que sus almas fueron consumidas por los demonios como castigo por crear la piedra demoníaca.

raw.pt: Um fragmento de uma pedra demoníaca feita pelos homens, que dizem ser a imitação de um cristal conhecido como a fonte dos poderes dos demônios. A pedra demoníaca completa não chegava nem perto do poder do terrível cristal, mas foi destruída mesmo assim quando a identificaram como ameaça à paz no mundo. Os pesquisadores que a criaram todos acabaram sofrendo mortes misteriosas e dizem que suas almas foram tomadas por demônios como punição.
raw.th: สะเก็ดของหินปีศาจที่มนุษย์สร้างขึ้นซึ่งว่ากันว่าเป็นของเลียนแบบคริสตัลชั่วร้ายซึ่งเป็นที่รู้กันว่าเป็นขุมพลังของปีศาจ แม้จะคิดกันว่าหินปีศาจสมบูรณ์แบบนั้นไม่ได้มีพลังเทียบเท่ากับคริสตัลชั่วร้ายที่น่าสะพรึงกลัว แต่มันก็ถูกทำลายเพราะมันถูกมองว่าเป็นภัยต่อความสันติสุขของโลก นักวิจัยผู้สร้างหินทุกคนต่างจบชีวิตลงอย่างลึกลับและลือกันว่าวิญญาณของพวกเขาถูกปีศาจเอาไปเพื่อเป็นการลงโทษ จากการสร้างหินปีศาจนี้
raw.vi: Một mảnh vỡ của ma thạch nhân tạo được cho là một bản mô phỏng viên pha lê tội lỗi vốn được biết đến như một nguồn sức mạnh ma quỷ. Ma thạch hoàn chỉnh không được xem là có sức mạnh như viên pha lê tội lỗi đáng sợ kia, tuy nhiên nó đã bị phá hủy tan tành kể từ khi được cho là một mối đe dọa nền hòa bình thế giới. Những người nghiên cứu đã từng tạo ra viên đá này đều có kết cục là cái chết bất thường bí ẩn và đồn rằng linh hồn của họ đã bị ma quỷ chiếm đoạt như là một hình phạt vì đã tạo ra viên đá ma quỷ.

id: Imitasi dari batu dengan kekuatan setan yang dibuat oleh tangan manusia. Benda yang bisa membuat dunia jatuh dalam kekacauan, hampir semua Keping Setan telah dihancurkan, kecuali beberapa klon yang disimpan. Beberapa tahun kemudian, keberadaan batu ini menjadi terkenal di antara para penyamun dan petualang, yang langsung mencari mereka. Tapi, banyak dari mereka menjadi korban kecelakaan aneh ketika melihat batu itu, yang membuat mereka berhenti mencarinya.
name: MST_SPHERES_38001_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An imitation of a stone with demonic powers fabricated by human hands. An item capable of sinking the world into chaos, most Demon Shards were destroyed, except for these clones that survived in safekeeping. Years later the existence of these stones became known to a large number of raiders and adventurers, who immediately sought after them. However, many of them were victims of very strange accidents while looking for the stones, which drove them to give up their search.

raw.es: La imitación de una piedra con poderes demoníacos fabricada por humanos. La mayoría de los fragmentos demoníacos, objetos capaces de hundir al mundo en el caos, fueron destruidos, con excepción de estos clones que sobrevivieron a buen recaudo. Años después, muchos aventureros y saqueadores se enteraron de la existencia de estas piedras y comenzaron a buscarlas inmediatamente. Sin embargo, muchos de ellos fueron víctimas de extraños accidentes mientras buscaban estas piedras, lo que los llevó a abandonar su búsqueda.

Um item capaz de afundar o mundo no caos, grande parte dos fragmentos demoníacos foi destruída, exceto pelos clones que sobreviveram guardados em segurança. Anos depois, a existência dessas pedras chegou aos ouvidos de muitos aventureiros e exploradores que partiram imediatamente em busca delas. No entanto, muitos deles foram vítimas de acidentes muito estranhos enquanto procuravam pela pedra, o que fez com que desistissem da busca.
raw.th: หินปลอมที่มีพลังความชั่วร้ายจากเงื้อมมือมนุษย์แฝงอยู่ มันมีอานุภาพในการทำให้ทั้งโลกตกอยู่ในความวุ่นวาย เศษผลึกของปีศาจถูกทำลายไปเป็นจำนวนมาก ยกเว้นของเทียมชิ้นนี้ที่เก็บรักษาเป็นอย่างดี หลายปีต่อมา กลุ่มโจรและนักผจญภัยถึงได้รู้ว่ามันมีอยู่จริง อย่างไรก็ตาม พวกเขาหลายคนตกเป็นเหยื่อในเหตุการณ์แปลกๆ ขณะกำลังมองดูหินเหล่านี้ และทำให้พวกเขาต้องล้มเลิกทำการค้นคว้ามัน
raw.vi: Bắt chước viên đá có sức mạnh ma quỷ do bàn tay con người chế tạo. Một vật phẩm có thể làm thế giới chìm vào hỗn mang, hầu hết các Mảnh vỡ Ma đã bị phá hủy, trừ các bản sao này còn lại vẫn được giữ an toàn. Nhiều năm sau sự tồn tại của các viên đá này đã được vô số kẻ cướp và người thám hiểm biết đến, khiến họ lập tức tìm kiếm chúng. Tuy nhiên, nhiều người trong số họ là nạn nhân của những vụ tai nạn rất kỳ lạ khi tìm kiếm các viên đá, điều đó khiến họ từ bỏ việc tìm kiếm.

id: Dalam istana kekaisaran tertentu, ada seorang penyihir memesona bernama Milavis. Takut pembunuhan dan kutukan, kaisar mencari Jimat Rouva dan memerintah si penyihir untuk membuat sesuatu yang lebih kuat, menjanjikan hadiah yang diidamkannya. Kaisar menerima kristal yang ia minta, melindunginya dari racun, penyakit, dan kutukan, tapi hadiah yang diminta si penyihir adalah nyawa yang ingin dilindungi kaisar dengan kekuatan jimat.
name: MST_SPHERES_38100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: In the palace of a certain empire, there was an alluring witch by the name of Milavis. Fearing assassination and curses, the emperor sought the Amulet of Rouva and ordered the witch to forge something even stronger than it, promising her any reward she desired. The emperor did receive the crystal he asked for which protects him from poison, sickness and curses, but the reward the witch asked for was the very life he wanted to protect with the powers of the amulet.

raw.en: In the palace of a certain empire, there was an alluring witch by the name of Milavis. Fearing assassination and curses, the emperor sought the Amulet of Rouva and ordered the witch to forge something even stronger than it, promising her any reward she desired. The emperor did receive the crystal he asked for which protects him from poison, sickness and curses, but the reward the witch asked for was the very life he wanted to protect with the powers of the amulet.
raw.es: En el palacio de cierto imperio, vivía una bruja seductora de nombre Milavis. El emperador temía que lo asesinaran o lo maldijeran, por lo que pensó en el Amuleto de Rouva y le pidió a la bruja que forjara algo incluso más fuerte. Prometió darle lo que ella quisiera. El emperador recibió el cristal que quería, que lo protegió de la ponzoña, la enfermedad y las maldiciones, pero la recompensa que pidió la bruja era la misma vida que el emperador quería proteger con los poderes del amuleto.
raw.id: Dalam istana kekaisaran tertentu, ada seorang penyihir memesona bernama Milavis. Takut pembunuhan dan kutukan, kaisar mencari Jimat Rouva dan memerintah si penyihir untuk membuat sesuatu yang lebih kuat, menjanjikan hadiah yang diidamkannya. Kaisar menerima kristal yang ia minta, melindunginya dari racun, penyakit, dan kutukan, tapi hadiah yang diminta si penyihir adalah nyawa yang ingin dilindungi kaisar dengan kekuatan jimat.
raw.pt: No palácio de um certo império, havia uma bruxa sedutora que se chamava Milavis. Temendo assassinatos e maldições, o imperador buscou o Amuleto de Rouva e ordenou à bruxa que forjasse algo ainda mais forte, prometendo a ela o que quisesse. O impeprador recebeu o cristal pelo qual pediu, que o protegeria de veneno, doença e maldições, mas a recompensa que a bruxa pediu foi a própria vida que ele quis proteger com o amuleto.
raw.th: ในปราสาทของจักรวรรดิหนึ่ง ยังมีแม่มดทรงเสน่ห์ที่ชื่อว่า มิลาวิส ด้วยความกลัวการถูกลอบสังหารและคำสาป จักรพรรดิ์ได้ค้นหาเครื่องรางแห่งโรวา และได้ออกคำสั่งให้แม่มดหลอมบางอย่างที่แข็งแกร่งยิ่งกว่านั้นด้วยการให้สัญญาว่าจะมอบรางวัลทุกอย่างที่เธอปรารถนา จักรพรรดิได้คริสตัลที่ต้องการจากแม่มดซึ่งสามารถปกป้องพระองค์ได้จากพิษ และ คำสาป แต่รางวัลที่แม่มดต้องการนั้นก็คือชีวิตของพระองค์ที่ต้องการจะใช้พลังของเครื่องนี้เพื่อปกป้อง
raw.vi: Dưới sự cai trị của một đế chế, có một mụ phụ thùy quyến rũ tên là Milavis sống trong một lâu đài nọ. Sợ hãi bị ám sát và nguyền rủa, vị hoàng đế đã cầu xin một Lá bùa của Rouva và đã đề nghị mụ phù thủy luyện ra một thứ gì đó mạnh hơn cả lá bùa đó và hứa hẹn sẽ trao thưởng cho mụ phù thủy như ước nguyện. Vị hoàng đế đã nhận được viên pha lê mà ông yêu cầu để bảo vệ ông khỏi độc dược, bệnh dịch và lời nguyền, tuy nhiên, phần thưởng mà mụ phù thủy cầu xin chính là mạng sống mà vị hoàng đế mong muốn được bảo vệ bằng sức mạnh của lá bùa đó.

id: Dulu ada raja negara kecil yang dikelilingi oleh negara musuh, mengkhawatirkan keselamatan rakyatnya. Eldione si penyihir menciptakan berbagai barang untuk membantu raja yang ia hormati dalam melindungi negara. Di antara mahakaryanya, kristal ini dianggap karya terbaik, mencegah penggunanya dari menjadi lemah, terluka, lumpuh. Namun tanpa pengelolaan bijak dari sang raja, negara akhirnya jatuh diserang, dan sang raja, ironisnya, adalah satu-satunya yang bertahan hidup berkat kekuatan kristal.
name: MST_SPHERES_38200_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There once was a king of a small country who, surrounded by rivaling countries, was worried about how he could keep his citizens safe. Eldione the wizard created a range of items to help the king he respected in protecting the country. Among his masterpieces, this crystal which prevents its user from becoming weak, getting injured, or being paralyzed, was considered to be his best piece of work. However, without the king's benevolent administration, the country eventually fell to attacks, and the king, ironically, was the only survivor thanks to its power.

raw.en: There once was a king of a small country who, surrounded by rivaling countries, was worried about how he could keep his citizens safe. Eldione the wizard created a range of items to help the king he respected in protecting the country. However, without the king's benevolent administration, the country eventually fell to attacks, and the king, ironically, was the only survivor thanks to its power.
raw.es: Una vez existió un rey de una pequeña nación que, rodeado por países rivales, estaba preocupado por mantener a sus ciudadanos a salvo. Eldione, el hechicero, creó una serie de objetos para ayudar al rey que él mismo respetaba a proteger la nación. Entre sus obras maestras, el cristal que evita que el usuario caiga presa de la flaqueza, las heridas y la parálisis está considerado como su mejor creación. Sin embargo, sin la administración benévola del rey, la nación finalmente sucumbió a los ataques, y el rey, irónicamente, fue el único sobreviviente gracias al poder del objeto.

raw.pt: Houve uma vez o rei de um pequeno país que, cercado por países rivais, estava preocupado em proteger seus cidadãos. Eldione, o mago, criou muitos itens para ajudar o rei que ele respeitava a proteger o país. Dentre suas obras-primas, este cristal que previne o usuário de enfraquecer, se machucar, ou ser paralisado, e foi consirado um de seus melhores trabalhos. Porém, sem a administração benevolente do rei, o país eventualmente caiu alvo de ataques e o rei ironicamente foi o único sobrevivente, graças a seu poder.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีราชาของประเทศเล็กๆ ผู้ที่ถูกโอบล้อมโดยประเทศศัตรู และพระราชาก็กังวลว่าท่านจะช่วยปกป้องชีวิตของประชาชนให้ปลอดภัยได้อย่างไรกัน พ่อมดเอลดิโอเน่ได้สร้างอุปกรณ์มากมายเพื่อช่วยพระราชาที่เขาเคารพนับถือในการปกป้องประเทศ หนึ่งในผลงานชั้นเลิศของเขา คือคริสตัลที่สามารถปกป้องผู้ใช้จากอาการ อ่อนแอ บาดเจ็บ หรือ อัมพาต มันถูกพิจารณาให้เป็นผลงานที่ดีที่สุดของเขา อย่างไรก็ตาม เมื่อขาดการบริหารประเทศที่เปี่ยมด้วยความเมตตาของพระราชา ในที่สุดประเทศก็ล่มสลายจากการถูกโจมตี และน่าขันที่ พระราชาเป็นเพียงคนเดียวที่รอดชีวิตเพราะพลังของ ของสิ่งนี้
raw.vi: Ngày xưa, có một vị vua trị vì một vương quốc nhỏ, bao quanh là các quốc gia thù địch. Vị vua rất lo lắng trong việc duy trì sự an toàn cho người dân của mình. Eldione là một thầy phù thủy đã tạo ra một loạt những thứ có thể giúp cho vị vua tôn kính của mình bảo vệ vương quốc. Một trong số những kiệt tác này là viên pha lê. Viên pha lê đã bảo vệ người nắm giữ nó tránh khỏi ốm yếu, bị tổn thương hay tê liệt và được xem là sản phẩm tốt nhất của thầy phù thủy đó. Tuy nhiên, khi thiếu sự cai trị nhân từ của nhà vua, cuối cùng đất nước đã rơi vào các cuộc tấn công, và trớ trêu thay, vị vua là người duy nhất sống sót nhờ vào sức mạnh của viên pha lê đó.

(Um treco do Capítulo 3, Seção 9 de “As Aventuras do Ladrão Cavalheiresco Zelnite!”)
raw.th:
เซลไนท์ แม้แต่ในช่วงวิกฤติความเป็นความตายของชีวิต เขาก็ไม่เคยยอมแพ้ แผนการณ์ที่แยบยลของเขาจุดประกายท้องฟ้ายามค่ำคืน และเรียกหาปาฏิหาริย์แห่งการฟื้นคืนชีวิต!

(ตัดตอนมาจาก บทที่ 3, ย่อหน้าที่ 9 ของ "การผจญภัยของ เซลไนท์ จอมโจรผู้กล้าหาญ!")
raw.vi:
Zelnite, ngay cả khi ở bên bờ vực của sự sống và cái chết, vẫn không bao giờ bỏ cuộc. Sự mưu trí tài tình của ông đã thắp sáng bầu trời đêm và khôi phục sự sống một cách thần kỳ!

(Trích dẫn từ Chương 3, Phần 9 của “Chuyến phiêu lưu của tên trộm Zelnite hào hiệp!”)

id: Pedang yang katanya hanya diberikan bagi yang dianggap layak oleh Raja Naga. Dengan bilah setajam taring Raja Naga sendiri, pedang ini dipercaya harus digunakan untuk tujuan menghapus apa yang telah merusak alam. Masih tidak jelas apakah pedang legenda ini pernah dilihat orang, atau apakah bagian dari tentara dewa, atau dimiliki pahlawan yang melawan para dewa saat perang.
name: MST_SPHERES_38400_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A sword that is said only to be given to those who are deemed worthy by the Dragon King. With a blade as sharp as the fang of the Dragon King himself, it is believed to be wielded with the goal of eradicating whatever damage has been done to nature. It is still unclear as to whether this sword of legend was really seen by anyone, whether it was part of the god army, or whether it was owned by a hero who defied the deities during the battle against the gods.

raw.es: Una espada que, aparentemente, solo reciben aquellos dignos del Rey dragón. Con una hoja tan filosa como el colmillo del mismísimo Rey dragón, se cree que esta espada se tiene que blandir con el objetivo de erradicar todo el daño hecho a la naturaleza. Todavía no se sabe si alguien llegó a ver esta espada legendaria, si fue parte del ejército de los dioses o si era el arma de un héroe que desafió a las deidades durante la gran batalla.

raw.pt: Uma espada que dizem ser dada somente aos que são julgados dignos pelo Dragão-Rei. Com uma lâmina tão afiada quanto suas presas, acredita-se que ela é empunhada com o intuito de erradicar qualquer dano causado à natureza. Ainda não se sabe se essa espada lendária foi realmente vista por alguém, se foi parte do exército dos deuses, ou se foi portada por um herói que os desafiou durante a grande guerra.
raw.th: ดาบที่ว่ากันว่าจะถูกมอบให้กับผู้ที่ถูกมองว่าคู่ควรโดยราชามังกรเท่านั้น ด้วยคมดาบที่คมเหมือนกับเขี้ยวของตัวราชา เชื่อกันว่ามันถูกใช้โดยมีเป้าหมายเพื่อลบล้างความเสียหายที่ถูกทำให้เกิดขึ้นกับธรรมชาติ มันยังไม่เป็นที่แน่ชัดว่าเคยมีผู้ใดได้เห็นดาบในตำนานเล่มนี้จริงๆ หรือไม่ ไม่ว่ามันจะเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของกองทัพของเทพเจ้า หรือว่ามันจะเป็นของผู้กล้าที่ต่อต้านเทพในช่วงการต่อสู้ต่อต้านเหล่าเทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Một thanh kiếm được cho là chỉ được trao cho những người xứng đáng bởi Long Vương. Với lưỡi kiếm sắc bén như nanh của Long Vương, nó được cho là được sử dụng với mục tiêu diệt trừ bất cứ thứ gì gây thiệt hại cho thiên nhiên. Vẫn chưa rõ liệu có ai thực sự thấy thanh kiếm huyền thoại này chưa, nó có phải thuộc vào quân đội của các vị thần không hay liệu nó có phải được sở hữu bởi một anh hùng đã thách đấu với các vị thần trong trận chiến chống lại các vị thần không.

id: Pedang ini katanya diberikan kepada manusia oleh Raja Naga Laut. Tak ada info tentang pemilik pedang, namun siapa yang memilikinya pasti punya keberanian yang sangat besar yang menjebak musuh dalam jaring ketakutan. Ada teori populer bahwa Raja Naga Laut mengambil sisik terbalik dari badannya sendiri untuk membuat bilah pedang ini, tapi karena naga laut tidak suka manusia, mereka bertanya mengapa raja mereka melakukan hal itu? Asal pedang ini masih dibahas sampai saat ini.
name: MST_SPHERES_38401_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This sword is said to have been granted to humans by the Sea Dragon King. There is no information concerning the owner of the sword, but only that whomever possessed it must have had an incredible amount of bravery that entrapped enemies in a net of fear. There is a popular theory that the Sea Dragon King peeled an inverted scale from its own body to create this blade, but since sea dragons are not fond of humans, it begs the question as to why their king would have done this. The origins of this blade are still being discussed today.

raw.es: Se dice que esta espada llegó a manos humanas por el Rey dragón de los mares. No hay información precisa sobre el dueño de la espada, pero quien la blandiera debería tener una increíble cantidad de valor, suficiente para dejar a los enemigos congelados de miedo. Una reconocida teoría asegura que el Rey dragón de los mares se quitó una escama invertida del cuerpo y creó la espada. Sin embargo, dado que a los dragones marinos no les agradan los humanos, todavía es un misterio por qué su rey llevaría a cabo un acto semejante. Hasta hoy en día se desconocen los orígenes de la espada.

raw.pt: Dizem que essa espada foi dada aos humanos pelo Rei dos Dragões do Mar. Não há informações sobre seu proprietário, somente que quem a empunhou deve ter sido dono de grande coragem, que paralisava os inimigos em uma rede de medo. Existe uma teoria popular de que o Rei dos Dragões do Mar puxou uma escama invertida de seu corpo para fazer a lâmina, mas já que os dragões do mar não gostam de humanos, não se sabe porque seu rei teria feito isso. As origens da lâmina são discutidas até hoje.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าดาบนี้ถูกมอบให้กับมนุษย์โดยราชามังกรทะเล ไม่มีข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับผู้ที่เป็นเจ้าของดาบนี้ รู้เพียงแต่ใครก็ตามที่ครอบครองมันจะต้องมีความกล้าหาญอย่างมาก จนสามารถดักจับศัตรูเอาไว้ด้วยความหวาดกลัว มีทฤษฎีที่โด่งดังว่าราชามังกรทะเลลอกเกล็ดชั้นในจากร่างกายของมันเพื่อสร้างดาบเล่มนี้ แต่ในเมื่อมังกรทะเลไม่ค่อยชื่นชอบมนุษย์สักเท่าไหร่ มันจึงอ้อนวอนถามว่าทำไมราชาของพวกมึงถึงได้ยอมทำแบบนี้ ที่มาของดาบเล่มนี้ยังคงเป็นที่ถกเถียงอยู่ในทุกวันนี้
raw.vi: Thanh kiếm này được cho là đã được Hải Long Vương ban cho con người. Không có thông tin nào về chủ sở hữu của thanh kiếm này, nhưng thông tin duy nhất là bất kỳ ai sở hữu nó phải có sự dũng cảm đáng kinh ngạc khiến kẻ thù rơi vào cạm bẫy đầy sợ hãi. Có một giả thuyết phổ biến rằng Hải Long Vương đã bóc chiếc vảy mọc ngược của mình khỏi chính cơ thể của mình để tạo lưỡi kiếm này, nhưng vì những con rồng biển không thích con người, nên người ta đặt ra câu hỏi là tại sao long vương lại làm việc này. Ngày nay, nguồn gốc của lưỡi kiếm này vẫn đang được thảo luận.

id: Malaikat dengan sayap di punggung dikenal sebagai pelayan setia para dewa. Kebanyakan dipercaya untuk menghukum pendosa. Untuk memuji yang telah memberikan pelayanan berjasa, mereka diberikan Pedang Malaikat hebat ini. Setiap Pedang Malaikat punya fitur khusus tersendiri, dan dinamai sesuai nama si Malaikat. Tidak disebutkan ada Malaikat bernama Zeliel, yakni nama pedang ini.
name: MST_SPHERES_38402_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The Angels with wings on their back are known as devoted servants of the gods. Most of them are entrusted with punishing sinners, but to praise those who have shown remarkable meritorious service, they present them with this great Angel Sword. Each Angel Sword has its own special features, and bear the names of the Angels themselves. However, there is no mention in any record of an Angel by the name of Zeliel, for which this particular sword was named.

raw.en: The Angels with wings on their back are known as devoted servants of the gods. Most of them are entrusted with punishing sinners, but to praise those who have shown remarkable meritorious service, they present them with this great Angel Sword. Each Angel Sword has its own special features, and bear the names of the Angels themselves. However, there is no mention in any record of an Angel by the name of Zeliel, for which this particular sword was named.
raw.es: A los ángeles con alas en la espalda se los conoce por ser devotos sirvientes de los dioses. La mayoría de ellos se encargan de castigar a los pecadores, pero algunos, luego de prestar un servicio notable y digno de alabanzas, reciben la gran Espada angelical. Cada una de estas espadas tiene características especiales y lleva el nombre de los ángeles que las empuñan. Sin embargo, en ningún informe se menciona a un ángel llamado Zeliel, que es el nombre que lleva esta espada en particular.
raw.id: Malaikat dengan sayap di punggung dikenal sebagai pelayan setia para dewa. Kebanyakan dipercaya untuk menghukum pendosa. Untuk memuji yang telah memberikan pelayanan berjasa, mereka diberikan Pedang Malaikat hebat ini. Setiap Pedang Malaikat punya fitur khusus tersendiri, dan dinamai sesuai nama si Malaikat. Tidak disebutkan ada Malaikat bernama Zeliel, yakni nama pedang ini.
raw.pt: Os anjos, com asas em suas costas, são conhecidos como servos devotos dos deuses. A maioria deles tem a incumbência de punir os pecadores, mas como recompensa aos que prestaram serviços notáveis, era presenteada essa grande Espada Angelical. Cada uma delas possui suas próprias características, portando o nome dos próprios anjos. Porém, não há menção a qualquer anjo chamado Zeliel, de quem essa espada em particular recebe o nome.
raw.th: ทูตสววรค์ที่มีปีกอยู่บนหลังเป็นที่รู้จักกันในฐานะทาสรับใช้ผู้ทุ่มเทของเทพเจ้า พวกนั้นส่วนใหญ่จะได้รับมอบหมายให้ทำโทษผู้ผิดบาป แต่จะชื่นชมผู้ที่สร้างความดีความชอบอย่างน่าทึ่ง พวกนั้นจะมอบดาบแองเจิลซอร์ดที่ยิ่งใหญ่นี้ให้พวกเขา ดาบแองเจิลซอร์ดแต่ละอันจะมีความสามารถพิเศษของตัวเอง และแบกรับชื่อของตัวทูตสวรรค์เองด้วย อย่างไรก็ตาม ไม่มีการกล่าวถึงในบันทึกใดๆ เกี่ยวกับทูตสวรรค์ที่ชื่อ เซลิเอล  ซึ่งเป็นชื่อของดาบเล่มนี้ด้วย
raw.vi: Những Thiên thần có đôi cánh trên lưng được gọi là những bầy tôi hết lòng trung thành của các vị thần. Hầu hết họ được giao nhiệm vụ trừng phạt những kẻ tội lỗi, nhưng để ca ngợi những người thể hiện sự phục vụ xuất sắc đáng khen thưởng, các thiên thần trao tặng cho họ Thanh kiếm thiên thần vĩ đại này. Mỗi Thanh kiếm thiên thần có các tính năng đặc biệt của riêng chúng và mang tên của chính các Thiên thần. Tuy nhiên, không có ghi chép nào nói về Thiên thần có tên là Zeliel, mà thanh kiếm cụ thể này được đặt tên.

id: Ada catatan tentang perang dewa melawan dewa. Saat dewa berpangkat lebih tinggi menantang dewa lain, pedang ini dibuat untuk menyegel kekuatannya. Ada catatan bahwa di beberapa perang antardewa yang tidak memakai pedang ini, "Pedang Penyegel Dewa" bisa diperoleh manusia, yang lalu memanfaatkannya.
name: MST_SPHERES_38403_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Within the large recorded history left behind, there is a record which states that the gods fought amongst themselves. When a higher ranking god sought to challenge the other gods, this sword was forged to seal his power. There are accounts left behind which state that there were battles in which this sword was not used, but unbeknownst to them, the "God Sealing Sword" found its way into human hands, who then carried out its true purpose.

raw.en: Within the large recorded history left behind, there is a record which states that the gods fought amongst themselves. There are accounts left behind which state that there were battles in which this sword was not used, but unbeknownst to them, the "God Sealing Sword" found its way into human hands, who then carried out its true purpose.
raw.es: Dentro de los registros históricos del pasado se menciona que los dioses pelearon entre sí. Cuando un dios de alto rango buscaba desafiar a los otros dioses, se forjaba esta espada para sellar su poder. Algunos informes aseguran que esta espada no se usó en ciertas batallas. Sin embargo, sin que los dioses los supieran, la "Espada selladora de dioses" cayó en manos de los humanos, quienes se encargaron de darle el uso adecuado.
raw.id: Ada catatan tentang perang dewa melawan dewa. Saat dewa berpangkat lebih tinggi menantang dewa lain, pedang ini dibuat untuk menyegel kekuatannya. Ada catatan bahwa di beberapa perang antardewa yang tidak memakai pedang ini, "Pedang Penyegel Dewa" bisa diperoleh manusia, yang lalu memanfaatkannya.
raw.pt: Em meio aos extensos registros da história, um deles conta que os deuses lutaram entre si. Quando um deus de categoria superior tentou desafiar os outros deuses, esta espada foi forjada para selar seu poder. Há relatos de batalhas nas quais esta espada não foi usada, mas sem o conhecimento deles, a “espada de selar deuses” parou nas mãos de humanos, que executaram sua prerrogativa oficial.
raw.th: ในบันทึกประวัติศาสตร์มากมายที่ถูกทิ้งไว้ มีการบันทึกที่ได้กล่าวไว้ว่าเทพเจ้าได้ต่อสู้กันเองด้วย เมื่อเทพเจ้าระดับสูงจ้องจะท้าทายจากเทพเจ้าองค์อื่นๆ ดาบเล่มนี้จึงได้ถูกหลอมมาเพื่อผนึกพลังของเขาไว้  ซึ่งบันทึกไว้ว่ามีการต่อสู้ที่ดาบนี้ไม่ได้ถูกนำมาใช้ แต่เป็นที่รู้จักกันว่ามีอยู่จริง "ดาบผนึกเทพเจ้า" ได้หาทางจนไปถึงมือของมนุษย์ ผู้ที่นำมันมาใช้เพื่อเจตจำนงค์ที่แท้จริงของมัน
raw.vi: Với lịch sử được ghi chép rất nhiều còn để lại, có ghi chép nói rằng bản thân các vị thần đã đánh lẫn nhau. Khi một vị thần có thứ hạng cao hơn tìm cách thách đấu với những vị thần khác, thanh kiếm này đã được rèn để phong ấn sức mạnh của vị thần này. Có những báo cáo còn lại nói rằng đã có những trận chiến mà thanh kiếm này không được sử dụng, nhưng họ không biết, "Thanh kiếm phong ấn thần" đã rơi vào tay của con người, người sau này đã thực hiện mục đích thực sự của thanh kiếm.

id: Yang diharapkan dari senjata adalah kekuatan untuk mengalahkan musuh, Namun meski kekuatan senjata berapi mungkin sangat menguntungkan di medan perang, perlu lebih dari sekadar pedang hebat untuk mengalahkan musuh yang sekuat dewa. Pandai besi yang menempa pedang yang dibuat untuk membunuh dewa ini tahu bahwa dia bisa terbunuh. Prajurit yang membawa pedang ini ke medan perang benar-benar siap mati di tangan Pasukan Dewa.
name: MST_SPHERES_38404_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: What is expected of a weapon is the power to destroy enemies. However, though the power of fire may be a great advantage on the battlefield, it takes more than a great sword to defeat an opponent as strong as a god. The smith who forged this sword created it to slay the gods, though he knew he could be killed by them himself. Any soldier who wielded this sword went off to battle ready to die at the hands of the God Army.

raw.en: What is expected of a weapon is the power to destroy enemies. However, though the power of fire may be a great advantage on the battlefield, it takes more than a great sword to defeat an opponent as strong as a god. The smith who forged this sword created it to slay the gods, though he knew he could be killed by them himself. Any soldier who wielded this sword went off to battle ready to die at the hands of the God Army.
raw.es: Se espera que un arma tenga el poder de destruir a los enemigos. Sin embargo, si bien el poder del fuego es una gran ventaja en el campo de batalla, se necesita más que una gran espada para derrotar a un adversario tan fuerte como un dios. El herrero que forjó esta espada la creó para asesinar a los dioses, si bien sabía que las deidades eran capaces de matarlo a él. Todos los soldados que blandieron esta espada partieron a la batalla listos para morir a manos del ejército de los dioses.
raw.id: Yang diharapkan dari senjata adalah kekuatan untuk mengalahkan musuh, Namun meski kekuatan senjata berapi mungkin sangat menguntungkan di medan perang, perlu lebih dari sekadar pedang hebat untuk mengalahkan musuh yang sekuat dewa. Pandai besi yang menempa pedang yang dibuat untuk membunuh dewa ini tahu bahwa dia bisa terbunuh. Prajurit yang membawa pedang ini ke medan perang benar-benar siap mati di tangan Pasukan Dewa.
raw.pt: O que se espera de uma arma é o poder de destruir o inimigo. Embora o poder do fogo seja uma vantagem em batalha, é preciso mais que uma espada para derrotar um oponente com poderes fortes como de um deus. O ferreiro que forjou esta espada a criou para acabar com deuses, mesmo sabendo que ele poderia ser morto por eles. Todos que empunharam esta espada, foram para batalha prontos para morrer pela mão do exército dos deuses.
raw.th: คนมักคาดหวังว่าอาวุธของตนจะมีพลังในการกำจัดศัตรู อย่างไรก็ตาม แม้พลังแห่งไฟจะค่อนข้างได้เปรียบในสนามรบ แต่มันก็มีพลังเกินกว่าดาบอันทรงพลังที่ใช้กำจัดศัตรูที่แข็งแกร่งทัดเทียมเทพเสียอีก ช่างตีเหล็กหลอมดาบนี้ขึ้นมาเพื่อใช้สังหารเทพเพราะเขารู้ว่าตนต้องถูกเทพกำจัดแน่ๆ ว่ากันว่านักรบที่ถือดาบนี้เข้าสู่สนามรบนั้นพร้อมใจจะสละชีพภายใต้เงื้อมมือของทหารเทพ
raw.vi: Thứ được mong đợi ở một vũ khí chính là khả năng tiêu diệt kẻ thù. Tuy nhiên, mặc dù sức mạnh của lửa có thể là một lợi thế tuyệt vời trên chiến trường, nhưng nó còn hơn cả một thanh kiếm tuyệt vời để đánh bại một đối thủ mạnh như một vị thần. Người thợ rèn đã rèn thanh kiếm này tạo ra nó để giết các vị thần, mặc dù ông biết bản thân ông cũng có thể bị họ giết. Bất kỳ chiến binh nào sử dụng thanh kiếm này đều ra đi chiến đấu với tinh thần sẵn sàng chết dưới tay của Quân Đội Các Vị Thần.

id: Tameng yang terlahir dari Pohon Dunia, dan saking tuanya, tidak tahu kapan persisnya. Sekilas, terlihat terbuat dari kayu, tapi awetnya melebihi baja dan berlian hitam, bahkan melebihi sisik naga. Diberikan kepada pahlawan sebelum Perang Dewa, tapi tidak ada catatan tentang adanya pahlawan yang memakai tameng ini, meski semestinya ia mewariskan tameng ke keturunannya.
name: MST_SPHERES_38500_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A shield born from the World Tree such a long time ago that it is hard to tell exactly when. At first glance it seems to be a shield made of wood, but its durability surpasses that of steel and black diamond, and it is even said to be better than the scales of a dragon. It is said to have been given to a hero before the Battle of the Gods, but there are no records of the hero using such a shield, though it is supposed that he passed it on to his descendants.

raw.en: A shield born from the World Tree such a long time ago that it is hard to tell exactly when. At first glance it seems to be a shield made of wood, but its durability surpasses that of steel and black diamond, and it is even said to be better than the scales of a dragon. It is said to have been given to a hero before the Battle of the Gods, but there are no records of the hero using such a shield, though it is supposed that he passed it on to his descendants.
raw.es: Un escudo nacido del Sumo árbol hace tanto tiempo que no se sabe a ciencia cierta el momento exacto. A primera vista parece un escudo de madera ordinario, pero su durabilidad supera a la del acero y el diamante negro. Incluso se dice que es más resistente que las escamas de un dragón. Aparentemente cayó en manos de un héroe antes de la batalla contra los dioses, pero no hay registros que aseguren que este héroe usó el escudo, si bien se supone que se lo legó a sus descendientes.
raw.id: Tameng yang terlahir dari Pohon Dunia, dan saking tuanya, tidak tahu kapan persisnya. Sekilas, terlihat terbuat dari kayu, tapi awetnya melebihi baja dan berlian hitam, bahkan melebihi sisik naga. Diberikan kepada pahlawan sebelum Perang Dewa, tapi tidak ada catatan tentang adanya pahlawan yang memakai tameng ini, meski semestinya ia mewariskan tameng ke keturunannya.
raw.pt: Um escudo nascido da Árvore do Mundo há tanto tempo que é difícil dizer quando. À primeira vista parece um escudo de madeira, mas sua durabilidade é muito maior do que a do aço ou até diamantes negros, alguns dizendo que é até melhor do que as escamas de um dragão. Dizem que foi dado a um herói antes da batalha contra os deuses, mas não há registros do herói ter usado tal escudo, embora supõe-se que ele o passou a seus descendentes.
raw.th: โล่ห์ที่เกิดจากต้นไม้โลกเมื่อนานมาแล้วซึ่งไม่สามารถบอกได้อย่างแม่นยำว่าเมื่อไหร่ เมื่อมองดูครั้งแรกมันจะดูเหมือนโล่ห์ที่ทำจากไม้ แต่ความทนทานของมันอยู่เหนือยิ่งกว่าพวกที่ทำจากเหล็กหรือเพชรดำ และกล่าวกันว่ามันดียิ่งกว่าเกล็ดของมังกร  ว่ากันว่ามันถูกมอบให้กับผู้กล้าก่อนการต่อสู้กับเทพเจ้า แต่ไม่มีบันทึกของผู้กล้าที่ใช้โล่ห์ดังกล่าว ถึงอย่างนั้นก็เชื่อกันว่าเขาได้มอบมันให้กับลูกหลานของเขา
raw.vi: Một tấm khiên được sinh ra từ Cây thế giới từ cách đây lâu đến mức khó có thể nói chính xác là khi nào. Thoạt nhìn, nó có vẻ như một tấm khiên được làm bằng gỗ, nhưng độ bền của nó vượt qua cả thép và kim cương đen, và nó thậm chí được cho rằng còn tốt hơn cả vảy rồng. Nó được cho là đã được trao cho một anh hùng trước Trận chiến của các Vị thần, nhưng không có ghi chép nào về anh hùng sử dụng một tấm khiên như vậy, mặc dù người ta cho rằng ông đã truyền nó cho con cháu của mình.

id: Di bawah kegelapan bawah tambang permata, ada langit malam penuh bintang. Tentu saja bukan bintang asli di langit. Bijih intan memantulkan cahaya dari tempat lain, dan bersinar. Cahaya misterius datang dari tameng tunggal. Di bawahnya terbaring tulang manusia, berdampingan dengan batu yang diukir dengan alat tambang yang kini pecah. Batu itu ditulisi "Jarva", pembuat zirah terkenal legendaris.
name: MST_SPHERES_38501_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Underneath the underground darkness in the depths of a jewel mine lies a night sky full of stars. Of course, these are not real stars that float in the sky. The ores of these gems reflect the light from something else, making them shine. This mysterious light came from a single shield. Laying down by it were the withering bones of a human next to a rock that had been carved with mining tools that were now broken. The stone read "Jarva," a very well known armor maker of legend.

raw.en: Underneath the underground darkness in the depths of a jewel mine lies a night sky full of stars. Of course, these are not real stars that float in the sky. The ores of these gems reflect the light from something else, making them shine. This mysterious light came from a single shield. Laying down by it were the withering bones of a human next to a rock that had been carved with mining tools that were now broken. The stone read "Jarva," a very well known armor maker of legend.
raw.es: Bajo la oscuridad, en las profundidades de una mina de joyas, yace un cielo nocturno bañado de estrellas. Es claro que no son estrellas reales que flotan en el cielo. Las menas de estas joyas brillan y reflejan la luz que tienen a su alrededor. Esta luz misteriosa provenía de un único escudo. Debajo de él, yacían los huesos marchitados de un ser humano junto a una roca en la que se había escrito un mensaje con herramientas de minería. La piedra decía "Jarva", el nombre de un armero mítico.
raw.id: Di bawah kegelapan bawah tambang permata, ada langit malam penuh bintang. Tentu saja bukan bintang asli di langit. Bijih intan memantulkan cahaya dari tempat lain, dan bersinar. Cahaya misterius datang dari tameng tunggal. Di bawahnya terbaring tulang manusia, berdampingan dengan batu yang diukir dengan alat tambang yang kini pecah. Batu itu ditulisi "Jarva", pembuat zirah terkenal legendaris.
raw.pt: Por baixo da escuridão no subterrâneo, nas profundezas de uma mina, há uma noite de céu estrelado. É claro que não são estrelas de verdade flutuando nesse “céu”. As pedras preciosas refletiam a luz de outra coisa, fazendo-as brilhar. Essa luz misteriosa vinha de um escudo. Deitados próximo a ele estavam os restos de um humano, ao lado de uma pedra entalhada com ferramentas de mineração agora quebradas. A pedra dizia “Jarva”, um conhecido e lendário fabricante de armaduras.
raw.th: ภายใต้ความมืดมิดใต้ดินในส่วนลึกของเหมืองอัญมณีที่อยู่ภายใต้ท้องฟ้าในยามค่ำคืนซึ่งเต็มไปด้วยดวงดาวมากมาย แน่นอนว่า พวกนั้นไม่ใช่ดวงดาวที่ลอยอยู่บนท้องฟ้าจริงๆ สินแร่ของอัญมณีพวกนี้สะท้อนแสงจากสิ่งอื่นบางอย่างที่ทำให้พวกมันส่องประกาย แสงลึกลับนี้มาจากโล่ห์อันหนึ่ง และที่นอนอยู่ข้างๆ มันก็คือโครงกระดูกผุพังของมนุษย์ที่อยู่ข้างข้างๆ ก้อนหินซึ่งถูกแกะสลักไว้ด้วยเครื่องมือเหมืองที่พังไปแล้วในตอนนี้  หินนั่นอานได้ว่า "จาร์วา" นักสร้างชุดเกราะที่โด่งดังในตำนาน
raw.vi: Dưới mặt đất, bóng tối ở độ sâu của một mỏ đá quý làm người ta nhầm tưởng là một bầu trời đêm đầy sao. Tất nhiên, không có ngôi sao thực sự nào lơ lửng trên bầu trời.  Quặng của những viên ngọc này phản chiếu ánh áng từ cái gì đó khác, khiến chúng tỏa sáng. Ánh sáng bí ẩn này đến từ một tấm khiên. Nằm cạnh nó là những chiếc xương khô của một con người bên cạnh tảng đá được khắc bằng công cụ đào mỏ đã bị vỡ. Hòn đá viết "Jarva", tên người làm giáp huyền thoại rất nổi tiếng.

id: Katanya tameng ini aslinya bukan untuk berperang, tapi untuk para dewa menunjukkan struktur dunia kepada manusia. Bumi, surga, laut, bulan semua ditulis dengan nama dewa yang memerintah. Beberapa sarjana percaya bahwa para dewa punya cetak biru utama saat menciptakan alam semesta, tapi itu tidak ada di mitologi. Ada cerita bahwa tameng ini dipakai untuk perang melawan para dewa, namun klaim ini sering ditolak.
name: MST_SPHERES_38502_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: It is said that this shield was not originally made for war, but for the gods to show humans the structure of the world. The earth, the heavens, the seas, and the moon were all written down along with the names of the gods that rule them. There are some scholars that believe the gods had a master blueprint when they created the universe, but no such thing is found in mythology. Though there are stories that state that this shield was used in the war with the gods, this claim is widely refuted.

raw.en: It is said that this shield was not originally made for war, but for the gods to show humans the structure of the world. The earth, the heavens, the seas, and the moon were all written down along with the names of the gods that rule them. There are some scholars that believe the gods had a master blueprint when they created the universe, but no such thing is found in mythology. Though there are stories that state that this shield was used in the war with the gods, this claim is widely refuted.
raw.es: Se dice que este escudo no fue creado para la guerra, sino para que los dioses les mostraran a los humanos la estructura del mundo. La tierra, los cielos, los mares y la luna estaban escritos junto con los nombres de los dioses que los gobernaban. Algunos eruditos creen que los dioses tenían un diseño maestro cuando crearon el universo, si bien nada de eso se ha encontrado en la mitología. Si bien hay historias que aseguran que este escudo se usó durante la guerra contra los dioses, los eruditos refutan esa teoría con mucho ahínco.
raw.id: Katanya tameng ini aslinya bukan untuk berperang, tapi untuk para dewa menunjukkan struktur dunia kepada manusia. Bumi, surga, laut, bulan semua ditulis dengan nama dewa yang memerintah. Beberapa sarjana percaya bahwa para dewa punya cetak biru utama saat menciptakan alam semesta, tapi itu tidak ada di mitologi. Ada cerita bahwa tameng ini dipakai untuk perang melawan para dewa, namun klaim ini sering ditolak.
raw.pt: Dizem que este escudo não foi feito para a guerra, mas sim para os deuses mostrarem aos humanos a estrutura do mundo. A terra, os céus, o mar e a lua foram todos inscritos junto aos nomes dos deuses que os governavam. Há alguns estudiosos que acreditam que os deuses teriam um projeto, uma “planta-baixa” do universo, mas nada parecido foi encontrado na mitologia. Apesar das histórias de que esse escudo foi usado na guerra contra os deuses, não se leva muito a sério essa teoria.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าโล่ห์นี้ไม่ได้ถูกสร้างมาเพื่อสงคราม แต่สำหรับเทพเจ้าเอาไว้เพื่อใช้แสดงโครงสร้างของโลกให้มนุษย์ดู โลก สวรรค์ ทะเล และดวงจันทร์ทั้งหมดถูกเขียนเอาไว้พร้อมกับชื่อของเทพเจ้าที่ปกครองพวกนั้น ยังมีปราชญ์บางส่วนที่เชื่อว่าเทพเจ้ามีพิมพ์เขียวหลักสำหรับสร้างจักรวาล แต่ไม่มีการพบขิงดังกล่าวในตำนานเทพ แม้ว่าจะมีเรื่องเล่าที่กล่าวถึงว่าโล่ห์นี้ถูกนำไปใช้ในสงครามกับเทพเจ้า แต่คำกล่าวนี้กลับไม่เป็นที่ยอมรับโดยทั่วไป
raw.vi: Người ta nói rằng tấm khiên này ban đầu không phải được chế tạo để phục vụ chiến tranh, mà để các vị thần cho con người thấy cấu trúc của thế giới. Trái đất, thiên đường, biển cả và mặt trăng tất cả đều được viết ra cùng với tên của các vị thần cai quản chúng. Có một số học giả tin rằng các vị thần đã có một bản thiết kế tổng thể khi họ tạo ra vũ trụ, nhưng không có thứ gì như vậy được tìm thấy trong truyền thuyết. Mặc dù có những câu chuyện nói rằng tấm khiên này đã được sử dụng trong chiến tranh với các vị thần, tuyên bố này đã bị nhiều người bác bỏ.

id: Tameng yang dibuat setan yang bersiap melawan manusia. Hanya sebesar kepalan tangan, tapi akumulasi sihir dan racun rawa di sekitarnya membentuk dinding pelindung. Mengandung lebih banyak sihir daripada yang biasanya disaksikan manusia, tameng ini melindungi setan dari segalanya saat perang. Namun karena setan ini bertarung di garis depan, tamengnya akhirnya diambil pahlawan dan dimiliki manusia.
name: MST_SPHERES_38503_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A shield made by a demon who was preparing to fight against the humans. It is only as big as a fist, but it accumulates all of the magic and miasma floating around it to construct to a protective wall. Condensing more magic than what the usual human gets to witness, it protected the demon from everything in battle. However, since this demon always fought in the front lines, his shield was eventually taken away by a hero, and thus made its way into human hands.

raw.en: A shield made by a demon who was preparing to fight against the humans. It is only as big as a fist, but it accumulates all of the magic and miasma floating around it to construct to a protective wall. Condensing more magic than what the usual human gets to witness, it protected the demon from everything in battle. However, since this demon always fought in the front lines, his shield was eventually taken away by a hero, and thus made its way into human hands.
raw.es: Un escudo hecho por un demonio que se preparaba para luchar contra los humanos. Es tan grande como un puño, pero acumula toda la magia y el miasma que flota a su alrededor para construir un muro defensivo. Este escudo, con una cantidad de magia condensada mayor que la que el humano promedio puede llegar a ver en su vida, protegió al demonio de todos los males en cientos de batallas. Sin embargo, ya que el demonio siempre luchaba en frente de la tropa, un héroe finalmente le arrebató el escudo, que terminó en manos humanas.
raw.id: Tameng yang dibuat setan yang bersiap melawan manusia. Hanya sebesar kepalan tangan, tapi akumulasi sihir dan racun rawa di sekitarnya membentuk dinding pelindung. Mengandung lebih banyak sihir daripada yang biasanya disaksikan manusia, tameng ini melindungi setan dari segalanya saat perang. Namun karena setan ini bertarung di garis depan, tamengnya akhirnya diambil pahlawan dan dimiliki manusia.
raw.pt: Um escudo feito por um demônio que estava se preparando para enfrentar os humanos. É do tamanho de um punho, mas acumular toda a magia e miasma a seu redor para construir uma muralha de proteção. Condensando mais magia do que os humanos costumam ter contato, ele protegia o demônio de tudo em batalha. Porém, como o demônio sempre estava na linha de frente, o escudo eventualmente foi tomado por um herói, caindo em mãos humanas.
raw.th: โล่ห์ที่ถูกสร้างโดยปีศาจผู้ที่เตรียมการจะต่อสู้กับพวกมนุษย์ มันมีขนาดใหญ่ขนาดเท่ากับกำปั้น แต่มันสะสมพลังเวทย์และไอที่ลอยอยู่รอบๆมันเพื่อสร้างกำแพงป้องกัน มันป้องกันเจ้าปีศาจจากทุกๆ อย่างในการต่อสู้ด้วยการกลั่นพลังเวทย์ปริมาณมากกว่าที่มนุษย์ทั่วไปจะเคยพบเห็น อย่างไรก็ตาม เมื่อเจ้าปีศาจนี้มักจะต่อสู้อยู่ในเนวหน้า โล่ห์ของมันก็ถูกชิงไปโดยผู้กล้า และมันก็ตกไปอยู่ในมือของมนุษย์ในที่สุด
raw.vi: Một tấm khiên đã được làm bởi một con quỷ đã chuẩn bị để chiến đấu chống lại loài người.  Nó chỉ to bằng nắm tay, nhưng nó tích lũy tất cả phép thuật và chướng khí lư lửng quanh nó để xây dựng thành một bức tường bảo vệ. Cô đặc nhiều phép thuật hơn những gì con người bình thường đã được chứng kiến, nó đã bảo vệ con quỷ này khỏi tất cả mọi thứ trong trận chiến. Tuy nhiên, do con quỷ này luôn chiến đấu ở tuyến đầu, tấm khiên của nó cuối cùng đã bị một anh hùng lấy đi và do đó, nó đã rơi vào tay của con người.

id: Tadinya ada Pemanggil yang ditakuti. Sebagai jenderal, ia memimpin garis depan. Ia punya tameng berkilau yang berat, penuh luka perang, yang dipakainya untuk mengambil kendali di medan perang. Meski banyak yang bilang gaya bertarungnya itu sembrono, mungkin lebih tepatnya dia sangat percaya diri akan keahlian pertahanannya. Tameng ini diuji berkali-kali dalam pertempuran dan selalu efisien.
name: MST_SPHERES_38504_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There was once a feared Summoner who as a general took command of the front lines. He possessed a heavy, shiny shield that bore many scars of battle, which he used to take control over the battlefield. Though some may call his fighting style reckless, it is perhaps more correct to assume he was very confident in his guarding abilities. This shield that was tested time and again in combat still remains as efficient as ever.

raw.en: There was once a feared Summoner who as a general took command of the front lines. This shield that was tested time and again in combat still remains as efficient as ever.
raw.es: Había una vez un temido invocador que, como general, tomó el mando de las líneas del frente de batalla. Tenía un escudo pesado y brillante, adornado por varias cicatrices de guerra, el cual usó para tomar control del campo de batalla. Si bien algunos podrían decir que su estilo de lucha era muy arriesgado, quizá lo correcto sea asumir que el hombre confiaba mucho en sus habilidades defensivas. Este escudo, que se probó una y otra vez en el campo de batalla, todavía sigue siendo tan eficiente como antes.

Embora muitos achassem seu estilo de luta imprudente, talvez seja certo supor que ele tinha muita confiança suas habilidades. Este escudo foi testado muitas vezes em batalha, e ainda continua eficiente.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีซัมมอนเนอร์ผู้เป็นที่หวาดกลัวของผู้คน คอยสั่งการในแนวรบแถวหน้า เขาถือโล่หนักที่ส่องประกายซึ่งช่วยให้เขาคุมเกมได้ แต่หลายคนกล่าวว่ารูปแบบการรบของเขานั้นค่อนข้างสะเพร่า แต่ก็อาจเป็นเพราะเขามีความมั่นใจในทักษะการป้องกันของตัวเอง และแม้โล่นี้จะถูกนำมาใช้อีกครั้ง แต่ก็ยังคงไว้ซึ่งประสิทธิภาพเช่นเดิม
raw.vi: Từng có một Người triệu hồi đáng sợ là tướng chỉ huy ở tuyến đầu. Ông sở hữu một chiếc khiên nặng, sáng bóng mang nhiều vết sẹo của cuộc chiến, ông sử dụng chiếc khiên này để kiểm soát chiến trường. Mặc dù một số người có thể gọi phong cách chiến đấu của ông là liều lĩnh, nhưng có lẽ chính xác hơn phải nói rằng ông rất tự tin vào khả năng phòng thủ của mình. Chiếc khiên này đã được thử nghiệm nhiều lần trong chiến đấu và vẫn duy trì được hiệu quả như ngày nào.

id:
Aku bertanya kepadamu.
"Mengapa hidup bukan mati, dan kematian tidak bisa membawa kehidupan?"
Aku menantangmu.
"Mengapa mati dan hidup itu berlawanan, dan ada bersamaan?"
name: MST_SPHERES_38600_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc:
I ask you.
"Why is it that life is not death, and death cannot bring life?"
I challenge you.
"Why is it that death and life are opposites, and yet they exist together?"

raw.en:

I challenge you.
"Why is it that death and life are opposites, and yet they exist together?"
raw.es:
Te pregunto.
"¿Por qué la vida no es muerte, y la muerte no puede dar vida?".
Te desafío.
"¿Por qué la vida y la muerte son opuestas, pero existen juntas?".

raw.th:
ข้าถามเจ้า
"ทำไมชีวิตถึงไม่ใช่ความตาย และความตายไม่สามารถสร้างชีวิตได้?"
ข้าขอท้าทายเจ้า
"ทำไมความตายและชีวิตถึงได้อยู่ตรงข้ามกัน แต่กระนั้นก็คงอยู่ด้วยกัน?"
raw.vi:
Ta hỏi ngươi.
"Tại sao sự sống không phải là cái chết và cái chết không thể mang lại sự sống?"
Ta đố ngươi.
"Tại sao cái chết và sự sống lại trái ngược nhau và chúng lại cùng tồn tại?"

id:
Aku bertanya kepadamu.
"Mengapa gairah tidak dapat dipuaskan dan harapan tidak dapat dipadamkan?"

ข้าถามเจ้า
"ทำไมความปรารถนาถึงไม่สามารถอิ่มเอม และความหวังถึงไม่ดับมอด?"

"Tại sao tuyệt vọng không bao giờ kết thúc và ác tâm không bao giờ cạn kiệt?"

id: Seorang ahli alkimia menciptakan alat setan yang berkekuatan membangkitkan potensi terpendam seseorang. Setelah serangkaian peristiwa, alat itu jatuh ke tangan dewa yang terkejut saat melihat seberapa jauh perkembangan keterampilan tukang manusia. Alat setan akhirnya dikembalikan ke ahli alkimia, dalam versi yang sudah diperbarui oleh si dewa. Tidak ada yang tahu apakah ini untuk memacu manusia agar lebih berprestasi atau sebagai peringatan dari para dewa.
name: MST_SPHERES_38700_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An alchemist once created a demon tool which had the power to awaken a person's dormant potential. After a strange series of events, it found its way into a god's hands, who became surprised when he saw how much human crafting skills had progressed. The demon tool was eventually returned to the alchemist, but it was not the original demon tool any longer, but a divine tool upgraded by the god. No one knows if this was meant to serve as encouragement for humans to aim higher, or if it was a warning from the gods.

raw.en: An alchemist once created a demon tool which had the power to awaken a person's dormant potential. raw.es: Una vez, un alquimista creó un dispositivo demoníaco que tenía el poder de despertar el potencial aletargado de una persona. Luego de una extraña serie de eventos, este artefacto cayó en las manos de un dios, que se sorprendió al ver lo mucho que había avanzado la habilidad de los humanos como artesanos. Eventualmente, el dispositivo demoníaco volvió a las manos del alquimista, pero ya no era el mismo artefacto, sino que había sido mejorado con los dotes divinos del dios. Nadie supo si el dios buscaba que los humanos intentaran alcanzar su máximo potencial o si los estaba amenazando.

raw.pt: Um alquimista uma vez criou uma ferramenta demoníaca com o poder de despertar o potencial dormente em uma pessoa. Após uma série de eventos estranhos, ela caiu nas mãos de um deus, que se surpreendeu quando viu o quanto a perícia humana havia progredido. A ferramenta demoníaca eventualmente foi devolvida ao criador, mas não era mais uma ferramenta demoníaca, mas sim divina, aprimorada pelo deus. Ninguém sabe se deveria servir como encorajamento para que os humanos mirassem mais alto, ou se era um aviso dos deuses.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งนักเล่นแร่แปรธาตุได้สร้างเครื่องมือปีศาจที่มีพลังในการปลุกศักยภาพซึ่งซ่อนเร้นอยู่ในตัวคน หลังจากผ่านเรื่องราวมากมาย มันก็ตกไปอยู่ในมือของเทพเจ้าผู้ซึ่งประหลาดใจว่าการประดิษฐ์ของมนุษย์ล้ำหน้าขนาดไหน ท้ายที่สุดเจ้าอุปกรณ์ปีศาจก็กลับไปอยู่กับนักเล่นแร่แปรธาตุ แต่ว่ามันไม่ใช่เครื่องมือปีศาจในแบบดั้งเดิมอีกต่อไป แต่เป็นเครื่องมือเทพที่ถูกพัฒนาโดยเทพเจ้า ไม่มีใครรู้ว่าสิ่งนี้เพื่อสร้างแรงผลักดันให้มนุษย์ตั้งเป้าสูงขึ้น หรือว่าจะเป็นคำเตือนขอเทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Một nhà giả kim đã từng tạo ra một công cụ ma quỷ có sức mạnh đánh thức tiềm năng vẫn ngủ im của con người. Sau một loạt những sự kiện kỳ lạ, nó đã rơi vào tay của một vị thần, thần ngạc nhiên khi chứng kiến kỹ năng chế tạo của con người đã tiến triển đến nhường ấy. Công cụ ma quỷ cuối cùng đã được trả lại cho nhà giả kim, nhưng nó không còn là công cụ ma quỷ ban đầu nữa, mà là một công cụ thần thánh đã được vị thần này nâng cấp. Không ai biết liệu đây có phải là dùng để khuyến khích những con người nhắm đến mục tiêu cao hơn hay liệu nó là một lời cảnh báo từ các vị thần.

id: Pada zaman mitos, ada manusia yang sangat berdosa sehingga tidak bisa diampuni. Ia menunggu hukuman, dan diberikan belati oleh para dewa. Tahu bahwa ia dihukum mati, pria itu menerima belati dengan berani dan menusukkan ke tubuhnya. Tapi ia tidak mati, dan hidup sampai 40 tahun kemudian. Selama itu, ia terus menderita berbagai penyakit, termasuk racun dan penyakit yang tak dapat disembuhkan, juga berbagai kutukan.
name: MST_SPHERES_38800_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: During mythological times there was once a man that committed a sin so great, that he could never be forgiven. The man awaiting punishment was presented with a dagger by the gods. Knowing he had been sentenced to death, the man accepted the dagger bravely, and pierced it through his body. However, the man did not die, and lived for 40 years after the fact. It is said that throughout this time he continued to suffer all kinds of illnesses, including poison and other incurable diseases, as well as the hardship of various curses.

raw.en: During mythological times there was once a man that committed a sin so great, that he could never be forgiven. The man awaiting punishment was presented with a dagger by the gods. Knowing he had been sentenced to death, the man accepted the dagger bravely, and pierced it through his body. However, the man did not die, and lived for 40 years after the fact. It is said that throughout this time he continued to suffer all kinds of illnesses, including poison and other incurable diseases, as well as the hardship of various curses.
raw.es: Durante épocas mitológicas, hubo un hombre que cometió un pecado tan grande que nunca pudo ser perdonado. El hombre que esperaba castigo recibió de manos de los dioses una daga. Al saber que había sido sentenciado a muerte, el hombre aceptó la daga con valentía y se atravesó el cuerpo con ella. Sin embargo, no murió, sino que vivió cuarenta años más. Se dice que durante todo estos años, el hombre siguió sufriendo toda clase de enfermedades incurables, además de haber quedado envenenado y haber sido atormentado por muchas maldiciones.

raw.pt: Durante os tempos miológicos havia um homem que cometeu um pecado tão grandioso, que jamais poderia ser perdoado. Enquanto esperava sua punição foi presenteado pelos deuses com uma adaga. Sabendo que havia sido sentenciado à morte, ele a aceitou com coragem, afundando-aí em seu ventre. Mas o homem não morreu; viveu por 40 anos após esse dia. Dizem que durante esse tempo ele sofria com toda sorte de doença, venenos e outras agruras incuráveis, bem como as dificuldades de maldições variadas.
raw.th: ในยุคสมัยของเทพเจ้า เคยมีมนุษย์คนหนึ่งที่ได้ทำบาปที่ร้ายแรง ที่ทำให้เขาไม่ได้รับการให้อภัย ชายที่รอรับการลงโทษได้รับกริชเล่มหนึ่งจากเทพเจ้า เมื่อรู้ว่าเขาถูกตัดสินทาตาย เขารับกริชนี้ไปอย่างกล้าหาญและแทงมันเข้าไปในร่างกาย อย่างไรก็ตาม ชายคนนั้นไม่ตายและมีชีวิตอยู่ต่อไปอีก 40 ปีหลังจากนั้น ว่ากันว่าระหว่างนั้นเขาต้องทนทรมาณกับความเจ็บป่วยทุกรูปแบบ รวมถึงพิษและโรคร้ายที่รักษาไม่หาย เช่นเดียวกับการทนทุกข์กับคำสาปมากมาย
raw.vi: Trong thời đại thần thoại, đã từng có một người phạm một tội rất lớn đến mức không bao giờ có thể được tha thứ. Trong khi chờ đợi sự phán xét, người này đã được các vị thần trao cho một con dao găm. Biết mình bị kết án tử hình, người này đã dũng cảm nhận con dao và đâm nó qua cơ thể mình. Tuy nhiên, ông không chết và sống thêm 40 năm sau đó. Người ta nói rằng trong suốt thời gian này ông tiếp tục phải chịu tất cả các loại bệnh tật, bao gồm ngộ độc và các bệnh nan y khác, cũng như những gian khổ của những lời nguyền khác nhau.

id: Inilah pistol paling biasa di dunia. Bisa diisi peluru normal, lalu tarik pelatuknya. Namun ada sesuatu yang aneh pada tubuh korban tembak, ia menjadi kebas, lemah, dan terkadang mati rasa sendi. Awalnya, dikira sial saja, tapi anehnya itu berlangsung berulang-ulang. Rumor tentang pistol terkutuk yang dapat merusak jiwa perlahan mulai menyebar.
name: MST_SPHERES_38900_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: This was the most ordinary gun in the world. One would load it with normal bullets, and then pull the trigger like with any other gun. However, something strange happened to the body of the person shot by it. It caused numbness, weakness, and sometimes loss of the function of the joints. At the beginning it was believed to have been just bad luck, but some found it strange when it continued to happen countless of times. Thus, the rumor of the cursed gun that could damage the soul was gradually spread.

raw.en: This was the most ordinary gun in the world. One would load it with normal bullets, and then pull the trigger like with any other gun. However, something strange happened to the body of the person shot by it. It caused numbness, weakness, and sometimes loss of the function of the joints. At the beginning it was believed to have been just bad luck, but some found it strange when it continued to happen countless of times. Thus, the rumor of the cursed gun that could damage the soul was gradually spread.
raw.es: Esta era el arma más ordinaria del mundo. Había que cargarla con municiones normales y apretar el gatillo como cualquier otra arma de fuego. Sin embargo, algo extraño sucedió en el cuerpo de la persona que recibió un disparo de ella. Le provocó entumecimiento y debilidad y, en ocasiones, hizo que las articulaciones dejaran de funcionar. Al comienzo se creyó que había sido suerte, pero la gente se sorprendió cuando esto seguía ocurriendo, una y otra vez. Por esa razón se corrió el rumor de que el arma estaba maldita y de que podía dañar el alma.
raw.id: Inilah pistol paling biasa di dunia. Bisa diisi peluru normal, lalu tarik pelatuknya. Namun ada sesuatu yang aneh pada tubuh korban tembak, ia menjadi kebas, lemah, dan terkadang mati rasa sendi. Awalnya, dikira sial saja, tapi anehnya itu berlangsung berulang-ulang. Rumor tentang pistol terkutuk yang dapat merusak jiwa perlahan mulai menyebar.
raw.pt: Essa era a arma mais comum do mundo. Carregada com balas normais, puxava-se o gatilho como qualquer outra arma. Mas às vezes algo estranho acontecia ao corpo de quem era alvejado. Amortecimento, fraqueza, e às vezes até a perda da função nas juntas. De início acreditava-se ser má sorte, mas alguns acharam estranho que isso viria a continuar acontecendo várias vezes. Assim se espalhou o boato da arma amaldiçoada, que machucava a alma.
raw.th: นี่เป็นปืนที่ธรรมดาที่สุดในโลก ที่ใช้กระสุนธรรมดาและลั่นไกเหมือนกับปืนอื่นๆ ทั่วไป อย่างไรก็ตามบางอย่างแปลกๆ เกิดขึ้นกับร่างกายของคนที่ถูกมันยิง มันทำให้เกิดอาการชา อ่อนแอ และอวัยวะบางอย่างสูญเสียการทำงานของข้อต่อ เดิมทีมันถูกเชื่อว่าเป็นแค่โชคร้าย แต่เรื่องแปลกๆ ก็ยังคงเกิดขึ้นมาเรื่อยๆ นับครั้งไม่ถ้วน จนทำให้ข่าวลือของปืนต้องสาปที่สามารถสร้างความเสียหายกับจิตวิญญาณค่อยๆ แพร่กระจายออกไป
raw.vi: Đây là khẩu súng thông thường nhất trên thế giới. Người dùng sẽ nạp đạn bình thường cho súng và sau đó, bóp cò như bất kỳ khẩu súng nào khác. Tuy nhiên, điều kỳ lạ xảy ra với cơ thể người bị bắn. Nó gây ra tê liệt, yếu ớt và đôi khi mất chức năng của các khớp. Ban đầu, người ta cho rằng đó chỉ là không may, nhưng một số người đã phát hiện ra nó kỳ lạ khi điều này tiếp tục xảy ra vô số lần. Cứ thế, lời đồn về khẩu súng bị nguyền rủa có thể làm tổn thương linh hồn từ từ lan rộng.

id: Dalam kombinasi langka, inilah dua pedang hebat yang digabungkan. Lembing dengan dua mata tombak disebut memiliki kekuatan untuk membuka dimensi lain. Kekuatan yang diserap dari apa pun yang ditusuk satu ujungnya akan dilepaskan di ujung lainnya. Sepertinya perlu kekuatan khusus untuk mengaktifkan ini. Jika dipakai normal, senjata ini memiliki sihir hitam yang menginfeksi racun, sakit, dan kutukan pada korbannya.
name: MST_SPHERES_38801_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: In a rare combination, these are two great swords joined together. This lance with two spearheads is said to have the power to open another dimension. The power absorbed through whatever is pierced by one end is said to be released from the other end, but it seems like a special kind of power is needed to activate this. When used normally, however, this weapon has dark magic that can also inflict poison, sickness, and curses upon its victims.

raw.en: In a rare combination, these are two great swords joined together. This lance with two spearheads is said to have the power to open another dimension. The power absorbed through whatever is pierced by one end is said to be released from the other end, but it seems like a special kind of power is needed to activate this. When used normally, however, this weapon has dark magic that can also inflict poison, sickness, and curses upon its victims.
raw.es: Esta lanza está creada con dos espadas grandes combinadas de forma extraña. Tiene dos puntas, y se dice que es capaz de abrir un portal hacia otra dimensión. Se dice que el poder absorbido desde el objetivo de una de las puntas se libera por la otra, si bien se necesita de un poder especial para activar este comportamiento. Sin embargo, si se la usa de forma normal, esta arma posee magia oscura que también puede causar ponzoña, enfermedad y maldiciones en la víctima.

Kekuatan yang diserap dari apa pun yang ditusuk satu ujungnya akan dilepaskan di ujung lainnya. Sepertinya perlu kekuatan khusus untuk mengaktifkan ini.
