raw.pt: Em uma combinação rara, aqui estão duas espadas largas unidas em uma. Dizem que essa lança de duas pontas tem o poder de abrir outra dimensão. O poder absorvido pelo que quer que seja atravessado por um lado é supostamente liberado do outro, mas parece que é necessário um tipo especial de poder para ativá-la. Quando usada normalmente, essa arma possui uma magia negra que pode infligir veneno, doenças e maldições a suas vítimas.
raw.th: ในการรวมกันที่ยากจะเกิดขึ้น มีดาบใหญ่สองอันผสมกัน หลาวที่มีสองหัวนี้ว่ากันว่ามีพลังที่จะเปิดไปอีกมิติหนึ่ง พลังที่มันดูดซับจากทุกอย่างที่มันแทงจากปลายด้านหนึ่งจะถูกปลอดปล่อยจากปลายอีกด้าน แต่มันดูเหมือนว่าจะต้องใช้พลังพิเศษเพื่อทำให้พลังนี้ทำงาน อย่างไรก็ตามเมื่อใช้ธรรมดา อาวุธนี้มีพลังเวทย์มืดที่สามารถทำให้ติดพิษ เจ็บป่วย และคำสาปใส่เหยื่อของมัน
raw.vi: Trong một kết hợp hiếm, đây là hai thanh kiếm vĩ đại đã hợp nhất làm một. Cây thương này có hai mũi thương được cho rằng có sức mạnh để mở ra một chiều không gian khác. Sức mạnh hấp thụ được qua bất cứ thứ gì bị một đầu đâm thủng được cho rằng sẽ được giải phóng ở đầu kia, nhưng dường như cần có một loại sức mạnh đặc biệt để kích hoạt điều này. Tuy nhiên, khi sử dụng bình thường, vũ khí này có phép thuật bóng tối cũng có thể gây độc, bệnh dịch và lời nguyền trên những nạn nhân của nó.

id: Menurut cerita rakyat dari Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha, setan bernama Gaze Ohma muncul ke atas tanah setahun sekali. Membawa penyakit sampar dan kutukan, orang tidak keluar rumah saat ia datang. Hari berikutnya, penduduk keluar dan menemukan pohon yang mirip tombak yang dipegang Gaze Ohma. Begitu pohon ini ditebang, mereka akan berdoa untuk setahun yang sehat.
name: MST_SPHERES_38802_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: According to a certain piece of folklore from the Vriksha Duchy, a demon called Gaze Ohma appears above ground once a year. Bringing with it pestilence and curses, the people never ventured outside on the day of its coming. It is said that the next day, the villagers went outside to find a tree that resembled the lance that the Gaze Ohma wielded. Once this tree had been chopped down, they would pray for another year of sound health.

raw.en: According to a certain piece of folklore from the Vriksha Duchy, a demon called Gaze Ohma appears above ground once a year. Bringing with it pestilence and curses, the people never ventured outside on the day of its coming. It is said that the next day, the villagers went outside to find a tree that resembled the lance that the Gaze Ohma wielded. Once this tree had been chopped down, they would pray for another year of sound health.
raw.es: Según la demosofía del Principado de Vriksha, un demonio llamado Gaze Ohma se hace presente en la tierra una vez al año. Como la criatura presagia pestilencia y maldiciones, la gente no sale de sus casas el día de la llegada del demonio. Se dice que al día siguiente, cuando los pobladores se atrevieron a salir, encontraron un árbol parecido al pico que Gaze Ohma blandía el día anterior. Cuando lograron derribar el árbol, rezaron por un año con mucha salud.
raw.id: Menurut cerita rakyat dari Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha, setan bernama Gaze Ohma muncul ke atas tanah setahun sekali. Membawa penyakit sampar dan kutukan, orang tidak keluar rumah saat ia datang. Hari berikutnya, penduduk keluar dan menemukan pohon yang mirip tombak yang dipegang Gaze Ohma. Begitu pohon ini ditebang, mereka akan berdoa untuk setahun yang sehat.
raw.pt: De acordo com certo folclore de Vriksha Duchy, um demônio chamado Gaze Ohma aparece na superfície uma vez por ano. Trazendo pestilência e maldição, as pessoas não saem de casa neste dia. Dizem que no dia seguinte, os aldeões saem para encontrar uma árvore que se assemelha com a lança de Gaze Ohma empunhada. Assim que esta árvore foi cortada, eles rezaram por mais um ano por saúde.
raw.th: มีความเชื่อส่วนหนึ่งเกี่ยวกับมณพลรัฐพฤกษาว่ามีปีศาจชื่อกาเซ่ โอมาห์ปรากฎตัวขึ้นปีละครั้ง นำมาซึ่งโรคระบาดร้ายแรงและคำสาป ไม่มีใครกล้าออกจากบ้านในวันที่มันปรากฎตัว ว่ากันว่าในวันถัดมา มีชาวบ้านกลุ่มหนึ่งออกมาเพิ่มตามหาต้นไม้ที่มีลักษณะคล้ายหอกที่กาเซ่ โอมาห์ใช้ และเมื่อต้นไม้นี้ถูกจาม พวกเขาจะสวดภาวนาสำหรับสุขภาพสมบูรณ์อีกปี
raw.vi: Theo một câu chuyện dân gian nào đó từ Vriksha Duchy, một con quỷ có tên là Gaze Ohma xuất hiện trên mặt đất một năm một lần. Nó mang theo bệnh dịch và những lời nguyền rủa, mọi người chưa bao giờ dám mạo hiểm ra ngoài vào ngày nó xuất hiện. Tương truyền rằng ngày hôm sau, dân làng ra ngoài để tìm một cái cây giống với cây thương mà Gaze Ohma sử dụng. Khi cái cây này bị chặt, họ sẽ cầu nguyện cho một năm sức khỏe tốt.

id: Ada mitos tentnang pahlawan yang turun ke dunia bawah tanah untuk mencari almarhumah kakaknya. Usahanya untuk membangkitkan si kakak terbukti sia-sia, tetapi ia membawa pulang tombak. Siapa pun yang terkena tombak ini akan menderita lemah, luka dalam, dan kebas yang akan mengakibatkan kematian. Sang pahlawan sukses dalam berbagai tugas berkat tombak ini, tapi akhirnya senjata makan tuan, dan ia mati.
name: MST_SPHERES_38901_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There is a myth that tells the story of a hero that descended to the underworld in order to find his deceased older sister. His attempt to revive her proved futile, but the hero brought back with him a lance. Those who were struck by this lance suffered from weakness, deep wounds, and numbness that subsequently lead to death. The hero was successful in many exploits thanks to this lance, but in the end was struck by it himself, causing his untimely death.

raw.en: There is a myth that tells the story of a hero that descended to the underworld in order to find his deceased older sister. His attempt to revive her proved futile, but the hero brought back with him a lance. Those who were struck by this lance suffered from weakness, deep wounds, and numbness that subsequently lead to death. The hero was successful in many exploits thanks to this lance, but in the end was struck by it himself, causing his untimely death.
raw.es: Hay un mito que cuenta la historia de un héroe que descendió hacia el inframundo para poder encontrar a su hermana mayor fallecida. Sus intentos por revivirla fueron en vano, pero el héroe trajo consigo una lanza. Antes de morir, aquellos golpeados por esta lanza quedaban debilitados, gravemente heridos y aturdidos. Este héroe llevó a cabo grandes hazañas gracias a esta lanza. Sin embargo, él mismo se asestó un golpe con ella y su vida se acabó en un instante.
raw.id: Ada mitos tentnang pahlawan yang turun ke dunia bawah tanah untuk mencari almarhumah kakaknya. Usahanya untuk membangkitkan si kakak terbukti sia-sia, tetapi ia membawa pulang tombak. Sang pahlawan sukses dalam berbagai tugas berkat tombak ini, tapi akhirnya senjata makan tuan, dan ia mati.
raw.pt: Há um mito que conta a história de um herói, que desceu ao submundo para encontrar sua irmã mais velha falecida. A tentativa de trazê-la de volta se provou fútil, mas ele trouxe consigo uma lança. Aqueles atacados por ela sofriam de fraquezas, ferimentos profundos e um amortecimento que depois levava à morte. O herói teve sucesso em muitas explorações devido à lança, mas no fim foi abatido pela própria, causando sua morte prematura.
raw.th: มีตำนานเล่าถึงผู้กล้าที่ลงไปยังใต้โลกเพื่อตามหาพี่สาวที่เจ็บป่วยของเขา ความพยายามในการชุบชีวิตของเธอนั้นไร้ผล แต่ผู้กล้าได้นำหลาวกลับมาพร้อมกับเขา ใครก็ตามที่ถูกแทงโดยหลาวนี้จะต้องทรมานจากความอ่อนแอ แผลลึก และเหน็บชาที่ในที่สุดก้นำไปสู่ความตาย ผู้กล้าประสบความสำเร็จในหลายๆด้ายเพราะหลาวอันนี้ แต่ในท้านที่สุดเขาก็ถุกมันแทงเสียเอง และทำให้เขาตายไปในที่สุด
raw.vi: Có truyền thuyết kể về câu chuyện của một anh hùng đã xuống thế giới bên kia để tìm chị gái đã mất của mình. Nỗ lực của anh nhằm hồi sinh chị gái đã được chứng minh là vô ích, nhưng người anh hùng này đã mang về một cây thương. Những người trúng đòn của cây thương này sẽ phải chịu sự ốm yếu, những vết thương sâu và tê liệt và sau đó dẫn đến tử vong. Vị anh hùng này đã thành công trong nhiều chiến công nhờ cây thương này, nhưng cuối cùng đã tự đâm nó vào mình, gây ra cái chết đột ngột của anh.

id: Banyak legenda tentang orang yang turun ke dunia bawah selagi masih hidup, Kisah Bastia salah satu legendanya. Tombak yang dibawanya pulang dari kunjungan dunia bawah memiliki kekuatan untuk menusuk organ vital begitu ia menarik tombak, sehingga musuh yang terluka jarang yang bertahan hidup. Namun Bastia tidak memiliki cukup kekuatan untuk mengontrol tombak, begitu ia lenyap dan kembali ke dunia bawah, ia tetap berlatih dengan tombaknya sampai selama-lamanya.
name: MST_SPHERES_38902_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There are many legends of people who descended to the underworld while they were still alive. The story of Bastia is one such legend. The pike he brought back with him from his visit there had the power to pierce vital organs as soon as it was drawn, leaving the wounded enemy with many afflictions in the case of having barely survived death. However, Bastia did not have enough power to control the pike, and once he perished and returned to the underworld, it is said that he kept training with his pike for eternity.

raw.en: There are many legends of people who descended to the underworld while they were still alive. The story of Bastia is one such legend. The pike he brought back with him from his visit there had the power to pierce vital organs as soon as it was drawn, leaving the wounded enemy with many afflictions in the case of having barely survived death. However, Bastia did not have enough power to control the pike, and once he perished and returned to the underworld, it is said that he kept training with his pike for eternity.
raw.es: Hay muchos mitos que hablan sobre gente que desciende al inframundo y sigue con vida. La historia de Bastia es digna de leyendas. El pico que trajo consigo tras su visita al inframundo tenía el poder de perforar órganos vitales tan pronto se desenvainaba, y si el enemigo lograba sobrevivir de alguna forma, quedaba afectado por muchas aflicciones. Sin embargo, Bastia no tenía el poder suficiente para controlar el arma, y cuando murió y regresó al inframundo, se dice que siguió entrenando con ella durante la eternidad.
raw.id: Banyak legenda tentang orang yang turun ke dunia bawah selagi masih hidup, Kisah Bastia salah satu legendanya. Tombak yang dibawanya pulang dari kunjungan dunia bawah memiliki kekuatan untuk menusuk organ vital begitu ia menarik tombak, sehingga musuh yang terluka jarang yang bertahan hidup. Namun Bastia tidak memiliki cukup kekuatan untuk mengontrol tombak, begitu ia lenyap dan kembali ke dunia bawah, ia tetap berlatih dengan tombaknya sampai selama-lamanya.
raw.pt: Há muitas lendas de pessoas que desceram até o mundo subterrâneo quando ainda vivas. A história de Bastia e uma lenda. O pique que trouxe de volta com ele da sua visita tinha o poder de perfurar órgãos vitais, deixando o inimigo ferido com muitas marcas se conseguir sobreviver. Contudo, Bastia não tinha poder suficiente para manusear o pique, e quando voltou para o mundo subterrâneo, dizem que ele continuou treinando para toda eternidade.
raw.th: มีหลายตำนานเกี่ยวกับผู้ที่ลงไปใต้พื้นโลกขณะที่ยังมีชีวิต หนึ่งคือเรื่องของบาสเทีย โดยหอกที่เขานำกลับมาจากใต้พื้นโลกนั้นมีพลังในการพุ่งแทงจุดสำคัญของร่างกายได้อย่างรวดเร็ว ทิ้งบาดแผลไว้ให้ศัตรูอย่างเจ็บปวดก่อนตาย อย่างไรก็ตาม บาสเทียมีพลังไม่มากพอจะควบคุมมัน แต่เมื่อเขาเสียชีวิตและล่องลงสู่ใต้พื้นโลก ว่ากันว่าเขาได้ฝึกใช้หอกนี้อยู่ชั่วกัปชั่วกัลป์
raw.vi: Có nhiều truyền thuyết về những người đã xuống thế giới bên kia trong khi họ vẫn còn sống. Câu chuyện của Bastia là một truyền thuyết như vậy. Cây giáo ông mang về từ chuyến đi của mình đến đó có sức mạnh xuyên thủng các cơ quan sống còn ngay khi nó được rút ra, để lại cho kẻ thù bị thương nhiều nỗi đau đớn trong cảnh ngộ sống không bằng chết. Tuy nhiên, Bastia không có đủ sức mạnh để kiểm soát cây giáo này, và khi ông chết và trở về thế giới bên kia, tương truyền rằng ông đã tiếp tục luyện tập với cây giáo của mình mãi mãi.

id: Para dewa menaruh para pendosa di penjara siksaan, tempat senjata ini dibawa pengawal untuk mengeksekusi hukuman. Tidak ada lagi yang diketahui tentang para pengawal ini, tapi alat hukuman ini dibuat oleh pandai besi manusia. Bentuk khusus kepala tombak menyebabkan siapa saja yang tersambar akan menderita segala macam penyakit, menjadikannya contoh alat penyiksa di dunia manusia.
name: MST_SPHERES_39000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The gods put sinners in a prison of torture, where this weapon was carried by its guards to execute condemnation. Not much else is known about these guards, but this tool for condemnation was reforged by a human blacksmith. The special shape of the spearhead causes anyone struck by it to suffer every type of pain imaginable, making it an example of a torture device in the human world.

raw.en: The gods put sinners in a prison of torture, where this weapon was carried by its guards to execute condemnation. Not much else is known about these guards, but this tool for condemnation was reforged by a human blacksmith. The special shape of the spearhead causes anyone struck by it to suffer every type of pain imaginable, making it an example of a torture device in the human world.
raw.es: Los dioses llevaban a los pecadores a celdas de torturas, donde los guardias utilizaban esta arma para ejecutar la condena. No se sabe mucho más acerca de estos guardias, pero un herrero humano volvió a forjar esta herramienta. La forma especial de la punta de esta alabarda hace que cualquiera que reciba un golpe de ella sufra toda clase de dolor imaginable. Es el ejemplo perfecto de un dispositivo de tortura en el mundo humano.
raw.id: Para dewa menaruh para pendosa di penjara siksaan, tempat senjata ini dibawa pengawal untuk mengeksekusi hukuman. Tidak ada lagi yang diketahui tentang para pengawal ini, tapi alat hukuman ini dibuat oleh pandai besi manusia. Bentuk khusus kepala tombak menyebabkan siapa saja yang tersambar akan menderita segala macam penyakit, menjadikannya contoh alat penyiksa di dunia manusia.
raw.pt: Os deuses colocam os deuses em uma prisão de tortura, onde essa arma é carregada por seus guardas para executar as punições. Não se sabe muito sobre estes guardas, mas essa ferramenta de condenação foi reforjada por um artífice humano. A forma especial da ponta faz com que quem é atacado sofra todo tipo de dor imaginável, fazendo dela um instrumento exemplar de tortura no mundo humano.
raw.th: เทพเจ้าส่งคนบาปไปอยู่ในคุกแห่งการทรมาน ที่ๆ อาวะนี้ถูกใช้โดยพวกยามเพื่อใช้พิพากษาความผิด ไม่มีใครรู้เรื่องราวของยามพวกนี้ แต่อุปกรณ์ที่ใช้พิพากษานี้ถุกหลอมใหม่โดยพวกมนุษย์ช่างตีเหล็ก รูปลักษณ์ปลายหัวที่พิเศษสร้างความทรมาน นานับชนิดให้กับคนที่โดน ทำให้มันเป็นต้นแบบของเครื่องมือทรมานคนในโลกนี้
raw.vi: Các vị thần đã tống những kẻ phạm tội vào nhà tù để tra tấn, ở đó vũ khí này được mang bởi những các quản ngục để thực thi bản án. Không có nhiều người khác biết về những quản ngục này, nhưng công cụ để kết án này đã được rèn bởi một thợ rèn là con người. Hình dáng đặc biệt của đầu kích khiến bất kỳ ai bị nó đâm sẽ phải chịu mọi loại đau đớn không thể tưởng tượng được, khiến nó trở thành một ví dụ về thiết bị tra tấn trong nhân gian.

id: Ada sekuel cerita Busur Setan. Setelah membantu banyak orang balas dendam, kekuatan mistis Busur Setan bertambah. Keberadaannya sendiri menjadi ancaman keseimbangan harmoni dunia, sehingga para dewa memerintah penyihir untuk menghancurkannya. Namun penyihir ini malah terpesona atas kekuatan si busur dan kabur. Di tempat yang tidak diketahui, dendam si busur semakin mendalam karena memakan pemiliknya.
name: MST_SPHERES_39002_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There is a sequel to the story of the Demon Bow. Having helped many to attain the revenge they sought, the Demon Bow's mystical power amplified. Its existence alone became a threat to the harmonious balance of the world, and thus the gods ordered a sorcerer to destroy it. However, this sorcerer became bewitched by the bow's power, and escaped with it elsewhere. Now, in a place no one suspects, the bow's grudge grows deeper as it feeds upon its owner.

raw.en: There is a sequel to the story of the Demon Bow. Having helped many to attain the revenge they sought, the Demon Bow's mystical power amplified. Its existence alone became a threat to the harmonious balance of the world, and thus the gods ordered a sorcerer to destroy it. However, this sorcerer became bewitched by the bow's power, and escaped with it elsewhere. Now, in a place no one suspects, the bow's grudge grows deeper as it feeds upon its owner.
raw.es: Hay una secuela para la historia del Arco demonio. Luego de ayudar a muchos a conseguir la venganza que anhelaban, el poder místico del Arco demonio se amplificó. Su mera existencia se convirtió en una amenaza para el balance armonioso del mundo, por lo que los dioses le dijeron a un hechicero que lo destruyera. Sin embargo, el mago quedó embelesado por los poderes del arco, lo tomó y escapó con él. Ahora, en un lugar que nadie sospecha, el rencor del arco aumenta sin parar y se alimenta de su dueño.

raw.pt: Há uma continuação para a história do Arco Demoníaco. Tendo ajudado muita a conseguir a vingança que queriam, o poder do Arco Demoníaco foi ampliado. Sua existência em si se tornou uma presente para a harmonia do mundo, e assim os deuses ordenaram que um feiticeiro o destruísse. Porem, este feiticeiro ficou enfeitiçado com o poder do arco e fugiu com ele para outro lugar. Agora, em um lugar escondido, o rancor do arco aumenta enquanto aumento o do seu dono.
raw.th: มีเรื่องราวต่อเนื่องกันมาเกี่ยวกับธนูของปีศาจ ที่ช่วยในการล้างแค้นมามากมายด้วยพลังลึกลับของมัน การมีอยู่ของมันนำมาซึ่งภัยต่อสมดุลย์ของโลก ทำให้เหล่าเทพสั่งจอมเวทย์ให้ทำลายมัน แต่จอมเวทย์ผู้นี้กลับโดนพลังของมันให้เกิดความหลงใหล และนำมันหลบหนีออกมา ในตอนนี้ ณ สถานที่ที่ไม่มีใครคาดคิด ความโกรธแค้นของธนูได้ทวีคูณขึ้นจากการได้รับพลังจากเจ้าของ
raw.vi: Có phần tiếp theo của câu chuyện Cung ma quỷ. Nhờ giúp nhiều người trả thù được, sức mạnh thần bí của Cung ma quỷ được khuếch đại lên. Chỉ riêng sự tồn tại của nó đã trở thành mối đe dọa đối với sự cần bằng hài hòa của thế giới và do đó, các vị thần lệnh cho một thầy phù thủy phải tiêu diệt nó. Tuy nhiên, thầy phù thủy này đã bị mê hoặc bởi sức mạnh của cây cung và chạy trốn cùng với nó đến nơi khác. Ở một nơi không ai nghi ngờ, thù oán của cây cung này giờ phát triển sâu hơn vì nó ăn vào chủ nhân của nó.

id: Mau balas dendam, seorang pria menjual jiwanya ke setan dan menerima senjata sihir gelap. Melebihi tinggi manusia biasa, bahkan jika Busur Setan ini tidak mengenai titik vital musuh, badan si musuh tetap membusuk. Yang diketahui tentang si pria adalah keberadaannya tiba-tiba tidak diketahui selagi ia balas dendam. Hanya tersisa busur kutukan yang melahirkan tragedi demi tragedi.
name: MST_SPHERES_39001_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: In search for revenge, one man sold his soul to a demon and received a weapon of dark magic in its stead. Surpassing the height of an ordinary man, even if this Demon Bow misses the vital points of an enemy, it will still cause their body to rot away. The only thing known about this man is that his whereabouts suddenly became unknown after he exacted his revenge. Only the cursed bow remained hence, giving birth to numerous tragedies one after the other.

raw.en: In search for revenge, one man sold his soul to a demon and received a weapon of dark magic in its stead. Surpassing the height of an ordinary man, even if this Demon Bow misses the vital points of an enemy, it will still cause their body to rot away. The only thing known about this man is that his whereabouts suddenly became unknown after he exacted his revenge. Only the cursed bow remained hence, giving birth to numerous tragedies one after the other.
raw.es: En busca de venganza, un hombre le vendió su alma a un demonio y recibió, a cambio, un arma cargada de energía oscura. Por más que el disparo no impacté en uno de los puntos vitales de un enemigo, este arco, que supera en altura a un hombre normal, hará que el cuerpo se pudra de todas formas. Lo único que se sabe sobre este hombre es que, una vez se hubo cobrado venganza, no se lo volvió a ver más. Solo el arco maldito permaneció, listo para sembrar una gran cantidad de tragedias, una tras otra.

raw.pt: Em busca de vingança, um homem vendeu sua alma ao demônio para receber uma arma de magia negra em troca. Superando a altura de um homem comum, mesmo que este arco demoníaco erre os pontos vitais do inimigo, ainda apodrece o corpo. A única coisa que se sabe sobre o homem é que sua localização se tornou desconhecida logo após ele cumprir sua vingança. Somente o arco maldito sobrou, dando origem a numerosas tragédias, uma após a outra.
raw.th: เพื่อหาทางล้างแค้น ชายคนหนึ่งได้ขายวิญญาณของเขาให้กับปีศาจและได้รับอาวุธที่มีพลังเวทย์ด้านมืดมาแทน จนอยู่เหนือกว่าคนธรรมดาทั่วไป แม้ว่าธนูปีศาจนี้จะยิงปลาดจุดตายของศัตรู แต่มันก็จะสาปให้ร่างกายของพวกนั้นเน่าสลายไปอยู่ดี สิ่งเดียวที่รู้เกี่ยวกับชายคนนี้ก็คือเขาหายตัวไปทันทีที่เขาได้ล้างแค้นสำเร็จ เหลือเพียงธนูต้องสาปเท่านั้นที่ยังอยู่ จึงทำให้เกิดโศกนาฏกรรมหลายครั้งตามมาเรื่อยๆ
raw.vi: Tìm cách trả thù, một người đàn ông đã bán linh hồn cho một con quỷ và thay vào đó sẽ nhận được một vũ khí có phép thuật bóng tối. Hơn cả chiều cao của một người bình thường, ngay cả khi chiếc Cung ma quỷ này bắn trượt điểm tử huyệt của kẻ thù, thì nó cũng sẽ khiến cơ thể của họ dần mục nát. Điều duy nhất được biết về người này là sau khi ông đã trả thù được, người ta đột nhiên không biết ông ở đâu. Chỉ có cây cung bị nguyền rủa vẫn còn đó, vì thế mà sinh ra rất nhiều bi kịch hết cái này đến cái khác.

id: Keahlian yang didapat dari dunia lain memuncakkan minat para tukang. Lahirlah Gaun Setan ajaib Manalarg. Seharusnya memperkuat kesehatan pemakainya, dan memberi si pemakai kekautan persepsi melebihi kecerdasan manusia, tapi berakhir sebagai zirah nyentrik. Sebagai zirah, ia masih inovatif. Berkekuatan mencegah serangan, dan agak mengurangi kerusakan yang diderita.
name: MST_SPHERES_39100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Skills obtained from another world peaked the interest of craftsmen. Thus, the miraculous Demon Dress Manalarg was born. It was supposed to amplify the health of the wearer, and grant them with powers of perception that surpassed human intellect, but it only ended up as an eccentric looking piece of cloth. However, as a piece a garment, this article of rare beauty still remains an innovative piece. It is said to have the power to avert attacks, as well as slightly decrease any damage taken.

raw.en: Skills obtained from another world peaked the interest of craftsmen. Thus, the miraculous Demon Dress Manalarg was born. It was supposed to amplify the health of the wearer, and grant them with powers of perception that surpassed human intellect, but it only ended up as an eccentric looking piece of cloth. However, as a piece a garment, this article of rare beauty still remains an innovative piece. It is said to have the power to avert attacks, as well as slightly decrease any damage taken.
raw.es: Las habilidades obtenidas de otro mundo llamaron la atención de los artesanos. Gracias a esto, nació Manalarg, el ropaje demon. Se suponía que amplificaría la salud del portador y le otorgaría poderes de percepción capaces de superar el intelecto humano. Sin embargo, solo terminó siendo una pieza de armadura excéntrica. Como armadura, esta prenda de una belleza inusual sigue siendo una pieza innovadora. Se dice que tiene el poder de evitar los ataques, además de disminuir levemente el daño recibido.

Seharusnya memperkuat kesehatan pemakainya, dan memberi si pemakai kekautan persepsi melebihi kecerdasan manusia, tapi berakhir sebagai zirah nyentrik. Sebagai zirah, ia masih inovatif. raw.pt: Habilidades obtidas em outro mundo atiçavam o interesse dos artífices. Assim, o milagroso Manalarg, o Vestido do Demônio, foi criado. Supostamente ele deveria melhorar a saúde do portador, e dar a ele ou ela poderes de percepção além do intelecto humano, mas acabou somente como uma armadura excêntrica. Porém, como peça de armadura, esse artigo ou beleza rara continua sendo inovador. Dizem que tem o poder de evitar ataques, bem como diminuir qualquer dano sofrido.
raw.th: ทักษะที่ได้รับมาจากโลกอื่นสร้างความสนใจให้กับนักประดิษฐ์ ฉะนั้น ชุดปีศาจมานาลาร์จจึงได้กำเนิดขึ้น มันควรที่จะขยายพลังชีวิตของผู้สวมใส่ และมอบพลังรับรู้ที่สูงกว่าปัญญามนุษย์ให้กับพวกเขา  แต่สุดท้ายมันก็เป็นแค่ชุดเกราะที่ดูแปลกๆ เท่านั้น อย่างไรก็ตาม ในฐานะชุดเกราะมันก็ยังคงเป้นนวัตกรรมชิ้นงาม ว่ากันว่ามันมีพลังที่จะหลีกเลี่ยงการโจมตีและลดค่าความเสียหายที่ได้รับลงเล็กน้อยด้วย
raw.vi: Kỹ năng có được từ thế giới khác là mối quan tâm hàng đầu của các thợ rèn. Do đó, bộ Xiêm y ma quỷ kỳ diệu Manalarg đã ra đời. Nó được cho rằng sẽ làm tăng thể lực của người mặc và ban cho họ sức mạnh nhận thức vượt qua trí tuệ của con người, nhưng cuối cùng nó chỉ là một mảnh giáp trông lập dị. Tuy nhiên, là một mảnh giáp, vật phẩm này và vẻ đẹp hiếm có vẫn là một sự sáng tạo. Nó được cho rằng có sức mạnh ngăn chặn các cuộc tấn công, cũng như giảm nhẹ thiệt hại gây ra.

id: Katanya dewi cinta punya dua gelang terbuat dari emas dan perak di tangan kirinya. Kedua gelang menyembunyikan kekuatan besar untuk memulihkan. Jika dipakai bersama dengan sihir penyembuh, dapat langsung menyembuhkan segala macam luka. Gelang Emas lebih efektif ketimbang Gelang Putih, tapi si dewi memberikan Gelang Emas ke orang lain, jadi ia menjaga Gelang Putih baik-baik.
name: MST_SPHERES_39200_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: It is said that the goddess of love had two bangles made of gold and silver on her left hand. Both bangles hide great restorative powers within them, and using them in combination with healing magic can cure any type of wound in an instant. The Gold Bangle seems to be more effective than the White Bangle, but since the goddess gave the Gold Bangle away to someone else, she treasured the White Bangle she had left very much in its stead.

raw.en: It is said that the goddess of love had two bangles made of gold and silver on her left hand. Both bangles hide great restorative powers within them, and using them in combination with healing magic can cure any type of wound in an instant. The Gold Bangle seems to be more effective than the White Bangle, but since the goddess gave the Gold Bangle away to someone else, she treasured the White Bangle she had left very much in its stead.
raw.es: Se dice que la diosa del amor tenía dos aros, uno de oro y otro de plata, en la mano izquierda. Ambas alhajas tienen poderes regenerativos, y si se los usa en combinación con magia sanadora, se puede curar cualquier tipo de herida en un instante. El Aro dorado es más efectivo que el Aro blanco, pero dado que la diosa le dio la joya áurea a alguien, comenzó a atesorar el Aro blanco en su lugar.

raw.pt: Dizem que a deusa do amor tinha dois braceletes feitos de ouro e prata em sua mão esquerda. Ambos os braceletes escondem grandes poderes de restauração, e usá-los junto a magias de cura pode eliminar qualquer ferimento em um instante. O Bracelete Dourado parece mais eficiente que o Bracelete Branco, mas já que ela o presenteou, ela adorava ainda mais o Bracelete Branco que lhe restou.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าเทพธิดาแห่งความรักมีกำไลข้อมือสองอันที่ทำจากทองและเงิน กำไลทั้งสองอันซ่อนพลังฟื้นฟูที่ยิ่งใหญ่อยู่ในตัวมันและการใช้พวกมันร่วมกับเวทย์รักษาจะสามารถเยียวยาบาดแผลทุกชนิดในทันที กำไลทองดูเหมือนจะให้ผลที่มากกว่ากำไลสีขาว แต่หลังจากที่เทพธิดาได้มอบกำไลทองให้กับใครบางคนไปแล้ว เธอถึงให้ความรักกับกำไลที่เธอเหลืออยู่อย่างมากแทน
raw.vi: Người ta nói rằng nữ thần tình yêu có hai chiếc vòng làm bằng vàng và bạc ở trên tay trái. Cả hai chiếc vòng ẩn giấu sức mạnh phục hồi thể lực lớn trong chúng và sử dụng chúng kết hợp với phép thuật chữa lành có thể chữa trị bất kỳ loại vết thương nào ngay lập tức. Chiếc Vòng vàng dường như có hiệu quả hơn chiếc Vòng bạc, nhưng kể từ khi nữ thần đã trao chiếc Vòng vàng cho người khác, thay vào đó cô trân trọng chiếc Vòng bạc còn lại rất nhiều.

id: Ada legenda tentang prajurit yang mengalahkan setan untuk menyelamatkan dewi cantik yang diserang si setan. Keduanya saling jatuh cinta, tapi si dewi memberi tahu bahwa ia harus kembali ke negeri asalnya, dan ia memberikan Gelang Emas dari tangan kirinya. Setelah itu, segala luka si prajurit langsung sembuh, dan ia dikenal sebagai pahlawan yang berkali-kali lolos dari maut.
name: MST_SPHERES_39201_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There is a legend about a soldier who defeated a demon in order to rescue a beautiful goddess that was being attacked by it. The two fell in love, but when the goddess informed him that she had to go back to the far away country she had come from, she left the Gold Bangle she wore on her left hand behind with him.  After that, any injuries that the soldier suffered were completely healed in a short amount of time, and is known as the hero who averted death time and time again.

raw.es: Un leyenda cuenta la historia de un soldado que derrotó a un demonio para rescatar a una hermosa diosa que estaba siendo atacada por él. El guerrero y la diosa se enamoraron, pero cuando la deidad le dijo al humano que tenía que volver al lugar del que había venido, le dejó el Aro dorado que había usado en la mano izquierda.  Después de eso, cualquier herida que el soldado recibiera se curaba completamente en un breve período, y el guerrero pasó a la historia como el héroe que evitó a la muerte una y otra vez.

Keduanya saling jatuh cinta, tapi si dewi memberi tahu bahwa ia harus kembali ke negeri asalnya, dan ia memberikan Gelang Emas dari tangan kirinya. Setelah itu, segala luka si prajurit langsung sembuh, dan ia dikenal sebagai pahlawan yang berkali-kali lolos dari maut.
raw.pt: Há uma lenda sobre um soldado que derrotou um demônio, para resgatar uma bela deusa que estava sendo atacada. Os dois se apaixonaram, mas quando a deusa o informou de que ela precisava voltar ao país longínquo de onde veio, ela deixou com ele o Bracelete Dourado que usava em sua mão esquerda.  Depois daquele dia, quaisquer ferimentos no soldado curavam completamente em pouco tempo, vindo ele a se tornar conhecido com o herói que escapou da morte inúmeras vezes.
raw.th: มีตำนานเกี่ยวกับทหารผู้เอาชนะปีศาจเพื่อช่วยเหลือเทพธิดาแสนสวยที่ถุกมันโจมตี ทั้งสองตกหลุมรักกัน แต่เมื่อเทพธิดาบอกเขาว่าเธอจะต้องกลับไปยังประเทศห่างไกลที่เธอจากมา เธอทิ้งกำไลข้อมือสีทองที่เธอสวมใส่ไว้ให้เขา หลังจากนั้น ไม่ว่าจะบาดเจ็บแค่ไหนทหารคนนั้นก็จะหายในระยะเวลาอันสั้น และกลายเป็นที่รู้จักในฐานะผู้กล้าที่หลบเลี่ยงความตายมานับครั้งไม่ถ้วน
raw.vi: Có truyền thuyết về một người lính đã đánh bại một con quỷ để giải cứu một nữ thần xinh đẹp khỏi bị con quỷ tấn công. Hai người đã yêu nhau, nhưng khi nữ thần cho anh biết cô phải quay về đất nước xa xôi mà cô đã đến từ đó, cô để lại cho anh chiếc Vòng vàng cô đeo trên tay trái.  Sau đó, mọi thương tích mà người lính này phải chịu hoàn toàn được chữa lành trong một khoảng thời gian ngắn và được biết đến là vị anh hùng ngăn chặn thần chết hết lần này đến lần khác.

id: Di zaman mitos, ada penjudi yang menjajal hokinya dengan dewa perjanjian. Si penjudi mencoba menipu dewa keras kepala dengan kata-katanya, namun akhirnya ia malah dimanipulasi si dewa. Dewa perjanjian ini berwatak serius dan menawarkan rampasan ke si penjudi, berupa mutiara yang dapat menambah kekuatan spiritual. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, si penjudi menjadi pendeta yang sangat dihormati.
name: MST_SPHERES_39300_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: In mythical times, there was once a gambler who tried his hand with a covenant god. The gambler tried to trick the stubborn god with his words, but in the end played right into the god's hands, and was manipulated by him. However, this covenant god had such a serious sense of duty that he offered the spoils of the bet to the gambler anyway. It was a pearl that could increase spiritual power, and it is said that years later, the gambler became a highly regarded priest.

raw.en: In mythical times, there was once a gambler who tried his hand with a covenant god. The gambler tried to trick the stubborn god with his words, but in the end played right into the god's hands, and was manipulated by him. raw.es: En épocas míticas, existió un apostador que probó su suerte contra un dios. El humano intentó engañar al obstinado dios con sus palabras, pero al final estaba haciendo justo lo que el dios quería, y él terminó siendo manipulado por la deidad. Sin embargo, este dios tenía sentido del deber tan alto que, de todos modos, le ofreció las ganancias de la apuesta al jugador. Era una perla que podía aumentar el poder espiritual. Se dice que más tarde, el apostador se convirtió en un sacerdote muy reconocido.

Dewa perjanjian ini berwatak serius dan menawarkan rampasan ke si penjudi, berupa mutiara yang dapat menambah kekuatan spiritual. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, si penjudi menjadi pendeta yang sangat dihormati.
raw.pt: Em tempos míticos, havia um apostador que tentou a sorte com um deus de um pacto. O apostador tentou enganar o deus teimoso com suas palavras, mas no final das contas caiu no golpe do deus e foi manipulado por este. Porém, este deus tinha um senso de dever tão sério que ele ofereceu os espólios da aposta ao apostador, mesmo assim. Era uma pérola que aumentava o poder espiritual. Dizem que, anos mais tarde, o apostador se tornou um sacerdote respeitado.
raw.th: ในยุคของเทพเจ้า มีนักพนันคนหนึ่งพยายามจะลองดีกับเทพเจ้าแห่งพันธะสัญญา นักพนันพยายามจะหลอกเทพผู้ดื้อรั้นด้วยคำพูดของเขา แต่สุดท้ายก็ถูกหลอกเสียเองในเงื้อมือของเทพเจ้า อย่างไรก็ตามเทพเจ้าแห่งพันธะสัญญานี้มีความยึดมั่นในคำสัญญาสูง เขาจึงได้มอบสิ่งที่พนันไว้ให้กับนักพนันอยู่ดี  มันเป็นไข่มุกที่สามารถเพิ่มพลังจิตวิญญาณ และว่ากันว่าหลายปีต่อมานักพนันนั้นก็ได้กลายเป็นนักบวชที่ได้รับการนับถืออย่างมาก
raw.vi: Ngày xửa ngày xưa, trong thời đại thần thoại, có một con bạc đã thử khả năng của mình với vị thần giao ước. Con bạc này đã khoa môi múa mép nhằm lừa vị thần cứng cỏi này, nhưng cuối cùng đã mắc mưu của vị thần này và bị vị thần này thao túng. Tuy nhiên, vị thần giao ước này có ý thức trách nhiệm nghiêm túc rằng dù sao đi nữa, ông vẫn nên đưa chiến lợi phẩm của vụ cá cược cho con bạc này. Đó là một viên ngọc trai có thể tăng sức mạnh tinh thần và người ta nói rằng nhiều năm sau đó, con bạc này đã trở thành một linh mục được đánh giá cao.

id: Festival budaya Falvana masih dirayakan di Elgaia. Asalnya adalah niat doa untuk kesehatan dengan mengapungkan boneka yang terbuat dari bunga ke sungai. Kini ditukar dengan patung dewi ini. Patung yang lebih besar dari bayi, mengurangi beban spiritual siapa pun yang memilikinya. Apakah cinta si dewi juga membuatnya menanggung rasa sakit si boneka bunga?
name: MST_SPHERES_39400_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The customary festival of Falvana is still celebrated in Elgaia. This festival, which originated with the intentions of praying for sound health by letting dolls made of flowers float down the river, is now said to take place in exchange for the statue of this goddess. The statue, bigger than a babe, abates the spiritual burdens of whomever possesses it. One has to wonder if the love of the goddess also makes her shoulder the pains of the flower dolls as well.

raw.en: The customary festival of Falvana is still celebrated in Elgaia. This festival, which originated with the intentions of praying for sound health by letting dolls made of flowers float down the river, is now said to take place in exchange for the statue of this goddess. The statue, bigger than a babe, abates the spiritual burdens of whomever possesses it. One has to wonder if the love of the goddess also makes her shoulder the pains of the flower dolls as well.
raw.es: El habitual festival de Falvana todavía se celebra en Elgaia. Se dice que este festival, que se originó con la intención de rezar por la buena salud al dejar que muñecas hechas con flores flotaran río abajo, ahora tiene lugar a cambio de la estatua de esta diosa. La estatua, de un tamaño mayor al de un bebé, calma las cargas espirituales de quien la tenga consigo. Uno se pregunta si el amor de la diosa también la lleva a soportar los dolores de las muñecas.
raw.id: Festival budaya Falvana masih dirayakan di Elgaia. Asalnya adalah niat doa untuk kesehatan dengan mengapungkan boneka yang terbuat dari bunga ke sungai. Kini ditukar dengan patung dewi ini. Patung yang lebih besar dari bayi, mengurangi beban spiritual siapa pun yang memilikinya. Apakah cinta si dewi juga membuatnya menanggung rasa sakit si boneka bunga?
raw.pt: O consagrado festival de Falvana ainda é celebrado em Elgaia. Este festival, que se originou com as intenções de orar por saúde soltando bonecas de flores no rio, agora dizem ser em troca da estátua da deusa. A estátua, maior do que um bebê, alivia os fardos espirituais de quem a possuir. É de se imaginar se o amor da deusa também faz com que ela alivie as dores das bonecas de flores.
raw.th: เทศกาลแห่งฟัลวาน่ายังคงถูกลิมฉลองกันในเอลไกอา เทศกาลนี้ซึ่งดั้งเดิมมีไว้เพื่อสวดภาวนาให้มีสุขภาพดี ด้วยการใช้ตุ๊กตาที่ทำจากดอกไม้ลอยไปในแม่น้ำในปัจจุบันเพื่อใช้แทนรูปปั้นของเทพธิดานี้ รูปปั้นมีขนาดใหญ่กว่าเด็กทารก และช่วยบรรเทาภาระทางจิตวิญญาณให้กับผู้ครอบครอง ตนคนสงสัยว่าความรักของเทพธิดาทำให้ไหล่ของเธอนั้นเจ็บปวดเช่นเดียวกับตุ๊กตาดอกไม้เช่นเดียวกัน
raw.vi: Lễ hội theo phong tục của Falvana vẫn được kỷ niệm tại Elgaia. Lễ hội này, bắt nguồn từ ý định cầu nguyện để có được sức khỏe tốt bằng cách thả những con búp bê kết bằng hoa xuống sông, hiện được cho rằng được tổ chức để trao đổi lấy tượng của nữ thần này. Bức tượng, lớn hơn một đứa trẻ sơ sinh, làm giảm bớt những gánh nặng tinh thần của bất kỳ ai sở hữu nó. Người ta phải tự hỏi liệu tình yêu của nữ thần có khiến cô cũng phải gánh nỗi đau của những con búp bê hoa không.

id: Ada topi yang sampai baru-baru ini diperlukan untuk berpartisipasi dalam urusan resmi di Aula Pemanggil Akras. Aturan ini tinggal nama saja sekarang. Tapi topi ini adalah replika yang dipakai salah satu teman Pemanggil pertama saat mereka memulai perjalanan bersama. Topi asli memiliki kekuatan mengurangi beban pemakainya, tapi hilang dalam perang melawan setan.
name: MST_SPHERES_39500_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There is a hat that until very recently was required when participating in official business at the Akras Summoners' Hall. This rule exists only in name now, but the truth is that this hat is a replica of the one the companion of the first Summoner wore when they set off on their journey together. The real one had the power of abating the burdens of the wearer, but it seems that it was lost in a battle against demons.

raw.en: There is a hat that until very recently was required when participating in official business at the Akras Summoners' Hall. raw.es: Hay un gorro que hasta hace poco era necesario durante la participación de los asuntos oficiales en el Consejo de invocadores de Akras. Esta regla ahora existe solo de palabra, pero lo cierto es que este sombrero es una réplica del que el compañero del primer invocador usó cuando se embarcaron juntos en su aventura. El real tenía el poder de mitigar las cargas del portador, pero parece que se perdió en una batalla contra los demonios.

raw.pt: Há um chapéu que até pouco tempo era obrigatório ao participar de assuntos oficiais no Salão de Invocadores de Akras. Agora essa regra só existe como referência, mas a verdade é que este chapéu é uma réplica daquele que o companheiro do primeiro Invocador vestia quando eles partiram em sua jornada. O verdadeiro tinha o poder de aliviar a carga sobre o portador, mas parece que foi perdido em uma batalha contra demônios.
raw.th: มีหมวกที่เคยต้องใช้เมื่อมาติดต่องานกับสภาซัมมอนเนอร์แห่งอาคราสจนกระทั่งระยะหลังมานี่ กฎนี้เหลือแต่ไว้แต่เพียงชื่อแล้วเท่านั้น แต่ความจริงคือหมวกนี้เป็นของเลียนแบบหมวกที่หนึ่งในสหายของซัมมอนเนอร์คนแรกสวมใส่ในตอนที่พวกเขาออกเดินทางด้วยกัน ของแท้มีพลังที่จะช่วยบรรเทาภาระให้กับผู้สวมใส่  แต่ดูเหมือนว่ามันจะสูญหายไปในระหว่างการต่อสู้กับปีศาจ
raw.vi: Có một chiếc mũ mà cho đến gần đây vẫn là bắt buộc khi tham gia công việc chính thức tại Đại sảnh người triệu hồi Akaras Quy tắc này giờ chỉ còn tồn tại trên danh nghĩa, nhưng sự thật là chiếc mũ này là một bản sao của chiếc mũ mà người bạn đồng hành của Người triệu hồi đầu tiên đã đội khi họ bắt đầu hành trình của mình cùng nhau. Chiếc mũ thực có sức mạnh giảm bớt gánh nặng cho người đội, nhưng có vẻ nó đã bị thất lạc trong trận chiến chống lại ma quỷ.

id: Di kekaisaran kuno, ada jenderal yang terkenal saleh. Ia berdoa pada dewi perlindungan siang dan malam, dan bergaya hidup pendeta. Dalam perang, tentaranya percaya ia mendapat perlindungan ilahi dari si dewi, sehingga lupa capek dan bertarung sampai akhir. Sebenarnya ia tidak menerima perlindungan ilahi, tapi reputasinya sebagai pria saleh memberikan perlindungan yang sama seperti jika ia mendapat perlindungan si dewi.
name: MST_SPHERES_39600_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: In an ancient empire, there was a general who was renowned around the world as a very devout man. He prayed to the goddess of protection day and night, and is said to have lived the lifestyle of a clergyman. When in battle, his soldiers believed that he had the divine protection of the goddess, and thus forgot their fatigue and fought till the bitter end. It is believed that he never actually received this divine protection, but that his fame as a pious man created for him a protection similar to the one he would have received from the goddess.

raw.en: In an ancient empire, there was a general who was renowned around the world as a very devout man. He prayed to the goddess of protection day and night, and is said to have lived the lifestyle of a clergyman. When in battle, his soldiers believed that he had the divine protection of the goddess, and thus forgot their fatigue and fought till the bitter end. It is believed that he never actually received this divine protection, but that his fame as a pious man created for him a protection similar to the one he would have received from the goddess.
raw.es: En un antiguo imperio, había un general reconocido en todo el mundo por ser un hombre muy devoto. Oraba a la diosa de la protección día y noche, y se dice que vivió el estilo de vida de un clérigo. Durante las batallas, sus soldados creían que el hombre estaba protegido por la diosa, se olvidaban de su fatiga y luchaban hasta el amargo final. Se cree que en realidad este hombre nunca recibió dicha protección, pero que su fama como persona devota creó para sí una protección similar a lo que podría haber recibido de la diosa.
raw.id: Di kekaisaran kuno, ada jenderal yang terkenal saleh. Ia berdoa pada dewi perlindungan siang dan malam, dan bergaya hidup pendeta. Dalam perang, tentaranya percaya ia mendapat perlindungan ilahi dari si dewi, sehingga lupa capek dan bertarung sampai akhir. Sebenarnya ia tidak menerima perlindungan ilahi, tapi reputasinya sebagai pria saleh memberikan perlindungan yang sama seperti jika ia mendapat perlindungan si dewi.
raw.pt: Em um antigo império, havia um general que era conhecido no mundo inteiro como um homem muito devoto. Ele orava à deusa da proteção dia e noite e dizem que ele vivia a vida do clericato. Quando em batalha, seus soldados acreditavam que ele tinha a proteção divina da deusa, assim esquecendo sua fadiga e lutando até o derradeiro fim. Acredita-se que ele nunca recebeu mesmo essa proteção, mas que sua fama como devoto criou uma proteção similar à que ele teria recebido da deusa.
raw.th: ในจักรวรรดิโบราณ มีนายพลคนหนึ่งซึ่งเป็นที่รู้จักกันทั่วโลกในฐานะชายที่ทุ่มเทมาก เขาสวดภาวนากับเทพธิดาแห่งการคุ้มครองทั้งวันและคืน และว่ากันว่าเขาใช้ชีวิตแบบนักบวช ในการต่อสู้ ทหารของเขาเชื่อว่าเขาได้รับพลังป้องกันที่ศักดืสิทธิ์จากเทพธิดา จนทำให้พวกนั้นลืมความอ่อนล้าและสู้จนถึงที่สุด เชื่อกันว่าอันที่จริงเขาไม่เคยได้รับพลังป้องกันที่ศักดืสิทธิ์เลย แต่ชื่อเสียงของเขาในฐานะของคนเคร่งศาสนาก็สร้างการป้องกันให้กับเขาไม่ต่างจากที่ไดรับจากเทพธิดา
raw.vi: Tại một đế chế cổ đại, có một vị tướng nổi tiếng khắp thế giới là một người rất sùng đạo. Ông đã ngày đêm cầu nguyện cho nữ thần bảo vệ và được cho rằng có lối sống của một mục sư. Khi chiến đấu, binh lính của ông tin rằng ông có sự bảo vệ của nữ thần linh thiêng và do đó, quên đi mệt mỏi và chiến đấu đến cùng. Người ta tin rằng ông thực tế không bao giờ nhận được sự bảo vệ linh thiêng này, nhưng việc nổi tiếng là người sùng đạo đã tạo cho sự bảo vệ tương tự như sự bảo vệ ông sẽ nhận được từ nữ thần.

id: Di kekaisaran kuno, ada jenderal mengerikan yang dijuluki setan. Ke mana pun pasukannya pergi, mayat bergelimpangan karena mereka membakar desa-desa. Anak buahnya tidak suka kejam, tapi semakin mereka mengikuti si jenderal, akal sehat pun hilang, terus menjarah dan membantai. Jalur berdarah setelah menghancurkan musuh mendorong tentara ke perang selanjutnya.
name: MST_SPHERES_39700_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: In an ancient empire, there was a terrifying general who was called a demon. Everywhere his troops lay foot gave way for mounds of corpses as they set village after village on fire till they were reduced to ashes. His subordinates did not enjoy performing such cruel acts, but the more they continued following these orders, the more they lost their reason, plundering and slaughtering everything in their path. The bloodbath that ensued after smashing their enemies into bits drove the soldiers onto their next battle.

Everywhere his troops lay foot gave way for mounds of corpses as they set village after village on fire till they were reduced to ashes. His subordinates did not enjoy performing such cruel acts, but the more they continued following these orders, the more they lost their reason, plundering and slaughtering everything in their path. The bloodbath that ensued after smashing their enemies into bits drove the soldiers onto their next battle.
raw.es: En un antiguo imperio, había un general terrorífico que todo el mundo describía como un demonio. Sus tropas dejaban pilas y pilas de cadáveres en cualquier lugar que pisaran e incendiaban aldea tras aldea hasta dejarlas hecha cenizas. A sus subordinados no les agradaba realizar actos de tanta crueldad, pero mientras más tiempo pasaban cumpliendo estas órdenes, más se desvanecían sus espíritus, y saqueaban y asesinaban todo a su paso. El baño de sangre resultante luego de aplastar a sus enemigos en pedazos llevaba a los soldados a su siguiente batalla.
raw.id: Di kekaisaran kuno, ada jenderal mengerikan yang dijuluki setan. Ke mana pun pasukannya pergi, mayat bergelimpangan karena mereka membakar desa-desa. Anak buahnya tidak suka kejam, tapi semakin mereka mengikuti si jenderal, akal sehat pun hilang, terus menjarah dan membantai. Jalur berdarah setelah menghancurkan musuh mendorong tentara ke perang selanjutnya.
raw.pt: Em um antigo império, havia um general terrível, chamado de demônio. No caminho de suas tropas, acumulavam-se montes de corpos enquanto eles queimavam vila após vila até as cinzas. Seus subordinados não apreciavam essa crueldade, mas quanto mais seguiam as ordens, mais perdiam a razão, pilhando e chacinando tudo em seu caminho. O massacre resultante do esmagamento de seus inimigos forçava seus soldados ao próximo embate.
raw.th: ในจักรวรรดิโบราณ มีนายพลที่น่ากลัวผู้ถูกเรียกขานว่าเป็นปีศาจ ทุกๆ ที่ ที่กองทัพของเขาย่างกรายเข้าไปจะเต็มได้วยศพ ขณะที่หมู่บ้านแล้วหมู่บ้านเล่าต้องถูกเผาจนเหลือแต่กองเถ้าถ่าน ลูกน้องของเขาไม่ได้สนุกไปกับการกระทำที่โหดร้ายนี้ แต่ยิ่งพวกนั้นทำตามคำสั่งของเขามากขึ้นเท่าไหร่ พวกนั้นก็ยิ่งสูญเสียความรู้สึกผิดชอบชั่วดีมากขึ้นเท่านั้น ปล้นและสังหารทุกๆ อย่างที่ขวางทาง การได้อาบเลือดของศัตรูหลังจากที่สังหารหวกนั้นจนสิ้น ผลักดันให้ทหารเข้าสู่การต่อสู้ครั้งถัดไปเรื่อยๆ
raw.vi: Tại một đế chế cổ đại, có một vị tướng đáng sợ được gọi là một con quỷ. Bất cứ đâu, quân đội của ông đặt chân đến đều nhường chỗ cho từng đống xác chết vì họ đốt cháy hết ngôi làng này đến ngôi làng khác cho đến khi chúng biến thành tro bụi. Các cấp dưới của ông không thích thực hiện những hành động tàn ác như vậy, nhưng họ càng tiếp tục làm theo những mệnh lệnh này, họ càng mất lý trí, dẫn đến cướp bóc và giết tất cả mọi thứ trên đường đi. Việc tắm máu xảy ra sau khi đập tan kẻ thù của họ thành từng mảnh đã dẫn những người lính vào trận chiến tiếp theo của họ.

id: Kaisar wanita Lilly Matah yang ditakuti, bereputasi buruk, melahirkan seorang putri. Ketika remaja, penerusnya mengambil nama Lilly Laze, juga dikenal tirani. Melanjutkan perang budak yang dipelopori ibunya, dan punya tiara terbaut dari intan jahat terlarang. Kebrutalan pejuang yang diberi tiara ini bertambah setiap kali ia dihantam, meninggalkan jejak darah yang begitu kuat, melampaui nenek moyangnya.
name: MST_SPHERES_39800_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The fearful empress Lilly Matah, who left a bad reputation throughout history, had a daughter. When she came of age, her successor took the name of Lilly Laze, and was also known as a tyrant. She carried on with the slave war her mother had started, and had a crown made of forbidden evil jewels. The brutality of the warrior who was given this demonic crown is said to have increased whenever he was struck, leaving a stench of blood so powerful that it surpassed that of his ancestors long ago.

raw.es: La temerosa emperatriz Lilly Matah, que dejó una mala reputación a través de la historia, tenía una hija. Cuando alcanzó la mayoría de edad, su sucesora tomó el nombre de Lilly Laze, y también fue conocida como una tirana. Continuó con la guerra de esclavos que su madre había empezado y pidió que forjaran una corona hecha de joyas malignas y prohibidas. Se dice que la brutalidad del guerrero que recibió esta corona demoníaca aumentaba cuando recibía un golpe; dejaba un hedor a sangre tan poderoso que superaba al de sus ancestros de antaño.

raw.pt: A temível imperatriz Lilly Matah, que deixou uma péssima reputação na história, tinha uma filha. Quando alcançou a idade, sua sucessora tomou o nome de Lilly Laze, também sendo conhecida como tirana. Ela levou adiante a guerra escravagista de sua mãe, portando uma coroa de joias vis e proibidas. Dizem que a brutalidade do guerreiro que recebeu essa coroa demoníaca aumentou sempre que ele era atingido, deixando um fedor de sangue tão forte que superou o de seus ancestrais há eras.
raw.th: จักรพรรดินีที่น่าหวาดกลัว ลิลลี่ มาทาห์ ผู้ที่ทิ้งความฉาวโฉ่เอาไว้ในประวัติศาสตร์นั้นมีบุตรสาวอยู่หนึ่งคน เมื่อเธอมีอายุครบ ผู้สืบทอดของเธอได้ใช้ชื่อว่า ลิลลี่ แลซ และเป็นที่รู้จักกันในฐานะของทรราช  เธอดำเนินสงครามทาสที่แม่ของเธอได้เริ่มไว้ต่อไป และสวมมงกุฎที่สร้างจากอัญมณีปีศาจต้องห้าม ว่ากันว่าความโหดร้ายของนักรบที่ได้รับมอบมงกุฎปีศาจนี้จะเพิ่มขึ้นทุกครั้งที่เขาอยู่ในสถานการณ์ที่หลบเลี่ยงไม่ได้ เหลือไว้เพียงแต่ กลิ่นคาวเลือดที่แรงยิ่งกว่าที่บรรพบุรษเคยทำเอาไว้
raw.vi: Hoàng hậu đáng sợ Lilly Matah, để lại tiếng xấu trong suốt lịch sử, có một con gái. Khi cô đến tuổi trưởng thành, người kế vị của bà lấy tên là Lilly Laze, và cũng được biết đến như một bạo chúa. Cô đã tiếp tục cuộc chiến tranh nô lệ mà mẹ cô đã bắt đầu và có chiếc vương miện làm bằng những viên đá quý ác quỷ bị cấm. Sự tàn bạo của chiến binh đã được trao cho chiếc vương miện ma quỷ này được cho là sẽ tăng lên bất cứ khi nào anh ta bị đánh trúng, để lại mùi hôi thối của máu mạnh đến mức vượt hơn cả của tổ tiên anh ta xa xưa.

id:
"Dongeng Prajurit dengan Sayap Bersinar di Punggungnya"
Burung api suci, sayap bersinar - simbol keabadian dan bukti keberanian. Si burung menyelamatkan si prajurit, dan menyembuhkan ksatria cinta. Saat mengepakkan sayapnya yang terbakar, sumbu kehidupan membara. Menyamarkan jantung di dada, memegang pedang yang membenci dosa untuk melindungi api kehidupan, sekecil apa pun. Tidak peduli berapa kali dihantam jatuh, ia terus bangkit lagi dan lagi.
name: MST_SPHERES_39900_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc:
"The Tale of the Soldier with Shining Wings on his Back"
The sacred fire bird, shining wings--symbols of immortality and proof of courage. Once it rescued a gentle soldier, and again healed a knight of love. When it flutters its burning wings, its wick of life bursts into flames. Concealing a just heart in its chest, it wields a sword that detests sin in order to protect the flame of life, no matter how small it may be. Regardless of how many times it is struck to the ground, it continues to stand up again and again.

raw.es:
"La historia del soldado con alas brillantes en la espalda".
El ave de fuego sagrada, con alas resplandecientes símbolos de inmortalidad y prueba de valor. Una vez rescató a un gentil soldado y curó a un caballero de amor. Cuando bate sus alas flamígeras, su mecha de vida estalla en llamas. Con un corazón justo en el pecho, blande una espada que detesta el pecado y protege la llama de la vida, sin importar lo diminuta que sea. Ni importa cuántas veces caiga al suelo; siempre se levantará, una y otra vez.

raw.pt:
“O Conto do Soldado com Asas Brilhantes em suas Costas”
O sagrado pássaro de fogo, asas brilhantes: símbolos de imortalidade e prova de coragem. Uma vez ele resgatou um gentil soldado, outra curou um cavaleiro do amor. Com o tremular de suas asas ardentes, a chama de sua vida queima com violência. Com um coração justo em seu peito, empunha uma espada que detesta o pecado, para proteger a chama da vida, não importa o quão pequena. Independente de quantas vezes for abatido, levanta-se de novo, de novo e de novo.
raw.th:
"เรื่องเล่าของทหารที่มีปิกส่องแสงบนหลังของเขา"
ปีกแสง นกไฟศักดิ์สิทธิ์--สัญลักษณ์ของความเป็นอมตะและหลักฐานของความกล้าหาญ เมื่อมันช่วยทหารผู้สุภาพ และอีกครั้งรักษาอัศวินแห่งความรัก เมื่อมันกระพือปีกที่เผาไหม้ของมัน แสงแห่งชีวิตก็ประทุเป็นเปลวไฟ มันปกปิดแค่หัวใจอยู่ในอกของมัน มันใช้ดาบที่เกลียดชังความผิดบาปเพื่อปกป้องเปลวไฟแห่งชีวิต ไม่ว่ามัจะมีอยู่น้อยแค่ไหน แม้ว่ามันจะร่วงหล่นสู่พื้นสักกี่ครั้ง มันก็ยังคงยืนหยัดขึ้นมาครั้งแล้วครั้งเล่า
raw.vi:
"Chuyện kể về người lính có đôi cánh tỏa sáng trên lưng"
Con chim lửa linh thiêng, đôi cánh tỏa sáng--biểu tượng của sự bất tử và bằng chứng của lòng dũng cảm. Xưa kia, nó đã giải cứu một người lính hiền lành, và một lần nữa chữa lành cho hiệp sĩ tình yêu. Khi nó vẫy đôi cánh rực cháy của mình, chiếc bấc thắp ngọn lửa cuộc sống của nó bùng cháy. Che giấu một trái tim duy nhất trong lồng ngực, nó cầm một thanh kiếm căm ghét tội ác để bảo vệ ngọn lửa cuộc sống, bất kể nó có nhỏ nhoi đến đâu. Cho dù nó bị quật ngã bao nhiêu lần, nó lại tiếp tục đứng dậy hết lần này đến lần khác.

id: Mesin yang tertinggal di peti harta karun Kerajaan Sama, menunjukkan tanda-tanda ditingkatkan. Akan membakar hati siapa pun yang memasangnya, sehingga ingin terus bersemangat berperang. Mesin ini ditingkatkan dengan desain yang tidak sepenuhnya dipahami, masih misteri. Dipercaya, mungkin para pembangunnya waktu itu merasa belum selesai dan terus menambahi sesuatu, sehingga penampilannya begitu.
name: MST_SPHERES_40000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A machine that was left in a treasure box of the Sama Kingdom, which shows signs of being upgraded. It would fire up the heart of whomever equipped it, making his desire to fight boil endlessly with excitement. However, how this machine came to be upgraded even though its design wasn't fully understood, still remains a mystery. It is believed that perhaps the people building it at the time thought it incomplete and kept adding to it, giving the appearance of having been upgraded.

raw.es: Una máquina que quedó en una caja de tesoros del reino de Sama y que muestra signos de haber sido mejorada. Solía resplandecer el corazón de quien se la equipaba, y hacía que sus deseos de lucha fueran infinitos. Sin embargo, todavía sigue siendo un misterio cómo se mejoró la máquina si su diseño no se comprendía por completo. Se cree que, tal vez, la gente que antaño la construyó pensó que estaba incompleta, le siguieron haciendo modificaciones y terminaron dándole la apariencia de haber sido mejorada.

raw.pt: Uma máquina que foi deixada em uma caixa de tesouro no Reino de Sama, que mostra sinais de ter sido melhorada. Ela incendiaria o coração de quem a equipasse, fazendo sua vontade de lutar ferver emocionadamente, sem fim. Porém ainda é um mistério como essa máquina foi aprimorada, mesmo com seu projeto não sendo compreendido por completo. Acredita-se que talvez as pessoas que a construíram acharam que ela estivesse incompleta e continuassem adicionando, dando a aparência atual.
raw.th: เครื่องจักรที่ถูกทิ้งไว้ในกล่องสมบัติของราชอาณาจักรซามะ แสดงให้เห็นสัญลักษณ์ของการได้รับการพัฒนา มันจะจุดไฟให้ลุกโชนในจิตใจของใครก็ตามที่สวมใส่มัน ทำให้ความต้องการที่จะต่อสู้ของเขาเดือดพล่านและตื่นเต้น แต่อย่างไรก็ตามวิธีการที่เครื่องจักรนี้ถูกพัฒนาโดยการออกแบบยังไม่เป็นที่เข้าใจอย่างเต็มที่ และยังคงเป็นปริศนา ซึ่งเชื่อว่าบางทีผู้ที่สร้างมันขึ้นมา อาจสร้างมันยังไม่สมบูรณ์และยังคงเติมแต่งมันไปเรื่อยๆ ทำให้มันมีรูปร่างเหมือนได้รับการพัฒนาแล้ว
raw.vi: Một cỗ máy được để lại trong hộp báu vật của Vương quốc Sama, cho thấy những dấu hiệu được nâng cấp. Nó sẽ làm trái tim của người trang bị nó giận giữ, khiến người đó mong muốn chiến đấu sôi sục không ngừng với sự phấn khích. Tuy nhiên, cỗ máy này được nâng cấp như thế nào ngay cả khi thiết kế của nó không được hiệu đầy đủ, vẫn là một bí ẩn. Người ta tin rằng những người tạo ra nó ở thời điểm đó nghĩ nó chưa hoàn tất và vẫn tiếp tục bổ sung thêm cho nó nên nó có vẻ đã được nâng cấp.

id: Harta karun dari Republik La Veda yang ditingkatkan. Teknik peningkatannya tidak diketahui tapi hasilnya dicatat secara detail. Yang memasang mesin ini di jantung akan merangsang kenikmatan dari bertarung di medan perang, mempercepat pemulihan fisik. Tercatat, beberapa pemakainya juga mengamuk, seperti beast dirasuki bulan.
name: MST_SPHERES_40100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A treasure from the lost La Veda Republic that was upgraded. The techniques used to upgrade it are unknown, but their results were recorded in detail. One would equip this machine on the heart, stimulating the pleasure gained from battling on the field, and promoting physical recovery. It is also recorded that some of the wearers of this treasure went berserk, like a beast possessed by the moon.

raw.es: Un tesoro de la antigua república de La Veda que fue mejorado. Las técnicas usadas para su mejora se desconocen, pero los resultados fueron anotados detalladamente. Uno se equipaba esta máquina en el corazón y simulaba el placer de la lucha dentro del campo de batalla, lo que daba como resultado una pronta recuperación física. También se dejó asentado que algunos de los usuarios de este tesoro enloquecieron y se comenzaron a comportar como si fueran bestias poseídas por la luna.
