raw.pt: Um tesouro da República de La Veda que foi aprimorada. As técnicas usadas para aprimorá-la são desconhecidos, mas seus resultados foram registrados em detalhes. Ela era equipada no coração, estimulando o prazer de estar em batalha e melhorando a recuperação física. Também dizem que alguns dos portadores ficavam enlouquecidos, como uma besta possuída pela lua.
raw.th: สมบัติที่หายไปจากสาธารณรัฐลาวีดาที่ได้รับการอัพเกรด เทคนิคที่ใช้ในการอัพเกรดมันไม่เป็นที่รู้จัก แต่ผลของพวกมันถูกบันทึกไว้ในรายละเอียด หนึ่งในนั้นสวมเครื่องนี้ที่หัวใจ เพื่อกระตุ้นความสุขที่ได้จากการต่อสู้ในสนามรบและส่งเสริมการฟื้นตัวทางกายภาพ และมันยังมีบันทึกไว้อีกว่าผู้สวมใส่สมบัติชิ้นนี้ได้คุ้มคลั่ง เหมือนกับสัตว์ร้ายที่ถูกครอบงำโดยดวงจันทร์
raw.vi: Một vật báu từ nước Cộng hòa La Veda bị vùi lấp đã được nâng cấp. Các kỹ thuật được sử dụng để nâng cấp nó chưa được xác định, nhưng kết quả thì được ghi lại chi tiết. Người ta trang bị máy này vào tim, làm kích thích niềm vui có được từ chiến đấu trên chiến trường và thúc đẩy phục hồi thể lực. Cũng có ghi chép lại rằng một số người mang vật báu này bị nổi điên, giống như con quái vật bị ám ảnh bởi mặt trăng.

id: Batu Jahat artifisial dibuat untuk melampaui kekuatan batu asli. Prosesnya sukses, batunya lebih kuat dari yang asli, meski periset penciptanya jadi tersihir. Ia tidak menganggap eksperimennya berbahaya, jadi dia tidak mengumumkan detailnya. Setelahnya, Batu Jahat pecah berkeping-keping, dan membawa bencana terus-menerus.
name: MST_SPHERES_40200_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: An artificial Evil Stone created in order to surpass the power of the original. The process was successful, and the resulting stone was more powerful than its original, though the researcher who had created it became mesmerized by it. He didn't regard this experiment he conducted as particularly dangerous, and so he didn't make any details public. Afterwards, the Evil Stone broke into pieces, and its shards are said to have brought continuous calamity about.

raw.en: An artificial Evil Stone created in order to surpass the power of the original. The process was successful, and the resulting stone was more powerful than its original, though the researcher who had created it became mesmerized by it. He didn't regard this experiment he conducted as particularly dangerous, and so he didn't make any details public. Afterwards, the Evil Stone broke into pieces, and its shards are said to have brought continuous calamity about.
raw.es: Una Roca vil artificial creada para superar el poder de la original. El proceso fue un éxito, y la roca resultante era más poderosa que la original, a pesar de que el investigador que la creó quedó hipnotizado por ella. No consideró que el experimento que había llevado a cabo era particularmente peligroso, por lo que no publicó ningún detalle. Luego, la Roca vil explotó. Se dice que sus fragmentos han dado fruto a continuas calamidades en todo el mundo.
raw.id: Batu Jahat artifisial dibuat untuk melampaui kekuatan batu asli. Prosesnya sukses, batunya lebih kuat dari yang asli, meski periset penciptanya jadi tersihir. Ia tidak menganggap eksperimennya berbahaya, jadi dia tidak mengumumkan detailnya. Setelahnya, Batu Jahat pecah berkeping-keping, dan membawa bencana terus-menerus.
raw.pt: Uma Pedra do Mal criada para superar o poder da original. O processo foi bem-sucedido e o resultado foi uma pedra muito mais poderosa do que a original, embora o pesquisador que a criou tenha ficado hipnotizado por ela. Ele não considerou o experimento particularmente perigoso, então não tornou nenhum detalhe público. Depois, a Pedra do Mal quebrou em pedaços. Dizem que seus fragmentos espalharam calamidades constantes.
raw.th: หินเทียมชั่วร้ายสร้างขึ้นเพื่อให้มีพลังมากขึ้นกว่าของแท้ดั้งเดิม ขั้นตอนประสบความสำเร็จและหินที่ได้รับนั้นมีประสิทธิภาพมากขึ้นกว่าเดิม แต่นักวิจัยที่ได้สร้างมันขึ้นมาลุ่มหลงไปกับมัน เขาไม่ได้มองว่าการทดลองที่เขาสร้างขึ้นมานั้นอันตราย และด้วยเหตุนั้นเขาก็เลยไม่ได้เผยแพร่รายละเอียดใดๆ สู่สาธารณะ หลังจากหินปีศาจได้แตกออกเป็นชิ้นๆ และเศษของมันได้นำพาภัยพิบัติมาอย่างต่อเนื่อง
raw.vi: Viên Đá quỷ nhân tạo được tạo ra để vượt qua sức mạnh của bản gốc. Quá trình này đã thành công và viên đá tạo thành mạnh hơn nhiều so với bản gốc, mặc dù người nghiên cứu tạo ra nó đã bị mê hoặc bởi nó. Anh không coi thí nghiệm mình đã tiến hành là nguy hiểm đặc biệt và vì vậy, anh không công khai bất kỳ chi tiết nào. Sau đó, viên Đá quỷ bị vỡ thành từng mảnh và tương truyền rằng những mảnh vỡ của nó tiếp tục reo rắc tai họa.

id: Ada gadis muda yang mengibarkan Bendera Dewa. Ia mengikuti praktik dewa ini dan melawan siapa pun yang melawannya. Saat si dewa unjuk gigi, si gadis juga akan mengibarkan panjinya. Saat itu, kekuatan si dewa akan pulih sekaligus. Rambut dan zirah si gadis dihiasi bunga amat cantik yang takkan layu, belum pernah dilihat manusia.
name: MST_SPHERES_40300_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There was a young maiden who raised the God Flag. She followed the practice of this god and fought anyone who opposed him. When the god exercised his power, she would wave the banner as well. It is said that when she did so, the god would recover all of his power in one shot. Her hair and armor were decorated with incredibly beautiful flowers that no human had ever seen before, and which never withered.

raw.en: There was a young maiden who raised the God Flag. She followed the practice of this god and fought anyone who opposed him. When the god exercised his power, she would wave the banner as well. It is said that when she did so, the god would recover all of his power in one shot. Her hair and armor were decorated with incredibly beautiful flowers that no human had ever seen before, and which never withered.
raw.es: Antaño, el dios Flag crio a una joven doncella. La joven seguía las costumbres de este dios y luchaba contra cualquiera que se le opusiera. Cuando el dios ejercía su poder, ella llevaba el estandarte. Se dice que cuando ella hacía esto, el dios recuperaba todo su poder rápidamente. El cabello y la armadura de la joven estaban decorados con flores que nunca se marchitaban y de una belleza como ningún humano había visto.
raw.id: Ada gadis muda yang mengibarkan Bendera Dewa. Ia mengikuti praktik dewa ini dan melawan siapa pun yang melawannya. Saat si dewa unjuk gigi, si gadis juga akan mengibarkan panjinya. Saat itu, kekuatan si dewa akan pulih sekaligus. Rambut dan zirah si gadis dihiasi bunga amat cantik yang takkan layu, belum pernah dilihat manusia.
raw.pt: Houve uma jovem que ergueu a bandeira dos deuses. Ela seguia as doutrinas deste deus e lutou contra qualquer que se opunha. Quando o deus executava seu poder, ela sacudia a bandeira. Dizem que quando ela o fazia, o deus recuperava todo seu poder de uma vez. Seu cabelo e armadura eram decorados com belas flores que humano algum havia visto antes, e que nunca murchavam.
raw.th: มีเด็กสาวที่ชูธงของเทพเจ้า เธอตามรอยคำสั่งของเทพเจ้าองค์นี้และต่อสู้กับทุกคนที่ต่อต้านพระองค์ เมื่อเทพเจ้าใช้อำนาจของตนเธอก็จะโบกสะบัดธงเช่นเดียวกัน ว่ากันว่าเมื่อเธอทำเช่นนั้นเทพเจ้าจะฟื้นฟูพลังของตนทั้งหมดในครั้ง ผมและชุดเกราะของเธอถูกตกแต่งด้วยดอกไม้ที่สวยงามที่ไม่มีมนุษย์เคยเห็นมาก่อนและมันไม่เคยเหี่ยวเฉา
raw.vi: Có một thánh nữ trẻ tuổi đã giơ cao ngọn Cờ thần thánh. Cô đã thực hiện theo mưu đồ của vị thần này và chiến đấu với bất kỳ ai chống lại thần. Khi vị thần này sử dụng sức mạnh của mình, cô cũng vẫy biểu ngữ. Người ta nói rằng khi cô làm như vậy, vị thần này sẽ phục hồi lại toàn bộ sức mạnh ngay lập tức. Mái tóc và áo giáp của cô được trang trí bằng những bông hoa tuyệt đẹp mà không con người nào từng thấy trước đó và không bao giờ khô héo.

id: Ada legenda di Gaia Besar tentang 9 Harta Karun rahasia yang amat kuat. Tidak diketahui dari mana asalnya dan siapa penciptanya. Saat namanya muncul, diyakin sesuatu yang besar akan terjadi. Quatre Marinus, nama yang disebutkan dalam sejarah kelahiran Ibu Kota Kerajaan Randall. Di sampingnya tertulis "pedang ini tidak boleh melihat terangnya siang lagi."
name: MST_SPHERES_40400_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There is a legend in Grand Gaia from long ago that tells of Nine Sacred Treasures which hold immense power. It is completely unknown where these treasures came from and who created them. However, when their names are mentioned, one can be certain that something amazing is bound to happen. The Sacred Gem Quatre Marinus is a name mentioned in the annals of the birth of the Imperial Capital of Randall, with an inscription next to it that reads "this sword should never see the light of day again."

raw.en: There is a legend in Grand Gaia from long ago that tells of Nine Sacred Treasures which hold immense power. It is completely unknown where these treasures came from and who created them. However, when their names are mentioned, one can be certain that something amazing is bound to happen. The Sacred Gem Quatre Marinus is a name mentioned in the annals of the birth of the Imperial Capital of Randall, with an inscription next to it that reads "this sword should never see the light of day again."
raw.es: En Gran Gaia existía una leyenda que hablaba sobre nueve tesoros sagrados que contenían un poder inmenso. Nadie sabía de dónde habían salido los tesoros o quién los había creado. Sin embargo, cuando se los nombra, está claro que algo grandioso ocurrirá. Quatre Marinus, un nombre que se menciona en los anales del nacimiento de la Capital imperial de Randall. Junto a él se lee la leyenda "Esta espada nunca debería salir a la luz otra vez".
raw.id: Ada legenda di Gaia Besar tentang 9 Harta Karun rahasia yang amat kuat. Tidak diketahui dari mana asalnya dan siapa penciptanya. Saat namanya muncul, diyakin sesuatu yang besar akan terjadi. Quatre Marinus, nama yang disebutkan dalam sejarah kelahiran Ibu Kota Kerajaan Randall. Di sampingnya tertulis "pedang ini tidak boleh melihat terangnya siang lagi."
raw.pt: Houve uma lenda em Grand Gaia sobre nove Tesouros Sagrados que possuem poderes imensos. Não se sabe se de onde esses tesouros vieram e quem os criou. Porém, quando seus nomes aparecem, pode-se ter certeza de que algo enorme vai acontecer. Quatre Marinus, um nome mencionado nos anais do nascimento da Capital Imperial de Randall. Ao lado do nome, “essa espada nunca deveria ver a luz do dia novamente.”
raw.th: มีตำนานทิ้งไว้เบื้องหลังในแกรนด์ไกอา เกี่ยวกับสมบัติศักดิ์สิทธิ์ทั้งเก้าที่มีพลังอำนาจอันยิ่งใหญ่ ไม่มีใครรู้ว่าสมบัติเหล่านี้มาจากที่ใดและใครเป็นผู้สร้างพวกมัน อย่าไรก็ตามเมื่อชื่อของพวกมันปรากฏขึ้น สิ่งหนึ่งซึ่งแน่นอนว่าบางสิ่งที่ใหญ่โตกำลังจะเกิดขึ้น ควอเตอร์ มารินัส เป็นชื่อที่ถูกกล่าวถึงในประวัติศาสตร์การกำเนิดของเมืองหลวงแห่งจักรวรรดิแรนดัล ด้านข้างของมันมีข้อความเขียนเอาไว้ว่า "ดาบนี้ไม่ควรเห็นแสงเดือนแสงตะวันอีกครั้ง".
raw.vi: Đã có một huyền thoại đằng sau tại Grand Gaia về chín Báu vật linh thiêng nắm giữ sức mạnh to lớn. Người ta hoàn toàn không biết những vật báu này đến từ đâu và ai tạo ra chúng. Tuy nhiên, khi tên của chúng được nêu ra, người ta có thể chắc chắn rằng có điều gì đó rất lớn sẽ xảy ra. Quatre Marinus, cái tên được nhắc đến trong biên niên sử về sự ra đời của Thủ đô nguy nga Randall. Bên cạnh nó có viết "thanh kiếm này sẽ không bao giờ thấy lại ánh sáng ban ngày."

id:
"Bodohnya! Apa kau mau menyerahkan hidupmu untuk sekantung kecil perubahan? Harta karun yang seharusnya kaulindungi ada di tempat lain, kan?"

(Cuplikan dari Bab 1, Bagian 2 "Petualangan Maling Ksatria Zelnite dan Putri si Ningrat Penipu!")
name: MST_SPHERES_40500_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc:
"How stupid! Are you going to give up your life for a little pocket change? The treasure that you should really be protecting is somewhere else, isn't it?"

(An excerpt from Chapter 1, Section 2 of "The Adventures of the Chivalrous Thief Zelnite and the Princess of the Wind")

raw.en:
"How stupid! Are you going to give up your life for a little pocket change? The treasure that you should really be protecting is somewhere else, isn't it?"

(An excerpt from Chapter 1, Section 2 of "The Adventures of the Chivalrous Thief Zelnite and the Princess of the Wind")
raw.es:
"¡Qué estúpido! ¿Vas a renunciar a tu vida por unas simples monedas? El tesoro que deberías estar protegiendo está en otro lado, ¿no es cierto?".

(Extracto del capítulo 1, sección 2 de "Las aventuras del magnánimo ladrón Zelnit y la impostora de la hija del noble").
raw.id:
"Bodohnya! Apa kau mau menyerahkan hidupmu untuk sekantung kecil perubahan? Harta karun yang seharusnya kaulindungi ada di tempat lain, kan?"

(Cuplikan dari Bab 1, Bagian 2 "Petualangan Maling Ksatria Zelnite dan Putri si Ningrat Penipu!")
raw.pt:
“Que estupidez! Vai perder a vida por uns trocados? O tesouro que você deveria estar protegendo está em outro lugar, né?”

(Um trecho da seção 2, capítulo 1 de “As Aventuras do Nobre Ladrão Zelnite e a Filha do Impostor Nobre!")
raw.th: โง่จริง! เจ้าจะเสี่ยงชีวิตของตนเพื่อเศษเงินในกระเป๋าเนี่ยนะ ? สมบัติที่เจ้าควรจะปกป้องนั้นอยู่ที่อื่นไม่ใช่รึไง (ตัดตอนมาจากบทที่ 1 ย่อหน้าที่ 2 ของ "การผจญภัยของเซลไนท์จอมโจรผู้กล้าหาญ และลูกสาวของขุนนางตัวปลอม!")
raw.vi:
"Thật ngu ngốc! Ngươi định bỏ mạng vì ít tiền lẻ trong cái túi nhỏ này sao? Kho báu mà ngươi thực sự nên bảo vệ nằm ở đâu đó, phải không?"

(Một đoạn trích từ Chương 1, phần 2 của của "Những cuộc phiêu lưu của kẻ trộm hào hiệp Zelnite!")

id:
Aku bertanya kepadamu.
"Jika perang melahirkan kebencian, mengapa berlanjut tanpa akhir?"
Aku menantangmu.
"Jika cinta melahirkan kebencian, mengapa kita berharap keabadian cinta?"
name: MST_SPHERES_40600_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc:
I ask you.
"If war gives birth to hatred, why does it continue without end?"
I challenge you.
"If love gives birth to hatred, why do we hope for an eternity of it?"

raw.en:
I ask you.
"If war gives birth to hatred, why does it continue without end?"
I challenge you.
"If love gives birth to hatred, why do we hope for an eternity of it?"
raw.es:
Te pregunto.
"Si la guerra da lugar al odio, ¿por qué continúa sin cesar?".
Te desafío.
"Si el amor da lugar al odio, ¿por qué deseamos que dure una eternidad".
raw.id:
Aku bertanya kepadamu.
"Jika perang melahirkan kebencian, mengapa berlanjut tanpa akhir?"
Aku menantangmu.
"Jika cinta melahirkan kebencian, mengapa kita berharap keabadian cinta?"
raw.pt:
Eu te pergunto.
”Se a guerra dá luz ao ódio, porque ela continua sem fim?”
Eu te desafio.
”Se o amor dá luz ao ódio, porque desejamos uma eternidade dele?”
raw.th:
ข้าถามเจ้า
"ถ้าสงครามให้กำเนิดความเกลียดชัง แล้วทำไมมันถึงยังดำเนินต่อไปไม่จบสิ้น?"
ข้าขอท้าทายเจ้า
"ถ้าความรักให้กำเนิดความเกลียดชัง แล้วทำไมพวกเราถึงยังหวังจะมีมันไว้ตลอดกาล?"
raw.vi:
Ta hỏi ngươi.
"Nếu chiến tranh sinh ra hận thù, tại sao nó tiếp tục mà không kết thúc?"
Ta đố ngươi.
"Nếu tình yêu sinh ra hận thù, tại sao chúng ta hy vọng nó tồn tại vĩnh viễn?"

id: Senjata pertama yang muncul dari satu dewa saat dipotong dalam perang para dewa. Mirip dengan pedang dari dunia lain, dipegang oleh prajurit tanpa nama dari Gaia Besar. Dipercaya adalah karya pandai besi legendaris Masamune, tapi asalnya masih tidak jelas. Saat menyerang, jiwa si pemilik pedang tersublimasi, mengeluarkan serangan ledakan langsung. Ini menyebabkan keletihan sehingga tidak mungkin memperpanjang pertarungan.
name: MST_SPHERES_40700_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The first weapon to spring from a god as it was cut down during the battle of the gods. Resembling a sword from another world, it was wielded by a nameless soldier from Grand Gaia. It is believed to be the work of the legendary blacksmith Masamune, but its origin is still unclear. When attacking, the soul of the owner of the blade sublimates, releasing an explosive strike in an instant. However, this causes severe exhaustion that makes it impossible to draw-out a fight.

raw.en: The first weapon to spring from a god as it was cut down during the battle of the gods. Resembling a sword from another world, it was wielded by a nameless soldier from Grand Gaia. It is believed to be the work of the legendary blacksmith Masamune, but its origin is still unclear. When attacking, the soul of the owner of the blade sublimates, releasing an explosive strike in an instant. However, this causes severe exhaustion that makes it impossible to draw-out a fight.
raw.es: La primer arma que cayó de los brazos de un dios cuando lo derribaron durante la gran batalla. Tiene la apariencia de ser de otro mundo. La blandía un soldado sin nombre de Gran Gaia. Se cree que es obra del legendario herrero Masamune, pero su origen todavía no es claro. Al atacar, el alma del dueño de la espada se sublima y libera un golpe explosivo en un instante. Sin embargo, esto causa una severa fatiga que impide seguir con la lucha.
raw.id: Senjata pertama yang muncul dari satu dewa saat dipotong dalam perang para dewa. Mirip dengan pedang dari dunia lain, dipegang oleh prajurit tanpa nama dari Gaia Besar. Dipercaya adalah karya pandai besi legendaris Masamune, tapi asalnya masih tidak jelas. Saat menyerang, jiwa si pemilik pedang tersublimasi, mengeluarkan serangan ledakan langsung. Ini menyebabkan keletihan sehingga tidak mungkin memperpanjang pertarungan.
raw.pt: A primeira arma a surgir de um deus quando ele foi abatido durante a batalha. Semelhante a uma espada de outro mundo, foi empunhada por um soldado sem nome de Grand Gaia. Acredita-se que seja o trabalho do lendário ferreiro Masamune, mas suas origens são incertas. Ao atacar, a alma do proprietário da lâmina sublima, liberando um ataque explosivo em um instante. Porém, isso causa exaustão severa que torna impossível estender uma luta.
raw.th: อาวุธแรกที่หลุดมาจากเทพเจ้าในขณะที่มันถูกตัดลงในระหว่างการต่อสู้ของเหล่าทวยเทพ มีรูปร่างคล้ายกับดาบจากอีกโลกหนึ่ง มันถูกใช้โดยทหารนิรนามจากแกรนด์ไกอา มีความเชื่อกันว่าเป็นผลงานของช่างตีเหล็กในตำนานมาซามุเนะ แต่กระนั้นต้นกำเนิดของมันก็ยังไม่ชัดเจน เมื่อโจมตี วิญญาณของเจ้าดาบก็จะระเหิดและปล่อยการระเบิดโจมตีในทันที อย่างไรก็ตามสิ่งนี้จะทำให้เกิดความอ่อนล้าอย่างรุนแรงที่ทำให้ไม่สามารถสู้ต่อไปได้อีก
raw.vi: Vũ khí đầu tiên bật ra từ một vị thần khi nó bị chặt trong trận chiến của các vị thần. Giống như một thanh kiếm đến từ thế giới khác, nó được sử dụng bởi một người lính vô danh đến từ Grand Gaia. Nó được cho là tác phẩm của thợ rèn huyền thoại Masamune, nhưng nguồn gốc của nó vẫn chưa rõ ràng. Khi tấn công, linh hồn của chủ sở hữu lưỡi kiếm sẽ thăng hoa, phát ra một đòn bùng nổ trong chốc lát. Tuy nhiên, điều này gây ra tình trạng kiệt sức nghiêm trong khiến không thể kéo dài trận chiến.

id: Ada tanaman yang memekarkan bunga yang sangat glamor. Anting yang meniru bentuk bunga ini sangat populer, dari bahan kayu murahan sampai permata berharga seperti rubi. Ada satu yang terbuat dari Batu Jahat, batu sial yang membawa bencana, dan bercampur dengan yang lain. Pemakai anting ini akan sangat jahat dan akan terus menyudutkan siapa pun yang dianggap musuh.
name: MST_SPHERES_40800_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There is a plant that blooms a very glamorous flower. Earrings that mimicked the shape of this flower became very popular, ranging from cheap wooden pieces to those made out of precious jewels, such as rubies. However, among these was a single stud made of Evil Stone, an unlucky stone which brought about calamity, that got mixed in with the rest. The person who wears this stud is said to display great evil, and will continue cornering whomever that person has deemed an enemy.

raw.en: There is a plant that blooms a very glamorous flower. Earrings that mimicked the shape of this flower became very popular, ranging from cheap wooden pieces to those made out of precious jewels, such as rubies. However, among these was a single stud made of Evil Stone, an unlucky stone which brought about calamity, that got mixed in with the rest. The person who wears this stud is said to display great evil, and will continue cornering whomever that person has deemed an enemy.
raw.es: Existe una planta que da unas flores muy glamorosas. Los aretes que copiaban la forma de esta flor se hicieron muy populares. Había desde aros creados con madera barata hasta con piedras preciosas como rubíes. Sin embargo, entre todos estos había un broche creado a partir de una Roca vil, una piedra que traía la mala fortuna y la calamidad, que se mezcló entre el resto. Se dice que la persona que lleva este broche es presa de la maldad y no dejará de amenazar a todos los que considere enemigos.
raw.id: Ada tanaman yang memekarkan bunga yang sangat glamor. Anting yang meniru bentuk bunga ini sangat populer, dari bahan kayu murahan sampai permata berharga seperti rubi. Ada satu yang terbuat dari Batu Jahat, batu sial yang membawa bencana, dan bercampur dengan yang lain. Pemakai anting ini akan sangat jahat dan akan terus menyudutkan siapa pun yang dianggap musuh.
raw.pt: Há uma planta que gera uma flor glamurosa. Brincos que imitam a forma dessa flor se tornaram populares, indo de peças baratas de madeira àquelas feitas com joias preciosas como rubis. Porém, dentre estes estava um único brinco feito de Pedra do Mal, uma pedra maldita que traz a calamidade e se misturou ao resto. A pessoa que usar esse brinco demonstra muito mal e vai continuar encurralando quem for que essa pessoa considerar um inimigo.
raw.th: มีพืชที่เบ่งบานและเป็นดอกไม้ที่มีเสน่ห์มาก ต่างหูที่เลียนแบบรูปทรงของดอกไม้นี้เป็นที่นิยมมาก ตั้งแต่งานชิ้นไม้ราคาถูกจนถึงพวกที่ทำจากอัญมณีล้ำค่าเช่นทับทิม อย่างไรก็ตามในของเหล่านี้ยังมีต่างหูอันหนึ่งที่ทำจากหินปีศาจ หินโชคร้ายที่นำมาซึ่งความหายนะที่ปนไปกับต่างหูทั้งหมด คนที่สวมใส่ต่างหูนี้ว่ากันว่าจะแสดงความชั่วร้ายอย่างใหญ่หลวง และยังทำให้คนที่มองเห็นว่าเป็นศัตรูนั้นจนตรอกอย่างไม่มีที่สิ้นสุด
raw.vi: Có một cái cây nở ra một bông hoa rất quyến rũ. Hoa tai bắt chước hình dáng của bông hoa này trở nên rất phổ biến, từ những mẩu gỗ giá rẻ cho đến những bông hoa tai làm bằng đá quý, như rubi. Tuy nhiên, trong số đó có một món trang sức duy nhất làm bằng Đá quỷ, một viên đá không may mắn sẽ mang lại tai họa, bị trộn lẫn trong số đồ trang sức còn lại. Tương truyền rằng những người đeo bông hoa tai này sẽ thể hiện cho cái ác và sẽ tiếp tục dồn bất kỳ ai người này cho là kẻ thù vào chân tường.

id: Di masa muda, satu tetua Pemanggil menemukan topi ini di puing para dewa. Topi berkekuatan melepaskan sebagian beban sebagai Pemanggil. Artefak asli katanya telah jatuh ke kawah saat si Pemanggil menghindari serangan dalam perang di dekat gunung berapi. Si tetua sangat menyesal kehilangan topi itu sehingga menjadikannya bagian dari seragam Aula Pemanggil.
name: MST_SPHERES_40900_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: In his younger days, an elder Summoner found this hat in the ruins of the gods, which has the power to relieve some of the burden as a Summoner. The real artifact is said to have fallen into a crater as the Summoner dodged an attack during a battle that took place by a volcano. The elder still regrets losing the hat so much that he made it a part of the Summoner's Hall uniform.

raw.en: In his younger days, an elder Summoner found this hat in the ruins of the gods, which has the power to relieve some of the burden as a Summoner. The real artifact is said to have fallen into a crater as the Summoner dodged an attack during a battle that took place by a volcano. The elder still regrets losing the hat so much that he made it a part of the Summoner's Hall uniform.
raw.es: Durante sus días mozos, un invocador ancestral encontró este sombrero en las ruinas de los dioses. Esta prenda tenía el poder de liberar a los invocadores de sus obligaciones. Se dice que el artefacto real cayó en un cráter cuando el invocador esquivó un ataque durante una batalla que tuvo lugar cerca de un volcán. El ancestro todavía se lamenta tanto haber perdido el sombrero que lo ha convertido en pieza del uniforme del Consejo de invocadores.
raw.id: Di masa muda, satu tetua Pemanggil menemukan topi ini di puing para dewa. Topi berkekuatan melepaskan sebagian beban sebagai Pemanggil. Artefak asli katanya telah jatuh ke kawah saat si Pemanggil menghindari serangan dalam perang di dekat gunung berapi. Si tetua sangat menyesal kehilangan topi itu sehingga menjadikannya bagian dari seragam Aula Pemanggil.
raw.pt: Em seus dias de juventude, um velho Invocador encontrou este chapéu nas ruínas dos deuses, que tem o poder de aliviar parte do fardo como Invocador. Dizem que o verdadeiro artefato caiu em uma cratera quando o Invocador desviou um ataque durante uma batalha em um vulcão. O ancião ainda se arrepende tanto de ter perdido o chapéu que fez dele parte do uniforme do Salão de Invocadores.
raw.th: ในช่วงวัยหนุ่มของเขา ผู้เฒ่าซัมมอนเนอร์ได้พบหมวกนี้ยู่ในซากปรักหักพังของเทพเจ้า ซึ่งมีอำนาจในการบรรเทาภาระในฐานะซัมมอนเนอร์ ว่ากันว่าสิ่งประดิษฐ์ของแท้นั้นได้ตกไปอยู่ในมือของผู้สร้าง ขณะที่ซัมมอนเนอร์หลบหลีกการโจมตีในระหว่างสงครามที่เกิดขึ้นตรงสถานที่ใกล้กับภูเขาไฟ ผู้เฒ่ายังคงรู้สึกเสียดายกับการสูญเสียหมวกเป็นอย่างมาก จนถึงขั้นทำมันให้เป็นส่วนหนึ่งของเครื่องแบบที่ใช้ในสภาซัมมอนเนอร์
raw.vi: Khi còn trẻ, Người triệu hồi trưởng lão tìm thấy chiếc mũa này trong đống tàn tích của các vị thần, nó có sức mạnh làm giảm bớt gánh nặng của Người triệu hồi. Chiếc mũ thật được cho rằng đã rơi vào miệng núi lửa khi Người triệu hồi lẩn tránh cuộc tấn công trong trận chiến diễn ra cạnh một ngọn núi lửa. Trưởng lão vẫn còn tiếc chiếc mũ đã mất rất nhiều nên ông đã biến nó thành một phần đồng phục của Đại sảnh người triệu hồi.

id: Sesaat sebelum perang dengan para dewa, ada penari tanpa nama yang menampilkan tarian aneh. Katanya, penari ini menampilkan tarian pedang dengan terampil. Ia sedang mencari seseorang. Suatu hari, salah satu gelang kakinya tertinggal di kota yang ia kunjungi. Penemu gelang kaki ini bisa menirukan tarian pedang si penari.
name: MST_SPHERES_41000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A little before the war with the gods happened, there was nameless dancer who performed a very particular dance. It is said that this dancer, who performed the sword dance skillfully, was on a journey to find someone. One time, that dancer forgot one of her anklets in a town she had visited. It is said that the person who found this anklet could imitate the same sword dance the dancer had been seen performing.

raw.en: A little before the war with the gods happened, there was nameless dancer who performed a very particular dance. It is said that this dancer, who performed the sword dance skillfully, was on a journey to find someone. One time, that dancer forgot one of her anklets in a town she had visited. It is said that the person who found this anklet could imitate the same sword dance the dancer had been seen performing.
raw.es: Un poco antes de que se diera la batalla contra los dioses, existió una bailarina sin nombre que danzaba de una forma muy particular. Se dice que esta bailarina, que realizaba la danza de la espada con mucha pericia, estaba en busca de alguien. En una oportunidad, la bailarina se olvidó una de sus ajorcas en una ciudad que había visitado. Cuentan que la persona que encontró esta ajorca podía imitar la danza de la espada que había visto realizar a la bailarina.
raw.id: Sesaat sebelum perang dengan para dewa, ada penari tanpa nama yang menampilkan tarian aneh. Katanya, penari ini menampilkan tarian pedang dengan terampil. Ia sedang mencari seseorang. Suatu hari, salah satu gelang kakinya tertinggal di kota yang ia kunjungi. Penemu gelang kaki ini bisa menirukan tarian pedang si penari.
raw.pt: Um pouco antes da guerra com os deuses, houve uma dançarina sem nome que fazia uma dança peculiar. Dizem que ela, que executava a dança da espada com habilidade, estava em uma jornada em busca de alguém. Uma vez, ela esqueceu uma de suas tornozeleiras em uma cidade que visitou. Dizem que a pessoa que encontrou a tornozeleira poderia imitar a mesma dança da espada que a dançarina executava.
raw.th: ก่อนสงครามที่เกิดกับเหล่าเทพเจ้าเล็กน้อย มีนักเต้นนิรนามที่ผู้ทำการแสดงการเต้นที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์ ว่ากันว่านักเต้นนี้เป็นผู้แสดงการรำดาบอย่างชำนาญ กำลังอยู่ในระหว่างการเดินทางเพื่อค้นหาใครบางคน ครั้งหนึ่งนักเต้นผู้นั้นได้ลืมกำไลข้อเท้าในเมืองที่เธอเคยไปเยือน ว่ากันว่าคนที่พบกำไลข้อเท้านี้จะสามารถเลียนแบบการเต้นอย่างเดียวกันกับที่นักเต้นผู้นี้ได้แสดงออกมา
raw.vi: Sớm hơn một chút trước khi cuộc chiến với các vị thần diễn ra, có một vũ công vô danh đã trình diễn một vũ điệu cực kỳ đặc biệt. Tương truyền rằng vũ công này, người đã trình diễn vũ điệu kiếm rất điêu luyện, đang trên đường đi tìm ai đó. Một lần, vũ công đó bỏ quên một trong những chiếc vòng của cô ở một thị trấn cô đã ghé qua. Người ta nói rằng người nhặt được chiếc vòng này có thể bắt chước vũ điệu kiếm mà vũ công đã từng biểu diễn.

id: Aslinya adalah anting normal milik putri bangsawan. Suatu hari ia mati diserang naga. Marah, si pacar memakai anting itu dan mulai membasahi diri dengan darah si naga. Anting menjadi bensin balas dendam si pacar. Pikirannya terfokus untuk membunuh naga, menyulut insting bertarung dalam dirinya.
name: MST_SPHERES_41100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Originally, they were normal earrings that belonged to a noble's daughter. However, one day the young daughter lost her life when she was attacked by a dragon. Enraged, her lover put on her earrings and set off to drench himself in the blood of the dragon. The earrings became the fuel for the lover's revenge. His thoughts focused only on slaying the dragon ignited the fighting instinct within him.

raw.en: Originally, they were normal earrings that belonged to a noble's daughter. However, one day the young daughter lost her life when she was attacked by a dragon. Enraged, her lover put on her earrings and set off to drench himself in the blood of the dragon. The earrings became the fuel for the lover's revenge. His thoughts focused only on slaying the dragon ignited the fighting instinct within him.
raw.es: Originalmente, eran aros normales que pertenecían a la hija de un noble. Sin embargo, un día, la joven perdió su vida tras el ataque de un dragón. Enfurecido, su amante se puso los aros y salió a empaparse con la sangre del dragón. Los dijes se convirtieron en el combustible de la venganza del amante. Sus pensamientos, focalizados en asesinar al dragón, encendieron los instintos de lucha dentro de él.
raw.id: Aslinya adalah anting normal milik putri bangsawan. Suatu hari ia mati diserang naga. Marah, si pacar memakai anting itu dan mulai membasahi diri dengan darah si naga. Anting menjadi bensin balas dendam si pacar. Pikirannya terfokus untuk membunuh naga, menyulut insting bertarung dalam dirinya.
raw.pt: Originalmente, eles eram brincos normais que pertenciam à filha de um nobre. Porém, um dia a jovem filha perdeu sua vida quando foi atacada por um dragão. Enfurecido, seu amante colocou os brincos e partiu para se banhar no sangue do dragão. Os brincos se tornaram o combustível da sua vingança. Seus pensamentos se focaram somente em matar o dragão e incendiaram o instinto de luta nele.
raw.th: แต่ดั้งเดิม พวกมันเป็นต่างหูธรรมดาที่เป็นของบุตรสาวชนชั้นสูง อย่างไรก็ตาม วันหนึ่งเธอได้เสียชีวิตลงเมื่อเธอถูกโจมตีโดยมังกร ด้วยความโกรธแค้น คนรักของเธอได้สวมใส่ต่างหูของเธอเอาไว้และออกเดินทางเพื่อไปอาบเลือดของมังกรตัวนั้น ต่างหูกลายเป็นเชื้อเพลิงสำหรับการแก้แค้นให้แก่คนรักของเขา ความคิดของเขามุ่งเน้นไปยังการสังหารมังกรและจุดประกายสัญชาตญาณการต่อสู้ภายในตัวเขาขึ้นมา
raw.vi: Ban đầu, chúng là những bông hoa tai thông thường thuộc về con gái của một bá tước. Tuy nhiên, một ngày nọ cô gái trẻ đã mất mạng khi bị một con rồng tấn công. Giận dữ, người yêu của cô đã đeo đôi hoa tai của cô và lên đường bắt đầu hành trình tắm mình trong máu của rồng. Đôi hoa tai trở thành động lực trả thù của người yêu. Suy nghĩ của anh chỉ tập trung vào việc giết rồng điều này đã làm bùng cháy bản năng chiến đấu trong anh.

id: Jika meriset legenda pandai besi pengembara asal Kekaisaran Agni, yang ditemukan adalah cerita rakyat tentang bintang jatuh. Dalam mineral yang ditemukannya, ada kristal unik seperti Debu Kosmis dan Intan Kelip, yang bisa ditarik sifatnya. Tidak jelas apakah ini benar-benar pecahan bintang. Tapi memang menambah kekuatan khusus ke zirah yang dibuat.
name: MST_SPHERES_41200_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: If one researches the legend of a traveling blacksmith native to the Agni Empire, one will find nothing but folklore telling of a fallen star. Within the minerals he found, there were unique crystals such as Cosmic Dust and Twinkle Gems, which he could draw their special properties out of. It is still unclear whether or not these were really star fragments, but it is true that they did add special power to the armor they were forged into.

raw.en: If one researches the legend of a traveling blacksmith native to the Agni Empire, one will find nothing but folklore telling of a fallen star. Within the minerals he found, there were unique crystals such as Cosmic Dust and Twinkle Gems, which he could draw their special properties out of. It is still unclear whether or not these were really star fragments, but it is true that they did add special power to the armor they were forged into.
raw.es: Si uno investiga la leyenda de un herrero errante del imperio de Agní, se encontrará con historias folklóricas que hablan de una estrella caída. Entre los minerales que encontró este hombre, había cristales únicos, como Polvo cómico y Gemas titilantes, de los que podía extraer propiedades especiales. Todavía no se sabe si estos eran o no fragmentos de una estrella, pero sí es cierto que agregaban un poder especial a la armadura en la que se engarzaron.
raw.id: Jika meriset legenda pandai besi pengembara asal Kekaisaran Agni, yang ditemukan adalah cerita rakyat tentang bintang jatuh. Dalam mineral yang ditemukannya, ada kristal unik seperti Debu Kosmis dan Intan Kelip, yang bisa ditarik sifatnya. Tidak jelas apakah ini benar-benar pecahan bintang. Tapi memang menambah kekuatan khusus ke zirah yang dibuat.
raw.pt: Se alguém pesquisar a lenda de um ferreiro viajante nativo do Império de Agni, não encontra nada além do conto de uma estrela caída. Dentre os minerais que ele encontrou, estavam cristais únicos como a Poeira Cósmica e as Gemas de Brilho, das quais poderia tirar propriedades especiais. Ainda não se sabe se estes eram realmente fragmentos de estrelas, mas é verdade que elas dão poder à armadura na qual são forjadas.
raw.th: ถ้าใครสักคนได้ทำการวิจัยตำนานการเดินทางของช่างตีเหล็กชาวพื้นเมือง ที่เดินทางไปยังจักรวรรดิแอ็กนี่ ก็จะไม่พบอะไรนอกจากเรื่องเล่าที่พูดเกี่ยวกับดาวตก ภายในเหมืองแร่ที่เขาพบ มีผลึกที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์เช่นฝุ่นผงจักรวาลและอัญมณีประกายแสง ที่เขาสามารถดึงคุณสมบัติพิเศษของพวกมันออกมาได้ มันยังไม่เป็นที่แน่ชัดว่าของเหล่านี้เป็นเศษชิ้นส่วนดวงดาวจริงๆ หรือไม่ แต่สิ้งที่เป็นความจริงคือพวกมันสามารถเพิ่มพลังพิเศษให้กับชุดเกราะที่พวกมันถูกหลอมลงไป
raw.vi: Nếu nghiên cứu truyền thuyết về một thổ dân là thợ rèn ngao du đến Đế chế Agni, người ta sẽ không tìm thấy gì nhưng dân gian lại để về một ngôi sao băng. Trong các khoáng vật ông tìm thấy, có những tinh thể độc đáo như Bụi vũ trụ và Ngọc lấp lánh, mà ông có thể khai thác các đặc tính đặc biệt của chúng. Vẫn không rõ đây có phải những mảnh vỡ thực sự của một ngôi sao hay không, nhưng việc chúng sẽ thêm sức mạnh đặc biệt cho bộ giáp được rèn từ chúng là sự thật.

id: Cerita rakyat turun temurun di Wilayah Agni. Saat orang menjual jiwa ke setan untuk balas dendan, ada suara yang memanggil nama orang itu di malam tak berbulan. Dipandu oleh si suara, ia akan mencapai pedang, Bilah Ratap, yang memotong setajam rasa sakit yang dirasakan si pemegang. Kisah ogre bersimbah darah mengayunkan pedang ini untuk balas dendam telah menakut-nakuti anak-anak.
name: MST_SPHERES_41300_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The following folklore has been passed down in the Agni Region. It is said that when selling one's soul to a demon in order to attain revenge, a voice will call one's name on a moonless night. Guided by the voice, one will reach a sword. This sword is called the Lament Blade, and it is said to cut as sharply as the pain felt by the wielder. The tale of a blood-drenched ogre swinging this sword to get his revenge has left many children trembling violently.

raw.en: The following folklore has been passed down in the Agni Region. It is said that when selling one's soul to a demon in order to attain revenge, a voice will call one's name on a moonless night. Guided by the voice, one will reach a sword. This sword is called the Lament Blade, and it is said to cut as sharply as the pain felt by the wielder. The tale of a blood-drenched ogre swinging this sword to get his revenge has left many children trembling violently.
raw.es: La siguiente historia ha pasado de generación en generación en la región de Agní. Se dice que cuando uno le vende el alma a un demonio para obtener venganza, se oirá una voz que clamará su nombre durante una noche sin luna. Guiado por la voz, el individuo tomará una espada. Esta espada se llama "Espada del lamento", y se dice que es tan filosa como el dolor que siente quien la lleva. La historia de un ogro empapado en sangre y blandiendo esta espada para conseguir su venganza ha dejado a muchos chicos temblando del miedo.
raw.id: Cerita rakyat turun temurun di Wilayah Agni. Saat orang menjual jiwa ke setan untuk balas dendan, ada suara yang memanggil nama orang itu di malam tak berbulan. Dipandu oleh si suara, ia akan mencapai pedang, Bilah Ratap, yang memotong setajam rasa sakit yang dirasakan si pemegang. Kisah ogre bersimbah darah mengayunkan pedang ini untuk balas dendam telah menakut-nakuti anak-anak.
raw.pt: O folclore a seguir era comum na Região de Agni. Dizem que ao vender a alma para um demônio em busca de vingança, uma voz chama o seu nome em uma noite sem lua. Seguindo a voz, encontra-se uma espada. Esta é a Lâmina do Lamento, que dizem cortar de forma tão afiada quanto a dor sentida por aquele que a empunha. O conto de um ogro ensanguentado usando essa espada para obter a vingança causou tremores incessantes a muitas crianças.
raw.th: เรื่องเล่าต่อไปนี้ได้รับการสืบทอดกันมาในดินแดนแอ็กนี่ ว่ากันว่าเมื่อใครสักคนขายวิญญาณให้กับปีศาจเพื่อการล้างแค้น เสียงจะเรียกชื่อของคนนั้นในคืนที่ไร้แสงจันทร์ ซึ่งถูกชักนำโดยเสียงให้คนผู้นั้นจะไปเจอดาบ ดาบนี้ถูกเรียกว่าลาเม้นท์เบลด และว่ากันว่ามันคมเทียบเท่ากับความ เจ็บปวดที่ผู้ถือรู้สึก เรื่องของยักษ์กินคนที่ตัวอาบไปด้วยเลือดขณะกวัดแกว่งดาบนี้เพื่อทำการล้างแค้น ได้ทำให้เด็กหลายคนตัวสั่นด้วยความหวาดกลัว
raw.vi: Truyền thuyết dân gian sau đã được truyền lại ở Khu vực Agni. Tương truyền rằng khi bán linh hồn cho một con quỷ để trả thù, một giọng nói sẽ gọi tên của người đó vào một đêm không trăng. Theo hướng dẫn của giọng nói đó, người này sẽ đi đến chỗ một thanh kiếm. Thanh kiếm này được gọi là Lưỡi kiếm ai oán và nó được cho rằng có nhát chém ngọt đến mức người cầm kiếm cũng cảm nhận được sự đau đớn. Câu chuyện về một yêu tinh người đầy máu đu đưa thanh kiếm để trả thù đã khiến nhiều trẻ em run lên bần bật.

id: Meski Kekaisaran Agni terkenal atas pandai besinya, tetap saja sering kebakaran. Karena itu, perlengkapan sihir yang melindungi pemakainya dari api dibuat untuk menyelamatkan orang yang terjebak dalam bangunan yang terbakar. Ini masalah standar bagi ksatria yang mungkin memakainya saat melawan monster bernapas api.
name: MST_SPHERES_41400_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Though the Agni Empire was known for its many blacksmiths, they were no strangers to fire emergencies. Because of this, a piece of magical equipment which protects its wearer from fire was created to save people who become trapped in burning buildings. It's also thought that it was standard issue for knights, who might have used it when fighting fire breathing monsters.

raw.en: Though the Agni Empire was known for its many blacksmiths, they were no strangers to fire emergencies. Because of this, a piece of magical equipment which protects its wearer from fire was created to save people who become trapped in burning buildings. It's also thought that it was standard issue for knights, who might have used it when fighting fire breathing monsters.
raw.es: Al imperio de Agní se lo conocía por sus herreros, y sus habitantes estaban acostumbrados a las emergencias ígneas. Por esta causa, se creó una armadura mágica que protegía a su portador del fuego con el objetivo de salvar a la gente que quedaba atrapada en las edificaciones que habían sido víctima de las llamas. También se cree que era una pieza común para los caballeros, que pueden haberla usado para luchar contra monstruos de aliento ígneo.
raw.id: Meski Kekaisaran Agni terkenal atas pandai besinya, tetap saja sering kebakaran. Karena itu, perlengkapan sihir yang melindungi pemakainya dari api dibuat untuk menyelamatkan orang yang terjebak dalam bangunan yang terbakar. Ini masalah standar bagi ksatria yang mungkin memakainya saat melawan monster bernapas api.
raw.pt: Embora o Império Agni seja conhecido por seus muitos ferreiros, eles também conheciam emergências de fogo. Por causa disso, uma peça de equipamento mágico que protege seu portador do fogo foi criada para salvar pessoas que ficavam presas em prédios em chamas. Também acredita-se que era um equipamento padrão para cavaleiros, que a usariam quando enfrentavam monstros cuspidores de fogo.
raw.th: แม้ว่าจักรวรรดิแอคนีจะเป็นที่รู้จักเพราะมีช่างตีเหล็กมากมาย พวกเขาก็ต้องพบกับเหตุฉุกเฉินด้วยไฟบ่อยครั้ง ด้วยเหตุนี้ชิ้นส่วนของอุปกรณ์วิเศษที่ปกป้องผู้สวมใส่จากไฟไหม้ ได้ถูกสร้างขึ้นเพื่อช่วยเหลือผู้คนที่ติดอยู่ในบ้านเรือนที่ถูกไฟไหม้ และคิดกันว่ามันเป็นอุปกรณ์มาตรฐานสำหรับอัศวิน ที่อาจจะต้องใช้มันเพื่อต่อสู้มอนสเตอร์ที่พ่นไฟได้
raw.vi: Mặc dù Đế chế Agni nổi tiếng có nhiều thợ rèn, nhưng họ không lạ gì với những tình huống hỏa hoạn khẩn cấp. Do đó, một thiết bị ma thuật bảo vệ người mang nó khỏi hỏa hoạn đã được tạo để cứu những người bị mắc kẹt trong những tòa nhà đang cháy. Người ta cũng cho rằng đó là vấn đề bình thường đối với các hiệp sĩ, những người có thể đã sử dụng nó khi chiến đấu với quái vật thở ra lửa.

id: Perlengkapan sihir yang dibuat oleh penyihir untuk membantunya bertarung selama musim dingin. Khawatir masih kurang, ia menolak memberikannya kepada orang lain, meski katanya kekuatannya melindungi banyak pengelana dari angin dingin di pegunungan bersalju. Banyak contoh pengelana yang diberi ini dalam perang Kerajaan Sama untuk membantu bertahan di air.
name: MST_SPHERES_41401_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A magical piece of equipment made by a magician to help her fight during the harsh cold. Worrying her piece was still lacking, she refused to hand it out to anyone, however it still said that its powers protected many a traveler from the freezing winds high up in the snowy mountains. There are also examples of them being handed out on Sama Kingdom warships to aid in aquatic survival.

raw.en: A magical piece of equipment made by a magician to help her fight during the harsh cold. Worrying her piece was still lacking, she refused to hand it out to anyone, however it still said that its powers protected many a traveler from the freezing winds high up in the snowy mountains. There are also examples of them being handed out on Sama Kingdom warships to aid in aquatic survival.
raw.es: Una armadura mágica creada por una maga para poder luchar durante una gran tormenta de frío. La maga pensaba que su armadura todavía no estaba completa, por lo que se negó a prestársela a alguien. Sin embargo, se comenta que sus poderes protegieron a muchos viajantes de los vientos helados que soplaban en las montañas nevadas. También se sabe que estas armaduras formaron parte de los barcos de guerra del imperio de Sama para ayudar a los marineros a sobrevivir a las expediciones acuáticas.
raw.id: Perlengkapan sihir yang dibuat oleh penyihir untuk membantunya bertarung selama musim dingin. Khawatir masih kurang, ia menolak memberikannya kepada orang lain, meski katanya kekuatannya melindungi banyak pengelana dari angin dingin di pegunungan bersalju. Banyak contoh pengelana yang diberi ini dalam perang Kerajaan Sama untuk membantu bertahan di air.
raw.pt: Uma peça de equipamento mágica feita por uma maga para ajudá-la contra o frio. Preocupada que seu equipamento ainda não estava bom, ela se negou a passá-lo a qualquer um, embora seja dito que seus poderes protegeram muitos viajantes dos ventos congelantes no topo de montanhas geladas. Também há exemplos destas sendo distribuídas nos navios de guerra do Reino de Sama para ajudar na sobrevivência na água.
raw.th: ชิ้นส่วนของอุปกรณ์วิเศษที่ถูกสร้างขึ้นโดยนักเวทย์เพื่อช่วยให้เธอต่อสู้ระหว่างความหนาวที่โหดร้าย ด้วยความกังวลว่าผลงานของเธอนั้นยังไม่ดีพอ เธอจึงปฏิเสธที่จะส่งมันให้กับผู้อื่น อย่างไรก็ตาม ว่ากันว่าพลังของมันนั้นปกป้องนักเดินทางมากมายจากสายลมเยือกแข็งที่อยู่สูงขึ้นไปบนภูเขาหิมะ นอกจากนี้ยังมีตัวอย่างของพวกมันถูกส่งออกไปที่เรือรบของราชอาณาจักรซามะเพื่อช่วยเหลือผู้รอดชีวิตในท้องทะเล
raw.vi: Một thiết bị ma thuật được chế tạo bởi một pháp sư để giúp cô chiến đấu trong cái lạnh khắc nghiệt. Lo lắng thiết bị của cô vẫn chưa hoàn thiện, cô đã từ chối đưa nó cho bất kỳ ai, tuy nhiên người ta vẫn nói rằng sức mạnh của nó đã bảo vệ nhiều khách lữ hành khỏi những cơn gió đóng băng ở những vùng núi tuyết phủ. Cũng có những ví dụ về chúng được truyền trên những tàu chiến ở Vương Quốc Sama để hỗ trợ sống sót dưới nước.

id: Dahulu ada pohon tua di hutan besar di Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha. Pada akhir hidupnya, sisa vitalitasnya ditaruh di batu mulia. Katanya perlengkapan yang dibuat dari batu mulia ("Eylarta") melindungi pemakainya dari serangan bumi, memberinya rasa aman bagai dilindungi si pohon besar itu sendiri.
name: MST_SPHERES_41402_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There was once an old tree in a great forest in the Principality of Vriksha. It's said that at the end of its life, it placed the remainder of its vitality in a precious stone. It is said that equipment made from this precious stone, known as "Eylarta," grants its wearer protection from earth attacks, as well as fills them with a sense of security as if they're being protected by the great tree itself.

raw.en: There was once an old tree in a great forest in the Principality of Vriksha. It's said that at the end of its life, it placed the remainder of its vitality in a precious stone. It is said that equipment made from this precious stone, known as "Eylarta," grants its wearer protection from earth attacks, as well as fills them with a sense of security as if they're being protected by the great tree itself.
raw.es: Antaño existió un antiguo árbol dentro de un bosque en el principado de Vriksha. Se dice que al final de su vida, insufló a una piedra preciosa con el resto de su vitalidad. El equipamiento creado a partir de esta piedra preciosa, conocida como "Eylarta", le otorga a su portador protección contra los ataques térreos, además de brindarles un estímulo de seguridad, como si el mismísimo árbol los estuviera protegiendo.
raw.id: Dahulu ada pohon tua di hutan besar di Kerajaan Kecil Vriksha. Pada akhir hidupnya, sisa vitalitasnya ditaruh di batu mulia. Katanya perlengkapan yang dibuat dari batu mulia ("Eylarta") melindungi pemakainya dari serangan bumi, memberinya rasa aman bagai dilindungi si pohon besar itu sendiri.
raw.pt: Houve outrora uma velha árvore, em uma grande floresta do Principado de Vriksha. Dizem que ao final de sua vida, ela colocou o que restava de sua vitalidade em uma pedra preciosa. Dizem que o equipamento feito com a pedra, conhecida como Eylarta, protegia o portador contra ataques de terra, bem como o preenchia com um senso de segurança como se fosse protegido pela própria grande árvore.
raw.th: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยมีต้นไม้เก่าในป่าใหญ่ ในอาณาเขตของพฤกษา ว่ากันว่าในตอนท้ายของชีวิตมันมันได้ทิ้งสิ่งย้ำเตือนถึงพลังชีวิตของมันในรูปแบบของหินล้ำค่า ว่ากันว่าอุปกรณ์ที่สร้างจากหินมีค่านี้เรียกว่า "อิลอาต้า" ซึ่งมอบการป้องกันการโจมตีจากธาตุดินให้กับผู้สวมใส่ รวมถึงให้ความรู้สึกมั่นคงราวกับพวกเขาถูกคุ้มครองจากต้นไม้ใหญ่
raw.vi: Từng có một cái cây già trong khu rừng vĩ đại của Lãnh Địa Vriksha. Tương truyền rằng vào cuối đời, nó truyền sức sống còn lại của nó vào một viên đá quý. Người ta nói rằng thiết bị đó được tạo từ viên đá quý này, được gọi là "Eylarta", giúp bảo vệ người mặc khỏi các đòn thổ công, cũng như cho họ cảm giác tuyệt đối an toàn như thể họ được bảo vệ bởi chính cái cây vĩ đại.

id: Perlengkapan sihir yang dibuat oleh penemu di Republik Atharva. Meski orang tersambar petir biasanya mati, memakai perlengkapan ini akan mengurangi risiko tersebut. Meski aslinya dibuat untuk mengontrol petir, juga dipuji untuk kemampuannya menahan serangan guntur, dan dipakai dalam perang melawan monster pemegang petir.
name: MST_SPHERES_41403_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A magical piece of equipment created by an inventor in the Atharva Republic. Though people struck by lightning would usually die, wearing this piece of equipment lowers that probability considerably. Though originally created to control lightning, it would be praised for its ability to resist thunder attacks, and was subsequently used in fights against lightning wielding monsters.

raw.en: A magical piece of equipment created by an inventor in the Atharva Republic. Though people struck by lightning would usually die, wearing this piece of equipment lowers that probability considerably. Though originally created to control lightning, it would be praised for its ability to resist thunder attacks, and was subsequently used in fights against lightning wielding monsters.
raw.es: Una armadura mágica creada por un inventor en la república de Atharva. A pesar de que la gente alcanzada por un rayo generalmente muere, al usar esta pieza de armadura, las probabilidad de fallecer disminuyen considerablemente. A pesar de que en un principio se la creó para controlar la electricidad, esta armadura era valiosa por su habilidad para resistir ataques atronadores, y se la usó para luchar contra monstruos que blandían el rayo como arma.
raw.id: Perlengkapan sihir yang dibuat oleh penemu di Republik Atharva. Meski orang tersambar petir biasanya mati, memakai perlengkapan ini akan mengurangi risiko tersebut. Meski aslinya dibuat untuk mengontrol petir, juga dipuji untuk kemampuannya menahan serangan guntur, dan dipakai dalam perang melawan monster pemegang petir.
raw.pt: Uma peça de equipamento mágico criada por um inventor da República de Atharva. Embora pessoas acertadas por trovões geralmente morressem, usar esse tipo de equipamento diminuía consideravelmente essa probabilidade. Apesar de criada para controlar raios, ela era elogiada por sua habilidade de resistir a ataques de trovão, sendo subsequentemente usada em lutas contra monstros elétricos.
raw.th: ชิ้นส่วนของอุปกรณ์วิเศษที่ถูกสร้างขึ้นโดยนักประดิษฐ์ในสาธารณรัฐอธาร์วา แม้ว่าปกติผู้คนที่ถูกสายฟ้าฝ่านั้นจะตายการสวมใส่อุปกรณ์นี้จะช่วยลดโอกาสเสี่ยงอยู่พอสมควร แม้ว่าเดิมทีจะถูกสร้างขึ้นมาเพื่อควบคุมสายฟ้า มันก็ได้รับการยกย่องสำหรับความสามารถในการต้านทานการโจมตีจากสายฟ้า และถูกนำมาใช้ในการต่อสู้กับมอนสเตอร์ผู้ใช้สายฟ้าอย่างต่อเนื่อง
raw.vi: Một thiết bị ma thuật được tạo ra bởi một nhà phát minh tại nước Cộng hòa Atharva. Mặc dù những người bị sét đánh thường sẽ chết, những mặc thiết bị này sẽ giảm khả năng đó đáng kể. Mặc dù ban đầu được tạo ra để kiểm soát sét, nhưng nó được đánh giá cao bởi khả năng chống lại các đòn lôi công và sau đó đã được sử dụng trong chiến đấu chống lại quái vật sử dụng sét.

id: Saat perang dengan dewa dimulai, banyak orang katuh dalam serangan suci pembawa pesan para dewa. Untuk menghentikan hal ini, Republik La Veda, dengan bantuan penyihir yang familier dengan sihir gelap, memproduksi perlengkapan yang melindungi pemakainya dari serangan terang. Meski tidak sempurna, ini membantu mengurangi jumlah kematian para ksatria yang memakainya.
name: MST_SPHERES_41404_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: When the war with the gods began, it is said many people fell to the holy attacks of the gods' messengers. In order to put a stop to this, the La Veda Republic, with the assistance of a magician familiar with dark magic, produced a piece of equipment that protects its wearer from light attacks. Though its efficacy wasn't perfect, it helped to reduce casualties among the knights who wore it.

raw.en: When the war with the gods began, it is said many people fell to the holy attacks of the gods' messengers. In order to put a stop to this, the La Veda Republic, with the assistance of a magician familiar with dark magic, produced a piece of equipment that protects its wearer from light attacks. Though its efficacy wasn't perfect, it helped to reduce casualties among the knights who wore it.
raw.es: Cuando comenzó la guerra contra los dioses, se dice que muchas personas cayeron presa de los ataques sagrados de los mensajeros divinos. Para ponerle fin a esta situación, la república de La Veda, con la ayuda de un familiar mágico que usaba magia oscura, creó una armadura que protegía a los usuarios de los ataques lumínicos. Si bien su eficacia no era perfecta, ayudó a reducir la cantidad de víctimas entre los caballeros de la tropa.
raw.id: Saat perang dengan dewa dimulai, banyak orang katuh dalam serangan suci pembawa pesan para dewa. Untuk menghentikan hal ini, Republik La Veda, dengan bantuan penyihir yang familier dengan sihir gelap, memproduksi perlengkapan yang melindungi pemakainya dari serangan terang. Meski tidak sempurna, ini membantu mengurangi jumlah kematian para ksatria yang memakainya.
raw.pt: Quando a guerra com os deuses começou, dizem que muitas pessoas caíram vítimas dos ataques sagrados dos mensageiros dos deuses. Para impedir isso, a República de La Veda, auxiliada por um mago versado em magia sombria, produziu um equipamento que protege o portador de ataques de luz. Embora sua eficácia não fosse perfeita, ele ajudou a reduzir as baixas entre os cavaleiros que o usavam.
raw.th: เมื่อสงครามกับเทพเจ้าได้เริ่มต้นขึ้น ว่ากันว่าผู้คนมากมายต้องล้มตายด้วยโจมตีจากผู้ส่งสารของเทพเจ้า เพื่อที่จะหยุดยั้งสิ่งนี้ สาธารณรัฐลาวีดาพร้อมกับความช่วยเหลือจอมเวทย์ผู้คุ้นเคยกับมนต์ดำได้ผลิตชิ้นอุปกรณ์ที่สามารถปกป้องผู้สวมใส่จากการโจมตีของแสง แม้ว่าผลของมันจะไม่สมบูรณ์แบบ แต่มันก็ช่วยลดการบาดเจ็บล้มตายในหมู่อัศวินที่สวมใส่มัน
raw.vi: Khi cuộc chiến với các vị thần bắt đầu, tương truyền rằng có nhiều người đã ngã xuống vì cuộc tấn công thần thánh của sứ giả của các vị thần. Để dừng việc này lại, nước Cộng Hòa La Veda, với sự hỗ trợ của một pháp sư thành thạo ma thuật bóng tối, đã tạo ra một thiết bị bảo vệ người mặc khỏi đòn quang công. Mặc dù hiệu quả của nó không được hoàn hảo, nhưng nó giúp giảm thương vong cho các hiệp sĩ mặc nó.

id: Banyak perlengkapan dibuat dengan kekuatan sihir gelap di Kekaisaran Bariura - tempat populer untuk riset sihir gelap. Perlengkapan ini adalah salah satunya, membungkus pemakainya dalam bayangan untuk mengurangi kerusakan akibat serangan gelap. Dianggap sangat berguna di Kekaisaran Bariura, karena sering perang dengan pemegang sihir gelap.
name: MST_SPHERES_41405_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Many pieces of equipment were made with the power of dark magic in the Bariura Empire, where research into dark magic was incredibly popular. This piece of equipment is one of them, wrapping its wearer in shadows to reduce damage taken from dark attacks. It is thought that this is a highly useful piece of equipment in the Bariura Empire, where battles with dark magic wielders is commonplace.

raw.en: Many pieces of equipment were made with the power of dark magic in the Bariura Empire, where research into dark magic was incredibly popular. This piece of equipment is one of them, wrapping its wearer in shadows to reduce damage taken from dark attacks. It is thought that this is a highly useful piece of equipment in the Bariura Empire, where battles with dark magic wielders is commonplace.
raw.es: En el imperio Bariura se crearon muchas armaduras con el poder de la magia oscura en la época durante la cual ese tipo de magia era muy popular. Esta pieza es una de ellas. Envuelve a su portador en las sombras y reduce el daño recibido de los ataques oscuros. Se cree que este artefacto es muy útil en el imperio Bariura, donde las batallas con los usuarios de la magia oscura son moneda corriente.

raw.pt: Muitas peças de equipamento foram feitas com o poder da magia sombria no Império de Bariura, onde a pesquisa deste tipo era incrivelmente popular. Essa peça de equipamento é uma delas, envolvendo seu portador em sombras para reduzir o dano sofrido por ataques sombrios. Acredita-se que esta era uma peça de equipamento muito útil no Império Bariura, onde batalhas com magos sombrios eram comuns.
raw.th: ชิ้นของอุปกรณ์มากมายที่ถูกสร้างขึ้นด้วยอำนาจของมนต์ดำในจักรวรรดิบาลิอุระ ที่ซึ่งการค้นคว้าในมนต์ดำนั้นได้รับความนิยมอย่างไม่น่าเชื่อ ชิ้นของอุปกรณ์นี้เป็นหนึ่งในของเหล่านั้น ใช้ห่อหุ้มผู้สวมใส่ในเงาเพื่อลดความเสียหายที่ได้รับจากการโจมตีของธาตุมืด คิดกันว่าอุปกรณ์ชิ้นนี้มีประโยชน์อย่างมากในจักรวรรดิบาลิอุละ ที่ซึ่งการต่อสู้โดยการใช้มนต์ดำเป็นเรื่องปกติ
raw.vi: Nhiều thiết bị được chế tạo bằng sức mạnh của ma thuật bóng tối trong Đế Chế Bariura, nơi nghiên cứu về ma thuật bóng tối vô cùng phổ biến. Thiết bị này là một trong số đó, bao bọc người mặc nó trong bóng tối để giảm thiệt hại do đòn hắc công gây ra. Người ta nghĩ rằng đây là thiết bị rất hữu ích tại Đế Chế Bariura nơi mà các trận chiến với những người sử dụng ma thuật bóng tối thường xuyên diễn ra.

id: Kalung yang katanya dipunyai oleh orang dari hutan besar di mana roh pelindung diam. Kalung misterius ini menggunakan kekuatan dari makhluk pelindung untuk meningkatkan daya juang dan vitalitas penggunanya. Ada cerita yang berkata seorang prajurit mengenakan kalung ini menjadi sukses di perang sampai tahap terakhir perang melawan para dewa. Tapi, katanya roh pelindung yang tinggal di dalamnya lenyap setelah beberapa lama.
name: MST_SPHERES_41500_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A necklace said to be possessed by the people of the great forest in which a protective spirit dwells. This mysterious necklace uses the power of a protective entity to increase the fighting spirit and vitality of the wearer. Some stories tell of a particular warrior that wore this necklace who was very successful in battle during the last stages of the war with the gods. However, it is said that the protective spirit that lived within it disappeared after some time.

raw.en: A necklace said to be possessed by the people of the great forest in which a protective spirit dwells. This mysterious necklace uses the power of a protective entity to increase the fighting spirit and vitality of the wearer. Some stories tell of a particular warrior that wore this necklace who was very successful in battle during the last stages of the war with the gods. However, it is said that the protective spirit that lived within it disappeared after some time.
raw.es: Se dice que este colgante está poseído por la gente del gran bosque donde habita un espíritu protector. Este misterioso collar usa el poder de una entidad protectora para elevar el espíritu de lucha y la vitalidad del portador. Algunas historias hablan de un guerrero particular que usó este colgante y que tuvo muchísimo éxito en la batalla durante las últimas etapas de la guerra contra los dioses. Sin embargo, se dice que el espíritu protector que vivía dentro de él desapareció hace tiempo.

raw.pt: Um colar que dizem ter pertencido ao povo da grande floresta onde vive um espírito protetor. Este colar misterioso usa o poder de uma entidade protetora para aumentar o espírito de luta e a vitalidade do usuário. Algumas histórias falam de um herói específico que usou este colar e que foi muito eficiente em batalhas durante as últimas partes da guerra contra os deuses. No entanto, dizem que o espírito protetor que vivia dentro dele desapareceu depois de um tempo.
raw.th: สร้อยที่ว่ากันว่าถูกครอบครองโดยผู้คนแห่งป่าใหญ่ ที่ซึ่งจิตวิญญาณการปกป้องอาศัยอยู่ สร้อยคอลึกลับนี้ใช้พลังของการป้องกันเพื่อเพิ่มจิตวิญญาณของการต่อสู้และพลังชีวิตของผู้สวมใส่ มีบางเรื่องบอกเกี่ยวกับนักรบคนหนึ่งที่สวมใส่สร้อยนี้ที่ประสบความสำเร็จในการต่อสู้ในช่วงสุดท้ายของสงครามกับเทพเจ้า อย่างไรก็ตามว่ากันว่าจิตวิญญาณปกป้องที่อาศัยอยู่ข้างในมัน ได้หายไปหลังจากชั่วระยะเวลาหนึ่ง
raw.vi: Một chiếc vòng cổ được cho là thuộc sở hữu của những người ở trong khu rừng lớn, nơi ngự trị linh hồn bảo vệ. Chiếc vòng cổ bí ẩn này sử dụng sức mạnh của vật bảo vệ để gia tăng tinh thần chiến đấu và sinh lực của người đeo nó. Vài câu chuyện kể về một chiến binh đặc biệt đeo chiếc vòng cổ này, người đã rất thành công trong trận đánh vào cuối cuộc chiến tranh với các vị thần. Tuy nhiên, người ta nói rằng linh hồn bảo vệ sống bên trong nó đã biến mất một thời gian sau.

id: Pedang bintang dari gladiator yang berdiri melawan pemerintahan keji dari seorang  kaisar. Pedang ini asalnya adalah milik sang kaisar sendiri, tapi gladiator itu akhirnya menerimanya dari istri kaisar sebagai bukti cinta padanya. Karena sang kaisar adalah keluarga dari permaisuri yang dicintainya, dia ragu-ragu untuk membunuhnya. Tapi, dia akhirnya menggunakan pedang ini melawan sang kaisar yang dulunya dia bantu itu dengan memimpin pemberontakan.
name: MST_SPHERES_41600_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: The stellar blade of the gladiator who stood against the despotic rule of an emperor. This blade originally belonged to the emperor himself, but the gladiator ended up receiving this from the empress as a token of her love for him. Since the emperor was kin of his beloved empress, the gladiator hesitated to strike him down. However, he ultimately wielded his sword against the emperor he had helped bring to power by leading an uprising.

raw.en: The stellar blade of the gladiator who stood against the despotic rule of an emperor. This blade originally belonged to the emperor himself, but the gladiator ended up receiving this from the empress as a token of her love for him. Since the emperor was kin of his beloved empress, the gladiator hesitated to strike him down. However, he ultimately wielded his sword against the emperor he had helped bring to power by leading an uprising.
raw.es: La hoja estelar del gladiador que le plantó cara al gobierno déspota de su emperador. Esta espada originalmente pertenecía al mismísimo emperador, pero el gladiador terminó recibiéndola de parte de la emperatriz como muestra de su amor hacia él. Dado que el emperador era familiar de su amada emperatriz, el gladiador dudó antes de asestarle un golpe mortal. Sin embargo, finalmente blandió la espada contra el emperador que había llevado al poder mediante una revuelta.

raw.pt: A lâmina estelar do gladiador que se rebelou contra o governo déspota de um imperador. Esta lâmina originalmente pertenceu ao próprio imperador, mas o gladiador acabou recebendo da imperatriz como símbolo do seu amor por ele. Já que o imperador era parente de sua amada imperatriz, o gladiador hesitou em atacá-lo. Mas no final ele empunhou sua espada contra o imperador que tinha ajudado a subir ao trono liderando uma rebelião.
raw.th: ดาบสตาร์ลี่ของกลาดิเอเตอร์ผู้ยืนหยัดต่อต้านการปกครองเผด็จการของจักรพรรดิ เดิมทีดาบนี้เป็นของจักรพรรดิเอง แต่กลาดิเอเตอร์ก็ได้รับสิ่งนี้จากจักรพรรดินีเพื่อเป็นสัญลักษณ์ที่เธอมีต่อเขา และเมื่อจักรดิพรรดิเป็นพี่น้องของจักรพรรดินีที่เขารัก นักสู้จึงลังเลที่จะสังหารเขาทิ้ง แต่ในที่สุดเขาก็ใช้ดาบนี้ต่อต้านจักรพรรดิ ผู้ที่เขาเคยช่วยนำมาสู่อำนาจ โดยเป็นผู้นำการปฏิวัติ
raw.vi: Lưỡi kiếm hình ngôi sao của đấu sĩ đã đứng lên chống lại sự cai trị độc đoán của một hoàng đế. Lưỡi kiếm này ban đầu thuộc về vị hoàng đế đó, nhưng cuối cùng đấu sĩ kia đã nhận được nó từ hoàng hậu như một dấu hiệu của tình yêu bà dành cho anh ta. Bởi vị hoàng đế đó là người thân của nữ hoàng yêu quý của anh, đấu sĩ đó đã ngần ngại khi hạ gục hoàng đế nọ. Tuy nhiên, cuối cùng anh đã cầm thanh kiếm của mình chống lại hoàng đế mà anh đã giúp đỡ mang lại quyền lực bằng cách cầm đầu một cuộc nổi dậy.

id: Anting yang katanya memberi kekuatan dan keberanian luar biasa kepada penggunanya. Katanya adalah milik seorang pahlawan yang mengalahkan wyvern hitam besar dan terus membuat kekaisaran kuat dengan menyatukan berbagai orang nomaden. Tapi, apakah kekuatan untuk melakukan hal ini datang dari anting ini, atau apakah pahlawan itu yang memberi kekuatan pada anting ini, masih merupakan perdebatan yang besar.
name: MST_SPHERES_41700_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: These earrings are said to bring great power and courage to the wearer. They are said to have belonged to a hero who defeated a great black wyvern and then proceeded to build a strong empire by unifying various nomadic peoples. However, whether the power to do this came from the earrings, or whether the hero endowed the earrings with his own power instead, is still cause of great debate.

raw.en: These earrings are said to bring great power and courage to the wearer. They are said to have belonged to a hero who defeated a great black wyvern and then proceeded to build a strong empire by unifying various nomadic peoples. However, whether the power to do this came from the earrings, or whether the hero endowed the earrings with his own power instead, is still cause of great debate.
raw.es: Se dice que estos aros le dan poder y valor al portador. Según se cuenta, pertenecieron a un héroe que derrotó a un gran güiverno negro y que luego construyó un poderoso imperio unificando varios pueblos nómadas. Sin embargo, si el poder para realizar esta hazaña vino de los aros o si el héroe insufló a las joyas con su propio poder, todavía es causa de gran debate.
raw.id: Anting yang katanya memberi kekuatan dan keberanian luar biasa kepada penggunanya. Katanya adalah milik seorang pahlawan yang mengalahkan wyvern hitam besar dan terus membuat kekaisaran kuat dengan menyatukan berbagai orang nomaden. Tapi, apakah kekuatan untuk melakukan hal ini datang dari anting ini, atau apakah pahlawan itu yang memberi kekuatan pada anting ini, masih merupakan perdebatan yang besar.
raw.pt: Dizem que estes brincos concedem grande coragem e poder ao usuário. Dizem que eles pertenciam a um herói que derrotou um grande dragonete negro e depois construiu um potente império unificando diversos povos nômades. Mas ainda há muito debate sobre o fato do poder de fazer isso ter vindo dos brincos ou se o herói injetou seu próprio poder neles.
raw.th: ต่างหูที่เชื่อว่าจะนำพลังที่ยิ่งใหญ่และความกล้าหาญให้กับผู้สวมใส่ ว่ากันว่ามันเป็นของผู้กล้าที่กำจัด ไวเวิร์นสีดำขนาดใหญ่ และจากนั้นก็ได้สร้างจักรวรรดิที่แข็งแกร่งโดยการรวบรวมคนเร่ร่อนจากเผ่าต่างๆ อย่างไรก็ตามไม่ว่าพลังที่ทำเรื่องนี้จะมาจากต่างหู หรือว่าผู้กล้านั้นจะมอบพลังของเขาให้กับต่างหูเอง มันยังเป็นเรื่องที่ถกเถียงกันอยู่
raw.vi: Những hoa tai này được cho là sẽ mang lại sức mạnh và lòng can đảm tuyệt vời cho người đeo chúng. Được cho là thuộc về vị anh hùng đã đánh bại một con hắc long to lớn và sau đó tiếp tục xây dựng một đế chế hùng mạnh bằng cách thống nhất các tộc du mục khác. Tuy nhiên, cho dù sức mạnh để làm điều này đến từ những hoa tai đó, hay vị anh hùng có được trời phú cho hoa tai với sức mạnh của mình thay thế hay không, mọi thứ vẫn còn gây nhiều tranh luận nảy lửa.

id: Prototipe untuk peralatan yang dibuat oleh Kekaisaran Bariura dalam masa akhir perang besar dengan para dewa. Meskipun tidak punya kemampuan pertahanan, alat ini bisa membalikkan serangan yang diterima oleh penggunanya. Kristal ini dibuat dengan tujuan untuk dipakai oleh prajurit yang tidak berpengalaman, yang lalu akan menjadikannya serangan balik kepada Pasukan Dewa. Tapi, banyak yang mengatakan penggunaannya tidak manusiawi, dan pembuatan kristal ini dihentikan setelah hanya beberapa prototipe dibuat.
name: MST_SPHERES_41800_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A prototype meant for equipment made by the Bariura Empire during the last stages of the great war with the gods. Though it has no capabilities for defense, it does have the ability to recoil attacks suffered by the wearer. This crystal was manufactured with the intention of having inexperienced soldiers equip it, who would then serve as physical counters for attacks suffered from the God Army. However, many denounced this intended practice as inhumane, and production of this crystal was halted after a few prototypes were made.

raw.en: A prototype meant for equipment made by the Bariura Empire during the last stages of the great war with the gods. Though it has no capabilities for defense, it does have the ability to recoil attacks suffered by the wearer. This crystal was manufactured with the intention of having inexperienced soldiers equip it, who would then serve as physical counters for attacks suffered from the God Army. However, many denounced this intended practice as inhumane, and production of this crystal was halted after a few prototypes were made.
raw.es: Un prototipo diseñado para los equipos del imperio Bariura, elaborado durante las últimas etapas de la gran guerra con los dioses. Si bien no tiene propiedades defensivas, sí tiene la capacidad de devolver los ataques sufridos por su portador. El cristal se creó con la intención de incorporarlo al equipo de los soldados más inexpertos, que a su vez se usarían como escudo humano contra los ataques del ejército divino. Dada la cantidad de denuncias que condenaban la crueldad de esta práctica, la producción del cristal se interrumpió después unos pocos prototipos.
raw.id: Prototipe untuk peralatan yang dibuat oleh Kekaisaran Bariura dalam masa akhir perang besar dengan para dewa. Meskipun tidak punya kemampuan pertahanan, alat ini bisa membalikkan serangan yang diterima oleh penggunanya. Kristal ini dibuat dengan tujuan untuk dipakai oleh prajurit yang tidak berpengalaman, yang lalu akan menjadikannya serangan balik kepada Pasukan Dewa. Tapi, banyak yang mengatakan penggunaannya tidak manusiawi, dan pembuatan kristal ini dihentikan setelah hanya beberapa prototipe dibuat.
raw.pt: Um protótipo feito para equipamentos fabricados pelo Império de Bariura durante as últimas partes da guerra contra os deuses. Embora não tenha capacidades defensivas, ele tem a habilidade de refletir ataques sofridos pelo usuário. Este cristal foi fabricado com a intenção de ser dado a soldados inexperientes que, por sua vez, serviriam como contra-ataques físicos aos ataques do exército dos deuses. No entanto, muitos consideravam essa prática desumana, e a produção do cristal foi interrompida após a fabricação de alguns protótipos.
raw.th: ต้นแบบสำหรับการสวมใส่นี้สร้างโดยจักรพรรดิบาริอูร่า ระหว่างการต่อสู้ด่านสุดท้ายในสงครามอันยิ่งใหญ่กับทวยเทพ ถึงแม้มันจะป้องกันไม่ได้ แต่ช่วยลดความบาดเจ็บของผู้ใส่ได้ คริสตัลนี้สร้างจากทหารที่ใส่มันโดยไม่รู้ และถูกโจมตีจากทหารเทพ อย่างไรก็ตาม มีการประณามว่าการฝึกนี้ไร้มนุษยธรรม และกระบวนการผลิตคริสตัลนี้ได้หยุดชะงักไปหลังจากทำออกมาได้จำนวนหนึ่ง
raw.vi: Một mẫu vật dành cho thiết bị được tạo ra bởi Đế Chế Bariura trong suốt giai đoạn cuối cùng của đại chiến với các vị thần. Mặc dù không có thể phòng thủ, nó vẫn có khả năng dội lại các cú tấn công người mặc phải chịu. Viên pha lê này được chế tạo nhằm giúp trang bị cho quân lính thiếu kinh nghiệm, những người này sau đó sẽ làm quân cản địa cho các cuộc tấn công của Đội quân các vị thần. Tuy nhiên, nhiều người tố cáo hành động này là vô nhân đạo và việc sản xuất viên pha lê này đã bị dừng sau khi vài nguyên mẫu được chế tạo.

id: Helm yang katanya dibuat dari komet kuno. Konon helm ini punya kekuatan misterius yang bisa mengembalikan waktu ketika penggunanya diserang, membuatnya seperti serangan itu tidak pernah terjadi. Menurut riset kontemporer, keakuratan kekuatan ini dipertanyakan. Tapi, banyak legenda yang menceritakan berbagai pahlawan yang menggunakan helm ini luput dari kematian karenanya.
name: MST_SPHERES_41900_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: A helmet said to have been forged from an ancient comet. It is said that this helmet has a mysterious power which allows it to turn back time when the wearer is attacked, making it seem like the assault never happened. According to contemporary research, the veracity of this ability is disputed. However, many legends tell of numerous heroes who wore this helmet and escaped death thanks to it.

raw.en: A helmet said to have been forged from an ancient comet. It is said that this helmet has a mysterious power which allows it to turn back time when the wearer is attacked, making it seem like the assault never happened. According to contemporary research, the veracity of this ability is disputed. However, many legends tell of numerous heroes who wore this helmet and escaped death thanks to it.
raw.es: Se dice que este yelmo supuestamente está creado a partir de un antiguo cometa. Está dotado de un misterioso poder que le permite volver el tiempo atrás cuando su portador recibe un ataque, anulando así su efecto. Según estudios contemporáneos, la veracidad de esta propiedad no es certera. No obstante, muchas leyendas hablan de héroes que usaron el yelmo y, gracias a él, lograron escapar de la muerte.

raw.pt: Um capacete que dizem ter sido forjado a partir de um cometa antigo. Dizem que esse capacete tem um poder misterioso que permite que ele inverta o tempo quando o usuário é atacado, fazendo parecer que o ataque não tenha acontecido. De acordo com pesquisas contemporâneas, a veracidade dessa habilidade é muito discutida. Mas muitas lendas falam de vários heróis que usaram esse capacete e escaparam da morte graças a ele.
raw.th: หมวกเกราะที่หลอมจากดาวหางโบราณ ว่ากันว่าหมวกใบนี้มีพลังลึกลับในการย้อนเวลาไปก่อนที่ผู้ใส่จะถุกโจมตี แปลว่าการโจมตีจะไม่เคยเกิดขึ้น จากผลวิจัยล่าสุดบอกว่า ความจริงเรื่องคุณสมบัติพิเศษนี้ดูวกวน อย่างไรก็ตาม มีหลายตำนานกล่าวว่ามีวีรบุรุษมากมายที่ใส่หมวกนี้แล้วรอดตายมากมาย ได้กล่าวขอบคุณต่อหมวกใบนี้
raw.vi: Một chiếc mũ cho là đã được rèn từ một sao chổi cổ đại. Người ta nói rằng chiếc mũ này có sức mạnh bí ẩn cho phép nó quay ngược thời gian khi người đội mũ bị tấn công, khiến cho các cuộc tấn công dường như không bao giờ xảy ra. Theo nghiên cứu đương đại, tính xác thực của năng lực này vẫn đang được tranh cãi. Tuy nhiên, truyền thuyết kể về rất nhiều vị anh hùng đã đội chiếc mũ này và thoát chết nhờ nó.

id: Ada seorang alkemis yang bernama Rigness yang membuat sepotong kaca yang bisa melindungi manusia dari berbagai bencana. Setelah kematiannya, penyihir yang menemukannya mencoba untuk membuatnya lebih kuat. Kemungkinan relik ini hilang sangat nyata, tapi dia tetap memperbaruinya tanpa ragu. Sangat disayangkan nama penyihir ini tidak masuk ke buku cerita mana pun.
name: MST_SPHERES_42000_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: Once there was an alchemist by the name Rigness who produced a piece of glass that could protect people against all sorts of disasters. After his death, the sorceress who found it try to make it even stronger. The possibility of losing this precious relic was very real, but she proceeded to refine it without hesitation anyway. The fact that the name of this heroine did not make the story books is an unfortunate thing indeed.

raw.en: Once there was an alchemist by the name Rigness who produced a piece of glass that could protect people against all sorts of disasters. After his death, the sorceress who found it try to make it even stronger. The possibility of losing this precious relic was very real, but she proceeded to refine it without hesitation anyway. The fact that the name of this heroine did not make the story books is an unfortunate thing indeed.
raw.es: Una vez existió un alquimista llamado Rigness que creó un fragmento de vidrio capaz de proteger a las personas contra todo tipo de desastres. Después de su muerte, la hechicera que encontró el fragmento trató de hacerlo aún más fuerte. La posibilidad de perder para siempre la preciada reliquia era muy real, pero ella siguió con su trabajo de refinamiento sin pensarlo dos veces. Es una verdadera pena que el nombre de esta heroína no haya llegado a los libros de historia.

Setelah kematiannya, penyihir yang menemukannya mencoba untuk membuatnya lebih kuat. Kemungkinan relik ini hilang sangat nyata, tapi dia tetap memperbaruinya tanpa ragu. raw.pt: Houve um alquimista chamado Rigness que produziu um fragmento de vidro que podia proteger as pessoas de todos os tipos de desastre. Depois de sua morte, o feiticeiro que o encontrou tentou torná-lo ainda mais forte. A possibilidade de perder essa relíquia preciosa era muito real, mas ele continuou a refiná-la sem hesitar. O fato do nome dessa heroína não ter ido parar nos livros de história é infeliz mesmo.
raw.th: เมื่อครั้งที่มีนักเล่นแร่แปรธาตุชื่อริกเนส ได้สร้างแก้วที่ช่วยป้องกันภัยพิบัติให้กับผู้คน เมื่อเขาเสียชีวิตลง ได้มีจอมเวทย์ที่เจอมันและพยายามจะทำให้มันแข็งแกร่งขึ้น แม้จะมีความเป็นไปได้ที่สิ่งล้ำค่านี้จะสุญหายไป แต่เธอก็ตัดสินใจทำโดยไม่ลังเล ความจริงเรื่องชื่อของอิสตรีผู้นี้ไม่ได้ทำให้เรื่องนี้กลายเป็นเรื่องโชคร้ายเลย
raw.vi: Ngày xưa, có một nhà giả kim mang tên Rigness đã chế tạo một mảnh thủy tinh có thể bảo vệ con người chống lại tất cả các loại thiên tai. Sau khi ông chết, một nữ phù thủy đã tìm thấy nó và cố gắng làm cho nó thậm chí còn mạnh hơn. Khả năng đánh mất di vật quý giá này là có thật nhưng bà ta tiếp tục tinh luyện nó mà chẳng hề do dự. Thực vậy, thông tin rằng tên của vị nữ anh hùng này đã không tạo nên quyển truyện mới là điều không may.

id: Ada tanah kosong yang disebut Ifrikya. Dikenal dalam sejarah sebagai tanah tandus dalam legenda sebagai sarang setan yang juga ditakuti para dewa sendiri. Katanya manusia ini yang membenci murka setan hanya diperburuk oleh efek Bijih Sejati yang ada di bawah tanah sarangnya.
name: MST_SPHERES_42100_LONGDESCRIPTION
desc: There is a wasteland called Ifrikya. This land that has been known throughout history as a barren wasteland has been mentioned in legends as the den of a demon feared by even the gods themselves. It is said that this human hating demon's anger is only exacerbated by the effects of the True Ore that lay underground its nest.

raw.en: There is a wasteland called Ifrikya. This land that has been known throughout history as a barren wasteland has been mentioned in legends as the den of a demon feared by even the gods themselves. It is said that this human hating demon's anger is only exacerbated by the effects of the True Ore that lay underground its nest.
raw.es: Existe un páramo denominado Ifrikya. Las leyendas cuentan que en esta tierra, que siempre se conoció como un páramo yermo, habita un demonio temido por los mismísimos dioses. Se dice que lo único que exacerba ira de este demonio, enemigo jurado de los humanos, son los efectos de la veracita que yace bajo su nido.
raw.id: Ada tanah kosong yang disebut Ifrikya. Dikenal dalam sejarah sebagai tanah tandus dalam legenda sebagai sarang setan yang juga ditakuti para dewa sendiri. Katanya manusia ini yang membenci murka setan hanya diperburuk oleh efek Bijih Sejati yang ada di bawah tanah sarangnya.
raw.pt: Há uma terra desolada chamada Ifrikya. Essa terra, que ficou conhecida pela história como uma desolação, foi mencionada como refúgio de um demônio temido até pelos próprios deuses. Dizem que o ódio contra humanos desse demônio só é exacerbado pelos efeitos do minério verdadeiro que fica abauxo de seu ninho.
raw.th: มีดินแดนที่ไม่ได้ทำประโยชน์อันใดชื่อ อิลฟริคย่า สถานที่นี้ตามประวัติศาสตร์นั้นว่ากันว่าเป็นที่ที่ไม่มีพืชผลใดๆ และกลายเป็นถ้ำของเหล่าปีศาจที่เกรงกลัวเทพ ว่ากันว่าความโกรธของมนุษย์ที่มีต่อพวกปีศาจยิ่งทำให้สถานการ์แย่ลงเพราะผลจากแร่ของแท้ที่อยู่ใต้ถ้ำของพวกมัน
raw.vi: Có một khu đất hoang được gọi là Ifrikya. Mảnh đất này đã được biết đến trong lịch sử như một khu đất hoang cằn cỗi được đề cập trong các truyền thuyết là hang ổ của một con quỷ đáng sợ thậm chí là cả với các vị thần. Người ta nói rằng sự giận dữ của con quỷ thù ghét loài người này chỉ làm xấu thêm ảnh hưởng của Quặng Thật ngầm dưới hang ổ của nó.
